name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event held in Gliwice, combining sport, a friendly atmosphere and time among the city’s green spaces. The run is open to both experienced runners and people who want to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and participants can look forward to a welcoming atmosphere and an active way to wrap up February. The event is a great opportunity to start a new month with energy and in a good mood.
course_highlights: Start in the clearing behind Piast Stadium (entrance from Leśna Street)
The route passes through the city’s green spaces
The event combines sport, a friendly atmosphere and recreation
additional: The event office is open from 9:00. To be included in the results, advance registration and an entry fee are required. The event takes place on the last day of February, making it a great way to end the month actively. trail run, online registration, start and finish in the clearing behind Piast Stadium

name: Jesienny Ultra Świr
description: Jesienny Ultra Świr is a mountain ultramarathon held in Grybów, offering a challenge for fans of long-distance running in natural terrain. The course runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with minimal asphalt, providing an authentic trail-running experience. The event offers different competition formats, including timed races and Nordic Walking, catering to various levels of experience. It is organised by experienced enthusiasts who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and participants’ safety.
course_highlights: 98% of the course runs along forest and gravel paths
Minimal asphalt: just 2%
Start and finish at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa
additional: The start, finish and race office are at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa. On race day, the race office is open from 06:45 to 07:30 for the 6/12/24-hour distances and until 09:30 for Nordic Walking and the one-lap race. In the 6-hour and 12-hour races, the winner is the participant who completes the greatest number of full 17 km laps. Running is prohibited during the Nordic Walking event, and judges on the course monitor proper technique. Participants must check in at the race office with an identity document and have the mandatory equipment. The event is part of the Jesienny Ultra Świr series, which includes various distances and activity formats, with online registration. The course may be changed due to weather conditions.

name: XXIII Maraton Komandosa
description: The XXIII Commandos Marathon is a challenging 42.195 km marathon held in Lubliniec. The race takes place on 28 November 2026 and is organized by the Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec. The course has recently changed and is available online. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and full technical support for the event.
course_highlights: New course available online
Marathon distance: 42.195 km
Organizer: Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec
additional: The race office is open on 28 November from 15:00 to 20:30 and on 29 November from 07:00 to 08:40. The entry fee can be paid only through an individual link to tpay.com online quick payments, sent by email. The participant limit has been reached and registration is suspended. New course; participant limit reached; urban and forest terrain; electronic timekeeping

name: Bieg po Ciacho 2026
description: Bieg po Ciacho is an autumn running event in Puszczykowo and the third and final race of the Puszczykowo running series. The 10 km main race runs through the scenic surroundings of Puszczykowo and along forest paths of Wielkopolska National Park. Shorter children's races are also planned, which makes the event a family-friendly end to the running season.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
Route along forest paths of Wielkopolska National Park
Final of the Puszczykowo running series
additional: Start and finish at the sports and recreation grounds at ul. Kościelna 13 in Puszczykowo, start at 10:30. Registration is handled by the organiser via biegiwlkp.pl.

name: 45 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a walking orienteering event in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on a map. The event is open to participants of different ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts and recreational participants to families. Rogaining combines tourism and sport, and participants can modify their route at any time during the competition, making it an appealing way to enjoy the outdoors. The event is organised by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin District Branch, which has been holding orienteering competitions in the region for many years.
course_highlights: Teams travel on foot only, using a map and compass to navigate the terrain
Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find
Participants can choose and change their own route, at any length from 5 to 70 km
additional: The competition is open to all age groups and genders. Teams consist of 2–5 people. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is suitable for both experienced competitors and families. Routes can be changed during the competition. In 2026, four rogaining events are planned around Strzelin, including the 45th edition in November. The events offer distances from 5 km to 70 km and use maps and compasses. They cater to different experience levels and offer both recreational and competitive participation.

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka is a 5 km race held in Lublin on 29 November 2026. The event is part of a series of races organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which promotes physical activity and the integration of the local community. The race is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness and enjoy the city’s sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the city
Training support for 8 to 20 weeks
Organized by a local sports foundation
additional: The race is part of local sporting events and includes various distances and age categories, as well as the Lublin Grand Prix classifications.

name: 9 Żorski Półmaraton Leśny
description: The Żory Forest Half Marathon is a run along forest trails around Żory, starting and finishing at the Twinpigs American Amusement Park at 24 Katowicka Street. There are three distances to choose from: a half marathon of approximately 21 km, a medium-distance run of approximately 11 km, and a short run of approximately 5 km. The 9th edition will take place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, at 12:00. It is organised by the Zarazić Pasją Association, with Twinpigs Park as co-organiser.
course_highlights: Forest trails, with the start and finish at Twinpigs
Three distances: approximately 21, 11 and 5 km
Participants may run with a dog on a leash
additional: The race office will be open at Twinpigs on November 28 from 16:00 to 18:00 and on November 29 from 8:00 to 11:00. Time limits: 21 km — 2 hours 20 minutes; 11 km — 1 hour 30 minutes; 5 km — 60 minutes. Participants with dogs start last, and only adults may enter the half marathon.

name: IV Charytatywna Mila Mikołajkowa
description: Charytatywna Mila Mikołajkowa z TAURONEM is a one-mile (1609 m) charity race run entirely on the athletics track of the Superauto.pl Silesian Stadium in Chorzów. It takes place in winter around St Nicholas Day, and runners start wearing Santa hats. Proceeds go to charity. The 4th edition is on 29 November 2026.
course_highlights: One mile (1609 m) on the Silesian Stadium track
Runners start in Santa hats
Mila Mikołajkowa Mini kids' races over 100, 200 and 400 m
additional: The race office and bag drop open at 08:00 on race day (packets until 12:00), entrance through Gate 1. Kids' races start at 09:30 and the main mile heats at 10:00, 10:15, 10:30 and 10:55 (company classification). Entry: 69 PLN for the main race, 29 PLN for kids' races; a limited number of extra packets cost 89 and 49 PLN. Stepping onto the pitch is strictly forbidden and leads to disqualification.

name: XIX Grand Prix Tychów w Biegach Długodystansowych
location: Kompleks Sportowy Paprocany, ul. Sikorskiego 110, Tychy, Poland
organizer: MOSiR Tychy i Stowarzyszenie Promocji Lekkiej Atletyki w Tychach

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa - płatna w dniu imprezy wynosi 30 zł

description: The 19th Grand Prix of Tychy is a series of long-distance races organized by the Association for the Promotion of Athletics in Tychy. The races take place at the Paprocany Sports Complex and include six races in the 2026 season, with different distances for women and men. The event promotes an active and healthy lifestyle and attracts runners of varying experience levels. The entry fee is nominal, and separate classifications are held for the 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: Long-distance races over 5 km and 10 km
Routes through the Paprocany Sports Complex in Tychy
A series of six races spread across the 2026 season
additional: Separate classifications are held for women and men over the 5 km and 10 km distances. The entry fee for an individual race is payable on the event day, while the fee for the full series of six races is payable before the first race. The season includes six races held between February and December 2026. The start is scheduled for 10:00; the race office accepts entries from 9:00 to 9:45. Online registration is available. Participants in the overall classification must stay with their chosen distance.

name: VI Biegowe Grand Prix Krainy Dobrej Energii
price_range: 40 zł za bieg; 160 zł za pakiet pięciu biegów lub 190 zł z koszulką; biegi juniorskie bezpłatne
description: Biegowe Grand Prix Krainy Dobrej Energii is a series of five cross-country races around the lake in Jezierzany, organised by the Fundacja Edukacji i Rozwoju foundation. The main race for adults and youths is about 4.5 km, three laps of the lake. The first race of the 2026/2027 series is on 29 November 2026 at 12:00, and the grand final is on 14 March 2027. There is also a free Junior Grand Prix over shorter distances.
course_highlights: Three laps of the lake, about 4.5 km
Free junior races over 500, 900 and 1500 m
Best four results of five count in the standings
additional: The other races in the series are on 13 December 2026, 10 January, 21 February and 14 March 2027. The main race is capped at 100 runners. Registration is once for the whole series, online through Euforia Biegacza or at the race office on race day 10:00-11:00. Runners keep the same bib all series, get electronic timing and a hot meal after every race, and the best receive cash prizes and vouchers.

name: X Bieg Olszynki Grochowskiej
description: The 10th Olszynka Grochowska Run is an annual road race held in Warsaw, in the scenic Olszynka Grochowska area. Runners can choose between two distances: 5.2 km and 10.4 km, which pass through charming green spaces and urban paths. The event attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, offering friendly competition in a welcoming atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of Warsaw’s nature in autumn.
course_highlights: The route passes through Olszynka Grochowska, the green lungs of Warsaw
Two distances available: 5.2 km and 10.4 km
The race takes place in a scenic autumn setting

name: Maraton Porannych Pokręconych Jesiennych
location: Miłoszyce, Jelcz-Laskowice, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners of all abilities. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete throughout the Grand Prix series. Registration is available only at the Race Office on race day, and participation is free.
course_highlights: 10 km race in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice
A series of seasonal events promoting a healthy lifestyle
A running community and opportunities to connect with the local community
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in the Grand Prix races is free. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. It focuses on promoting physical activity, health, and the running community, with varied courses and seasonal editions.

name: Bunt Mikołajów
description: Bunt Mikołajów is a Santa-themed 5 km run in Niepołomice, with its 6th edition on 5 December 2026 at 16:30. Start and finish are at the Royal Castle, and the route follows city streets over asphalt, concrete and cobblestones. Runners wear Santa outfits, this year green elf outfits. Online registration runs until 3 December 2026 or until the 999-place limit is reached.
course_highlights: City route over asphalt, concrete and cobblestones
Start and finish at the Royal Castle
50 minute time limit
additional: The race office is at the Royal Castle, ul. Zamkowa 2, from 14:00 to 16:15. Every registered runner gets a chip bib, a medal, a mug and refreshments.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL — Wrocław
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury, Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego oraz Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland setting of Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can track their results on the same course. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and participants can compete in both local and series-wide classifications. The start and finish are near the sports field in Osobowicki Forest, and the races take place in the morning.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the woodland setting of Osobowicki Forest
Start and finish located by the sports field in Osobowicki Forest
A cross-country course suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race bibs and timing chips are collected on race day. There is no participant limit. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. Parking is available along Osobowicka Street, following directions from traffic staff. Participants must obey traffic regulations. As part of a season pass, participants may take one free start in another city in the series after notifying the organizers by email in advance. Online registration is available via the CITY TRAIL website; registration is also possible at the race office on race day. Participants in the main race must be at least 16 years old, or turn 16 in 2026.

name: VI Nocny Mikołajkowy Bieg Nyski
description: Nocny Mikołajkowy Bieg Nyski is an evening street run in Nysa over about 5.2 km. The sixth edition takes place on 5 December 2026. The organiser is the W działaniu foundation, which also runs the Bieg Nyski in May. The previous edition started in the evening from the Market Square in Nysa.
course_highlights: Evening run through the streets of Nysa
Distance of about 5.2 km
St Nicholas edition in December
additional: The race office is open on race day from 13:00 to 18:45 in the DSPiLH sports hall at Św. Piotra 1A. The 2026 field limit has been reached and registration is closed. Minors need consent from a parent or guardian.

name: XII Półmaraton Mikołajkowy w Mikołajkach
description: The 12th St Nicholas Half Marathon takes place in Mikołajki on 5 December 2026 together with the 20th St Nicholas Street Runs. Runners can choose the 21 km half marathon or the 10 km Mikołajkowa Dyszka, and children's and youth races are held in the morning. The half marathon and 10 km start at 11:45. The field is limited to 450 registered runners.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon and 10 km race
Children's and youth races before the main races
Free entry for over-70s and residents of Mikołajki municipality
additional: Children's registration and bib pickup run from 8:00 to 11:00, and the children's races start at 10:30. The 10 km and half marathon prize giving is at 14:15. Online registration runs until 1 December 2026, and payment on site is also possible. Runners aged 60-69 and people with disabilities pay half price.

name: 6 Bieg Mikołajkowy wzdłuż Leńcy
description: The 6th St. Nicholas Run along the Leńca invites you to Boronów for a sporting event in a festive St. Nicholas atmosphere. The program includes 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. It’s an opportunity to spend the day actively on routes through the Boronów area.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly along farm roads and forest tracks.
The routes also include asphalt sections.
Available distances are 5 km and 10 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event.
additional: The participant limit is 200.

name: 57 Biegi Przełajowe
location: Polana leśna przy ul. Zakopiańskiej, Legionowo
description: The 57th Cross-Country Runs for the Legionowo Mayor's Cup take place on 5 December 2026 in the Legionowo forest, with start and finish on a forest clearing at ul. Zakopiańska. The 12 km main race starts at 12:00 and costs 40 PLN with a full starter package of bib, bag drop, a running gadget, a meal and a medal. The organizer is the City of Legionowo, reachable at arena@um.legionowo.pl.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in the Legionowo forest
Start and finish on the forest clearing at ul. Zakopiańska
12 km main race
additional: The city page lists 08:30 as the start of the event day, and online registration runs through zapisyonline.pl.

name: Mikołajkowa Sianowska 5
organizer: Fundacja Zastopuj, Sportowiec.info, Gmina i miasto Sianów
description: Mikołajkowa Sianowska 5 is a 5 km race in Kłos in the Sianów municipality and the final race of the five-race Sianowska series. Children's races from 100 to 1000 metres start before the main race, and on every distance a parent may run together with their child. The race counts towards the RUNking runners' ranking, and the series will be wrapped up at the 9th RUNking Runners' Gala. The organisers have prepared 120 medals for participants.
course_highlights: Main 5 km race in Kłos (Sianów municipality)
Children's races over 100, 200, 400, 800 and 1000 m
Final race of the Sianowska series, counting towards RUNking
additional: Race packs are handed out from 9:30, the last ones at 10:45 at the latest. Children's races start from 11:00, the main race at 12:00. Race-day entry only if places remain. Runners must be 16 or older; younger runners take part under the care of a parent or guardian.

name: Piastowski Bieg Mikołajowy
description: Piastowski Bieg Mikołajowy is a cross-country race organised by the WKB Piast Wrocław running club. Start and finish are in Wilkszyn by the ORLIK pitch on ul. Sportowa. Runners can choose a 10 km cross-country race over two loops, a shorter cross-country run of about 5 km, or 5 km of Nordic walking. The organisers invite everyone to treat themselves to some exercise and time together over the festive season.
course_highlights: 10 km cross-country race over two loops
Shorter run of about 5 km and 5 km Nordic walking
Start by the ORLIK pitch in Wilkszyn
additional: Start at 11:00. A lower fee (70 zł) applies to Miękinia residents and club members. A separate free race is held for children.

name: Trail!ON Stawiguda 2026/2027 #1
description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a winter series of four off-road races in Ruś near Olsztyn, held in a bend of the Łyna river. The first race of the series offers a 5 km main race and children's races over 300 m, 500 m and 1 km. Every date follows the same schedule, and after the main race anyone who wants to can join a winter swim. After the last race of the series the overall standings are announced and finisher medals for the series are handed out.
course_highlights: 5 km main race in a bend of the Łyna river
Children's races over 300 m, 500 m and 1 km
Winter swimming after the main race
additional: Children's races start from 9:45, the main race at 11:00, winter swimming from 11:45 to 12:15. A season-pass bib is valid for the whole series; on race day only single-race entries are sold. Registration and payment via sportaktywni.pl.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Parking leśny Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter series of four cross-country races and nordic walking events in the Warta river forests near Biedrusko. The St Nicholas Run on 5 December 2026 opens the 2026/2027 series, followed by the New Year Run, the Valentine's Run and the final Women's Run. Races are held over 42.2 km and 21.3 km, plus 5 and 10 km. The event centre and race office are by Lake Łyse at the Łysy Młyn forest car park. Each race this season has a theme and the organiser encourages themed outfits.
course_highlights: Forest tracks and paths along the Warta river
Marathon 42.2 km, half marathon 21.3 km plus 5 and 10 km
Themed St Nicholas Run opening the winter series
additional: The race office is open on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The marathon and half marathon start at 10:00, the 5 and 10 km races at 10:15. Nordic walking is held over 21.3 km and over 5 and 10 km. Online registration ran until 30 November, and the field is limited to 250 people.

name: XXI Bieg Mikołajów i Mikołajek
organizer: MOSiR „Pszczelnik” i Urząd Miasta Siemianowice Śląskie
description: Bieg Mikołajów i Mikołajek is a traditional running and Nordic walking event in Siemianowice Śląskie, organised by the MOSiR Pszczelnik sports centre and the city hall. The 5.5 km route follows the paths of Pszczelnik Park to the golf course, through the Bażantarnia woods and past the Rzęsa pond, finishing back in the park. Every participant gets a sweet gift and a drink. It is a festive chance to get moving for runners and Nordic walkers alike.
course_highlights: 5.5 km route along the paths of Pszczelnik Park
Passes the golf course, Bażantarnia and the Rzęsa pond
Sweet gift and a drink for every participant
additional: Start at 11:00. Entries by email to sport@um.siemianowice.pl; after the deadline, paper entries at the race office on race day between 10:15 and 10:50.

name: Mikołajkowa Piątka
organizer: Opalenicki Klub Biegacza, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu
description: Mikołajkowa Piątka is a 5 km run in Porażyn and part of the Nowy Tomyśl county winter Grand Prix over 5 km. The race takes place on 5 December 2026. Start, finish and race office are at Porażyn Tartak 14. The organisers are the Opalenica Runners Club and the Nowy Tomyśl County Sports Centre.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
Part of the Nowy Tomyśl county winter Grand Prix
Start and finish at Porażyn Tartak 14
additional: The race office in Porażyn is open on race day from 8:00 to 8:45. Registration runs through the Datasport panel.

name: VII Charytatywny ZwariOWany Trip Nocny
description: The 7th Charity ZwariOWany Night Trip is a nighttime running event held in Kąkolewo for a good cause. This year’s edition supports Mikołaj Wróblewski. Participants come together to run and support the charity initiative.

name: 22. Bieg Barbórkowy - Rybnik
description: Bieg Barbórkowy is an annual road race in Rybnik organised by MOSiR Rybnik. The 22nd edition takes place on 6 December 2026 on a certified 10 km course. It is the fourth and final race of the 9th Rybnik Running Grand Prix, together with Bieg Wiosny, the Rybnik Moon Half Marathon and Kamień Extreme. The event is part of the MOSiR Rybnik Klub programme.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Final race of the 9th Rybnik Running Grand Prix
Discounts with the Rybka card
additional: Online entries close on 29 November 2026, and up to 30 places are available at the race office on race day from 9:00 to 11:15. The entry fee is 90 zł to 180 zł depending on payment date, or 72 zł to 144 zł with the Rybka card.

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
description: The Festival of Santa Claus Runs in Toruń is a Christmas-themed race that the organiser calls the biggest in Poland. The 24th edition takes place on 6 December 2026, starting at 12:00 near the Old Town Market Square and finishing at the City Stadium on ul. Bema 23/29. Distances are half marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km and 5 km nordic walking, plus virtual runs. The organiser is the Maraton Toruński physical culture association.
course_highlights: Start by the Old Town Market Square, finish at the City Stadium
Half marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km and 5 km nordic walking
Polish team championship in the Santa Claus half marathon
additional: The race office is at the MOSiR tennis courts, ul. Szosa Chełmińska 75B, on 5 December from 15:00 to 20:30 and on 6 December from 8:00 to 11:00. Online entry costs 170 zł (5 km) to 220 zł, and 250 zł in cash at the race office. Finishers get a medal, hot soup with bread and hot tea.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a series of 5 km runs in forest settings, and in Katowice the race is held in the State Forests of the Katowice forest district. The finish is at the Rybaczówka centre by Janina pond, with the start about 700 m away inside the forest. The course is always the same, so runners can compare their results across races and seasons. CITY TRAIL Junior runs take place before the main race. The race on 6 December 2026 is the second of four rounds of the 2026/2027 season in Katowice.
course_highlights: Fixed 5 km course in the Katowice forest district
Finish at the Rybaczówka centre by Janina pond
CITY TRAIL Junior runs from about 200 m to 1 km
additional: The race office is open from 8:30 to 10:30 and the main race starts at 11:00. There is no road access near the start and race office; park on ul. Karolinki by the Staszic-Wujek mine, under a kilometre away.

name: II Bieg Mikołajkowy
description: The 2nd Gorenice St. Nicholas Run is organized by the Srebrna Dziesiątka Association and Gorenice Volunteer Fire Department. The main race covers approximately 5 km along a route familiar from the previous edition. There is also a 5 km Nordic walking event. Children can take part in stadium races over distances of 100 to 300 m. The event headquarters is at Leśnik Gorenice Stadium. The event is held under the patronage of the Olkusz County Governor.
course_highlights: Main race: approximately 5 km, with a short uphill section
5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s stadium races over distances of 100 to 300 m
additional: The limit is 200 participants in the main race and 50 children. The online registration fee is 70 zł for the run or Nordic walking and 40 zł for the children’s race. On race day, the fees are 80 zł and 50 zł, respectively.

name: W pogoni za św. Mikołajem
description: W pogoni za św. Mikołajem (Chasing St Nicholas) is a 7 km Christmas run organised by Radio Wrocław in Millennium Park (Park Tysiąclecia) in Wrocław. The 2026 edition takes place on Sunday 6 December with an 11:30 start. The run is recreational and festive, and runners wear Santa hats. Finishers receive a medal and a hot meal.
course_highlights: 7 km run in Millennium Park
Festive atmosphere and Santa hats
Medal and hot meal at the finish
additional: The field is capped at 250 runners and the time limit is 1 hour. The race is for runners aged 18 and over. Online registration closes on 2 December 2026 at 23:59, and there is no race-day entry. The race office opens on race day at the start, address ul. Karkonoska 10.

name: XIV Bieg Mikołajkowy
description: The 14th St Nicholas Run in Police takes place on Sunday 6 December 2026. It is organised by the BiegamBoLubię Team Police association. The main race over 5 or 10 km starts at 12:00 from the OSiR stadium at ul. Piaskowa 97, and the course follows forest paths. A 5 km Nordic walk starts at 12:10, and children's races and a Christmas tree relay are held earlier. Every runner gets a Santa hat for the race and a Christmas medal at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 or 10 km on forest paths
Start and finish at the OSiR stadium in Police
Christmas Dream Relay carrying Christmas trees
additional: Schedule: 8:00 race office opens, 10:00 children's races, 11:30 Dream Relay, 12:00 main race, 12:10 Nordic walking, 13:30 prize giving. The race office is at Primary School no. 8, ul. Piaskowa 99 (5 December 11:00-15:00, 6 December 8:00-11:30). Entry costs 85 to 120 zł (110 to 130 zł with a shirt) depending on the date, and the field is capped at 800. Online registration closes on 30 November 2026; after that, entry is only at the race office if places remain.

name: XV Grand Prix Krakowa w biegach górskich – Bieg Mikołajkowy
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 72, al. Modrzewiowa 23, Kraków
organizer: Grand Prix Krakowa w Biegach Górskich
description: The St Nicholas Run is the second stage of the 15th Kraków Mountain Running Grand Prix, held on Sunday 6 December 2026. There are four distances: Harda Dwudziestka Trójka (23.2 km, start 9:00), Przyjazna Trójka (3.7 km, 9:40), Tradycyjna Piątka (5.7 km, 10:45) and Ambitna Jedenastka (11.6 km, 11:00). A Vertical race and a GPS challenge are held on Saturday 5 December, and children's races on Sunday. The race centre with office, changing rooms, buffet and bag storage is at Primary School no. 72, aleja Modrzewiowa 23.
course_highlights: Four distances from 3.7 to 23.2 km
Vertical GPK on Saturday 5 December
Children's races in several age groups
additional: Single-race entry depends on distance and date: 55 to 80 zł for 3.7 km, 80 to 100 zł for 5.7 km, 80 to 110 zł for 11.6 km and 90 to 120 zł for 23.2 km; the children's race costs 25-30 zł. Children, youth and seniors 65+ get discounts. Single-race entries are capped at 100 per distance. The race office is open only on Sunday 6 December, 8:00-11:00.

name: Mikołajkowy Bieg Świerzawy
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Sportu i Turystyki w Świerzawie
description: Bieg Mikołajkowy in Świerzawa is organised by the Świerzawa Culture, Sport and Tourism Centre together with the local school. Start and finish are on the market square in Świerzawa. Adults aged 16 and over run about 6 km, which is 8 laps, while children and youth run 400 m and 720 m. The race is held together with the Christmas market. In 2026 the adult race starts on 6 December at 10:30.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the market square in Świerzawa
Adult race of about 6 km over 8 laps
Children's and youth runs over 400 m and 720 m
additional: Entries are taken by the CKSiT office until 4 December 2026 or at the race office on race day from 9:00 to 9:55. The entry fee is 30 zł, paid at the race office.

name: XXIII Memoriał  Stefana Mielczarka
organizer: TKKF Jaworzanie, OSiR w Jaworze, LO Jawor
description: The Stefan Mielczarek Memorial is a road race in Jawor in memory of Stefan Mielczarek, an honorary citizen of the town. The 23rd edition takes place on 6 December 2026 at 11:00, with start and finish at the I LO high school, ul. Kościuszki 8. The course is 5.6 km, two laps of 2.8 km through the town streets, including the market square. It is organised by TKKF Jaworzanie, OSiR Jawor and LO Jawor. A St Nicholas run for children and youth starts at 10:30.
course_highlights: 5.6 km, two laps of 2.8 km
Course through Jawor including the market square
Start and finish at I LO, ul. Kościuszki 8
additional: Entry is 70 zł until 2 December 2026 and 90 zł after that and on race day. The field is capped at 120, and online registration closes on 2 December 2026 at 12:00. The race office at LO Jawor opens on race day from 9:00 to 10:30. Runners must be at least 16.

name: Bieg Mikołajkowy Radia Wrocław
description: Bieg Mikołajkowy Radia Wrocław is a festive running event in Tysiąclecia Park in Wrocław, on ul. Graniczna. There are two distances to choose from, 2 km and 7 km, and the organisers stress that records do not matter, only joy and having fun together. The race pack includes a specially designed Santa running cap, and a medal and a hot meal await at the finish.
course_highlights: Two distances: 2 km and 7 km
Specially designed Santa running cap in the race pack
Medal and hot food at the finish
additional: The 2 km race starts at 10:30 (100 runners, 40 min time limit), the 7 km at 11:30 (200 runners, 60 min time limit, age 18+). Race packs are collected on race day at the race office in Tysiąclecia Park. No entries at the race office.

name: I Uliczny Bieg Mikołajkowy
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Nidzicy, MOSiR w Nidzicy, Stowarzyszenie Nidzica Biega
description: The 1st St. Nicholas Street Run is a 5 km road race in Nidzica. The course consists of two 2.5 km laps along Plac Wolności, Warszawska, Kraszewskiego, Kolejowa and Kościuszki streets, with restricted vehicular traffic. The start, finish and race office are located at Plac Wolności. Participants must be at least 13 years old, and the participant limit is 150. The first edition will take place on December 6, 2026, at 10:00.
course_highlights: Two 2.5 km laps through the streets of Nidzica
Start and finish at Plac Wolności
Every kilometre marked
additional: The race package includes a Santa hat, a race bib and a chip, and everyone who finishes the race will receive a medal. The time limit is 50 minutes. On race day, registration is possible only for any spots that become available.

name: II Górski Bieg Mikołajkowy
location: Altany i Amfiteatr nad Czarnym Potokiem, Rymanów-Zdrój
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Rymanowie
description: II Górski Bieg Mikołajkowy in Rymanów-Zdrój is a mountain run and nordic walking race of about 7 km. The course runs through the hills of Rymanów municipality with about 230 m of climbing. Start and finish are at the arbours and amphitheatre by the Czarny Potok stream. There is also a category for children and youth up to 16. The race takes place on 6 December 2026 at 11:00.
course_highlights: Mountain course of about 7 km with about 230 m of climbing
Start and finish by the Czarny Potok stream in Rymanów-Zdrój
Run and nordic walking race
additional: The time limit is 2 hours. Participants receive a medal, a recovery meal and hot drinks, and runners are encouraged to wear Santa-themed outfits. Entry costs 50 zł online and 60 zł on race day if places remain.

name: Mikołajkowy Charytatywny Bieg i Marsz NW
description: The Charity St Nicholas Run and Nordic Walk is a cross-country run and Nordic walking event in Bielawki, Pelplin municipality, organised by the Pelplin Sports Centre. Start and finish are near the Bielawki forester's lodge, and the race is held on a 3.5 km loop. Participants choose a 7 or 3.5 km run or a 7 or 3.5 km Nordic walk. The 2026 edition takes place on Sunday 6 December with a 12:00 start. Every year the event raises money for residents of the Pelplin municipality in need.
course_highlights: 3.5 km loop near the Bielawki forester's lodge
Run and Nordic walking over 7 or 3.5 km
Charity event for residents of the Pelplin municipality
additional: The entry fee is 10 zł and the field is capped at 450 paid entries. Online registration is open until 3 December 2026 at 23:59. Participants should be in the start area by 11:50. The detailed course will be posted at facebook.com/biegpelplin at least 7 days before the race.

name: Zalew Run!
organizer: Burmistrz Sokółki Ewa Kulikowska, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sokółce, Sokólskie Centrum Sportu i Rozrywki oraz Sokólski Ośrodek Kultury
price_range: 20 zł za bieg na 2 lub 5 km; 10 zł od osoby w sztafecie; biegi dziecięce bezpłatne
description: Zalew Run is a winter running event held in Sokółka on December 6, 2026. Participants can compete in 2 km and 5 km races, as well as relay races in categories including corporate, family, women’s, and men’s. The youngest participants can take part in short mini-races and scooter races, making the event appealing to the whole family. The event promotes active recreation and social connection in the winter setting of the Sokółka Reservoir.
course_highlights: 2 km and 5 km races
5 km relay race (600 + 2,200 + 2,200 m)
Mini-races and scooter races for children from 1 year old
additional: Event schedule: 10:30–11:30 collection of race packs; 10:30–10:55 registration for children’s races and scooter races; 11:00 start of scooter races and children’s races; 11:50 technical briefing; 11:55 official opening; 12:00 start of the 2 km race; 12:20 start of the 5 km relay; 13:00 start of the 5 km race; 13:40 course closes; 13:45–14:00 awards ceremony and event closing. The relay consists of three legs: 600 m, 2,200 m, and 2,200 m. Children aged 1–12 can take part in races of 50, 100, or 500 m and in scooter races.

name: Bieg Mikołajkowy
organizer: Gmina Duszniki, Biblioteka Publiczna i Centrum Animacji Kultury w Dusznikach
description: The 13th Bieg Mikołajkowy (St Nicholas Run) takes place on Sunday 6 December 2026 in Duszniki in Szamotuły County. The start and finish are at the Public Library and Cultural Centre at ul. Jana Pawła II 8. There is a 1.5 km family run and the 5 km Mikołajkowa Piątka, both on asphalt. The organizers are the Municipality of Duszniki and the Public Library and Cultural Centre in Duszniki.
course_highlights: 1.5 km family run at 14:30 and 5 km Mikołajkowa Piątka at 15:15
Medal and recovery meal for every finisher
Christmas market at the same venue from 13:00 to 17:00
additional: Entries only via dostartu.pl until 4 December 2026 at 23:59 or until the limit of 250 places per race is reached. Entry fee: 15 PLN for the family run and 70 PLN for the 5 km; on race day, if places remain, 20 PLN and 80 PLN. The race office in the BPiCAK hall is open 11:00-14:45. The 5 km is open to those who turn 15 by 4 December 2026; electronic timing.

name: IX Bieg Pamięci Trenera Emila Wzorka
location: Stadion Lekkoatletyczny im. Trenera Emila Wzorka, ul. Piłsudskiego 32, Tarnów
description: The 9th Coach Emil Wzorek Memorial Run takes place on 6 December 2026 in Tarnów, starting and finishing at the Coach Emil Wzorek Athletics Stadium at ul. Piłsudskiego 32. The main race of about 10 km runs on a flat course, 95% asphalt and 5% hard-packed road. Children's and youth races from 100 to 800 m are held in the stadium. The organizers are Kępa Sport and LKS Burzyn.
course_highlights: Flat course of about 10 km, marked every kilometre
Start and finish at the athletics stadium
Children's and youth races over 100, 250, 500 and 800 m
additional: The race office is open 9:30-11:30 at the stadium. The children's and youth races start at 11:00, the main race at 12:00 and the prize ceremony is around 13:30. The main race has a 90-minute time limit and electronic timing. The race pack includes a training T-shirt, a finisher medal and a meal at the finish.

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: The Bieg Śladami Żubra is an annual running event organized by the Aktywna Pszczyna Sports Association in Studzienice, held in December. The route follows one or two loops through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest, offering scenic woodland views. The event features several distances, including the Fancy Dress Run, children’s races, 6 km and 12 km runs and Nordic Walking, as well as a half marathon and marathon. Participants can expect medals, awards for costumes, and traditional pea soup at the finish.
course_highlights: The route runs through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest
Races cover one or two forest loops
Scenic woodland views and natural mud
additional: Start times are staggered: 08:00 marathon, 08:30 Fancy Dress Run (1.8 km), and 10:10 half marathon. Children’s races are offered over distances of 200 m, 400 m, 800 m and 250 m, 400 m, 850 m, depending on age. Medals and awards for the most creative costumes await at the finish. A team classification is held (the four fastest times after one loop). The route is also used for Nordic Walking. Traditional pea soup is served at the finish. GPX files are available for the half-marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km routes. New marathon distance, changed start and finish location, food and recovery attractions, honorary patronages, additional cross-country races, and team classification.

name: 6 Wigilijny Bieg Charytatywny
price_range: 45–90 zł, zależnie od konkurencji i terminu zapisów
description: The 6th Christmas Eve Charity Run is a cross-country race on a forest course in Lasek Majoński in Luboń, taking place on December 12, 2026. Participants can choose between a 5 km run and a Nordic Walking event on the same course. The event is charitable and supports the Dobro się niesie Foundation, which helps people experiencing homelessness. Shorter distances are available for children, with separate categories for girls and boys. The organizers provide a race pack, a commemorative wooden medal, a meal, and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: 5 km run and Nordic Walking on a 100% forest trail course
Babki Forest District grounds — Lasek Majoński in Luboń
Cross-country race with a 50-minute time limit
additional: The race office opens at 9:45 near the cemetery in Luboń, ul. Armii Poznań 51B. The race pack includes a race bib, a wooden medal, a meal (sweet yeast bun and tea), and gifts from sponsors. Timing is provided by reusable chips attached to shoes. Age categories and OPEN, Luboń residents, ZSM Poznań, and four-person team classifications are available. The limit for children's races is 100 participants. An additional race-pack pickup is available on December 10, 2026, in the afternoon (location to be announced by the organizer). The 5 km run and Nordic Walking start at 12:30. The time limit is 50 minutes, and the combined participant limit for these events is 200. The entry fee includes a charitable contribution of 10 or 20 zł.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Sątopy, Nowy Tomyśl County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of races organized by the Nowy Tomyśl Chyży Running Club, held off-road in autumn and winter. The event has a social and sporting character and is intended for both experienced and beginner runners. The minimum distance is 10.5 km, while the full marathon distance is 42.2 km, which can be completed by running multiple 10.5 km loops. The event takes place in Sątopy and aims to help participants stay active outdoors during the challenging autumn and winter months.
course_highlights: Off-road course with a 10.5 km loop
Option to complete a full marathon or multiple loops
Races take place in autumn and winter conditions
additional: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of races held one weekend per month from October to March, each in a different town. The race office opens at 09:00, and the first race starts at 10:00. The time limit for the first race is 16:00. The second race starts at 09:00 the following day, with a time limit of 15:00. The event is co-funded by Nowy Tomyśl County and is held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. Information for the 2026/2027 edition gives the date as December 12, 2026; the December 13 date provided by the user may refer to another event day or to the weekend.

name: Dwumaraton Pamięci Wojtka Pismenko
description: Dwumaraton Pamięci Wojtka Pismenko is a pair of informal marathons in Świdwin on consecutive days, held in memory of local ultrarunner Wojtek Pismenko. The first race is on Saturday 12 December 2026 and the second on Sunday 13 December. The course is 8 laps of about 5.3 km, combining the parkrun Świdwin loop with a foot and bike path towards Lake Bukowiec. Runners may complete any number of laps, and the double marathon ranking is based on the combined time of both marathons.
course_highlights: 8 laps of about 5.3 km in the town park and along a foot and bike path
Half marathon is 4 laps, marathon 8 laps
Unpaved park paths and asphalt
additional: Starts are at 10:00 on Saturday and 8:00 on Sunday from the campfire meadow in the town park on Drawska street. Both races have a 7 hour limit. The organizational fee is at least 49 zł per race, and each race requires a separate registration. Free basic overnight accommodation is offered at the agricultural school.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: The Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Bydgoszcz. The race is recreational and competitive, aimed at people aged 16 and over, and promotes outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the forested areas of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District, offering beautiful natural surroundings. Races take place regularly, giving participants the opportunity to test themselves on the same course throughout the season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
A cross-country route through forests and urban parks
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:45 before the race. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; participants are advised to use parking areas approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The event schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Register via the participant portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day.

name: WINTER TRAIL MAŁOPOLSKA
location: Kasinka Mała, Mszana Dolna, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Winter Trail Małopolska 2026 is the tenth edition of the winter mountain running festival and the 19th event in the ULTRA-TRAIL® MAŁOPOLSKA series. The routes pass through the scenic areas of the Beskid Wyspowy and Gorce mountains, through some of Małopolska’s most beautiful forests, in the Myślenice and Limanowa forest districts. The event is exceptionally demanding and intended for true ultrarunners who are not afraid of challenging winter conditions. A hot vegetarian meal and a warm welcome await at the finish.
course_highlights: Routes through the Beskid Wyspowy and Gorce mountains
Routes through forests in the Myślenice and Limanowa forest districts
Challenging winter conditions and demanding elevation gain
additional: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Mszana Dolna, ul. Spadochroniarzy. Race office and baggage drop at the Municipal Cultural Centre in Mszana Dolna, open one hour before the start. No race packs; a finisher pack is provided at the finish. Mandatory equipment is checked during registration and on the course. Vegetarian aid stations and a hot VEGE meal are available on the course and at the finish. A drop bag can be left on the course for the WTM 140 and WTM 105 distances. A GPS tracker is mandatory for WTM 140 and WTM 105. The 2026 edition will take place on 12–13 December. Registration, participant information, FAQ and online tracking are available.

name: Bieg Mikołajkowy
description: Bieg Mikołajkowy is a December race in the Kabacki Forest in Warsaw, organised by ActiveSports as part of the Grand Prix Warszawy series. Runners choose between 5 km and 10 km, and there is also a 5 km Nordic walking class. The 2026 edition is on Saturday 12 December and entries are capped at 450. Race headquarters is at Kabaty, in the clearing next to the metro depot.
course_highlights: Courses in the Kabacki Forest
Special trophy for the oldest man and woman
Award for the funniest costume
additional: The 5 km starts at 10:00, Nordic walking at 10:03 (60-minute limit) and the 10 km at 11:30 (80-minute limit). Race headquarters opens at 09:00 and bibs are only handed out on race day. Entry fee: 80 PLN until 25 November, 90 PLN from 26 November, 100 PLN on race day if places remain. The entry includes a medal, a hot meal and tea.

name: VII Zimowy Półmaraton Myszkowski
description: The Myszków Winter Half Marathon is an annual running event organized by the Actus Association and held in Myszków. The race attracts runners eager to tackle the half-marathon distance in a winter setting. The race is scheduled to start at 11:00, and timing is provided by the experienced Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu team using modern technology. This sporting event combines a passion for running with professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly along forest tracks.
The course also includes stony sections, natural obstacles, and stretches of asphalt.
The start and finish are on Batalionów Chłopskich Street in Myszków.
additional: Online registration closes on November 30, 2026, at 23:59. Timing is provided using an RFID system and mats at the start and finish lines. The organizer provides professional assistance and support during the event. A 5 km run or walk is also available. The participant limit is 400, and times will be recorded electronically.

name: 13. Bieg po Choinkę
description: Bieg po Choinkę is a pre-Christmas cross-country run in Mińsk Mazowiecki organized by the Barakuda sports club. The main run is about 5 km and open to runners aged 14 and over. The course runs over uneven, hilly and sandy ground and is not certified. Besides the main run there is a run with dogs, a health walk and children's races. The 13th edition is on 12 December 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country course of about 5 km on hilly, sandy ground
5 km run with dogs and health walk
Children's races from 100 to 600 m
additional: The race office at ul. Sportowa 1 opens at 7:45. Children's races start from 10:00, the dog run at 11:15 and the main run at 11:20. There is also a contest for the best Christmas costume.

name: Kropelka Run
organizer: Urząd Miasta w Piechowicach, Fundacja Przejście Kotliny
description: Kropelka Run is a winter trail race in Piechowice-Górzyniec near the Kropelka waterfall. Runners choose between 20 km and 10 km, with start and finish on ul. Słoneczna next to the forester's lodge. The course is marked with white tape bearing the UltraKotlina logo and has checkpoints. The organizers are the Piechowice town office and the Przejście Kotliny foundation. The race is on 12 December 2026.
course_highlights: 20 km and 10 km near the Kropelka waterfall
Start and finish by the forester's lodge in Górzyniec
Electronic chip timing
additional: Bibs are handed out from 8:00 to 10:45 at ul. Słoneczna 2. The 20 km starts at 10:00 and the 10 km at 11:00, with time limits of 13:00 for 10 km and 14:00 for 20 km. The main race is for adults, and 16 and 17 year olds may run 10 km with guardian consent. Parking is recommended at the Piechowice train station.

name: Perly Malopolski Rabka Zdroj Gorce
description: The event is part of the Perły Małopolski running series, which covers various locations in Małopolska and attracts running enthusiasts from different regions. The route passes through the scenic Gorce Mountains, offering participants a unique experience and the chance to admire the beauty of the surrounding nature.
course_highlights: Scenic route in the Gorce Mountains
Part of the prestigious Perły Małopolski series
Various distances suited to runners of different levels
additional: The event features various distances, and registration opens in January 2025. Participants can look forward to beautiful views and a sporting atmosphere.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (12)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach
price_range: 20-110 zł, pakiety od 220 zł do 800 zł, opłaty dla pracowników i studentów 30 zł

tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w wysokości 20 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w dniu biegu 30 zł

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: pozostałe osoby – w wysokości 45 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: pozostałe osoby – w dniu biegu 60 zł
