tiers.description: małżeństwa – w wysokości 80 zł przelewem na konto (każda osoba z małżeństwa zapisuje się osobno)

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewniki forests in Katowice. The event takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. It promotes an active lifestyle and education about responsible behaviour in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewniki forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. Annual race-entry packages are available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable but may be transferred to a subsequent race if requested by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the race. The event is recreational, with a 3-hour time limit and online registration; entry fees are non-refundable. It also has an educational aspect, promoting responsible behaviour in forest areas.

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 2/5
description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of cross-country races in Pietrasze Forest in Białystok. The 2026/27 season has five races, and the second is on 13 December 2026. The course is 7.83 km over natural, hilly terrain. Runners and Nordic walkers compete on the same course.
course_highlights: 7.83 km course in Pietrasze Forest
Hilly cross-country route
Running and Nordic walking on the same distance
additional: Race packs are handed out 8:30-9:30 at Primary School No. 32, ul. Pietrasze 29. Warm-up with a coach at 9:40, start at 10:00. A music event with doughnuts and tea runs 10:00-12:00. A season pass covering all five races is available.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: ul. Spokojna, Mały Kack, Gdynia, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity area in the Gdańsk Forest District and around Mały Kack in Gdynia. The races take place in natural settings among forests and urban parks, promoting outdoor physical activity. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both local and overall rankings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part with a guardian’s consent. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and urban parks
The Tricity location includes the Gdańsk Forest District and the area around Mały Kack in Gdynia
The race takes place in a natural setting and promotes outdoor activity
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race numbers and timing chips are collected on race day. The schedule is the same at all locations. Participants can buy a pass for the entire series or enter individual races. The entry fee is higher on race day. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with a guardian’s consent. Pass holders can race for free in another city by registering in advance. Online registration is available through the Participant Portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. A pass for four races at one location is available.

name: III Bieg Crossowy Śladami Bobra
description: The 3rd Cross-Country Beaver Trail Run is a trail race held in Szarlejka, on a 5 km course. The event is organized by the Positive Sport Foundation and is aimed at running and nordic walking enthusiasts. The event takes place in December, and participants can expect professional timekeeping and a friendly atmosphere. The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30, and the race starts on the same day at 2 Borowa Street.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Trail run in a natural setting
Participation in either the race or nordic walking
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30. Organizer: Positive Sport Foundation. Electronic timekeeping. Categories: 5 km run and 5 km nordic walking. The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30.

name: VII Bieg Mikołajów
organizer: Stowarzyszenie WKR FAN, Superczas.pl i Miejski Ośrodek Kultury w Olsztynie
price_range: od 30 zł; opłata w dniu imprezy od 60 zł

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Podstawowa opłata startowa jest równa 30 zł ale to Ty zdecydujesz jaką kwotą wesprzesz potrzebujące dzieciaki.

description: The 7th Santa Run is an annual charity race held in Olsztyn as part of the Warmia Christmas Market. The 5 km route passes through the picturesque Old Town, Central Park, and Łynostrada. The event is open to adults and young people aged 12 and over. Its aim is to have fun and support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn. Participants receive commemorative Santa hats, and the limit is 420 participants.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through Olsztyn’s Old Town
Scenic paths in Central Park
A run along Łynostrada
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:00 at the Czesław Niemen Amphitheatre, ul. Zamkowa 1. Participants receive commemorative Santa hats. Timing is provided by chips, which must be returned at the finish. All entry fees support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn. Participants must be at least 12 years old (born in 2014 or earlier). Online registration is open until December 9, 2026, or until the participant limit is reached. The race office is located at the Czesław Niemen Amphitheatre, ul. Zamkowa 1. Entry fees support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn.

name: Białołęcki Bieg Wolności
location: Areszt Śledczy Warszawa-Białołęka, ul. Ciupagi, Warszawa
description: Białołęcki Bieg Wolności is an annual run commemorating the imposition of martial law in Poland on 13 December 1981. The course circles the Białołęka detention centre, where more than 600 opposition activists were interned, and covers a symbolic 13 km in three laps of 4.3 km. The 12th edition is on Sunday 13 December 2026, with the race village, office, start and finish by the prison walls. It is the final stage of the Białołęka Running Triad.
course_highlights: Three 4.3 km laps around the Białołęka detention centre
Exhibition about martial law and music from the era
New: three-person relay, one lap each
additional: Before the start archive recordings from December 1981 and 1989 are played, and coal braziers stand in the event area. Everyone who completes at least one lap gets a medal. Entry for the main race and the relay is 50 PLN, children under 16 pay 10 PLN and people aged 70+ run for free. There are 940 places and registration is through b4sportonline.pl.

name: I Bieg w Krainie Kormoranów
location: Ośrodek Wypoczynkowy Bursztynowo, ul. Morska 9, Sztutowo
description: I Bieg w Krainie Kormoranów is a 5 km run held as part of the 14th Cormorant Land Rally in Sztutowo. A Power Walk and a Nordic walking march over the same distance take place alongside the run. The start is on 13 December 2026 at 11:00 at the Bursztynowo holiday centre, ul. Morska 9. The organiser is the Sztutowo Local Tourism Organisation, with the Sztutowo municipality among the co-organisers.
course_highlights: Joint start for the run, Power Walk and Nordic walking at 11:00
Prizes in age categories
Commemorative medal and refreshments afterwards
additional: Race office opens 10:00-10:50. The closing and prize ceremony is at 13:00-13:30 at the Sztutowo Cultural Centre (SZOK), ul. Obozowa 16. The entry fee is 70 PLN, or 100 PLN on race day, and is non-refundable. Registration is through zapisyvaldano.pl.

name: Łódzkie Biegi Górskie
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 61, ul. Okólna 183, Łódź
description: Łódzkie Biegi Górskie is a series of cross-country hill races in the Modrzew forest in Łódź, organised by the UKS Orientuś club. The 2026/2027 season has five races: 22 November and 13 December 2026, and 17 January, 14 February and 14 March 2027. The race is run on a 6.6 km loop, with distances of 6.6 km, 10.5 km or 14.4 km. The race base is at Primary School no. 61, Okólna 183.
course_highlights: 6.6 km loop in the hilly Modrzew forest
6.6, 10.5 and 14.4 km with 140, 220 or 300 m of climbing
Five races per season with an overall series ranking
additional: Every race starts at 11:00 and the race office opens at 09:30 on race day. Entries via the form on gorywlodzi.pl until the Sunday before each race; late entries only at the race office on the day at a higher fee. Minors need consent from a parent or guardian. Parking at the school is limited to a few dozen spaces.

name: Cytadela by Night # 122
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free monthly timed runs in Cytadela Park in Poznań. Participants cover one lap (5 km) or two (10 km) and may run, walk, jog or use Nordic walking poles. Edition #122 is on Tuesday 15 December 2026 at 19:00 and marks the tenth birthday of the series, which started in December 2016. No registration or fee is needed.
course_highlights: 10th birthday of CBN, first run in December 2016
5 km or 10 km on a loop in Cytadela Park
Free and without registration, with accurate timing
additional: There is always a briefing before the start, plus an extra briefing for first-timers. After the finish a volunteer hands you a token and your result is written down. Latecomers can join but get a gun time. Results are published on Facebook and biegi.xyz.

name: Bieg po moczkę i makówki
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Stanowicach, Stanowice, Opole, Poland
description: Bieg po Moczkę i Makówki is an annual, friendly running event held in Stanowice. Since 2012, it has become a fixture on the holiday running calendar. The course is 10 km long, divided into four 2.5 km loops, and runners may finish after any number of loops. After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and traditional moczka and makówki, and can also enjoy hot coffee and tea. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere, with a prize-winning contest for the most interesting costume and a spectator competition.
course_highlights: A 10 km course divided into four 2.5 km loops
Start and finish at Stanowice Primary School, ul. Szkolna 17A
Runners may finish after any number of loops
additional: After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and servings of traditional holiday dishes: moczka and makówki. A prize-winning spectator competition is held along the course, as well as a contest for the most interesting individual or group holiday-carnival costume. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and encourages active spectating. It features costume contests and recreational activities, is based at Stanowice Primary School, and offers the option to take part in the 10 km run. The event is usually held in December during the holiday season.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Gór...

price_tiers.distance: Bieg dorosłych 5 km i 10 km oraz Nordic Walking

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 74 zł – w przypadku rejestracji do ostatniego poniedziałku poprzedzającego zawody.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 84zł – w przypadku rejestracji w ostatni wtorek, środę i czwartek przed zawodami.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 25zł – w przypadku rejestracji do ostatniego poniedziałku poprzedzającego zawody.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 35zł – w przypadku rejestracji po tym terminie.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The races take place on forest trails, on a 5.15 km loop that climbs twice to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the park’s highest peak. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. It brings together runners and sports enthusiasts of all ages in a friendly atmosphere with a spirit of competition.
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop entirely on forest trails
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The route passes through the event center, allowing spectators to cheer on participants
additional: Children’s races are held over distances of 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m, with a separate start schedule from 9:00 to 9:45. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Registration for the adult race and Nordic Walking event is also available on race day until 10:00 (at a higher fee). Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps. After leaving the forest, the finish-area setup separates runners finishing the race from those continuing onto the second lap. The season comprises six races; routes are marked with orange ribbons, and times are recorded electronically.

name: Zimna Połówka
description: Zimna Połówka is a race held in Niegowonice, Łazy Municipality, on December 19, 2026. The race starts at 10:30. The event is organized by Grupa ExtremeJura, with timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu using modern electronic RFID chip systems. The event is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition amid the winter scenery of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer half-marathon course
Jura hills and forest trails
A challenging, technical course
additional: Online registration closes on December 15, 2026, at 23:59. The organizer provides high-quality timing using systems tested at the world's largest marathons. Telephone contact is available from 8:00 to 16:00 and on race day via the emergency number. Zimna Połówka starts at 10:30. The event will also include Chłodna Ćwiartka, an 11 km race, and a Nordic walking event over the same distance. Online registration is open until December 15, 2026, at 23:59.

name: XIX Nocny Bieg Wigilijny Od zmierzchu do...
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Wał Matejki 2, Kalisz
description: Nocny Bieg Wigilijny „Od zmierzchu do świtu” (dusk till dawn) is an overnight timed race in Kalisz organised by KTS Supermaraton Kalisz. Runners lap a flat, mostly lit loop of about 2 km on the paths of the city park from 15:25 on Saturday 19 December until 07:42 on Sunday 20 December 2026. The runner with the most full laps wins, and one lap is enough to be classified. The start and race office are at the city stadium, ul. Wał Matejki 2.
course_highlights: Dusk to dawn, more than 16 hours
Flat loop of about 2 km in the city park
Aid station by the start/finish
additional: The field is limited to 150 runners aged 18 and over. The race office is open on 19 December from 13:00 to 15:15, and parking is at ul. Sportowa 10. Entry fee: 110 PLN for entries 1-50, 130 PLN for 51-100 and 150 PLN for 101-150. Registration closes on 16 December 2026.

name: XXXVII Strzelecki Bieg Uliczny im. Euzeb...
description: The Euzebiusz Fert Street Run is a 15 km race in Strzelce Opolskie organised by the municipal sports and recreation centre (MOSiR). The course runs through the town's streets and the roads of nearby Rożniątów and Dolna, with start and finish on ul. Mickiewicza. About 90 percent of the course is asphalt. The 37th edition is on Saturday 19 December 2026 with the start at 11:00.
course_highlights: 15 km through Strzelce Opolskie, Rożniątów and Dolna
Long tradition, 37th edition
VIP run before the main start
additional: The race office is open on race day from 07:00 to 10:20 in the PSP nr 1 sports hall, ul. Kozielska 34. The time limit is 2 hours and the minimum age is 16. Entry fee: 80 PLN until 30 November, 100 PLN from 1 to 13 December, registration through Datasport. The prize ceremony is at 14:15 in the hall on ul. Kozielska 34.

name: 25 Bieg Maratończyka
description: Bieg Maratończyka is a pre-Christmas race organised by the TKKF Maratończyk Szczecin club. The 25th edition is on Sunday 20 December 2026 in Szczecin-Osów, near the forest car park on Pod Urwiskiem street. The course is 8 km, two laps of 4 km. Entries are capped at 100 and runners must be at least 16 on race day.
course_highlights: Two 4 km laps in Osów
Medals for all finishers
Prize draw among participants
additional: Start at 11:00, results and prize draw at 12:15. Race office open on 20 December from 09:00 to 11:00. Entry fee 40 PLN until 15 November, then 50 PLN while places remain. Trophies for the top three women and men. No changing rooms. The forest car park on Pod Urwiskiem street is about 200 metres from the start and finish.

name: XII Sylwestrowy Bieg i Nordic Walking
location: Ośrodek Wypoczynkowy Barcelona, ul. Bursztynowa 10, Mikoszewo
description: The New Year's Eve Run and Nordic Walking March in the Stegna municipality is a holiday event in Mikoszewo organised by VALDANO. The 12th edition is on 27 December 2026, with start and finish at the Barcelona holiday resort, Bursztynowa 10. Participants run or Nordic walk a course of about 5 km that is not PZLA certified. The time limit is 60 minutes and total entries are capped at 200.
course_highlights: Run and Nordic walking on the same course of about 5 km
Start and finish at the Barcelona holiday resort
Unique medal for participants
additional: Race office open from 10:30 to 11:50, run starts at 12:00, Nordic walking at 12:01, event ends at 13:00. Entry fee: 60 PLN online without a gift, 80 PLN with a gift (until 11 December), 100 PLN on race day at the race office.

name: Bieg Sylwestrowy
description: The Ryszard Burgiel International New Year's Eve Run is a race around Lake Malta in Poznań, organised by the Wielkopolska Society for Physical Culture (WTKKF). The 42nd edition is on Sunday 27 December 2026. The shorter race is one lap of the lake (5.4 km) and the main race is two laps (10.8 km). Entries are capped at 500 and every finisher gets a cast medal.
course_highlights: Loop around Lake Malta
Two distances: 5.4 km and 10.8 km
Best costume contest
additional: Both races start at 12:00, prize giving around 13:15. Race office in the boat hangars by Lake Malta on 27 December from 09:30 to 11:55. Online entry fee: 69 PLN until 30 September, 79 PLN until 20 November, 89 PLN until 22 December (online entries close); 130 PLN cash on race day while places remain. Minimum age 13 for 5.4 km and 16 for 10.8 km. No time limit.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Generała Józefa Dowbor...
organizer: Towarzystwo Pamięci Generała Józefa Dowbora Muśnickiego
description: The General Józef Dowbor Muśnicki Ultramarathon is an overnight race in Lusowo commemorating the Greater Poland Uprising and its commander. The 8th edition runs from 27 to 28 December 2026, starting and finishing at the village hall at Ogrodowa 3. The full distance is 108 km, ten laps of 10.8 km on paths through the surrounding meadows and forest. Runners may complete any number of full laps within the 18-hour limit.
course_highlights: 10.8 km lap on natural surfaces through meadows and forest
Start after laying a wreath at the general's grave
Buffet with a hot meal after every lap
additional: Race office opens at 14:00, start on 27 December at 18:00, finish on 28 December at 12:00. Entry fee 90 PLN, limit 108 runners, start list closes on 23 December 2026. Adults only, no professional timing. A head torch and reflective clothing are mandatory. Open classifications for women and men plus Nordic walking; at least one full lap is needed to be classified.

name: IX Sztumski Sylwestrowy Bieg Wieczorny
description: The Sztum New Year's Eve Evening Run is an evening race around Lake Zajezierskie in Sztum, held together with a recreational Nordic walking march. The 9th edition starts at 18:00 on 30 December 2026 from the beach. The course is about 4.8 km on a lit footpath and cycle path around the lake. Entries are capped at 400 paid participants.
course_highlights: One lap of Lake Zajezierskie
Lit footpath and cycle path
Awards for couples and costumes plus a prize draw
additional: Bibs and chips handed out from 15:45 to 17:30 in the beach building. Run starts at 18:00, Nordic walking at 18:05, recovery meal from 18:20, awards at 19:00. Online fees: run 60 PLN, residents of Sztum and Sztum county 40 PLN, LKS Zantyr Sztum members 30 PLN, Nordic walking 30 PLN; 100 PLN on race day. Online entries close on 27 December 2026.

name: XVII Koszaliński Bieg Sylwestrowy
location: Hala Widowiskowo-Sportowa, ul. Śniadeckich 4, Koszalin, Poland
description: The 17th Koszalin New Year’s Eve Run is a sporting way to say goodbye to the year in Koszalin, scheduled for December 31, 2026. The program includes a 5 km run, a 3.4 km Nordic walking event, and races for children and youth. The start and race office are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 4 Śniadeckich Street. It’s an event for runners and anyone who enjoys staying active at the end of the year.
course_highlights: 5 km main run
3.4 km Nordic walking event
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m, and 800 m
additional: Online registration. The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:00 at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 4 Śniadeckich Street. The Nordic walking event starts at 11:30.

name: 22. Krakowski Bieg Sylwestrowy Smocza Piątka
organizer: Fundacja Vena Sport, Labosport Polska Sp. z o.o.
description: The Kraków New Year's Eve Run goes through the streets of Kraków on the last day of the year, and most runners take part in costume. The 22nd edition is on 31 December 2026, with start and finish on the Main Market Square near Sienna street. There are two distances: 10 km (PZLA certified) and 5 km (GPS measured). Proceeds go to the Schola Cordis foundation for children's heart surgery.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Main Market Square
Mostly flat PZLA-certified 10 km course
Costume contests for individuals, couples and teams
additional: The 10 km starts at 11:30 and the 5 km at 12:00. Time limits: 1 h 15 min for 5 km and 1 h 45 min for 10 km. Race office and expo at the MOS Kraków Zachód stadium (entrance from Plac Na Groblach). The entry fee rises in steps: 109, 119, 139, 149 and 169 PLN (last step online until 30 December and on race day); under-18s get 15 PLN off. Minimum age for 10 km is 16. The rules also include a virtual run option.

name: V Tarnobrzeski Bieg Sylwestrowy
description: The Tarnobrzeg New Year's Eve Run is a race by Lake Tarnobrzeg organised by the WITAR runners' club. The 5th edition is on Thursday 31 December 2026, starting on the Mariusz Zaruski boulevard on Żeglarska street near the Na Fali restaurant. The course is about 11 km out and back along Żeglarska, Plażowa and Turystyczna streets, on asphalt with one climb. Runners must be 18, or 16 with parental consent.
course_highlights: Course along Lake Tarnobrzeg
Asphalt with one climb
Age categories for women and men
additional: Race office open from 08:00 to 10:00 on Żeglarska street. The main race starts at 11:00, awards at 13:30. Entry fee: 60 PLN until 15 November, 80 PLN until 25 December, 100 PLN on race day. Online entries close on 25 December 2026; on-site entries from 08:00 to 10:00. Runners over 70 and WITAR members run for free.

name: XXXV Gorlicki Bieg Sylwestrowy
description: The Gorlice New Year's Eve Run is an end-of-year race starting from the market square in Gorlice. The 35th edition is on 31 December 2026 at 11:00. There are two distances: 5 km, open to children from age 8, and 10 km. There are open classes for women and men on both distances and 11 age categories on the 10 km.
course_highlights: Start on the Gorlice market square
5 km open to children from age 8
Trophies, prize money and diplomas for the best
additional: Every participant gets a race pack (bib, socks, buff) and finishers receive a medal. The entry fee depends on when you register and pay. Registration is handled by time-sport.pl.

name: VI Szybka Piątka Jurka Siemaszki
organizer: Fundacja Od Zmierzchu Do Świtu, Dobre Czasy s.c.
description: Szybka Piątka Jurka Siemaszki is a New Year's Eve 5 km race on Bolko Island in Opole. The 6th edition is on 31 December 2026. It is organised by the Od Zmierzchu Do Świtu foundation and Dobre Czasy, together with partners including the Opole city sports department and MOSiR Opole. The 5 km course is PZLA certified.
course_highlights: Race on Bolko Island in Opole
PZLA-certified 5 km course
additional: Race office open from 10:00 to 11:30. Registration and timing by ZmierzymyCzas.pl, with a limit of 250 places.

name: XI Bieg Sylwestrowy
description: The TOYOTA New Year's Eve Run in Jelcz-Laskowice is an end-of-year race organised by the KB Harcownik club. The 11th edition is on 31 December 2026. Runners choose between 10 km and 5 km, both PZLA certified, and there is also a 5 km Nordic walking march. Partners include the town hall, the local sports and recreation centre and Toyota Motor Manufacturing Poland.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 10 km and 5 km courses
5 km Nordic walking march
additional: Race office at the Jelcz-Laskowice sports and recreation centre on 30 December from 18:00 to 19:30 and on 31 December from 08:00 to 10:30, with late entries possible. Minimum age 14 for the 5 km and Nordic walking, 16 for the 10 km. The limit is 1000 places.

name: 42. Bieg Sylwestrowy Trzebnica
organizer: Gmina Trzebnica, Młodzieżowe Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji
description: The Trzebnica New Year's Eve Street Run has been held for more than 40 years and is organised by the Trzebnica municipality and its youth sports centre. The 42nd edition is on Thursday 31 December 2026, starting and finishing at the municipal sports hall at 3 Maja 6. The main race is 10 km (two 5 km laps) and the shorter race is 5 km, both PZLA certified. Entries are capped at 1500 across both distances.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 5 km loop through Trzebnica
New Year's Eve costume contest, themed 'cats' in 2026
Children's races on 30 December and a free family run
additional: Both races start at 12:00 with a 90-minute limit. Entry fee: 100 PLN until 13 December, then 120 PLN; residents of the municipality 80 PLN until 13 December. 10 PLN of every fee goes to charity. Those registered by 13 December get a shirt. Pack pickup on 30 December from 18:00 to 20:00 and on 31 December from 08:00 to 11:00. Children's races on 30 December at 11:00 (20 PLN), family run on 31 December at 11:00 (free). Minimum age 12 for 5 km and 16 for 10 km.

name: VII Charytatywny Ultramaraton Włoszakowicki
description: The Włoszakowice Charity Ultramarathon is a social off-road run organised by the Sokół gymnastics society in Włoszakowice. The 7th edition is on 31 December 2026, starting and finishing in the Włoszakowice park. The course is about 56 km, mostly on forest and dirt tracks, passing lakes Trzebidzkie, Dominickie and Moszynek and Wilson's Mound. Part of every entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: About 56 km on forest and dirt tracks around Włoszakowice
Five mobile aid stations
Medal for every participant
additional: Start at 09:00, check-in at the Sokół clubhouse (Karola Kurpińskiego 29) from 07:30 to 08:30. The course is not marked; participants receive a GPS track by email. Cut-offs at the aid stations: Boguszyn 10:45, Charbielin 12:00, Lake Dominickie 13:00, Papiernia 14:00, Krzyżowiec 15:30. Entry fee 160 PLN, of which 56 PLN goes to charity; registration on datasport.pl until 21 December 2026. Limit 25 runners and 10 cyclists, adults only, no rankings.

name: 27 Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny
location: Teatr Letni im. Heleny Majdaniec, Szczecin, Poland
description: Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny 2027 is an annual running event held on January 1 at the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre in Szczecin. The program includes the 5 km Main Run, Nordic Walking, and children’s races for different age groups. The Main Run route follows the paths of Jan Kasprowicz Park, passes by Psia Polana, and loops around Jasne Błonia. The start and finish are at the same location. The event is a great opportunity to start the new year actively in a sporting atmosphere, with medals for every participant.
course_highlights: The Main Run route consists of two 2.5 km loops
The route follows the paths of Jan Kasprowicz Park, passes by Psia Polana, and loops around Jasne Błonia
Start and finish at the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre
additional: Race bibs are distributed on December 29 and 30, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:30. A baggage deposit is available at the race office throughout the event. Changing rooms are available in the start area by the Summer Theatre from the time the race office opens. Capacity: 470 places for the Main Run and Nordic Walking combined, and 115 places for the children’s races. Children start in three heats according to age group, over distances of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m. Every child participating in a race receives a commemorative medal. The program includes Nordic Walking and children’s races over distances of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m. Places are limited.

name: Śląski Maraton Noworoczny Cyborg
description: The Silesian New Year’s Marathon CYBORG is an annual running event held on January 1 in Chorzów. Participants can take on the half-marathon or marathon distances. Organized by the W Kręgu Natury Association, the race combines sporting competition with the unique atmosphere of New Year’s celebrations. The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering professional organization and support.
course_highlights: Distances: half-marathon and marathon
Course in Chorzów, in Silesia
New Year’s atmosphere and a sporting challenge
additional: Distances: half-marathon and marathon.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation, held in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. It is an activity for everyone, regardless of age or experience, combining sport with adventure and exploring nature using a map and compass. The Foundation promotes accessibility by also creating courses for blind and visually impaired participants. The series includes a variety of courses at different difficulty levels, and participants can earn badges for completing individual rounds.
course_highlights: A variety of forest terrain around Bydgoszcz, changing with each round
Courses for beginners and advanced participants, including courses for blind and visually impaired participants
The opportunity to earn digital badges and collectible stickers for completing rounds
additional: The series consists of six rounds held from November to January in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collector card. A special final badge is available after completing the entire series. Courses cater to different ability levels, and the final round features a mass start on the semi-open grounds of a former farmstead.

name: Kresowe Trail #1
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are for both beginner and experienced runners, aiming to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. Each race offers carefully marked courses, electronic timekeeping, and a generous race package.
course_highlights: Trail courses ranging from approximately 5 km to over 18 km
Carefully marked trails with colored arrows (green, red, purple)
Aid stations along the course and at the finish; time limit of approximately 2 hours
additional: Registration is available on race day until 08:40 and on-site from 8:00. New race numbers are in use starting with the 2026 season; the first race number is free of charge. The race package includes a hot recovery meal (vegetarian option also available), electronic timekeeping, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography service, and points toward the series’ overall standings. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. Online registration and race-day on-site registration are available.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
description: The 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships will be held in Toruń. As part of the event, a 5 km road race is being organised, offering masters runners an excellent opportunity to compete on the city’s scenic routes. The competition combines sporting rivalry with a spirit of camaraderie among masters athletes.
course_highlights: A 5 km road race in the centre of Toruń
Scenic urban routes with historic views
An accompanying event to the indoor athletics championships
additional: The 5 km road race is part of the programme of the 15th European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor in Toruń. Programme details are available in a PDF on the main website. No information is available about entry fees or online registration. The 5 km road race was also one of the championship events in 2026.

name: XVII Noworoczny Bieg z Ochotą
description: The New Year's Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, giving participants the chance to run into the New Year full of energy. The course passes through the capital's scenic spots, offering both amateur and more experienced runners a unique sporting experience. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere, encouraging everyone to celebrate together and start the new year actively.

name: XX Jubileuszowy Śląski Maraton Noworoczn...
description: The 20th Anniversary Silesian New Year’s Cyborg Marathon took place in Silesian Park in Chorzów. Participants could choose between one and six 7 km loops, covering distances from 7 km to the marathon, while Nordic Walking enthusiasts could take part in a half marathon. The start and finish were by the Silesian Park administration building. It was an opportunity for people to start the new year actively, at their own pace and over a distance of their choice.
course_highlights: 7 km loops, with a choice of one to six
Running distances from 7 km to the marathon
Nordic Walking half marathon over three loops
additional: The start was scheduled for 12:00. The marathon time limit was 360 minutes; participants could change the number of loops during the race. At the finish, participants received a medal, hot tea and a warm meal.

name: Wbiegnij z Nami w Nowy Rok
price_range: Od 20 zł do puszki na cel charytatywny
description: “Run” into the New Year with us is an annual running meet-up held in Szczecin by Lake Głębokie. Participants cover around 5 km together. The event is social and charitable, combining sport with an opportunity to support those in need. There is an option to take an ice bath after the run, and the whole event takes place in a friendly atmosphere that encourages people to exchange New Year’s wishes. This informal running event invites everyone to start the new year actively.
course_highlights: An approximately 5 km route by Lake Głębokie
Option to take an ice bath after the run
A social meet-up with New Year’s wishes
additional: The event takes place on 1 January at 12:00 by Lake Głębokie in Szczecin. There is an option to take an ice bath after the run. The event is charitable, with a minimum donation of 20 zł to the collection tin. It is not a traditional running event, but a social running meet-up. The start is at 12:00 from a forest clearing or car park, approximately 400 m from the roundabout at Głębokie, in the direction of Wołczkowo. Participation is non-competitive and at your own risk. Anyone planning to take an ice bath should bring suitable equipment.

name: Bieg Noworoczny Transformers
description: Transformers Bieg Noworoczny is a New Year's road race in Leszno. The main race is 5 km. Registration is online through B4Sport, which also shows the participant list. The 2027 edition is on 1 January 2027.
course_highlights: 5 km main race through the streets of Leszno
New Year's Day start on 1 January

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn forest parking, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, held on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.2 km) distances, as well as shorter 5 km and 10 km runs and walks. The event has an intimate atmosphere and is intended for both amateur and professional athletes, with themed races and special touches. The start and race office are located by the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko, and the race starts at 10:00. The course follows forest trails and tracks, with some paved sections and natural obstacles such as leaves, mud, and puddles.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon consists of two loops.
The course mainly follows the blue cycling trail along the Warta River and the Łysy Młyn running trail.
The forest surface is slippery and uneven, with leaves, mud, and puddles; total elevation gain is 110 m for the half-marathon.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and touches are encouraged for the individual races. The course is not officially certified and is measured using bicycle odometers and a Garmin device. Nordic Walking events are also held over 21.3 km, as well as runs and walks over 5 km and 10 km. The New Year's Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event centre and race office are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection on race day is scheduled for 7:45–9:30, and the start is at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event centre.

name: Poznański Bieg Noworoczny
description: The Poznań New Year Run is the first race of the Poznań Running Triad, held on cross-country paths around Lake Rusałka. The 2027 edition is on Sunday 3 January 2027, with the race centre at the POSiR Golęcin stadium. There are 5 km and 10 km distances, which can be run or walked with no time limit. It is organised by the Biegiemwlas association and Pracownia Urban Projekt, with a cap of 750 participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country paths around Lake Rusałka
First race of the 2027 Poznań Running Triad
Traditional sweet Poznań treat at the finish
additional: Race office opens at 08:30, the 5 km starts at 10:00 and the 10 km at 11:00, children's races from 12:30. Basic entry: 79 PLN until 30 November, 89 PLN until 18 December, 99 PLN until 31 December; packages with a buff or shirt up to 149 PLN, 120 PLN at the race office if places remain. Registration closes on 31 December 2026 at 23:59. A pass for the whole Triad (3 January, 3 May, 11 November 2027) costs 209-229 PLN. Minimum age 15 with parental consent.

name: 5 Wieluński Bieg Noworoczny
description: The 5th Wieluń New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Atelier Sport Association in Wieluń. The race takes place in early January and attracts runners from various regions. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and timing is provided using modern electronic systems. The organizers ensure a high standard of event organization and sporting competition, providing professional support and an atmosphere conducive to racing.
additional: Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and mats at the start and finish lines. The organizer provides telephone contact from 8:00 to 16:00 and support on race day. The event is organized by the Atelier Sport Association. No confirmed details are available about the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
organizer: Fundacja Duet – Rozwój z Pasją; Stowarzyszenie Wroniecki Klub Biegacza
description: The New Year’s Run kicks off the new year and running season in the Wronki Municipality on January 3, 2027. The running and walking route passes through the picturesque forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest, offering participants an unforgettable experience. The event is open to runners and walkers of different ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. At the finish, participants can enjoy attractions, prizes, and the chance to connect with fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque forests of the Noteć Forest
Distances of approximately 5 km and 10 km are available for runners, and 5 km for walkers
The start and finish are on Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: The race office will be open on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 on Rzecińska Street. Chip timing will be provided by PLUS TIMING. The winners’ awards ceremony will take place at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. A food and drink area with hot tea and coffee will be available at the finish. Participants under 18 must submit written consent from a parent or guardian. The organizer does not allow anyone under 15 to take part in the race. Participation is open from age 15; minors need written consent from a guardian.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: Zamczyska Winter Trail
location: Wooden shelters above Czarny Potok, Rymanów-Zdrój, Poland
description: The 12.5 km course follows both marked and unmarked hiking trails, additionally marked by the organizer to make navigation easier. The race requires good physical fitness and experience in challenging terrain. Participants must cover a total elevation gain of +650 m within 2 hours and 30 minutes. The participant limit is 200, and the start and finish are by the wooden shelters above Czarny Potok.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course with a total elevation gain of +650 m
Race along marked and unmarked hiking trails
Two checkpoints and water stations along the course
additional: The participant limit is 200, with the possibility of increasing it. The race office is open from 8:00 to 9:45. There are two checkpoints and water stations along the course. The time limit is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Participants must be at least 18 years old and have experience in mountain running. The entry fee must be paid within 48 hours of registration. If withdrawing, a refund of the entry fee is possible until 30.11.2026. The participant limit is 200, and the time limit is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Participation is for adults with experience running in challenging terrain. Registration is via raatiming.pl.

name: 10 Bieg Trzech Króli
description: The 10th Łódź Three Kings Run is a 5 km street race held on January 6, the Feast of the Epiphany. The start and finish are at Manufaktura Market Square, and the route runs through the streets of Łódź, including Piotrkowska Street. Join us to kick off the year with a sporting event in a festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square
5 km street route
The route includes Piotrkowska Street

name: Ultra CK Maraton
description: Ultra CK Marathon is a winter endurance event featuring running and cycling in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Participants can choose from three routes: a 51 km ultra run with substantial elevation gain, a fast 15 km mountain run, and a 30 km MTB ride. The ultra route passes through challenging, snow-covered forests and the freezing Piekło Cave, making it especially demanding and atmospheric. Held in harsh winter conditions, the event offers participants a true challenge and the satisfaction of conquering a hellish course.
course_highlights: Hellish Loop: 51 km ultra run with approximately 1,520 m of elevation gain through snow-covered forests and Piekło Cave
Devil’s Breath: 15 km fast mountain run with approximately 422 m of elevation gain on technical forest trails
Ghostly Thirty: 30 km MTB ride on wintery, slippery singletracks with approximately 828 m of elevation gain
additional: The race office is open on 5.01.2027 from 16:00 to 20:00 and on 6.01.2027 from 6:00 at Hala Legionów Kielce. Mandatory equipment for participants in the 51 km ultra run: a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, a charged mobile phone, proof of identity, and clothing suited to the weather conditions. Time limits apply at the individual checkpoints and at the finish. Ultra-run participants must carry safety equipment, including a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, and a charged phone.

name: 3 Maraton Alei Wielkiej Wyspy
location: Aleja Wielkiej Wyspy, Park Wschodni, Wrocław, Poland
description: The 3rd Great Island Avenue Marathon is a marathon held in Wrocław. The street course runs along Great Island Avenue, and the event is associated with East Park. It is an option for runners looking to take on the full marathon distance in an urban setting.
course_highlights: Street course in Wrocław
Run along Great Island Avenue
Located in the area of East Park

name: Grand Prix Trójmiasta 1/3
location: Brzeźno Pier (Molo w Gdańsku-Brzeźnie), Gdańsk, Poland
description: The 3 Kings Run is the first event in the 2027 Grand Prix of the Tri-City series, held on a 100% sandy beach course in Gdańsk-Brzeźno. The event includes a 6 km cross-country run and 6 km Nordic walking, with age categories and three-person team competitions requiring at least one woman. The event is small-scale, with a participant limit of 500, offering an intimate atmosphere and sporting competition on the scenic coast. The run starts at 9:00, and the winners’ awards ceremony will take place at around 11:30.
course_highlights: 100% beach course
6 km cross-country run
6 km Nordic walking
additional: The event office opens at 07:30. Three-person teams (for both the run and Nordic walking), with at least one woman, must register at the event office. Participant limit: 500. Participants can choose the 6 km cross-country run or Nordic walking. Three-person team competition is also available, with at least one woman on each team.

name: 10 Bieg III Króli
location: Hotel Barczyzna Medical Spa, Barczyzna, Nekla, Poland
description: The 10th Three Kings Run is a 10 km road race taking place on January 6, 2027, in Nekla. The event is an excellent opportunity to start the new year actively and check your running fitness. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using individual training plans tailored to their level. The race is moderately challenging and takes place on an asphalt course.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Moderate difficulty
Held in scenic Nekla
additional: Individual training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and supported by experts with detailed training instructions.

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and the Łyna River, close to Ruś. The winter scenery, forest trails and changing terrain create unique running conditions, giving runners a chance to test their fitness and enjoy the excitement of competition throughout the season. The event is for everyone who wants to spend their winter Saturdays actively, regardless of experience level. The organizers help make the event comfortable for participants by offering passes for the full series as well as the option to enter a single race.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish by the beach at the bend of the Łyna River in Stawiguda Municipality
Winter forest scenery with natural, changing terrain
additional: Mini Trail!ON children’s races are held over distances from 300 m to 1,000 m, with age-group divisions. Children’s races take place from 9:45 to 10:15. The race office closes at 10:30. An awards ceremony for the series winners and a bonfire with the Mayor are planned for the final race. Single-race entry can be purchased at the race office on race day. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. The program also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m, as well as winter swimming. Online registration is open until January 6, 2027, at 23:59.

name: Backyard Ultra Polska
location: Poligon Wojskowej Akademii Technicznej, Bemowo, Warsaw, Poland
description: Backyard Ultra Warszawa - Bemowo is the first edition of a backyard-format race, held on the grounds of the Military University of Technology training area in Warsaw. The course is 6,706 km long, in accordance with the worldwide backyard rules. The event lasts a maximum of 24 hours, during which runners complete successive loops. The participant limit is 80, and the winner receives cash prizes, a trophy, and gifts from partners. All participants receive a commemorative medal and certificate.
course_highlights: A 6,706 km course in accordance with the backyard rules
The race takes place on the grounds of the Military University of Technology training area in Warsaw
A time limit of 24 hours (24 loops)
additional: The participant limit is 80, with the possibility of an increase at the organizer’s discretion. The winner receives a cash prize, a trophy, and prizes from partners. The winner of the Polish Uniformed Services Open Championships receives a trophy and prizes. The top resident of the Bemowo district receives a statuette and prizes. The limit is 80 runners. Available entry-fee options include a “for fun” participation option of up to 7 loops and a discount for members of the Polish Ultra Sports Association and the Bemowo Biega group.

The event combines recreation and sport, promotes outdoor physical activity, and offers a friendly atmosphere for sporting competition. The series runs from October to April, and each race starts at 11:00. Participants can enter individually or purchase a season pass for the entire series in their city.
course_highlights: The course runs through Osobowicki Forest, a natural woodland area
A 5 km cross-country course in an urban forest
The series consists of four races in the 2026/2027 season

Participants can take part in a charity run in support of the Siepomaga Foundation. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, and the event ends at around 12:15. Cars cannot access the area near the start and race office; parking along Osobowicka Street is subject to traffic staff instructions.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic course in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The route follows a 5.15 km loop through forest, climbing the highest hill, Dziewicza Góra, twice. The races bring together runners of different ages and abilities across various distances, and also offer Nordic walking and races for children and young people. The organizers provide professional timing and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a unique “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event centre, where spectators can cheer on participants
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted chip band. Race office open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The races are held as a series of six stages. Children’s and youth races over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,500 m. The course is marked with orange ribbons and directional arrows. Participants in the 10 km race complete two loops; after the first loop, they cross the finish line and continue onto the second loop. The 2026–2027 season consists of six stages; passes for the whole series were also available.

name: Viva Las Natalin
description: Viva Las Natalin is the 3rd Carnival Run, held in the picturesque forests of Natalin and attracting running and Nordic walking enthusiasts from across the Mazovia region. The event takes place in a wintry setting, and participants start in colorful costumes, creating a unique, lively atmosphere. It is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. The event offers several distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking, with separate classifications for women and men.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forests of Natalin
Picturesque winter scenery
Carnival atmosphere with participants in colorful costumes
additional: The event is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. Participants can take part in 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking. Prizes are presented by the authorities of Wyszków Municipality. The event has a carnival theme, with participants wearing colorful costumes.

The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and sporting excitement.

Scenic winter setting in Strzyżewo

The race office and start are at the football pitch in Strzyżewo 46A. On race day, participant registration runs from 8:00 to 8:45.

The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering exciting competition and beautiful views. The organizers ensure professional race management and a rich program of additional events, including team classifications and relays. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and take on a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Routes of varying lengths: 3.7 km, 5.7 km, 11.6 km, 23.2 km, and the 1.5 km Vertical
Scenic mountain terrain in Kraków with varied courses
Special races for children, as well as team competitions and relays
additional: Races start at various times on Sunday, including 9:00 (Harda Dwudziestka Trójka), 9:10 and 9:20 (children’s races), 9:40 (Przyjazna Trójka), 10:45 (Tradycyjna Piątka), and 11:00 (Ambitna Jedenastka). description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The Szczecin course runs through beautiful woodland around Emerald Lake, with the start and finish behind the Szmaragd Inn. The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event aims to promote running and outdoor physical activity, and to offer the opportunity to compete on a permanent course.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Emerald Lake

Varied course profile with uphill and downhill sections

The race-day entry fee is higher (60 zł). The start is at 11:00. Registration is available online through the CITY TRAIL website or at the race office on race day.

name: XVIII Jelczańsko-Oławski Zimowy Maraton
location: Chwałowice, Oława County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 19th Jelczańsko-Oławski Toyota Winter Stage Marathon is a winter running event held in Chwałowice and nearby towns. It consists of seven stages, each approximately 7 km long, held on Sundays from January to February 2027. The event includes both running and Nordic walking. Race packs can be collected the day before the first stage. The organizers provide a mass start for all categories and allow race bibs to be collected by an authorized person.
course_highlights: Seven stages, each approximately 7 km long
The route passes through Chwałowice, Oława, Jelcz-Laskowice, Janików and Miłoszyce
A mass start for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: The race office will be open on 09.01.2027 in Oława (Termy Jakuba) from 17:00 to 18:00 and in Jelcz-Laskowice (City Hall) from 19:00 to 20:00. Race packs can be collected on the day of each stage at the start location from 9:00 to 10:30.

Stage IV in Oława is the Zygmunt Pawlik Memorial Run
Running and Nordic walking in one series
additional: Stage I: 10 January 2027 in Chwałowice, joint start for running and Nordic walking at 11:00. tiers.description: Biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe - do dnia 03.01.2027 r. – 35 zł płatne na konto w momencie zapisów

description: The 13th Winter Run as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP) will take place on January 10, 2027, in Krajkowo at the Riding Center IDMAR. The main race, covering approximately 10 km, starts at 12:00. Races for children and young people are also held over several shorter distances. The start, finish, and race village are inside the arena, providing comfortable conditions regardless of the weather. A public collection will be held in support of WOŚP, along with challenges and competitions for spectators, so there will be something for everyone.
course_highlights: Main race distance: approximately 10 km
Start and finish inside the Riding Center IDMAR arena in Krajkowo
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Race Office opening hours: January 8, 2027, in Mosina (17:00–20:00), and January 10, 2027, in Krajkowo (09:30–11:55). Participants can support WOŚP with voluntary donations when collecting their race packs. Challenges and competitions for spectators, as well as the HARPAGAN challenge, will also be held. The main race starts at 12:00. Registration is open until January 3, 2027; voluntary donations to WOŚP will be collected during race-pack collection.

name: 9 Świdnicki Bieg Noworoczny Zupbadura
description: The 9th Świdnica Zupbadura New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Świdnicka Grupa Biegowa Association. The race takes place in Świdnica, with the start and finish at the Zawiszów Sports Hall. It is a New Year’s event that attracts runners of varying experience levels, who train from the time they register until race day. The event has a friendly atmosphere and promotes physical activity and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Zawiszów Sports Hall, ul. Galla Anonim 1, Świdnica
The race takes place in the center of Świdnica
Training from registration until race day is taken into account
additional: The race office is open at the Zawiszów Sports Hall on race day from 8:00 to 11:30. Training from registration until race day is taken into account. For the 9th edition, registration and race-pack collection took place at the Zawiszów Sports Hall, ul. Galla Anonima 1, on race day from 8:00 to 11:30.

name: Bieszczadzki Bieg Lotników
location: Trasy biegowe im. Stanisława Nahajowskiego, Ustjanowa Górna, Poland
description: The Bieszczady Aviators’ Run is an annual race held on the Stanisław Nahajowski running trails in Ustjanowa Górna. The event attracts runners seeking mountain challenges and beautiful views. The Górskie Loty half-marathon course is demanding, with significant elevation gain, making the race an unforgettable experience for participants. The race has a long tradition and is an important sporting event in the Bieszczady region.
course_highlights: The 21 km Górskie Loty half-marathon course
Mountain elevation gain and steep sections
Beautiful views of the Bieszczady Mountains
additional: The race takes place on the running trails named after [incomplete in the source]. The half-marathon course is new for 2025 and features significant elevation gain. The event is held under the patronage and with the support of the Regional Directorate of State Forests in Krosno. Past editions have taken place in both summer and winter, and the event has also included Nordic walking marches. The race commemorates Ustjanowa Górna’s aviation traditions and Stanisław Nahajowski.

name: Górski Bieg Nawoja
location: Nawojowa Góra, Krzeszowice, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Górski Bieg Nawoja is a mountain race held in Nawojowa Góra, showcasing the natural attractions and surroundings of Górzanka. The race takes place on 3 km and 7 km courses marked with arrows and tape, with distance-to-finish markers. The event is held regularly and is supported by local institutions and sponsors. Participants can use the on-site refreshment point, changing rooms, and toilets.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of 3 km and 7 km
Marked with arrows and white-and-red tape on more difficult sections
Distance-to-finish markers every kilometre
additional: Race office located at the LKS Górzanka sports field in Nawojowa Góra, with parking for participants. Changing rooms, toilets, and a refreshment point are available at the office. Race materials will be distributed from 10:00 to 10:50. The 7 km race starts at 11:00 and the 3 km race at 11:01. The race ends at 12:30.

name: V Dziki Cross 2026 – Edycja I
description: Dziki Cross is a winter series of trail races in the Kozienice Landscape Park, organised by the Biegiem Radom! association. The organiser describes it as a training run with technical support. Edition I starts from the forest car park in Kozłów. There is a 10 km run, a half marathon and a 10 km Nordic walking march.
course_highlights: Forest routes in the Kozienice Landscape Park
Half marathon, 10 km and 10 km Nordic walking
Overall classification for the whole series
additional: In 2026 the half marathon and Nordic walking started at 10:00 and the 10 km at 11:00. Edition I cost 30 PLN online and 40 PLN on the day. Time limits were 3 hours for the half marathon and 2 hours for the 10 km and Nordic walking. Medals for all finishers. There is no medical cover.

name: VII Żniński Bieg Powstańczy
description: The VII Żnin Uprising Run is a 5 km race taking place in Żnin. The course is flat and paved, with one small hill and a turnaround halfway through. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street, near the tennis courts. The race is organized by the Jedynka Association and is limited to 200 participants.
course_highlights: 5 km course measured by GPS
Flat paved course with one small hill
Turnaround 2.5 km from the start
additional: The race is limited to 200 participants. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street in Żnin, near the tennis courts (property number 14). The payment title must include the participant’s first name, surname, and year of birth.

name: X Zimowe Grand Prix Zadyszki
location: ul. Kamieniec, near the animal shelter, Oświęcim, Poland
description: The 10th Zadyszka Winter Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Oświęcim Running Club “Zadyszka,” which promotes running as a healthy and active lifestyle. The club brings together recreational runners who value community and the joy of movement, regardless of their experience level. The events take place in the scenic surroundings of Oświęcim, where participants can expect a welcoming atmosphere and support from the local running community. The club also organizes meetups and social events that help build a strong running community.
course_highlights: Routes in the area around Kamieniec Street, near the animal shelter in Oświęcim
Scenic surroundings well suited to recreation and active leisure
A sense of community and support among local runners
additional: The club holds meetups on the first Wednesday of every month at 17:00 at MOSiR, ul. Legionów 15, Oświęcim. An event calendar, updated regularly, is available on the website. The club promotes recreational running and brings together the local running community. For the 2025/2026 edition, registration took place on race day from 10:00 to 10:45, and the races started at 11:00.

name: XIII Bieg Zimowego Dziadka
description: The XIII Winter Grandfather Run is a friendly 10 km race held on the Kuchary Forest District running route. The route is fully marked and has limited vehicular traffic, ensuring participants’ safety. The time limit for completing the course is 90 minutes. The event starts with a warm-up, followed by an awards ceremony and refreshments for participants after the race.
course_highlights: Kuchary Forest District running route
Fully marked 10 km course
Limited vehicular traffic on the route
additional: Registration takes place from 10:00 to 10:30 on race day. There is a warm-up before the 10:30 start. The participant limit is 120. The awards ceremony and refreshments take place after the race, at around 12:30. The entry fee was PLN 40 when registering in advance and PLN 50 on the day of the event, and the participant limit was 120.

name: Zimowa Piątka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Zimowa Piątka is an annual race organized by the Suwałki Sports and Recreation Centre, held by Arkadia Reservoir. It is a unique opportunity to kick off the winter season with an active outing in the picturesque surroundings of Suwałki, known for its harsh climate and beautiful landscapes. The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting competition among residents and visitors. For years, OSiR Suwałki has ensured the professional organization of sporting events, providing participants with comfort and safety.
course_highlights: The race route follows a picturesque course around Arkadia Reservoir
The winter scenery of Suwałki, with its characteristic cold climate
A well-prepared and marked route suited to runners of different abilities
additional: In previous editions, the race was part of Stacja Pogodne Suwałki, whose program also included a Nordic walking event and a children's race. Participants in Zimowa Piątka could take part in carnival costumes.

name: Zimowy Bieg Niedzwiedzia
location: Nowy Dębiec, Kościan County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kościanie
description: The Winter Bear Run in Nowy Dębiec is an annual running event organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Center. The race takes place at the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec, giving participants the chance to compete in scenic surroundings. The event is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix, promoting active recreation and community integration.
course_highlights: The course runs through the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec
Scenic areas by the lake
Organized as part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix
additional: The event is organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Center. The race is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix series. The resort has a swimming area, beach, and sports fields in Nowy Dębiec. Cash prizes were awarded in previous editions.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski
description: The Świętokrzyski Winter Marathon is a mountain challenge held in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, in the town of Chęciny. The event brings together runs, hikes and run-walks, giving participants the opportunity to discover the region’s beautiful, scenic landscapes. For years, the organizers have promoted outdoor activity and mountain tourism by creating and restoring hiking trails. This event is for those who enjoy long-distance challenges and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Scenic landscapes and natural hiking trails
Routes suitable for running, hiking and run-walks
additional: The organizers also restore and promote hiking trails in the region. The event is part of a broader range of outdoor activities in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Aid and checkpoint stations are available to participants, as is the option to download a GPX file with the routes. The event is aimed at runners and hikers taking on challenging winter conditions.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful, wooded settings in city parks, including Młociński Park in Warsaw. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the required permission. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish in Warsaw are in Młociny Forest, and the course stays the same, allowing results to be compared over the years.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the wooded setting of Młociński Park
The start is about 1.5 km from the finish, which is on a clearing in Młociny Forest
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. In Warsaw, the warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:30. The course stays the same throughout the season. Parking nearby is limited, so using public transport is recommended. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. A pass for four races at one location is also available.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich

price_tiers.distance: Bieg dorosłych 5 km i 10 km oraz Nordic Walking

tiers.description: 84zł – w przypadku rejestracji w ostatni wtorek, środę i czwartek przed zawodami.
