description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series consists of six races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park near Czerwonak. The event offers a variety of distances: 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. The course follows forest paths and climbs twice to the park’s highest peak, Dziewicza Góra. The event promotes physical activity, community integration, and nature conservation in the region.
course_highlights: A fully forested 5.15 km loop course
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the highest point in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park
The course passes through the event centre about 3.7 km after the start, allowing spectators to cheer on participants
additional: Children’s and youth races are held over distances of 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,500 m, with separate starts from 9:00 to 9:45. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Race-day registration is available only until 10:00 and only for the adult races and walk. Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. After the course exits the forest, the finish-area layout separates participants finishing the race from those continuing on to their second lap. The series programme also includes a Nordic Walking event and races for children and young people. Online registration is available through the form on the organiser’s website.

name: Ultramaraton Annogórski
description: The Annogórski Winter Ultramarathon is a challenging mountain race held on Góra Świętej Anny in January 2027. Runners can choose from four distances: 21 km, 30 km, 50 km, and 70 km, taking them through scenic winter terrain. The event is organized by Grupa KAPIJA Sport Zdzieszowice and attracts fans of ultrarunning and winter challenges. The race office opens the day before the start, and timing is electronic.
course_highlights: Mountain routes ranging from 21 to 70 km
Scenic winter landscapes of Góra Świętej Anny
Electronic timing for all distances
additional: The race office is open on 15 January 2027 from 16:00 to 18:00 and on 16 January from 5:30. The rules and GPX route files are available to download. The organizers note that additional fees may apply for optional extras during registration. The race office will be open on 15 January from 16:00 to 18:00 and on 16 January from 5:30. The organizer’s website provides the rules, GPX route files, and registration form.

name: XI Eko Cross po Ziemi Pietrowickiej
location: Szkoła Podstawowa, ul. M. Konopnickiej 28, Pietrowice Wielkie
description: Eko Cross po Ziemi Pietrowickiej is a 10 km race in Pietrowice Wielkie near Racibórz. The 11th edition is on Saturday 16 January 2027 at 11:00, with start and finish at the primary school. The course is one hilly loop on asphalt, gravel roads and field paths. The race also serves as a championship for uniformed services, Eko Okna employees and local residents.
course_highlights: One hilly 10 km loop
Start and finish by the race office at the school
Medal, hot meal and prize draw
additional: The race office at the primary school opens from 09:00 to 10:30. Time limit 90 minutes, capped at 250 paid entries, minimum age 18. Entry fee 60 PLN until 20 December 2026, 80 PLN until 14 January 2027 and 100 PLN on the day if places remain. Online entry closes on 14 January 2027 at 23:59. Prize giving and a quiz at 13:00.

name: Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race Stary Wilk
description: Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race is a winter running festival taking place on January 16, 2027, in Gdynia. The event offers six distances of varying difficulty, from 5 km to over 76 km, with significant elevation gains and challenging courses. The race combines sporting competition with the beauty of the Kashubian landscape, offering participants unforgettable views and excitement. The organizers provide professional timing, checkpoints, and course support, as well as transport to the start for selected distances.
course_highlights: Courses with significant elevation gains: Nocny Jeleń +2309 m, Tropem Rysia +1501 m
Start and finish at the Gdynia Sports Centre - National Rugby Stadium
Refreshment and hydration points on courses longer than 10 km
additional: Participants are transported to the start by buses from the Gdynia Sports Centre - National Rugby Stadium (paid transport; registration required). Cutoff times: Nocny Jeleń 15 hours, Tropem Rysia 11 hours. Electronic chip timing and mandatory checkpoints. Refreshment and hydration points on courses longer than 10 km. DZIKI DUET is run in pairs.

name: 17 Chrustowski Bieg Zimowy
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. Bronisława Malinowskiego, Chrustowo, Gmina Oborniki, Poland
description: The Chrustowo Winter Run is the oldest running event in the Oborniki municipality, held since 2007. The 12 km main race passes through the picturesque villages of Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka and Ślepuchowo, while accompanying races for primary school pupils take place on courses suited to their age. The event promotes physical activity and brings the local community together. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. Prizes are also awarded to the top finishers in the OPEN and age categories.
course_highlights: The 12 km main race passes through Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka and Ślepuchowo
Accompanying races for children and young people on courses suited to their age categories
Picturesque surroundings and a wintry atmosphere make for an active start to the year
additional: The main race is limited to 200 participants. The race package includes a commemorative medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut and water. The top finishers receive statuettes or trophies. The children’s accompanying races start at 11:05, immediately after the main race begins. In the 2026 edition, the main race was scheduled to start at the Bronisław Malinowski Primary School in Chrustowo; the limit was 200 participants. This information refers to the previous edition.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by a group of running enthusiasts. The events take place in scenic locations, with a particular focus on the visual appeal of the courses, often in botanical gardens and green spaces. The Łódź race takes place in the Botanical Garden, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The organizers promote running and create a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden in Łódź
Scenic surroundings and attractive green spaces
Courses suited to runners of different abilities
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las from Poznań. The events are cross-country races held at various locations in Greater Poland and other cities. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrates its 10th anniversary. The organizers encourage people to subscribe to the newsletter to stay up to date with events. Children’s races are also held at the Łódź editions.

name: Dziki w Ogniu & Sztafety Ogniomistrza
location: OSP fire station, Spręcowo, Dywity, Poland
organizer: Gmina Dywity, OSP z terenu gminy Dywity i Gminne Dywickie Zrzeszenie LZS
price_range: 30-40 zł za bieg indywidualny; sztafeta bezpłatnie
description: Dziki w Ogniu & Sztafety Ogniomistrza is a winter cross-country race held in Spręcowo, Dywity municipality. The approximately 6 km course runs entirely along forest roads and tracks. It is very challenging, with numerous climbs and natural terrain obstacles. The event includes an individual race and relays for members of volunteer and state fire services (OSP/PSP). The start and finish are at the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The race takes place in January and is a sporting and recreational event, with manual timekeeping and a commemorative medal for participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 6 km, entirely along forest roads and tracks
Challenging cross-country course with numerous climbs and natural obstacles
Start and finish at the OSP fire station in Spręcowo
additional: Race office hours are 9:00–10:30 at the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The individual race is limited to 100 participants, with additional on-site registration available for 20 runners. Timekeeping is manual; start chips must be returned at the finish. Proceeds from additional registrations support the 34th WOŚP Grand Finale. In previous editions, the relay was for teams of six firefighters.

name: Run in Sopot - 1 etap
location: Sopot Beach, Entrance No. 23 by Sopot Pier, Sopot, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie
description: Run in Sopot is a series of running events held on Sopot’s beach and around the Forest Opera. The first stage is a unique opportunity to test yourself on sandy coastal terrain. The race is open to runners of different ages and ability levels, and participants also compete in the overall standings for cash prizes. This sporting event combines physical activity with the beauty of Sopot’s coastline, creating a welcoming atmosphere for families and running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Beach run at entrance no. 23 by the Sopot Pier
Coastal route with views of the Baltic Sea
Sandy terrain and seaside atmosphere
additional: The #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series includes three beach-running events and an additional round around the Forest Opera. Participants can use the Sopot Card, which reduces the entry fee. The event is open to all and family-friendly, with cash prizes in the overall standings. The limit was 250 participants. Sopot Card holders paid 40 zł, the standard fee was 49 zł, and participants aged 65+ were exempt from the fee. A medal, hot drinks, and a hot meal were provided at the finish.

name: WOŚPowa 5
description: WOŚPowa 5 is a 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Dąbki during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The start and finish are located at the Water Sports Centre. The event combines sporting competition with a worthy cause, encouraging participants to support WOŚP with voluntary donations. Shorter races of 200, 400 and 800 metres are also planned for children, making the event appealing to the whole family. Join us to celebrate sport and helping others together.
course_highlights: The main 5 km race starts and finishes at the Water Sports Centre
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m and 800 m
A scenic route in the spa town of Dąbki
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary donation to the WOŚP collection box. The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale, combining sport with charitable support. The start and finish are located at the Water Sports Centre in Dąbki. Donations collected at the previous edition were given to the 33rd WOŚP Grand Finale.

name: IV Zimowy Bieg Chrząszcza
description: The 4th Winter Chrząszcz Run is a winter running event held in Szczebrzeszyn, with Kawęczynek listed as the start or event location. The race is an opportunity to spend time actively amid the winter scenery around Szczebrzeszyn. Running calendars list the distance as 10 km, although route details are not available in the sources used.
course_highlights: Winter run in the area around Szczebrzeszyn
Event location: Szczebrzeszyn - Kawęczynek
10 km distance listed by running calendars

name: Rajd Beskidy Winter
description: Rajd Beskidy Winter is a challenging adventure race held near Żywiec, featuring a range of disciplines including MTB, trekking, climbing, and skiing. The event offers several distances, including 150 km with a ski stage, 70 km, and 50 km and 25 km hiking marathons. The route runs through the Silesian and Żywiec Beskids, combining forested and open terrain, with numerous checkpoints and special tasks. The start and event base are in Pewel Ślemieńska. Depending on the distance, participants compete in two-person teams or individually.
course_highlights: The 150 km route has 3,700 m of elevation gain and is divided into 6 stages of varying character
The approximately 25 km ski stage can be completed on ski touring skis, cross-country skis, or on foot
Varied terrain: forested and mountainous areas, low-traffic paved roads, and forest trails
additional: Start and event base: Primary School, ul. Krakowska 169, 34-331 Pewel Ślemieńska. Two-person teams of any gender may enter the 150 km and 70 km distances; individual entries are permitted for the 70 km. Schedule: registration from 15:00, map distribution at 18:00, race briefing at 19:00, start at 20:00. The time limit for the 150 km race is 24 hours, with the awards ceremony at around 20:00 the following day. The 150 km route includes MTB, trekking, climbing, and skiing, along with special tasks and navigation. Teams return to the base after stages III, IV, V, and VI. Route and event-base information is from the 2026 edition.

name: XVII Bieg o Puchar Burmistrza Miasta Pszów
description: The 17th Run for the Mayor of Pszów Cup is an annual running event organized by the Pszów City Hall. The race attracts participants of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and integration within the local community. The event takes place on a course in Pszów and combines sport and recreation with competition for the Mayor’s Cup. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities and celebrate sport together in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main race: 12 km
Course in Pszów
additional: A total of 156 runners took part in the 12 km race.

name: IV Pogórzański Bieg Górski
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Burzynie, Burzyn, Poland
description: The 4th Pogórzański Mountain Run is a mountain race of approximately 21 km with around 800 m of elevation gain, held in Burzyn. The course is hilly, running approximately 70% through forest and 30% on asphalt. There are three aid stations along the course, and the time limit is 240 minutes. The start, finish and race office are located at the Primary School in Burzyn, where changing rooms, baggage storage and showers are also available. The race has an overall classification for women and men, as well as age categories.
course_highlights: Approximately 21 km with around 800 m of elevation gain
Hilly course: 70% forest trails and 30% asphalt
3 aid stations along the course (5 km, 12 km, 19 km)
additional: The race office is open from 7:30 to 10:00 in the Sports Hall at the Primary School in Burzyn. Changing rooms, baggage storage and showers are available on site. Race packs may be collected on another participant’s behalf provided a signed authorization is presented. The course is marked every 1 km; timing is electronic. The time limit is 240 minutes, and the awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 14:30–15:00. Changing rooms, baggage storage and showers are available at the Primary School in Burzyn; an overall classification for women and men and age categories are held.

name: 9 Miński Bieg Biegiem dla WOŚP
description: The 9th Mińsk Biegiem dla WOŚP Run is an annual 10 km road race held in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event is charitable and offers an excellent opportunity to support the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity through sport. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the streets of Mińsk Mazowiecki
Asphalt course of moderate difficulty
Charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to participants’ VDOT levels. Expert support is available during preparation. The organizer encourages the use of its platform for managing the race listing and marketing collaboration.

name: Bieg Dobrego Serca
organizer: Grupa ExtremeJura i Biegaj z Żarkami
description: Bieg Dobrego Serca is a charity race in Jaroszów in the Żarki municipality. Entry fees go to children with disabilities at the local community self-help centre and rehabilitation centre in Żarki. The main race is 12 km (two 6 km laps), and there is also a 6 km recreational run and a 6 km Nordic walking march. The course is cross-country through forest and meadows. It is organised by Grupa ExtremeJura and Biegaj z Żarkami.
course_highlights: 6 km loop through Jura forests and meadows
Children's races
All entry fees go to charity
additional: In 2026 the start and race centre were at the Jaroszów community hall. Children's races started at 10:30, the runs at 10:40 and Nordic walking at 10:41. The entry donation was at least 30 PLN online and 50 PLN on the day.

name: Zamieć 24h
description: ZAMIEĆ 2027 is an extreme winter mountain ultramarathon held in the Beskids, on a route leading to the summit of Skrzyczne (1,257 m above sea level). The race is a demanding 24-hour challenge in which participants complete a 14.12 km loop multiple times, facing winter conditions such as snow, wind and frost. There are three distances to choose from: the full 24 hours, 12 hours and 6 hours, allowing participants to tailor the challenge to their abilities. The race takes place in Szczyrk, with the start and finish at the Amphitheatre on Wypoczynkowa Street. The organizer provides professional support, warm refreshment points, a commemorative medal and accident insurance.
course_highlights: A 14.12 km route with significant elevation gain to the summit of Skrzyczne (1,257 m above sea level)
Start and finish at the Amphitheatre in Szczyrk, on a mountain loop with refreshment points
Extreme winter conditions: snow, wind and frost
additional: All distances take place simultaneously on 22–23 January 2027. Participants receive a commemorative medal and have access to warm refreshment points. Places are limited. Registration is available at bgtimesport.pl. The Zamieć series also offers 12-hour and 6-hour races.

name: 11 Górski Zimowy Maraton Ślężański
description: The Górski Zimowy Maraton Ślężański is a challenging mountain race held in Sobótka, covering 42.6 km with approximately 1,130 m of elevation gain. A half marathon is also held as part of the event, covering 23.9 km with approximately 575 m of elevation gain. The course runs through scenic mountain terrain, offering participants unique challenges and beautiful views. The event has a long-standing tradition and is popular among mountain runners.
course_highlights: Marathon distance: 42.6 km with ±1,130 m of elevation gain
Half marathon distance: 23.9 km with ±575 m of elevation gain
Mountain course with scenic views and a challenging profile
additional: The event includes two races: a marathon and a half marathon. The attendance record is 714 people (2020). The marathon and half-marathon course records are listed with the athletes’ names and times. GPX routes are available for both distances. The event’s Facebook page provides a GPX track of the course.

name: Zimowy Półmaraton Gór Stołowych
location: Centrum Szkoleniowo-Edukacyjne Parku Narodowego Gór Stołowych, Karłów, Poland
description: The Stołowe Mountains Winter Half Marathon is a challenging 21 km mountain race held in winter conditions in the scenic Stołowe Mountains. The route follows hiking trails with numerous rocks, turns and significant elevation gains. It is often covered in snow and ice, requiring participants to be in good shape and have sound technique. The start and finish are located at the Stołowe Mountains National Park Training and Education Centre and the Shelter on Szczeliniec, which can be reached only under your own power. The race is part of a series of mountain running events and takes place whatever the weather, with mandatory equipment and environmental rules.
course_highlights: The route follows hiking trails in Poland’s Stołowe Mountains
Significant elevation gains, many rocks and turns, and potentially heavy snow and ice
The finish is at the Shelter on Szczeliniec, accessible only on foot
additional: The time limit for completing the route is 5 hours. There are 2 checkpoints with refreshment stations and time cutoffs: Parking under Szczeliniec (6.7 km, cutoff 2:30 hours) and Błędne Skały (13.6 km, cutoff 4:00 hours). Participants may use snowshoes. Race packs can be collected at the Stołowe Mountains National Park Training and Education Centre in Karłów on Friday and Saturday morning. After the race, a recovery meal, an awards ceremony and a prize draw for prizes from partners are planned. Deposits weighing up to 3 kg can be left at the finish, but valuables and documents must not be left. The start is at 09:00; the finish time limit is 5 hours. Snow and ice may occur on the route in winter; snowshoes are permitted. There are two checkpoints on the route with refreshment stations and time cutoffs.

name: X Ultra River Ultra Świder - zima
location: Baza kajakowa River Squad, ul. Mlądzka 46a, Otwock
description: Ultra River Ultra Świder is a winter adventure running event organised by the Ultra River Foundation. The 10th winter edition is on Saturday 23 January 2027, based at the River Squad kayak centre in Otwock, where the finish is. There is no competition, timing or classification. The routes mostly run through the forests of the Mazovian Landscape Park and along the Świder and Piaseczna rivers.
course_highlights: Forest routes along the Świder and Piaseczna rivers
Distances of about 11, 21, 35 and 50 km
Hot soup and grill at the finish
additional: The 35+ and 50+ km routes start away from the base, with buses leaving around 07:30 and the start around 08:30. The 21+ and 11+ km routes start around 10:00 from the base in Mlądz. Fees: 199 PLN (50+ km), 179 PLN (35+ km), 159 PLN (21+ km), 129 PLN (11+ km). Entry via dostartu.pl until 18 January 2027. A phone with the route loaded, a cup, enough fluids and a foil blanket are required. No age limit; minors must run with an adult.

name: 6 Nocny Maraton / Półmaraton
organizer: Klub Sportowy Ultra Team Łódź i Fundacja Wybiegaj Marzenia
description: The 6th Night Marathon and Half Marathon with the Ultra Team in Łagiewnicki Forest is a unique running event organized by runners for runners. The race takes place in the scenic Łagiewnicki Forest in Łódź, offering participants a nighttime atmosphere and a memorable running experience. It is a great opportunity to test yourself on a marathon or half-marathon course surrounded by nature. The event has become a tradition and is attracting growing interest among runners from the region.
course_highlights: The course runs through scenic Łagiewnicki Forest
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
Organized by the experienced Ultra Team—runners for runners
additional: According to the available information, the participant limit is 250: 170 for the half marathon and 80 for the marathon. The program includes a race pack, a hot meal, prizes for the women's and men's overall categories, and a medal for every participant.

name: 20 Bieg WOŚP Policz się z cukrzycą
description: The 20th WOŚP “Count Yourself in with Diabetes” Run is the Warsaw edition of the charity run organized as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity finale. The event combines exercise and running together with support for WOŚP’s fundraising goal. It invites people who want to take an active part in the finale campaign.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic
description: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński is a small marathon in Chwałowice, started by local runner Arek Tołłoczko together with Rafał Malitkowski. The race is part of a cycle of four marathons held in winter, spring, summer and autumn. The course follows forest and field roads around the village, with the Napoleon Stone as its landmark. The organizers stress a friendly atmosphere, no crowds and a relaxed approach to competition.
course_highlights: 42.195 km marathon on forest and rural roads
Course passes the Napoleon Stone
Loop marked out by the Harcownik running club
additional: The running loop in Chwałowice is 7 km long, with start and finish on Polna street and every kilometre marked. Parking is available nearby. Registration runs through elektronicznezapisy.pl.

name: X Zabrzański Bieg dla WOŚP
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 15 im. ks. Jana Dzierżona, ul. Czołgistów 1, Zabrze, Poland
organizer: Sztab WOŚP Zabrze oraz Bieg Pluszaka działający przy Stowarzyszeniu Wielka Flota Zjednoczonych Sił
description: The 11th Zabrze Run for WOŚP is an annual sporting event organized by the WOŚP Zabrze Team and Bieg Pluszaka, part of the Wielka Flota Zjednoczonych Sił Association. The run takes place on January 30, 2027, in Zabrze, at Primary School No. 15 named after Rev. Jan Dzierżon. Participants can choose between two distances: 3 km and 6 km (two 3 km laps). The event is charitable and inclusive, welcoming runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: 3 km and 6 km routes (two 3 km laps)
Start and finish at Primary School No. 15 in Zabrze
Charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: The run takes place from 10:00 to 15:00. The event is inclusive and charitable and is held on school grounds. It will take place on January 30, 2027, at Primary School No. 15 named after Rev. Jan Dzierżon, ul. Czołgistów 1. There is no age limit for participation.

name: XII Zimowy Maraton Bieszczadzki
description: The 13th Bieszczady Winter Marathon is a winter mountain race taking place in Cisna on 23 January 2027. Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, 26/28 km, and 42/44 km, with routes adapted to weather conditions and snow cover. The races start from designated points, and the course runs through the scenic Bieszczady Mountains, featuring challenging climbs and descents. Participants can expect refreshment points with drinks and snacks, as well as shared transport to the start for the 10 km distance. The finish closes at 15:30, and the organizer provides professional support and attractive race packages.
course_highlights: Mountain routes of 10 km, 26/28 km, and 42/44 km, with a total elevation gain and loss of up to 860 m
A route adapted to winter conditions, with alternative versions in the event of heavy snow cover
Refreshment points along the course with water, tea, and snacks
additional: The 42/44 km and 26/28 km races start at 7:00 at the school in Cisna. The 10 km race starts at 8:40 in Przysłup, with coach transport from Cisna at 8:00 (participants cannot make their own way to the start). Participants must bring their own cups or bottles for the refreshment points. The time limit for completing the course is when the finish closes at 15:30. Safety and hygiene rules in force at the time apply during the race. The start is scheduled for 7:00. The race office is located at the school in Cisna, Cisna 58; it will be open on 22 January 2027 from 17:00 to 22:00 and on 23 January from 6:00 to 9:30.

name: XIII Karnawałowy Bieg Górski Pielgrzym
description: The 13th Carnival Mountain Run Pielgrzym is a challenging 10 km mountain race taking place in Leśnica. The event is an excellent opportunity to test yourself on a demanding trail course, ideal for fans of mountain challenges. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The race takes place in a winter setting, which adds to its unique character and appeal.
course_highlights: A challenging 10 km mountain trail course
Winter scenery in Leśnica
A challenge for runners who prefer demanding terrain
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including training instructions and expert support. The date shown in calendars is approximate; the date listed there, January 24, 2027, differs from the event date provided.

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 3/5
description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of cross-country races held in the picturesque Pietrasze Forest in Białystok. The course is entirely natural and highly varied, featuring forest trails, uphill and downhill sections, and different surfaces such as forest floor, grass, sand, and mud. The race requires versatility and good fitness from participants, with volunteers and lead cyclists present along the course. After the race, participants can socialize over music, doughnuts, and tea, adding to the event’s friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A course entirely on varied, natural forest terrain
Numerous climbs and descents, with a total elevation gain of 140 m+
The course is marked with blue-and-white tape, with lead cyclists and volunteers present
additional: Race packs are distributed from 8:30 to 9:30 at Primary School No. 32 named after Major Henryk Dobrzański, nom de guerre Hubal, at ul. Pietrasze 29. Before the start, a warm-up with a trainer and music takes place from 9:40 to 9:50. After the race, a music event and social gathering with doughnuts and tea continue until 12:00. Participants start from the start zones, where race numbers are checked by officials at 9:55. The series includes multiple races on different dates, with online registration available. Participants can look forward to a sporting atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of running events organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club and held in a friendly, social-sporting spirit. The event is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to stay active on trails during the challenging autumn and winter months. Participants run a marathon or a multiple of the 10.5 km loop. Races take place in different towns from October to March. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and invite all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 10.5 km loop
Trail running in autumn and winter conditions
Choose to run a marathon or a multiple of the loop
additional: Dwumaraton Olęderski takes place over a series of weekends from October to March, each in a different town. Races start at 10:00, and the race office opens an hour earlier. The time limit for the first race is 16:00 and for the second race, 15:00. The minimum distance is 10.5 km. The events are co-funded by Nowy Tomyśl County and held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. The date of January 17, 2027, is taken from the running calendar.

name: XVIII Jelczańsko-Oławski Zimowy Maraton ...
description: The 19th Jelczańsko-Oławski Toyota Winter Marathon in Stages is a series of seven races, each 7.033 km long, held at different locations around Jelcz-Laskowice and Oława. The event combines running and Nordic walking, with a shared start and electronic timing. Participants can collect their race packets the day before the first stage or on race day. The event is organized by KB Harcownik Jelcz-Laskowice and supported by local authorities and partners, including Toyota Motor Manufacturing Poland.
course_highlights: Seven stages, each 7.033 km long
Courses in different localities: Chwałowice, Oława, Jelcz-Laskowice, Janików, Miłoszyce
Nordic walking and running starts with electronic timing
additional: A race packet may be collected by an authorized person presenting a printed and signed form. Collection the day before the start is recommended, at Termy Jakuba in Oława or at Jelcz-Laskowice City Hall. Nordic walking and running starts take place at 11:00, with Nordic walking starting 30 minutes earlier from the second stage onward. On race day, the race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 before the first stage and from 10:00 before subsequent stages. For the date January 31, 2027, the source lists Stage III of the 19th edition, not the 18th edition. Nordic walking is scheduled for 10:30 and the run for 11:00.

name: Zimowa Zawierucha
organizer: Urząd Miasta i Gminy Działoszyn, Atelier Sportu, Wieluń Biega, Klub Biegacza Warta
description: Zimowa Zawierucha is a winter race in Bobrowniki in the Działoszyn municipality. It takes place on Sunday 24 January 2027, with start and finish for all distances at the Bobrowniki fire station (OSP). Runners can choose a half marathon or a 5 km run, and there is also a 5 km Nordic walking event. The course mostly follows forest paths, partly stony, with natural obstacles and some asphalt.
course_highlights: Half marathon, 5 km run and 5 km Nordic walking
Forest paths, partly stony
Shared start and finish at OSP Bobrowniki
additional: All distances start at 11:00; the race office is open from 08:00 to 10:30. Time limits: half marathon 3 hours, 5 km 1.5 hours, Nordic walking 2 hours. Entry fee 50 PLN for the first entrants, 60 PLN until 20 January 2027 and 80 PLN on race day. Online entries close on 20 January 2027 at 23:59. Limits: 150 in the half marathon, 100 in the 5 km and 100 in Nordic walking. The half marathon is for adults only. Entry includes a medal and a hot meal after the race.

name: VII Zimowy Bieg po Zdrój
description: The Winter Run to the Spa is an annual running event held at the sports complex in Jaworze. The race attracts runners of all ages, offering a winter route that combines roads and trails. Participants can expect professional organization and the option to download the route in GPX format for navigation devices. The race is a great opportunity to spend an active winter day in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: A winter route combining roads and trails
Option to download the route in GPX format
Held at the sports complex in Jaworze
additional: Age categories: M20 (16–29 years), M30 (30–39 years), M60 (60+ years). Race packs can be collected from the Race Office at the sports complex on Koralowa Street, in the tents. Downloading the GPX route to navigation devices is recommended.

name: X Zimowy Półmaraton / Ćwierćmaraton Łękn...
location: Wigwam przy Leśniczówce Łękno, gmina Zaniemyśl
description: The 10th Winter Quarter Marathon and Half Marathon Łękno are winter races in the Łękno forest district in the Zaniemyśl municipality. They take place on Sunday 24 January 2027. Runners choose a 10.55 km quarter marathon or a 21.1 km half marathon, both on soft forest paths and tracks. Start, finish and race office are at the Wigwam by the Łękno forester's lodge.
course_highlights: 10.55 km quarter marathon and 21.1 km half marathon
Soft forest paths and tracks
Medal for every finisher
additional: The race office opens at 08:00. The quarter marathon starts at 09:30 and the half marathon at 10:00. The time limit is 3 hours on both distances. The fee is the same for both: 79 PLN until 30 November 2026, 89 PLN in December, 99 PLN until 10 January 2027, 109 PLN until 20 January 2027 and 120 PLN on the day if places remain. Online entries close on 20 January 2027 at 23:59. The limit is 300 paid entrants in total. There is a water point on the course and refreshments after the race.

name: 10 Bieg Pobiegnij z WOŚP
description: The 10th Run with WOŚP in Ostrów Wielkopolski is an annual running event held under the patronage of the WOŚP Ostrów Wielkopolski Branch. The race covers 10 km and is charitable in nature, combining sporting competition with a community initiative. It takes place in January, and participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to train and compete together. On race day, the organizer provides an information point at Plażowa Restaurant.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer road race
Charitable event supporting WOŚP
Race in Ostrów Wielkopolski
additional: Training sessions count from the time of registration until race day. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or additional equipment. The race calendar gives January 25, 2027, as an approximate date.

name: 13 Bieg Wielkich Serc
location: Bulwar Kurlandzki near Galeria Kazimierz, Kraków, Poland
organizer: Sztab Wielkiej Orkiestry Świątecznej Pomocy #7702 przy Hufcu ZHP Kraków-Podgórze
description: The 13th Bieg Wielkich Serc is an annual running event held in Kraków on the Kurlandzki Boulevard near Galeria Kazimierz. The race is a charity event associated with the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. Participants can expect a special atmosphere and the opportunity to support a worthy cause through a sporting event. The organizers provide a baggage drop at Galeria Kazimierz, but there are no changing rooms for participants.
course_highlights: The route follows Kurlandzki Boulevard in Kraków
Start and finish near Galeria Kazimierz
The race takes place in the morning on 25 January
additional: The organizer does not provide changing rooms. The baggage drop for participants will be located at Galeria Kazimierz and will be open on race day from 11:00 to 13:30. Previous editions have also included races for children and young people, as well as Nordic walking. Information for the 2026 edition listed a baggage drop at Galeria Kazimierz; the organizer did not provide changing rooms.

name: 14 Opolski Bieg
organizer: Sztab Wielkiej Orkiestry Świątecznej Pomocy w Opolu
description: The 14th Opole “Count Yourself in with Diabetes” Run is an annual event held during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity in Opole. The run is a charity event, and all entry fees go to the account of the 34th WOŚP Grand Finale. Participants can expect a certificate, a medal, and gifts from sponsors. Registration is online, and places are limited.
course_highlights: Approximately 5-kilometre route
Start at Plac Wolności
The route passes, among other places, along the Nadodrzański Boulevard and through Bolko Island, with the finish at the National Centre of Polish Song
additional: Every participant will receive a certificate, a medal sponsored by ARTAL, and gifts from SFD and Smooth The Fruit at the finish. Start numbers are sponsored by INFODRUK printing house (www.startowe.eu). Registration opens on 11 November at 11:11 via zmierzymyczas.pl; places are limited. At the finish, participants will receive a certificate, a medal, and a gift.

name: 16 Postomiński Bieg Policz się z cukrzycą
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Postominie
description: The Postomino Run “Count Yourself in the Fight Against Diabetes” is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino. The race is charitable and is part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity, promoting awareness and support for people with diabetes. The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino, bringing together the local community and runners from various regions. The event combines sporting competition with an important health and social message.
course_highlights: The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino
A charity event supporting people with diabetes
Organized as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity
additional: The race is organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino and takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event involves local running clubs and the community. The available websites provide no details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The race takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity.

name: 18 Bieg Policz się z cukrzycą
organizer: Szczecińska Agencja Artystyczna; Klub Biegacza Maratończyk Team Szczecin
description: The 18th Run for Diabetes is an annual running event organized by Maratończyk Team in Szczecin. The race takes place on Łasztownia near the Old Slaughterhouse, giving participants a chance to spend time actively and support the fight against diabetes. The event brings people together and promotes a healthy lifestyle among runners and city residents.
course_highlights: The route runs through scenic Szczecin Łasztownia
The start and finish are located near the Old Slaughterhouse
The race takes place in the afternoon, helping create a great atmosphere
additional: Newsletter sign-up is available. No details are provided about distances, fees, or start waves. Information about the route, fees, and location comes from the regulations for the 18th edition in 2026.

name: 34 Finał WOŚP
organizer: Tarnogórskie Stowarzyszenie Obywatelskie i Gmina Świerklaniec

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: minimum 30 zł od osoby za pośrednictwem eSkarbonki WOŚP Tarnogórskiego Stowarzyszenia Obywatelskiego

description: The 34th Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity in Świerklaniec is a special charity event organised jointly with the Świerklaniec Municipality. As part of the finale, the 3rd Run in Funny Costumes takes place, with participants covering a route of approximately 2 kilometres in amusing and unusual outfits. The event combines sporting fun with a rich arts programme and numerous attractions for the whole family. The fundraising goal is the diagnosis and treatment of digestive tract diseases in children. In the evening, the symbolic “Light to the Sky” illuminates the park in Świerklaniec.
course_highlights: Approximately 2 km route through the park in Świerklaniec
Run in amusing and unusual costumes
Symbolic “Light to the Sky” at 20:00
additional: Participants receive a commemorative medal, and the creators of the most original and funniest costumes are rewarded. Adults and minors may take part, with parental or guardian consent required for minors. After the run, numerous attractions are available, including a bonfire with free sausages in exchange for a donation to a WOŚP collection box, dance performances, a food area, first-aid lessons, a children’s play area, and free admission to the Pałac Kawalera. Participation is at the participant’s own risk and requires acceptance of the event rules. Costumes are not compulsory. Registration is via a Google form, and payment is made through the WOŚP Tarnogórskie Stowarzyszenie Obywatelskie e-collection box. Minors may participate with the consent of and under the supervision of a parent or guardian; participation is at the participant’s own risk.

name: Bieruński Bieg Utopca
description: The Bieruń “Utopiec” Run is a cross-country race promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity, held in Bieruń. The event brings the running community together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. Competitors can choose between two distances: 17 km (the main race) and 5 km (running and Nordic walking). The course features varied surfaces, along with numerous uphill and downhill sections. The start and finish are in Bieruń’s Market Square, alongside a Family Sports Picnic with activities for children and local exhibitors.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with varied surfaces
Numerous uphill and downhill sections
Start and finish in Bieruń’s Market Square
additional: The race package includes a personalised race bib, a commemorative T-shirt and a medal featuring a depiction of the “Utopiec” that changes each year. The race office is located at the Sports Hall at 15 Szarych Szeregów Street, about 400 metres from the Market Square. The event also features a Family Sports Picnic with local artists, sports clubs, handicrafts, food products, activities for children and an awards ceremony. Previous editions offered 17 km and 5 km distances, with Nordic walking also available on the shorter distance. The race package included a bib, commemorative T-shirt and medal; the race office was located at the Sports Hall at 15 Szarych Szeregów Street. Details of the 24 January 2027 edition are not provided in the available materials.

name: Gramy dla WOSP
description: Gramy dla WOŚP is a running event and walking rally held in the forested areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest, with marked routes that partly follow the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail. Participants can choose from several walking distances or an 11 km run, finishing in Nowa Wieś Wielka. The organizer provides return transport from the finish to the starting points and a generous race package including a medal, refreshments, and a hot meal. The event is charitable in nature, supporting the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the forested areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest
Part of the route follows the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail
Marked routes include a section on a public road during the final 3 km to the finish
additional: Race packages are distributed one hour before the start in the starting area. The organizer provides return bus transport from the finish in Nowa Wieś Wielka to the car parks by the beach in Piecki and to Solec Kujawski. Refreshments are available on the route, with a hot meal and commemorative medal at the finish. A mobile baggage drop is available for participants’ personal belongings. The combined participant limit for the run and walking rally is 250. The time limit is 2.5 hours for the run and 4.5 hours for Nordic walking. Available information concerns previous editions. In the edition described by the organizer, the run started at 11:00, and participants made their own way to the starting point.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Trójmiejski Park Krajobrazowy, okolice AWFiS, Gdańsk
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury, Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego, Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL z Fundacją Lotto is a national series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations. In the Tricity, the 24 January 2027 race takes place in Gdańsk, in the Tricity Landscape Park near the AWFiS sports university. Each location hosts four races per season with its own final classification. The main race is open to runners born in 2010 or earlier.
course_highlights: 5 km cross-country course through the forest
Tricity Landscape Park near AWFiS Gdańsk
Third of four Tricity races this season
additional: Start at 11:00. Race packs are collected at the race office between 8:30 and 10:30. A single race costs 52.99 zł online until the Wednesday before the race or 60 zł on race day; a season pass costs 154.99 zł.

name: III Urodzinowy Maraton Grzegorza Pawła N...
Policz się z cukrzycą
description: The 11th “Count Yourself In with Diabetes!” Run is an annual sporting event held in the Municipal Park in Stalowa Wola, combining physical activity with charitable support. The run is part of the 34th Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity, and aims to support the treatment of digestive diseases in children. The event attracts families and sports enthusiasts, with activities for both children and adults. Participants can expect professional organization, race packs, and a varied accompanying program.
course_highlights: The route runs through the picturesque Municipal Park in Stalowa Wola
A family event featuring races for children and young people (Kids/Junior)
A sports warm-up led by activity leaders before the main race
additional: The race office opens at 9:00 at the Municipal Park. Races for children and young people start at 11:00, with a warm-up led by an activity leader. After the main race at 12:00, there will be an awards ceremony and auctions in support of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity at the Hall of the State Music School. The event officially ends at 16:30. The event combines sport, music, and charitable activities.

name: X Bieg Wokół Stołu
description: The X Bieg Wokół Stołu is a celebratory recreational running event organized by the „Pszczelnik” Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Siemianowice Śląskie. The challenge is to cover a distance of 1 km, or 117 laps around a table, without touching it. The race takes place in the sports hall of the „Michał” Sports Complex and is divided into two age categories, with separate classifications for women and men. Participants start in heats of six, and everyone who completes the race in accordance with the rules receives a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: Distance: 1 km — 117 laps around a table
The race takes place in the sports hall of the „Michał” Sports Complex
Two age categories, with separate classifications for women and men
additional: Until 15:00, and after that time on race day from 9:00 to 9:40 using an entry form. Starts are in heats of six. Trophies are awarded to the winners, and commemorative medals to everyone who finishes. In the edition described, participants started in heats of six. The categories were birth year 2013 and younger, and birth year 2012 and older, with separate classifications for women and men.

name: XI Bieg z Puszką dla WOŚP
description: The 11th Run with a Can for WOŚP is an annual charity running event held in the Kleszczewo municipality. Participants start in Komorniki and run through several localities, finishing in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce. The run brings people together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP), while the route offers a chance to explore nearby towns and villages. The event also features children’s races and a play zone, where children receive medals and gifts. The main race is scheduled to start at 14:30.
course_highlights: The route passes through Komorniki, Nagradowice, Kleszczewo, Gowarzewo and Tulce
The finish is in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce
The run is a charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Children’s races and a play zone are available, with age categories and distances ranging from 200 m to 2,000 m. In the youngest children’s category, a parent or guardian may accompany the child during the race. Every child who finishes receives a commemorative medal and gifts from the organizers and sponsors. The date in the source calendar is approximate and indicates 25 January 2027; the event date provided is 24 January 2027.

name: XII Biegu Pobij Dystans z Sercem!
description: The 12th Run Beat the Distance with Heart is an annual race held in Piła as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale and combines sporting competition with a charitable purpose, supporting children and seniors by raising funds for medical equipment. The race attracts people from the city and surrounding areas, bringing together a community of kind-hearted people who join forces to help those in need. It is a special opportunity to take an active part in Poland’s largest charitable campaign.
course_highlights: The race will take place in Piła, in the Greater Poland Voivodeship.
The running calendar lists the distance as 10 km, although route details are unavailable.
The event takes place on the day of the WOŚP Grand Finale.

name: XIII Bieg z Termami
description: The Run with the Thermal Baths is a running event in Mszczonów, inviting running enthusiasts and those who enjoy an active lifestyle. It’s an opportunity to meet at the starting line and run in the surrounding area.

name: XX Indywidualny Bieg dla WOŚP
description: The 20th Individual Run for WOŚP in Radom is an annual running event organized to support the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. The race takes place on city routes that combine sporting competition with bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and comprehensive technical support, ensuring participants’ comfort and safety. The event is for runners of various ability levels and promotes an active lifestyle and charitable causes.
course_highlights: City route in Radom
Professional RFID electronic timekeeping
Charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Timekeeping and technical support are provided by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in professional timing for sporting events with many years of experience. The event uses RFID technology to ensure accurate timekeeping. Results from previous editions and a complaints form are available on the website. The event is part of a broader calendar of races organized by Time-Sport.pl in the region.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of city parks. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located by the city beach. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced runners, who can regularly check their times on the same course. The races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street, finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start at 10:45. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The event is co-financed from the budget of the City of Poznań. The CITY TRAIL program also includes races for children.

name: KOLIBA ŁOMNICKA
description: Koliba Łomnicka is a winter mountain race in Łomnica in the Głuszyca municipality, organised by the Walim Na Żądanie association. The 2027 edition is on Saturday 30 January 2027. The course is 15 km through mountain terrain around Łomnica. Entries are handled through raceresult, and the rules and GPX track are on the organizer's site.
course_highlights: 15 km mountain course
Winter race at the end of January
GPX track published by the organizer
additional: Entries, rules and the GPX file of the course are on the Walim Na Żądanie association's site. The organizer also runs other races in the Sudetes, such as Waligóra Run Cross and Walimskie Biegi Górskie.

name: Bieg Charytatywny 35. Finału WOŚP Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie
organizer: Klub Biegacza Kąty Wrocławskie i Sztab WOŚP #7352 Gmina Kąty Wrocławskie
price_range: darowizna min. 50 zł na WOŚP lub pakiet 21. Biegu WOŚP 85 zł
description: A charity 5 km cross-country run held as part of the 35th Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). Start and finish at 27 Zwycięstwa Street in Kąty Wrocławskie, Saturday, January 30, 2027, at 11:00. Participation is available with a donation of at least 50 PLN to WOŚP or with the 21st WOŚP Run package for 85 PLN. Limit: 200 participants. Registration via Datasport. Organizers: Kąty Wrocławskie Running Club and WOŚP Headquarters #7352 Gmina Kąty Wrocławskie.
additional: NOTE: This submission replaces an existing estimated listing (incorrect date: January 23, 2027): https://www.biegajpl.com/strony_biegow/bieg_charytatywny/ . Correct date: Saturday, January 30, 2027, start at 11:00. name: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa
location: Polana przy ul. Chorzowskiej za Stadionem Piasta Gliwice, Gliwice, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: opłata za każdy start: 15 zł - roczniki 2007-2026

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2027, on a clearing on Chorzowska Street behind the Piast Gliwice stadium. The 4,219.5 m course runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps, covering distances from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon. The events are organized by the Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania „Pędziwiatr” Gliwice and take place on Saturdays at 10:00 (running) and 10:03 (Nordic Walking).
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course along forest trails, gravel paths and asphalt
Start and finish on the clearing near the Piast Gliwice stadium
A refreshment point with drinks available after each lap
additional: The events take place once a month on Saturdays. The time limit for running and Nordic Walking is 3 hours; e-Prowokacja has no time limit. Participants can complete 1 to 5 laps (from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon). After the event, participants should return their race bib and can collect a drink, sausage or banana, and a snack bar in a prize draw (if sanitary regulations allow). There is a perseverance classification for participants who take part in at least 9 events. Registration is annual, and changing disciplines requires a new registration and race bib. Available schedule information refers to previous editions: the race office opened at 9:00, and the start was at 10:00.

name: Przybij Piątkę
description: Przybij Piątkę is a winter 5 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Klub Biegacza Chyży in the Municipal Park in Nowy Tomyśl. The course is 90% on unpaved surfaces and is not officially certified. The race is free, and every participant who finishes will receive a commemorative medal. Trophies will be awarded to the top finishers. The participant limit is 200.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
90% unpaved surface
Start and finish in the Municipal Park in Nowy Tomyśl
additional: The results are scheduled to be announced at 10:00 on the same day. The race is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Nowy Tomyśl County. The race is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Nowy Tomyśl County.

name: XVIII Jelczańsko-Oławski Zimowy Maraton
description: The XIX Jelczańsko-Oławski Toyota Winter Marathon in Stages is a series of seven races, each covering 7.033 km, held at various locations around Oława and Jelcz-Laskowice. The event combines running and Nordic walking, with a joint start and electronic timing. Participants can collect their race packs the day before the first stage or on race day. The event has a winter and commemorative character, including a race in memory of Zygmunt Pawlik.
course_highlights: A series of seven stages, each 7.033 km long
Routes pass through Chwałowice, Oława, Jelcz-Laskowice, Janików and Miłoszyce
Nordic walking and running start together, with electronic timing
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before the first stage at Termy Jakuba in Oława or at the Jelcz-Laskowice Town and Municipality Office. The organizer allows a race pack to be collected by an authorized person with a signed form. Nordic walking starts at 10:30 and the running races at 11:00. On race day, the race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 for the first stage or from 10:00 for subsequent stages. The Nordic walking start is scheduled for 10:30 and the running race for 11:00.

name: 5 Winter Run - Górnolotni
description: Winter Run - Górnolotni is a winter running event held in Tarnów and associated with the Górnolotni Festival at the Mościce Centre for Art. Previous editions included a main race of approximately 12 km, with the start and finish at the Mościce Centre for Art. The event promotes running as a form of exercise and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The main race distance in previous editions was approximately 12 km.
The route in previous editions was entirely on asphalt.
The start and finish were at the Mościce Centre for Art.
additional: Previous editions also featured children's races. Earlier information indicates that the main race used electronic timing and had a 90-minute time limit.

name: Bieg 3 Jezior
description: Bieg 3 Jezior is a series of races held in Chodzież, comprising three events over 5 km and 10 km distances, taking place by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie. The event has an intimate feel, with a limit of 130 participants. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series, which includes all three races and a commemorative T-shirt. A permanent race number with a timing chip makes participation convenient, without needing to collect a number separately for each event. The race takes place on Sundays at 10:00, making it a great way to spend an active weekend in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Race routes by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie
5 km and 10 km distances
Scenic areas of Chodzież
additional: The participant limit is 130. Pass holders receive a permanent race number with a timing chip, used for all three races, so they only need to visit the race office once. In the 2026 edition, the limit was 130 participants; the pass included a commemorative T-shirt and a permanent race number with a chip.

name: Bieg Wedla
description: Bieg Wedla is a non-profit running event organized by enthusiasts from the PTTK Warsaw-Praga Branch. It takes place in the picturesque Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw. The routes follow a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths, and participants can enjoy the special atmosphere and historic park. The event is held in winter, which gives it a unique character, while the organizers take care to minimize its impact on the environment and local residents. After the race, participants receive medals and gifts, and can also enjoy free pea soup and hot tea.
course_highlights: Running routes on a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths
Picturesque, historic Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw
Routes covered with compacted snow and sand, providing winter running conditions
additional: Starts are held over various distances: Nordic walking at 10:00; O-run from 10:30 to 12:00; running routes of 1.86 km (for children and young people up to age 15), 5.43 km, and 9 km; and a 250 m route for children up to age 7. Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected in the days before the race at the Decathlon City store in Warsaw, or on event day at the Drukarz Sports Club. After the race, participants receive medals and a gift. Free pea soup (including a vegetarian option) and hot tea are available on site, but water is not provided. Parking is available in public spaces around the park; vehicles are not permitted to enter the park. Archived results confirm that the event has been held regularly from 2011 to 2026. The distances and schedule provided are for the 2026 edition; registration and fee details for 2027 are not available.

name: IV Cross Smolarza
description: The 4th Cross Smolarza is a cross-country race held in the scenic area around Krzyżowiec. The event takes place on natural forest and off-road trails, offering a challenge for runners who enjoy being close to nature. The participant limit is 170, divided among three categories: two running distances and Nordic walking. Entries are accepted online only until January 23, helping ensure the event is well organized.
course_highlights: Forest and off-road trails in the area around Krzyżowiec
Natural terrain suited to cross-country running
Limit of 70 participants for each running distance and 30 for Nordic walking
additional: The participant limit is 170: 70 for each running distance and 30 for Nordic walking. Entries are accepted online only. The event runs from 11:00 to 16:00. Participants are offered grilled sausage, bread, and tea.

name: IX Cross wokół Małego Giewontu
description: Cross around Mały Giewont is one of the toughest and most beautiful cross-country races in Poland, held in the scenic area of Olsztyn. The route takes runners through challenging terrain, offering them a unique running experience and a chance to connect with nature. The event attracts runners who appreciate tough conditions and beautiful views.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country terrain
Scenic views around Mały Giewont
Natural trails and forest sections

name: Marceliński Bieg Zimowy
description: The Marcelin Winter Run is a trail race in Poznań’s Marcelin Forest, opening a year-round series of runs in the area. Participants can choose a 5 km or 10 km route and run along forest paths. It’s an option for both experienced runners and anyone looking to start the season actively over a shorter distance.
course_highlights: Forest route in Marcelin Forest
Choose between a 5 km or 10 km distance
The race opens a series of events held in the area
additional: In the edition described by the city, the start was at 100 Ptasia Street. The series includes four races, and the medals from the individual events fit together like a puzzle.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdrojska Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented running and Nordic walking league held on the scenic routes of the Międzyzdroje Municipality. In the 2026/2027 season, participants compete over distances of approximately 5 and 10 km running, and 5 and 7 km Nordic walking. The league is known for healthy competition and fun, welcoming both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. Participation is free, and the overall standings require taking part in at least four races or walks over the specified distances.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must finish at least four events over the required distances. This is a series of events for the 2026/2027 season. Participants must be at least 14; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian and must compete under their supervision. Participation in at least four events is required for the overall standings.

name: VI Zimowy Ultramarton Kurpiowski
location: Wiata Leśnictwa Lelis, Łęg Starościński, Poland
description: The 6th Kurpie Winter Ultramarathon is a winter running event held in Łęg Starościński, in the Lelis Forest District. The event offers four distances: 10 km Nordic Walking and 10 km, 28 km, and 56 km runs. The routes follow forest trails with a few climbs, and the start and finish are at the Running Shelter. Participants in the longer distances have access to refreshment stations along the route. The event has an intimate atmosphere, with a limit of 150 paid participants.
course_highlights: Routes follow forest trails with a few climbs
Refreshment stations on the 56 km route (at 19, 35, and 44 km) and the 28 km route (at 8 and 19 km)
Start and finish at the Running Shelter
additional: The participant limit is 150 paid runners. The 56 km and 28 km routes are forest loops, with refreshment stations available at specified times. Nordic Walking and the 10 km run each consist of two 5 km loops. Starts are in waves: 56 km at 7:00, 28 km at 9:00, 10 km Nordic Walking at 10:00, and the 10 km run at 11:00. The calendar lists the next edition for 2027 but provides no details.

name: Zimowy Bieg Zbója
description: The Zimowy Bieg Zbója is a mountain race in Bielsko-Biała inspired by the legend of the Klimczok outlaw. The course follows scenic but demanding mountain trails, offering participants exceptional views and an intense challenge. The 18 km and 13 km distances, with substantial elevation gain, will test every runner’s strength and determination. It’s a great opportunity to kick off the running season in a winter setting and experience the atmosphere of a true mountain race.
course_highlights: 18 km course with 996 m of elevation gain, starting below the Szyndzielnia cable car
Klimczok summit as the course’s high point
A fast, rugged descent that demands stamina and courage
additional: The Zbójnik 18 km starts at 09:00, and the Piechur 13 km at 09:45. GPX files of the routes are available to download. The entry fee depends on the payment date, not the registration date. Payment by PayU, PayPal, or bank transfer is available. Organizer: Alpas Artur Sarosiek, Bielsko-Biała. Registration for the 2027 edition is open. Detailed elevation figures and route information are based on descriptions from previous editions.

description: The Grand Prix of Dziewicza Góra Mountain Running is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. The course follows forest paths around Dziewicza Góra, the park’s highest hill, offering challenging climbs and scenic views. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic walking event, and children’s races over shorter distances. The organizers foster a welcoming sporting atmosphere that brings participants and families together.
course_highlights: A fully forested 5.15 km loop
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event center, where spectators can cheer on runners
additional: Children’s races are held over 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. After emerging from the forest at the finish, runners head to the left or right side of the balloon marked “Finish,” depending on their race distance. The participant limit is 500. People who have purchased a pass for the entire series are automatically added to the start list.

location: Ruda, Wieluń County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Trail!ON Stawiguda #3
