The event attracts runners who appreciate well-organized races and the beautiful landscapes of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the amphitheater in Niegowa, on Sportowa Street
Picturesque landscapes of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Professional timekeeping using an RFID system
additional: In the 2025 edition, distances from 6.5 km to 30 km were available, with Nordic walking also offered on most routes. The start and event venue for the 2026 edition were listed as the amphitheater on Sportowa Street in Niegowa.

name: Ekstremalna Droga Krzyżowa
description: The Extreme Way of the Cross is a spiritual, nighttime hike of approximately 40 km, undertaken in silence and contemplation. Participants follow the route alone or in small groups, focusing on prayer and reflection rather than sports competition. This unique event aims to inspire inner transformation and take participants beyond their comfort zones, offering a profound spiritual and personal experience. The route may be approximately 30 km if the elevation gain exceeds 500 m. EDK is a way of life and a path to changing yourself, not just covering the distance.
course_highlights: 40 km at night in silence and contemplation
A route of approximately 30 km when the elevation gain exceeds 500 m
The Way of the Cross with spiritual reflections, without sporting or social elements
additional: Participants set out at their own risk. It is recommended that they download the official EDK app, which includes route maps, GPS navigation, and the Way of the Cross reflections in text and audio, and also works offline. Silence and contemplation are observed along the route; picnics and social stops are not part of the event. Participants should be prepared for varying weather conditions and bring suitable clothing, food and drink, and a phone with a power bank. EDK takes place at participants’ own risk. Registration and route selection are available through the EDK service.

name: Lake run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startowa 69 zł kończy się za

description: Lake Run is a unique trail race held on the shores of Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań. The approximately 5 km and 10 km routes, as well as the Nordic Walking course, follow natural paths around the lake, offering a light trail feel with uphill sections and a short off-road stretch. The start and finish are right by the water, providing beautiful views and an intimate atmosphere that’s ideal for both beginners and experienced runners. Organized by the EVsport Foundation, the race combines a passion for sport with closeness to nature and a welcoming community.
course_highlights: The routes loop around Lake Strzeszyńskie, with views of the lake
Natural paths and a light trail feel, including a short off-road stretch
Start and finish right by the water, with no streets or traffic jams
additional: One entry fee applies to all distances: 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. Souvenirs from the “Feel the Rhythm of the Lake” collection can be purchased separately (T-shirt, mug, bandana, premium bag or set). Participants under 18 must have a consent form signed by a parent or guardian. The routes have a light trail feel, with natural surfaces and gentle uphill sections. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip. The available options are 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip; a detailed route map will be published later. Participants under 18 need a consent form signed by a parent or guardian when collecting their race pack.

name: 12 Górska Pętla UBS 12:12
location: Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness, Brenna, Poland
description: The 12th Górska Pętla UBS 12:12 is a 12-hour mountain race held on a varied loop approximately 16 km long in the Stary Groń area of the Silesian Beskids. Runners aim to complete as many loops as possible within 12 hours, and at least one loop is required to be classified. The route starts at Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness in Brenna and passes through scenic terrain, with approximately 800 m of elevation gain per loop. A new distance has also been introduced: one 16 km loop for beginner mountain runners who want to test themselves before taking on an ultra distance.
course_highlights: A loop approximately 16 km long with around 800 m of elevation gain
The route passes through the Silesian Beskids, including Hala Jaworowa and the summit of Kotarz
Scenic, fast descents to the Brennica River and the transition area
additional: To be classified, runners must complete at least one loop. The route is identical to previous years. The start and finish are at Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness in Brenna. The route includes one difficult section requiring particular attention for safety.

name: Charytatywny II Fenomenalny Bieg Kolorowy
price_range: Bezpłatnie dla dzieci i młodzieży; 50 zł dla dorosłych
description: The Charity 2nd Phenomenal Color Run is an event in Łupstych near Olsztyn, combining recreational running with support for people with Down syndrome. The routes follow forest roads in the Kudypy Forest District and are designed for children, teenagers, and adults. Participants can choose a distance of 600 m, 2 km, or 3.5 km, and commemorative medals await them at the finish. The run is informal and does not include timekeeping.
course_highlights: Forest routes in the Kudypy Forest District
Three distances: 600 m, 2 km, and 3.5 km
Routes for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: Adult entry fees go toward the charitable cause. Participants receive commemorative medals; the run is not timed.

name: Dzikie Ultra dla Lenki
description: Dzikie Ultra is a six-hour race organized by the BDB Team crew, held in the scenic Valley of Three Ponds in Katowice. This unique event for long-distance running enthusiasts combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The course follows natural trails, offering participants an unforgettable experience and a chance to test their endurance.
course_highlights: A six-hour race through the Valley of Three Ponds
The course follows natural trails and green areas
Organized by the experienced BDB Team crew
additional: Running calendars list the date as March 28, 2027, one day later than the date indicated in the metadata; the calendar date is marked as tentative.

name: Ekstremalna Droga Krzyżowa
location: Kościół przy ul. Kościelnej 2, Bezrzecze, Poland
description: The Extreme Way of the Cross is a demanding route from the church at 2 Kościelna Street in Bezrzecze to the cross by the church in Bezrzecze. The route is interesting and varied, passing partly through woodland and partly through urban areas. Most of the route is on paved surfaces, so soft-soled footwear is recommended. It is a spiritual and physical challenge for participants, combining reflection with outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Partly woodland and partly urban route
Most of the route is paved
Start and finish by the church in Bezrzecze
additional: Soft-soled footwear is recommended because of the varied terrain. The route description recommends soft-soled footwear. The Extreme Way of the Cross takes place in silence and contemplation, with reflections on the Stations of the Cross.

name: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa
location: Las Komunalny przy ul. Chorzowskiej, Gliwice, Poland
description: Gliwice Park Run Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice, in the municipal forest. The 4,219.5 m route runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections, and is open to runners and Nordic Walking participants. The events are amateur and promote a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps, covering distances from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon. A refreshment station with drinks is available after each lap, and participants receive a drink and a snack after the event.
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m route along forest paths, gravel paths and asphalt
Start and finish on a clearing near Piast Stadium in the Municipal Forest
A refreshment station is available after each lap
additional: Events are held once a month on Saturdays. Participants can take part in the run, Nordic Walking or e-Provocation (any activity). The time limit for completing the route is 3 hours. Race bibs are valid for the whole year and must be returned after each race. After the event, participants receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a chocolate bar in a prize draw, if sanitary regulations allow. According to information about the series for 2026, the race office opens at 9:00, and the run starts at 10:00.

name: Grand Prix Cross Polska cz.1
location: ReMi fish fry, ul. Lipowa 31, Stegna, Poland
organizer: Gmina Stegna i Valdano Organizacja Imprez Sportowych
description: Grand Prix Cross Polska Part 1 is a prestigious running event held in the picturesque seaside municipality of Stegna. The event launches the Grand Prix Cross Polska 2027 series and offers participants a unique sporting atmosphere combined with the beauty of the Amber Coast. The organizers look after runners’ comfort by providing a race office and a recovery meal at the Municipal Cultural Centre. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and fair play, bringing together the local community and athletes from across Poland.
course_highlights: A route through the seaside scenery of the Municipality of Stegna
Start and finish near the “ReMi” fish fry shop at 31 Lipowa Street
The event is organized and concludes at the Stegna Municipal Cultural Centre
additional: The race office, recovery meal, and award ceremony take place at the Stegna Municipal Cultural Centre. The event is held under the patronage of the Municipality of Stegna and the Polish Olympic Committee. The route passes near beach access No. 69 from Lipowa Street. The organizers provide comfortable conditions and opportunities for participants to connect.

name: I Jura Wild Dog Run
price_range: 60–160 zł; opłaty rodzinne: 90 zł za 5 km i 150 zł za 13 km
description: The Jura Wild Dog Run is a unique event for people and their dogs, offering three distances: 5 km, 13 km and 28 km. The routes suit different levels of experience, from a leisurely, family-friendly option to more demanding running and dogtrekking challenges. The dogtrekking format offers comfort and safety, with a marked route, checkpoints and a GPX file, removing the stress of navigating the terrain. Participants start in pace-based waves, and the atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with a quiet start and dogs creating a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 km, 13 km and 28 km to suit different levels of experience
Marked route with checkpoints and a GPX file
A dogtrekking format that removes the stress of navigating the terrain
additional: Participants start in pace-based waves: ELITE (under 5:00 min/km), RUNNERS (5:01–6:00 min/km), OTHERS (over 6:01 min/km, walkers, families and first-timers). The start is quiet, with no gunshots or countdown; a designated person at the start line gives the signal to start. Race packs are handed out on Friday evening before the race, with priority given by distance. In the edition described on the website, participants started in waves, without a gunshot or countdown.

name: Prymulek-Dąbrowska Górka skansen forteczny
description: Prymulek-Dąbrowska Górka Fortified Open-Air Museum is a 10 km race held in the picturesque surroundings of Karczew. Runners can prepare for the start with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is intended for runners seeking a challenge on a moderately difficult course. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy outdoor activity amid the historic fortified open-air museum.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Moderate difficulty
Picturesque surroundings of the fortified open-air museum in Karczew
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support. The organizer encourages using the platform to manage the race listing and for marketing collaboration. The date in the race calendar is marked as tentative and differs by one day from the stated event date.

name: Skoczów biega
location: Wyciąg narciarski Pod Dębem, Skoczów, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Skoczowie i Skoczowski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji
description: We invite you to the 9th edition of the “Skoczów Runs” cross-country race, taking place at the Pod Dębem ski lift in Skoczów. This sporting event, organised by Skoczów City Hall and the Skoczów Sports and Recreation Centre, attracts runners of different ages and skill levels. The course runs through scenic areas, giving participants the chance to spend time outdoors and stay active. The event is open to all and promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Course by the Pod Dębem ski lift
Cross-country races through the scenic surroundings of Skoczów
Organised by the local sports and recreation centre

name: Stęszewski Bieg Przełajowy
description: The Stęszew Cross-Country Run is an annual running event organized by the Municipality of Stęszew, bringing the local community together through active recreation. The races take place on scenic routes in Wielkopolska National Park, mainly along forest trails and dirt tracks. The main race offers 5 km and 10 km distances, alongside a 5 km Nordic Walking event and children’s races tailored to younger participants’ ages. The start and finish are on the beach by Lake Lipno, and the time limit is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: 95% of the route follows forest trails, dirt tracks, and unpaved roads
The 5 km race is one loop through the forest by Lake Lipno and the Trzebaw forest
The 10 km race consists of two loops of the same route
additional: The participant limit is 300. Net chip timing is used. The course is not certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The Nordic Walking event starts at 13:15. Parking is available by the Sports and Entertainment Hall and along Trzebawska Street. Previous editions have included children’s races over age-appropriate distances and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The official website lists the contact details: +48 698 050 150, bieg@steszew.pl.

name: Tropem Wilczym
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Olsztyńska, Dobre Miasto, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Wolność i Demokracja; lokalnie OSiR w Dobrym Mieście
description: Tropem Wilczym – Run in Memory of the Cursed Soldiers in Dobre Miasto is an annual running event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers. The race takes place at the municipal stadium on Olsztyńska Street and consists of two events: an individual 1.963 km race and an 8 km relay held on the stadium’s tartan track. The event has a sporting and patriotic character, and participants can expect commemorative medals and T-shirts. The organizers provide timekeeping and professional race-office support.
course_highlights: The individual race course runs on the stadium’s tartan track
The 8 km relay consists of 20 laps of the stadium
Time limit for the individual race: 20 minutes
additional: The race office is open from 10:30 to 12:30 at the Municipal Stadium. The relay starts at approximately 13:00. Each participant collects their own race bib and race pack. The team captain receives a relay baton with a timing chip. Timing chips are returned at the finish. Participant limit: 150 (70 individual runners + 20 four-person relay teams). Previous editions featured relays with teams of 4–6; each participant had to cover at least 400 m.

name: VIII Otwarte Górskie Mistrzostwa Polski
description: The 8th Polish Open Mountain Nordic Walking Half Marathon Championships is a prestigious event held in the scenic area of Prudnik-Las. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and the inclusion of people with disabilities and families. Participants compete over 21.1 km or take part in a 5 km walk, with no age categories. The event follows the regulations of the Polish Nordic Walking Association and offers an opportunity for sporting competition and to discover the beauty of the region.
course_highlights: Mountain half-marathon distance: 21.1 km
5 km mountain Nordic Walking walk open to all groups
The course runs through the Prudnik-Las area, near the Sanctuary of St. Joseph
additional: Start and finish at the Sanctuary of St. Joseph, ul. Józefa Poniatowskiego 5, 48-200 Prudnik. Time limits apply to both the 21.1 km and 5 km distances. Schedule: 9:30–9:45 group warm-up, 9:45 official opening, 10:00 half-marathon start, 10:15 5 km walk start. Winners’ awards ceremony at 15:05, with a prize draw. Organisational enquiries and other matters can be handled via the registration form. B4SPORT results include information about electronic timing.

name: Wiosenna Lwówecka 5
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Lwówku, Rozbiegany Lwówek, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu
description: Wiosenna Lwówecka 5 is an annual race held in the picturesque town of Lwówek, attracting runners from various places. The course runs through the charming grounds of the Municipal Park, offering participants pleasant conditions for competition and recreation. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors in an atmosphere of sporting camaraderie.
course_highlights: The course runs through Municipal Park in Lwówek
Picturesque surroundings that are welcoming to runners
A 5 km distance suited to different ability levels
additional: The race office is open on event day from 7:30 to 8:30 at the start location, Parkowa 2, 64-310 Lwówek. For the 2025 edition, the address was listed as Parkowa 2, 64-310 Lwówek, with opening hours of 7:30–8:30.

name: WRC Waligóra Run Cross
description: WRC - Waligóra Run Cross is a mountain running festival held in Głuszyca, featuring three distances: an 82 km ultra, a 53 km mountain half marathon, and a 28 km race. The event is part of the Sudetes Mountain Running Festival and is included in the international ITRA and UTMB Index rankings. The course winds through scenic mountain terrain, with challenging climbs and varied surfaces. It is an excellent choice for mountain runners seeking long-distance challenges.
course_highlights: Mountain course with distances of 82 km (ultra), 53 km (half marathon), and 28 km
Scenic landscapes of the Sudetes
Challenging climbs and varied terrain
additional: The races are included in the international ITRA and UTMB Index rankings. Results are available on the RaceResult platform. The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Walim Na Żądanie. Registration is handled through Race Result. Information about distances and elevation gains comes from previous editions.

name: XI Maraton Gocki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Lokalna Grupa Działania Sandry Brdy
description: The 11th Gocki Marathon is a unique running event held in the picturesque village of Wojtal, in the heart of the Tuchola Forest, near the Stone Circles Nature Reserve in Odry. The marathon, half-marathon, and 10 km race courses pass through unique areas associated with the ancient Gothic culture, offering participants a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and beautiful scenery. The event is a regular fixture on the region’s sporting calendar, attracting running and outdoor recreation enthusiasts. The organizers warmly invite everyone to take part in this event, which combines sport with local history and nature.
course_highlights: The course runs through the heart of the Tuchola Forest
Close to the Stone Circles Nature Reserve in Odry
Picturesque landscapes and unique natural surroundings
additional: The event features three races: a marathon, a half-marathon, and a 10 km race. It is organized by the Sandry Brdy Local Action Group Association as part of the implementation of the Local Development Strategy (LDS) and is co-financed by the European Union. The Municipality of Czersk was a co-organizer of the event.

name: XVII Maraton Jastrowski
organizer: Gmina i Miasto Jastrowie; współorganizator: Dariusz Mańkowski
description: The 17th Jastrowie Marathon is an annual running event organized by the Municipality and Town of Jastrowie, held in late March. Competitors race over three distances: the marathon (42.195 km), the half marathon, and a 10.55 km Nordic walking event. The marathon course is cross-country in character and consists of four loops, taking runners along forest roads in the forest district and through a built-up area just after the start. Participants who finish receive a commemorative medal and a race pack. This is a small-scale event, limited to 50 starting places, giving it a distinctive character and local atmosphere.
course_highlights: A cross-country course along forest roads in the forest district
The marathon consists of four loops
The start and finish are near the Sports and Entertainment Hall and Jastrowie-Miasto railway stop
additional: The race office is located in the Sports and Entertainment Hall and will be open on race day from 7:00 to 9:45. The limit is 50 starting places, allocated in order of registration. Once the limit is reached, registration will close and any overpayments will be refunded. Every participant who finishes receives a commemorative medal and a race pack.

name: 20 Półmaraton Warszawski LET’S RUN THIS PARTY!
description: The 21st Warsaw Half Marathon is a prestigious running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting both professionals and amateurs. The 21.0975 km course is fast and flat, certified by the PZLA and World Athletics, and passes some of the capital’s most beautiful landmarks, including views of the Vistula River, PGE Narodowy Stadium and the Presidential Palace. The event also includes a 5 km race and a rich programme of accompanying events, including the Running&Lifestyle Expo and live music. The organisers also promote the #BiegamDobrze charity initiative, combining sport with support for people in need.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km course certified by the PZLA and World Athletics
A very fast, flat course conducive to personal bests
Views of the Vistula River, PGE Narodowy Stadium and the Presidential Palace
additional: The start and finish are in central Warsaw, by the Palace of Culture and Science. Participants start in corrals marked on their race bibs. Bag drop facilities, changing rooms and toilets are available on race day. The event also includes the New Balance Bieg na Piątkę 5 km race and the Running&Lifestyle Expo. The organisers encourage spectators to cheer along the course, with activities for fans of all ages. The entry limit for the 2026 half marathon has been reached.

name: 25. PKO Półmaraton dookoła Jeziora Żywie...
description: The PKO Half Marathon around Lake Żywieckie is an annual running event traditionally starting and finishing at Żywiec Market Square. The event attracts runners from across Poland, offering a unique course around picturesque Lake Żywieckie. The race atmosphere is enhanced by numerous cheering zones and the support of the local community and volunteers. It is a true celebration of running and cheering in the heart of the Beskids.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Żywieckie
Start and finish at Żywiec Market Square
Support from numerous cheering zones and local residents
additional: The event is organized with the help of more than 100 volunteers. The race course is part of the PKO Crown of Silesian Half Marathons series and the Beskids Euroregion Cup in road running. The event takes place on Sunday, March 14, 2027.

name: 6 Biegam z Czystą Przyjemnością
organizer: Polska Agencja Antydopingowa (POLADA); Fundacja Wychowanie przez Sport
description: Biegam z czystą przyjemnością is a charity hybrid race organised by the Polish Anti-Doping Agency in cooperation with the Sport Through Education Foundation. The event promotes clean sport and fair competition, raising awareness of the harmful effects of doping and unverified supplements. Participants can choose a distance of 5 km or 10 km, which can be run in person on designated courses in four Polish cities or virtually. The race also welcomes people with disabilities, and proceeds from entry packages go to charity to support athletes in need.
course_highlights: Distances of 4,999 m and 9,999 m on in-person courses in Chorzów, Warsaw, Kielce and Wrocław
Timing chips used on all in-person courses
Virtual participation available from anywhere in Poland during the designated period
additional: Race packages can be collected at the in-person courses between 8:40 and 9:30 upon presentation of an identity document. Medals are presented at the finish line. Participants in the virtual race will receive their race package and medal by InPost courier within 7 days of the race ending. The participant limit is 1,300. 10:00 via email contact. 23:59.

name: Biegi Powitanie Wiosny
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Sportowa 1, Mińsk Mazowiecki, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mińsku Mazowieckim
description: The Welcome Spring Runs are an annual running event held at the Municipal Stadium in Mińsk Mazowiecki, combining sporting competition with a joyful spring atmosphere. It is a great opportunity to check your fitness after the winter break, get some fresh air and spend time actively with family or friends. The program includes races for children and young people in various age categories, as well as the Spring Flower Parade for the youngest participants. Participants can look forward to beautiful medals, prizes and a unique, family-friendly atmosphere on a sporty morning.
course_highlights: Cross-country races at the Municipal Stadium in Mińsk Mazowiecki
Age categories for children and young people
Spring Flower Parade for children born in 2021 or later
additional: The event is part of the Powiatowa Trzynastka series. Participants can look forward to medals, prizes and special awards. The races take place at the Municipal Stadium, ul. Sportowa 1, Mińsk Mazowiecki. In 2026, the event was held at the Municipal Stadium at ul. Sportowa 1.

name: Duch Pogórza
description: Duch Pogórza is a series of ultra races held in the Przemyśl-Dynów Foothills, with its base near Dubiecko. The 2027 edition offers courses ranging from 13 to 350 km, so the event is open both to those looking for a shorter challenge and to ultra runners. The races include Diabelska Trzynastka, Duszek, Duch, Upiór, and Ultra Demon.
course_highlights: The courses run through the Przemyśl-Dynów Foothills.
The 2027 edition offers distances of 13, 34, 60, 115, and 350 km.
The races include both the shorter Diabelska Trzynastka and the 350-kilometre Ultra Demon.
additional: Registration is available for several distances: Diabelska Trzynastka 13 km, Duszek 34 km, Duch 60 km, Upiór 115 km, and Ultra Demon 350 km. The final registration deadline for most distances is 20.03.2027; for Ultra Demon 350 km, it is 17.03.2027. You can contact the organizer via the registration form on the website. The registration page lists the distances and provides participant lists. The 2027 edition dates listed there differ from the date 2027-03-28 in the metadata.

name: Grand Prix Tychów - bieg nr 2
organizer: MOSiR Tychy i Stowarzyszenie Promocji Lekkiej Atletyki w Tychach
price_range: 30 zł za bieg; 150 zł za udział w 6 biegach

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa - płatna w dniu imprezy wynosi 30 zł

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Opłata startowa za 6 biegów - 150 zł - płatna przed pierwszym biegiem.

description: The Tychy Grand Prix is a series of six long-distance races organized by the SPLA Tychy Athletics Promotion Association. The races are held over 5 km and 10 km distances for women and men, promoting an active and healthy lifestyle among residents of Tychy and the surrounding area. The event is open and welcoming to runners of different abilities, who can compete in individual races or in the overall standings after all six races. The races start at the Paprocany Sports Complex, and the entry fee can be paid on race day or in advance for the entire series.
course_highlights: Race routes over 5 km and 10 km
Races take place at the Paprocany Sports Complex in Tychy
A series of six races spread throughout the season
additional: The entry fee for all six races can be paid in advance. Separate standings are kept for women and men over the 5 km and 10 km distances. The organizer provides a child safeguarding standard at events. Pricing and organizational information are from the 2026 edition. In the 2026 edition, participants who completed at least four races received a commemorative gift.

name: IX Cartusia Półmaraton
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. 3 Maja, Kartuzy, Poland
description: The IX Cartusia Half Marathon is a prestigious race in the heart of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the picturesque landscapes of Kashubian Switzerland and a rich historical heritage. Participants run a certified, fast course through the lakes, forests and post-glacial hills of the Kartuzy region. The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy. This event is a true celebration of running for the whole family, with a rich program and regional Kashubian cuisine. The organizers provide attractive prizes, a prize draw and a unique medal for every participant.
course_highlights: A certified, fast course through the picturesque areas of the Kartuzy region
Route through lakes, forests and post-glacial hills
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy
additional: The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy at ul. 3 Maja. Full facilities are available at Primary School No. 1 (race office, bag drop, changing rooms, showers and changing areas). Safety and medical support is provided by firefighters, police, municipal police, medical staff and volunteers. Race packs include commemorative items, and participants can access a recovery area at the finish. Regional Kashubian cuisine will be available for participants to sample. Prizes will be drawn among all participants in the main race. Start and finish: Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy at ul. 3 Maja. Event facilities are to be located at Primary School No. 1; accompanying races have also been announced, including a race for preschoolers.

name: Kibolska Dycha
description: Kibolska Dycha is the fourth edition of the Kolejorz fans’ race, taking place on 28 March 2027 at the Malta Regatta Course in Poznań. Runners will cover a 10-kilometre route that includes almost two laps of Lake Malta. The event is open to everyone, with a maximum time of 120 minutes to complete the course, making it accessible to less experienced runners too. The event also includes children’s races, which start earlier. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: The route includes almost two laps of Lake Malta
10-kilometre distance
Start and finish at the Malta Regatta Course
additional: The maximum time to complete the course is 120 minutes. Children’s races start at 10:00. Before the main race, participants take a commemorative photo, after which runners head to their starting corrals. The time limit for the main race is 120 minutes. Children’s races are also included in the programme.

name: Niebieska Fala
location: ENEA Stadion, ul. Bułgarska 17, Poznań, Poland
description: Niebieska Fala is a charity run held in Poznań, combining a passion for running with support for people in need. It focuses particularly on raising autism awareness and purchasing therapeutic equipment. The main race route follows scenic paths through Marceliński Forest and Węgorka Street, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The youngest participants can take part in the Niebieska miniFala family run, covering 1 km around ENEA Stadium. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting a healthy lifestyle and working to prevent the social exclusion of people with disabilities.
course_highlights: The main course is a 5 km loop in Marceliński Forest, with 30% paved and 70% forest surface
New on the course: a section along Węgorka Street, adding variety and making the run more comfortable
The Niebieska miniFala family run covers 1 km around ENEA Stadium on a paved, child-safe route
additional: The time limit for completing the main race (5, 10 or 15 km) is 120 minutes. The course is marked with blue-and-white tape, and volunteers assist participants along the route. There is a refreshment station on the course. The MiniFala family run starts at 11:30, the main race at 13:00, and Nordic Walking at 12:30. The start and finish are by Stand 2 at ENEA Stadium. In the 2026 edition, the start and finish were by Stand 2 at ENEA Stadium, at 17 Bułgarska Street. The time limit for the race was 120 minutes. Information about fees and the course refers to the previous edition.

name: V Bieg Strażaka
description: The 5th Firefighter Run is an annual race organized by the Dąbrowa Volunteer Fire Department (OSP Dąbrowa), held in the picturesque village of Dąbrowa. The event attracts runners looking to test themselves on a running course. Timing is professionally provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu, ensuring accurate results and high-quality organization. The race is scheduled to start at 3:00 p.m., and participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and sporting competition.
course_highlights: A 5 km main race in the 2026 edition
A 5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s races and a firefighter competition in full structural firefighting gear
additional: The 2026 edition also included a 998 m race for Youth Fire Brigades; the children’s race distances ranged from 300 m to almost 1,000 m.

name: V Bieg W samo południe
location: Kompleks sportowy Zespołu Szkół im. Mikołaja Kopernika, Samborowo, Poland
description: The 5th “W samo Południe” Run is an annual running event held at the sports complex of the Mikołaj Kopernik School Complex in Samborowo. The race attracts both amateurs and more experienced runners, offering an opportunity to compete and spend time actively outdoors. The event is local in character and provides an opportunity to bring the community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: An approximately 10-kilometer loop around Samborowo
A cross-country route running mainly along rural tracks
Start and finish at the sports complex of the Mikołaj Kopernik School Complex
additional: Participant limit: 250 people. A prize drawing will take place after the race.

name: VIII Półmaraton Świebody i Sulecha
organizer: OSiR „Sulechowianka” w Sulechowie, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Świebodzinie, Sulechowski Klub Sportowy oraz Wierzbicki Running Project
description: The VIII Świebodzin and Sulechów Half Marathon is a race connecting Sulechów and Świebodzin, organized to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The course passes through the picturesque streets of both towns and the villages of Kalsk and Rosin, giving participants the chance to test themselves in a sporting competition. The participant limit is 300. The organizers provide transport from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów. The race starts at 11:00 at Plac Ratuszowy in Sulechów.
course_highlights: The course runs from Sulechów to Świebodzin through town streets and along Route 276
Passes through the villages of Kalsk and Rosin
Start and finish at town squares: Plac Ratuszowy in Sulechów and Plac Jana Pawła II in Świebodzin
additional: The organizers provide bus transport for participants from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów. The bus departs at 9:40 from the parking lot by Primary School No. 2. The time limit is 2 hours 30 minutes; participants must finish by 13:30. The race office is open on race day from 7:30 to 9:30 at the Town Hall in Świebodzin. The participant limit was 300, and the time limit for finishing was 2 hours 30 minutes. The organizers provided bus transport for participants from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów.

name: Wrocławska Dycha Cztery Pory Roku
description: Wrocławska Dycha Four Seasons is a series of four park runs held in Wrocław at different times of the year. Each race covers a distance of 10 km and follows scenic paths through Wrocław’s parks, giving both amateur and experienced runners the chance to compete and get to know the city. Participants can earn points toward the overall series standings, and generous refreshment stations and commemorative medals await them at the finish. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively amid the unique atmosphere of sporting competition and beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: The routes pass through four different parks in Wrocław
Scenic park paths and forest trails
Each race covers a distance of 10 km
additional: The series consists of four races: the Valentine’s Day Run (February), Wrocławska Dycha Spring (April), Wrocławska Dycha Summer – St. John’s Eve (June), and Wrocławska Dycha Autumn (September). Each race also includes a Great KIDS children’s run, with medals and safe race conditions. Participants can compete in the overall series standings. Generous refreshment stations are available on the course and after the race. The 2027 spring edition is listed for April 4, not March 28. The website schedule also includes the summer race on June 20 and the autumn race on September 26.

name: Halowe Mistrzostwa Europy Masters - 5 km
description: The European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships are an international athletics competition for masters athletes, held in Toruń. The event is a championship competition and brings together experienced athletes from across Europe. It is organized by the Polish Masters Athletics Association and takes place at the indoor athletics arena on Bema Street. It is an excellent opportunity for high-level competition and for bringing the masters community together.
course_highlights: 5 km race inside the indoor athletics arena
International championship-level competition
Organized by the Polish Masters Athletics Association in Toruń
additional: Masters competitions are intended for athletes born on March 27, 1991, or earlier.

name: 18. PANAS Półmaraton Ślężański Piątka Ślężysława
organizer: Miasto i Gmina Sobótka, Ślężański Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sobótce, Klub Biegacza Sobótka, Zespół Szkolno-Przedszkolny im. Janusza Korczaka w Sobótce oraz Centrum Szkolenia Wojsk Inżynieryjnych i Chemicznych
description: Piątka Ślężysława is a 5 km race held as part of the 19th Ślęża Half Marathon, which starts on 20 March 2027 in Sobótka. The course was designed by local runners and has a unique route with no equivalent in Poland. The start and finish are in the centre of Sobótka, and the finish is inside a sports hall, providing comfort for participants. The event promotes physical activity and the tourist attractions of the Ślęża region.
course_highlights: Course designed by runners from Sobótka, unique in Poland
Start and finish in the centre of Sobótka; finish inside a sports hall
Scenic surroundings at the foot of Mount Ślęża
additional: The race finish is inside a sports hall, providing comfort for participants. The course is available to download in .gpx format. The event is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Lower Silesian Half Marathon classification for the Sudeten Mouflon statuette. The race will take place on 20 March 2027. Detailed information about the start time of Piątka Ślężysława was not provided in the available materials.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The course runs through beautiful woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe, with varied uphill and downhill sections, making the event appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The races aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity, while providing an opportunity for friendly sporting competition. The start and finish are located at Zajazd Szmaragd, and races take place regularly during the season from October to April.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe
Varied uphill and downhill sections, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
Start and finish behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start, at 10:45. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course is permanent, making it possible to compare results over the months and years. The race is scheduled for 4 April 2027, with the start at 11:00. CITY TRAIL Junior races are also held as part of the series.

name: 36 Maraton Juranda
distance_verbose: Maraton, Półmaraton, 10 km, 0.8 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km, 0.1 km
description: Maraton Juranda is a marathon in Lipowiec near Szczytno, held since 1981. 2027 is the 36th edition. The certified course covers 42.195 km in two loops and is flat and fully on asphalt. Alongside the marathon there is the 6th Półmaraton Rycerski half marathon, the 9th Dyszka Jurandówny 10 km and the Biegi Jagienki runs for children and youth.
course_highlights: Certified flat asphalt course in two loops
Route through Masurian villages, forests and fields
At least 7 water stations, 5 hour time limit
additional: Online registration closes on 22 March 2027 or when the limit of 150 paid entrants is reached. Entry at the race office on 3-4 April 2027 costs 250 PLN. Runners born in 1967 or earlier and wheelchair entrants get 50% off.

name: 6 BMWielkanocny
description: The 6th BMWielkanocny is a 10 km race held in Kraków. Participants can prepare with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers offer detailed training instructions and expert support to help runners prepare optimally for race day. The race is part of the running calendar and is aimed at people looking to improve their fitness and achieve good results over 10 km.
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to each runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. The race listing can be managed and marketing collaboration arranged through the TreningBiegacza platform.

name: XII Bieg do Pustego Grobu
organizer: Parafia Rzymsko-Katolicka pw. Świętego Antoniego w Nowej Soli
description: The 12th Run to the Empty Tomb is a 10 km race held in Nowa Sól on Easter Monday at 14:00. The course passes important churches in the city, including St. Anthony’s, St. Barbara’s, St. Joseph’s, the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and St. Michael’s, as well as the cemetery on Wandy Street. The race has a spiritual and symbolic character, recalling the footsteps of St. Peter and St. John as they ran to the Tomb of the Lord to confirm the Resurrection of Jesus.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Nowa Sól’s churches: St. Anthony’s, St. Barbara’s, St. Joseph’s, the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and St. Michael’s
Passes through the cemetery on Wandy Street
The race takes place on Easter Monday at 14:00
additional: The organizer is the Roman Catholic Parish of St. Anthony in Nowa Sól. The race has a spiritual and symbolic dimension, referring to the Easter tradition. No information was found about entry fees or participant limits. The start is scheduled for Easter Monday at 14:00. The 12th edition took place in 2026.

name: 23 Bieg Europejski Mistrzostwa Polski Ciepłowników
organizer: Klub Sportowy Altom Gniezno oraz Przedsiębiorstwo Energetyki Cieplnej w Gnieźnie Sp. z o.o.
description: The 23rd European Run is an annual running event held in Gniezno, commemorating Poland’s accession to the European Union. The 10 km main race runs through the city streets, with the start and finish on Gniezno’s Market Square. The course is certified by the PZLA and consists of one loop with asphalt and cobblestone surfaces. The event attracts runners from many countries, creating an international atmosphere for this sporting celebration. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal on the Market Square and attend the winners’ awards ceremony.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the streets of Gniezno, asphalt and cobblestones (5%)
Start and finish on Gniezno’s Market Square
PZLA-certified, single-loop course
additional: The race office is open on Friday, 10.04.2027, from 17:00 to 20:30, and on race day, 11.04.2027, from 11:00 to 15:00 (the location has changed to the sports hall at Primary School No. 2 in Gniezno). The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour 30 minutes. Timing is by chips in the race bibs. A recovery meal will be served after the race on the Market Square (available to runners only). The winners’ awards ceremony takes place at 18:00 on the stage on the Market Square. The event also includes a Preschoolers’ Run, divided into age groups, with wristbands and T-shirts required. The Polish Heating Professionals Championships are intended for employees of the district heating industry.

name: 9 Półaraton Leśny Na Żarcie
location: Leśna polana przy ul. Zakopiańskiej, Legionowo, Poland
price_range: 50 zł; biegi dzieci i młodzieży bez opłat
description: The 9th Półmaraton Leśny "Na Żarcie" is a cross-country race of approximately 21 km, held in a forest clearing on Zakopiańska Street in Legionowo. The course consists of two loops and runs exclusively along forest roads, giving the event the character of a trail race. The event is open to adults and also features cross-country races for children and young people with no entry fee. Participants receive a race pack with a bib, a sports gadget, a meal, and a commemorative medal. The race takes place regardless of weather conditions in April, with a 12:00 start.
course_highlights: A cross-country course of approximately 21.1 km over two loops
Runs exclusively along forest roads
Start and finish in a forest clearing on Zakopiańska Street
additional: A baggage deposit is available to participants in the main race. The race pack includes a returnable race bib, a baggage-deposit bag, a sports gadget, a "Na Żarcie" meal, and a commemorative medal. Prizes and trophies are awarded to the top finishers in the overall and age categories, as well as to the top participants from Legionowo. The event takes place regardless of weather conditions. The main race course is not officially certified.

name: Arm Race Wrocław
price_range: Karnet na 3 starty w 2027 roku: 699 zł; karnet Selection na 2 starty: 699 zł
description: Arm Race is an extreme obstacle race offering a range of formats for different ability levels. Participants can choose from the classic 5 km and 10 km distances in PRO, OPEN and FUN categories, take on challenges lasting several hours in the Selection format, or try the fast-paced OCR100. This event is for people looking for sporting competition, technical obstacles and real excitement on the course, as well as for families and younger athletes. Arm Race combines physical activity, endurance and the satisfaction of overcoming challenge after challenge.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses with around 25 and 40 obstacles
Selection format with 12- and 24-hour challenges
Family course of around 1 km, with no competitive pressure
additional: You can purchase a 2027 season pass covering 3 ARM RACE starts (5 km or 10 km, PRO/ELITE with no additional fees) or 2 starts in the SELECTION format for 699 zł, with an ARM RACE technical cap as a gift. The pass can be purchased by bank transfer to the account of Stowarzyszenie Rajsport Active. Family formats and formats for young athletes, with timing and rankings, are also available.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu im. Adama Mickiewicza, Poznań, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań is a spring edition of a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska. The event takes place in the picturesque Botanical Garden in Poznań, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. Since 2014, the organizers have emphasized the aesthetics of the courses and the promotion of running among different age groups. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and discover Poznań’s charming surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden in Poznań
Picturesque, aesthetically pleasing natural surroundings
Race organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las, based in Poznań. The event is a cross-country race and emphasizes the aesthetic qualities of its proposed locations. In summer 2026, the organizers are celebrating the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka. The organizer provides a participant guide and separate information about children’s and youth races. Registration for the main distance and children’s races has closed.

name: I Charytatywny Otwarty Bieg i Marsz Nord...
Leśny Zryw w Starych Jabłonkach
location: Hotel Anders Beach, ul. Spacerowa 2, Stare Jabłonki, Poland
description: Leśny Zryw in Stare Jabłonki is a race held on the beach at Hotel Anders and in the forest managed by the Stare Jabłonki Forest District. The event combines sport with an environmental initiative to plant a forest, offering two distances: a 10 km individual run and a 5 km family run or walk with tree planting. The event is family-oriented and inclusive, with additional culinary and educational activities for participants and their families. The start and finish are on the beach at Hotel Anders, and the 5 km route is on gravel and asphalt surfaces. Online registration has closed, but registration and payment are available at the Race Office.
course_highlights: 5 km route: 4 km on gravel, 1 km on asphalt
Pine saplings are planted along the 5 km route (1 tree per person)
Start and finish on the beach at Hotel Anders; the route runs through the forest managed by the Stare Jabłonki Forest District
additional: The Race Office and the start/finish are on the beach at Hotel Anders. Parking is available on the municipal sports field opposite the hotel. The time limit for the 5 km route is 2 hours. Participants receive a timing chip, which must be returned after the race. After the race, there are culinary and educational activities, as well as attractions for children. In the 2025 and 2026 editions, the start, finish, and Race Office were on the beach at Hotel Anders at ul. Spacerowa 2. Entry fees from those editions were allocated to charitable causes.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Bie...
location: Zachowice, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Niebieska 5-ka
description: The Blue 5K is a race organized in Słupsk by the “Sub ventum” Foundation for Supporting Unconventional Initiatives. The event invites everyone to run together and spend time actively.

name: Piknik Charytatywny
description: The Charity Picnic in Wolsztyn is a 10 km race that combines sporting competition with charitable giving. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event takes place on a paved course of moderate difficulty, making it accessible to a wide range of runners. It’s a great opportunity to combine physical activity with support for important community initiatives.
course_highlights: 10 km paved course
Moderate difficulty
A charity event combining sport and helping others
additional: Training plans are available for 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to participants’ VDOT levels and supported by experts.

name: Towarzyskie Mistrzostwa Polski w 12-godz...
location: Stadion Miejski w Morągu, Morąg, Poland
description: The Polish Social Championships in the 12-hour cross-country race “Parkowy Ultra Kros #STOPdepresji” is a unique running event held at the Municipal Stadium in Morąg. Competitors race on an approximately 1.46 km loop for 12 hours. To be classified, participants must spend at least 3 hours on the course. The event offers electronic timing, a marked course and a generous race pack, including a commemorative medal and refreshments. The race is recreational in character and promotes physical activity and support for mental health.
course_highlights: The course follows an approximately 1.46 km loop
Electronic timing using returnable chips
Medical support on the course and at the Race Base
additional: The race pack includes an original race bib, a marked course, electronic timing, hot and cold drinks, and a cold refreshment station available throughout the event. Participants receive a commemorative medal. Medical support is provided on the course and at the Race Base. The participant limit is 150. Runners must spend at least 3 hours on the course to be classified. Classification requires at least 3 hours of activity on the course.

name: Ultra miles of Beskid Wyspowy
location: Łącko, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Ultra miles of Beskid Wyspowy is a recurring running event held in the picturesque Beskid Wyspowy region in Łącko. The event offers a variety of distances, allowing participants to discover the appeal of mountain trails and beautiful landscapes. Race packets for all distances include bandanas, and the organizers ensure smooth communication through the registration form. It’s a great opportunity for mountain-running enthusiasts who want to take on challenging courses and enjoy the atmosphere of a sporting event.
course_highlights: Mountain trails in Beskid Wyspowy
Picturesque landscapes and natural scenery
A variety of distances suited to different ability levels
additional: You can contact the organizer through the registration form on the website.

name: V Bieg na Kokocińcu
description: The 5th edition of the Bieg na Kokocińcu is a family running event held in the scenic Panewnicki Forest in Katowice. The routes follow forest paths with varied surfaces, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy active recreation outdoors. The event brings people together and welcomes both adults and children, who can take part in the family run. All participants receive a commemorative medal reflecting the event’s woodland character.
course_highlights: The routes pass through scenic parts of Panewnicki Forest
Varied surfaces and natural terrain
A family-friendly event with routes for younger participants
additional: All participants who complete the race receive a commemorative medal featuring leaf motifs and green accents symbolising closeness to nature. Radio Katowice is the event’s media patron. The organisers are the W Kręgu Natury Association and the Kokociniec and Sadyba Residents’ Initiative, together with the official Katowice city profile. The co-organisers were the Kokociniec and Sadyba Residents’ Initiative and the City of Katowice.

name: VIII Festiwal Pieszo-Biegowy Przedwiośni...
description: The 8th Przedwiośnie Hiking and Running Festival is a unique event bringing together fans of long-distance challenges and mountain scenery in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Participants can choose from a range of distances: the family-friendly 7 km Przedwiośniaczek, Mini (25 km), Marathon (44 km), Ultra (76 km), and the demanding Giga (101 km). The routes pass through scenic areas, including the vicinity of Łysica, with the start and finish at the symbolic Stefan Żeromski Manor in Ciekoty. The festival welcomes both beginners and experienced hikers and runners, offering an unforgettable spring experience on the trails.
course_highlights: Routes pass through scenic areas of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, including the vicinity of Łysica
A range of distances from 7 km to 101 km, suited to different experience levels
Start and finish at the symbolic Stefan Żeromski Manor in Ciekoty
additional: The festival offers five distances: Przedwiośniaczek (7 km), Mini Przedwiośnie (25 km), Marathon Przedwiośnie (44 km), Ultra Przedwiośnie (76 km), and Giga Przedwiośnie (101 km). The routes are planned anew each year to visit the most interesting and scenic parts of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. The event brings hikers and runners together and welcomes both beginners and experienced participants. It combines running and hiking; the shortest, 7-kilometre route is for hikers. The date, 10 April 2027, comes from the event data.

name: X Rajd Wilczy
description: Rajd Wilczy is an Adventure Race-style sporting challenge combining trail running, cycling, special stages and tasks. The event takes place in Żory, where participants compete on different courses suited to various ability levels and team or individual formats. It brings families together and promotes outdoor activity, combining sport with adventure and nature. The organizers provide professional event management and engaging courses that require fitness, navigation skills and teamwork.
course_highlights: PROFI course: 130–150 km, midnight start, running, cycling and water stages, plus special tasks; 16-hour time limit
OPEN course: 60–80 km, two-person teams, running and cycling with technical challenges; 6-hour time limit
BIEG course: approximately 20 km of orienteering through wooded areas; 5-hour time limit
additional: Courses for different categories: PROFI (two-person teams, 130–150 km, 16-hour limit), OPEN (two-person teams, 60–80 km, 6-hour limit), ROWER (individual competition, 40–50 km, 5-hour limit), BIEG (individual orienteering run, 20 km, 5-hour limit), and RODZINNA (recreational course, 5–8 km, no classification, free entry). The event is organized in cooperation with MOSiR Żory and Hufiec ZHP Żory. Participants need to demonstrate navigation skills and physical fitness. The PROFI course starts at midnight. The event is family-friendly and adventure-oriented. In the 2025 edition, the event base was the MOSiR Sports and Events Hall in Żory.

name: XI Kuźniański Półmaraton Leśny
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Kuźni Raciborskiej
description: The 11th Kuźniański Półmaraton Leśny »Rafamet« is an annual sporting event held at the municipal stadium in Kuźnia Raciborska. The main race, a half marathon (21.0975 km), follows scenic forest trails, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature and fresh air. The event also features a 10 km race and a 10 km Nordic walking event, creating a unique sporting atmosphere. It is organized by the Municipal Cultural, Sports and Recreation Centre in Kuźnia Raciborska, which invites everyone to take part in this special event.
course_highlights: The route follows forest trails
Enjoy nature and fresh air
Scenic natural surroundings
additional: The event includes three activities: a half marathon, a 10 km race, and a 10 km Nordic walking event. Registration is conducted separately for each activity. An article about the 11th edition gives the date as 11 April, while the specified event date is 10 April 2027.

name: XVIII Wiszeńska (za)Dyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury Sportu i Rekreacji w Wiszni Małej
description: The 18th Wiszeńska (za)Dyszka is a 10 km race held in Ligota Piękna, in the municipality of Wisznia Mała. The event takes place annually and attracts runners from various places, offering a sporting challenge on a scenic course. The start and finish are near Ligota Piękna, and the event is organized by the Culture, Sport and Recreation Centre in Wisznia Mała. The race takes place in April and is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Scenic surroundings of Ligota Piękna
Organized by the local Culture, Sport and Recreation Centre

name: Zorientowane Kozy
description: Zorientowane Kozy is an orienteering race held in Kozy, on the site of a former quarry and in the surrounding forests. Participants can test themselves on sport courses of varying difficulty or choose a recreational course, also suitable for beginners and families. Map navigation leads through varied terrain, with forest sections, elevation changes, and steep slopes. It’s an opportunity to spend time actively and discover the area from a different perspective.
course_highlights: Sport courses A, B, and C, plus recreational course R
Map navigation through the former quarry and surrounding forests
Varied terrain with significant elevation changes and steep slopes
additional: Editions in previous years were held at the Quarry in Kozy; course and fee details may differ for the 2027 edition.

name: 14 Bieg o Złote Gacie
description: The 14th Run for the Golden Trousers is an annual road race held in Brzeszcze, taking place on April 11, 2027. The traditional race route is 10 km long and runs along Nosala Street. The event also includes a 5 km children’s run and Nordic walking. It is a family-friendly sporting event that promotes physical activity among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: 10 km main race route
5 km children’s run
Start and finish on Nosala Street in Brzeszcze
additional: The race office is open on race day from 7:30 to 11:00. The children’s run starts at 10:00 at the KS “Górnik” Brzeszcze Stadium. The main race and Nordic walking start at 11:30 on Nosala Street. In 2026, the main race and the “Almost 5K” were scheduled to start at 11:30 on Nosala Street; the entry fee was PLN 65 until March 8 and PLN 75 from March 9 to April 8.

name: 14 Półmaraton Jeleniogórski
location: Plac Piastowski, Cieplice, Jelenia Góra, Poland
description: The 14th Jelenia Góra Half Marathon is a unique race set in the picturesque landscape of the Karkonosze Mountains, with views of the mountains. The half-marathon course is certified by the PZLA and passes through charming parts of Jelenia Góra and Cieplice. The event is a great opportunity to enjoy the excitement of sport and spend time actively outdoors. The organizers invite runners to take part in several distances, including the half marathon, 10 km, Cieplicka Piątka, Uzdrowiskowa Mila, and races for children.
course_highlights: A 21.097 km half-marathon course certified by the PZLA
Scenic views of the Karkonosze and Izera Mountains
Start and finish at Piastowski Square in Cieplice
additional: The race office is located in Zdrojowy Park by the Animation Theatre. The event takes place on 11–12 April 2027 (in 2026, it took place on 11–12 April). Available distances include the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.6 km, and races for children. The half-marathon course is certified by the PZLA. The 2026 program also included 10 km, 5 km, and 1.6 km races, as well as junior races. The race office was located in Zdrojowy Park by the Animation Theatre, and the Sunday races were scheduled to start at Piastowski Square in Cieplice. Free changing rooms and baggage storage, as well as a post-race meal at the finish, were to be available.

name: 18 Półmaraton Dąbrowski
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji w Dąbrowie Górniczej
description: The 18th Dąbrowa ArcelorMittal Poland Half Marathon is an annual running celebration in Dąbrowa Górnicza, attracting both elite athletes and recreational runners from across Poland and abroad. The 21.097 km course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association, fast and relatively flat, yet scenic, passing through the city’s most beautiful areas. The event offers substantial prize money and professional organization, with refreshment stations, medical support, and pacemakers. The race has a unique atmosphere, and its participant limit is 2,000, reflecting the event’s popularity.
course_highlights: Certified 21.097 km course
Fast and relatively flat, ideal for personal bests
Scenic route through the most beautiful areas of Dąbrowa Górnicza
additional: Refreshment stations with water and isotonic drinks, medical support, and pacemakers to help runners maintain their pace are available along the course. A course map showing refreshment stations and notable locations is available. The organizer provides free parking in designated areas, except for the car park in front of CENTRUM Hall and Nemo Aqua Park. The race office operated at the CENTRUM Sports and Entertainment Hall; the participant limit was 2,000.

name: 40 Bieg Sokoła
description: Bieg Sokoła is an annual running event organized by the “Sokół” Gymnastics Society in Bukówiec Górny, promoting physical activity and the Włoszakowice Municipality region. The event includes several races, including a 15 km race and shorter distances, as well as the Polish Physicians’ 15 km Championships. The event is marked by a sporting spirit, professional organization, and electronic timing. The start and finish are located at the Village Cultural Centre in Bukówiec Górny.
course_highlights: 15 km main race course
Additional distances: 5 km, 2 km, and 1 km
Start and finish at the Village Cultural Centre in Bukówiec Górny
additional: Participant verification and race-bib collection take place on Saturday from 16:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 8:00 to 10:15. Timing is electronic and uses chips, which are mandatory for participants to be classified. Participants must bring an identity document for age verification. Those under 18 must have written consent from a parent or guardian. Runners must comply with safety rules and the regulations; taking a shortcut results in disqualification.

name: 41 Biegi o Puchar Kocich Gór
location: Kobyla Góra, Ostrzeszów County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The National Races for the Kocie Góry Cup are an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Kobyla Góra. The competition attracts runners from all over Poland, offering the chance to compete on courses of varying difficulty. It is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and discover the charms of the region. Registration is via an online form, and the organizers warmly welcome both amateur and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses in Kobyla Góra
A nationwide competition
The event includes cross-country championships for people with disabilities
additional: In the previous edition, registration was handled through the UltimaSport online form.

name: 42 Bieg Szpęgawski
location: Stadion Miejski im. Kazimierza Deyny, Starogard Gdański, Poland
organizer: Miasto Starogard oraz Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Starogardzie Gdańskim
description: The 42nd Bieg Szpęgawski with AQ is one of the oldest road races in Pomerania, held since 1983. The race is intended for amateurs, professionals, and young runners alike. The certified 5 km course is historic and symbolic, running from Szpęgawsk to Starogard Gdański. The organizers provide bus transport to the start and a bag drop for runners. This event has a rich tradition and attracts runners hungry for records and personal bests.
course_highlights: Certified, fast 5 km course
Historic and symbolic route from Szpęgawsk to Starogard Gdański
Organizer-provided bus transport to the start
additional: The organizer provides bus transport to the start from 10:40 to 11:20. Transport is not guaranteed after 11:20. Road traffic is completely stopped at 11:45. A mobile bag drop and a bag drop under a tent at the start are available. Bags can be collected after the race, at approximately 13:15, at the Deyna Center. The organizer provides free bus transport to the start. A mile race is also available.

name: Bieg Mestwina
description: Bieg Mestwina is a running event held in Przywidz and part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The race offers two main routes, 5 km and 10 km, through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia. It attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting an active lifestyle and local running culture. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and professional organization, continuing the tradition of the largest running event in northern Poland.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in Przywidz, surrounded by Kashubian nature
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland
additional: Bieg Mestwina is one of many events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, which includes various distances and locations across Kashubia. The event promotes physical activity and brings the local community together. The series also features children’s and youth races, as well as other accompanying events. In the edition described in the sources, the children’s races are free and require no registration. Open, age-group, and Przywidz municipality resident classifications are listed.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego, Warszawa, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Botanical Garden in Warsaw. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has promoted running and the beauty of natural routes since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate beautiful surroundings and being close to nature. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the unique setting of a botanical garden.
course_highlights: A cross-country route through the Botanical Garden in Warsaw
Picturesque natural surroundings
Part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, which promotes trail running
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts active since 2014, with an emphasis on cross-country running and the aesthetic appeal of the routes. In summer 2026, they are celebrating the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages.

name: Cross Śrem Grand Prix
location: Orlik w Psarskiem, Psarskie, Śrem County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Śremski Sport, Gmina Śrem i Nadleśnictwo Konstantynowo
price_range: 40 zł za jeden bieg online; 120 zł za pakiet czterech biegów; 50 zł w dniu startu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przy zapisie online na jeden bieg

description: Cross Śrem Grand Prix is a series of trail races held in the scenic forests around Psarskie, near Śrem. The approximately 5.4 km course follows forest paths and paved cobblestones, giving runners a chance to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie, which also houses the race office and is the venue for the warm-up and official opening. Participants can expect a medal, a recovery meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications. The event is organized by Śremski Sport together with the Śrem Municipality and Konstantynowo Forest District.
course_highlights: Approximately 5.4 km over forest paths and paved cobblestones
Start and finish at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie, with a modern building and changing rooms
A run through scenic woodland close to the centre of Śrem
additional: The race office, warm-up, and official opening take place at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie at around 11:45. Participants have access to water, hot tea, and coffee in the new building with changing rooms. The event is funded from the Śrem Municipality budget as part of its programme for preventing and addressing alcohol-related problems and drug addiction. Information about fees and the series is from the 2025–2026 edition. In this edition, the start was scheduled for 12:00; participation in at least three of the four races was required for the final classification.

name: DOZ Maraton Łódź 10K Run
description: DOZ Maraton Łódź 10K Run is a 10 km race held as part of DOZ Maraton Łódź. In the previous edition, runners set off from the area around Atlas Arena and ran through the streets of Łódź, finishing inside Atlas Arena. It is suitable both for people making their 10K debut and for runners looking to test their fitness at a major running event.
course_highlights: Urban route through the streets of Łódź
Start near Atlas Arena
Finish inside Atlas Arena
additional: Route and schedule information is from the 2026 edition.

name: Ekonomiczna Piątka
description: Ekonomiczna Piątka is an annual race organized by the Poznań University of Economics and Business, held in the area around Lake Malta. The 5 km course runs on asphalt, making it appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The event combines sport and socializing, offering a chance to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course around Lake Malta
Asphalt surface
Scenic recreational areas of Poznań

name: I Bieg Grodkowski
description: The 1st Grodków Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Grodków on April 12, 2027. The course is moderately challenging, ideal for runners looking for a challenge on asphalt. The race is a great opportunity to test your fitness and compete in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with an individual training plan tailored to each runner’s level.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Moderate difficulty
Race on asphalt
additional: The organizer offers individual training plans with a coach, tailored to the runner’s level and needs, with the option to get in touch via WhatsApp. The plans include technique and diet adjustments, as well as analysis of data from sports watches. Expert support is available online for runners preparing for the race.

name: IX Bieg Wiosny
description: The 9th Spring Run is an annual running event held at the Tustań Forest Lodge in the Naruszewo municipality. Participants can choose 2.5 km and 10 km running routes along forest roads, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. The event combines sport and recreation, attracting runners from across Poland. At the finish, commemorative medals, trophies, and gifts await the top finishers. The organizers also provide post-race refreshments and music, creating a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: The running routes follow forest roads in the Tustań Forest District
Available distances: 2.5 km, 10 km, and a 5 km Nordic walking event
The scenic areas of the Naruszewo municipality provide an appealing setting for sporting competition
additional: The main race starts at 11:00. Every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish, while the top finishers receive trophies and gifts. Post-race refreshments and music are provided. Around 157 runners from across Poland took part in the event. In the 2026 edition, the 10 km race followed two 5 km loops.

name: IX Mazurski Bieg na Kulke
description: The 9th Mazurian Kulka Run is an annual running event held at the picturesque Kulka Holiday Resort near Szczytno. The course has been slightly modified and runs through the beautiful Masurian countryside, with the start and finish on the resort grounds. The event is open to runners of varying abilities, and participants can look forward to a positive atmosphere, a medal, and a post-race recovery meal. The event also has a charitable purpose, supporting Kornelia through fairs and auctions. Organizers provide activities for children and young people, as well as the option to stay overnight at the resort.
course_highlights: A picturesque course starting and finishing on the grounds of Kulka Holiday Resort
A slightly modified route through the heart of Masuria
An atmosphere full of positive energy and sporting adventure
additional: Race packet pickup is on race day from 08:30 to 10:30 at the Race Office. Registration on race day is available until the limit of 250 participants is reached (16 places currently available). After the race, a recovery meal prepared by the resort’s cooks is served. Children and young people can take part in activities at the resort under instructors’ supervision, depending on weather conditions. The event is charitable, with fairs and auctions in aid of Kornelia. For the 2026 edition, the time limit is 105 minutes and the participant limit is 250. The event also features activities for children and a recovery meal.

name: Leśna Pętla Niepołomice
description: Leśna Pętla Niepołomice is a family running and cycling event held in Niepołomice, surrounded by the Niepołomice Forest. In the 2026 edition, runners could choose between 5 or 10 km, while cyclists covered a 20 km route; a shorter cycling route was also prepared for children. It’s an event for those who want to combine sporting competition with an active day outdoors.
course_highlights: Forest routes surrounded by the Niepołomice Forest
A 5 km running loop, with the option to choose 5 or 10 km
A family program featuring cycling events, including a route for children

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly and family-oriented sporting competition held in Międzyzdroje. In the 2026/2027 season, participants can compete in runs of approximately 5 and 10 km and in nordic walking events of approximately 5 and 7 km. The league is known for its healthy competition and welcoming atmosphere, inviting both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete the required distances in at least four events. Participation is free, and people aged 14 and over may take part.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: To qualify for the league’s overall standings, participants must enter at least four events and complete the required distances: two 5 km and two 10 km runs, or two 5 km and two 7 km nordic walking events. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian and must be accompanied by them. The league final is scheduled for 11 April 2027. Registration is available at protiming24.pl.

name: Perły Małopolski Skała
location: Skała, Kraków County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Perły Małopolski Skała is a trail race in the Perły Małopolski mountain running series, held around Skała and Ojców. The routes pass through scenic parts of Małopolska, near or within national parks. Choose from distances of approximately 5, 10, and 20 km to match the challenge to your abilities.
course_highlights: Trail routes around Skała and Ojców
Scenic landscapes of Małopolska
Three distances: approximately 5, 10, and 20 km

name: Podkowa Biega
location: Centrum Podkowy Leśnej, Podkowa Leśna, Poland
description: Podkowa Biega is an annual race held in Podkowa Leśna, promoting sport and physical activity among residents and bringing the local community together. The main 10 km race runs through the town centre and along the picturesque paths of Młochowski Forest, showcasing the varied character of this garden city and its historic landmarks. The event also includes children’s and youth races over shorter distances suited to participants’ ages. After the race, participants can enjoy a finisher’s area with a recovery meal, massage and group stretching. The event is family-oriented and co-funded by the Podkowa Leśna Municipal Office.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the centre of Podkowa Leśna and Młochowski Forest
Picturesque paths and historic landmarks of the garden city
Children’s and youth races over distances from 100 m to 1 km
additional: Children’s races start from 9:30 a.m., grouped by year of birth. Race packs can be collected at the Bohaterów Warszawy Primary School on Saturday from 11:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. and on Sunday from 8:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.; children’s race packs are handed out at the start on Aleja Lipowa. After the race, a finisher’s area is available with a recovery meal, massage, cakes and group stretching. In the previous edition, the children’s and youth races were free, and the time limit for the main race was 2 hours.
