name: Suwałki Miss Run & Suwalski Bieg z Wąsem
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Suwałki Miss Run & Suwalski Bieg z Wąsem is a colorful and joyful sporting event held in Suwałki, combining sport, fun and a unique atmosphere. The event is aimed at runners of different ability levels, as well as families and groups of friends who want to spend time actively. The program features a variety of events, including the High-Heel Run, the Egg Run and the main races over 3.5 km for women and 5 km for men. It is also an opportunity for creative fun and shared excitement, with numerous contests for the most interesting outfits and Miss titles.
course_highlights: The High-Heel Run combines a sporting challenge with elegance
The Egg Run calls for concentration and precision
Main races over 3.5 km (women) and 5 km (men)
additional: The event also includes the Little Lady and Little Gentleman Run for children. Participants receive commemorative medals. Men are required to have a moustache, natural or artificial. The event promotes creativity and fun, and also features the Suwałki Miss Fashion, Miss Photo and Miss Audience Choice contests. The program also includes children’s races and contests and pageants. Moustaches, including artificial ones, are required for the Bieg z Wąsem.

name: V Bieg Hazoka
description: The 5th Hazok Run is an annual running event organized by MK Team Events and held in Siemianowice Śląskie. The race is part of the MK Team Grand Prix series and attracts runners from the region, promoting an active and healthy lifestyle. Participants can expect professional organization and a unique sporting atmosphere. The event also includes races for children, making it appealing to the whole family.
course_highlights: Running distances of 5 and 10 km, plus 5 km Nordic walking
Approximately 75% of the route runs along forest trails
Children’s races over distances from 50 to 800 m
additional: The event also includes races for children and a Nordic walking event. Participants receive commemorative medals. The routes are not certified by the PZLA.

name: Wiosenna Dycha
description: Wiosenna Dycha is an annual road race held in Lublin, attracting both amateur and experienced runners. The event takes place in spring and is a great opportunity to spend time actively and test your fitness over the 10 km distance. Lublin, one of Poland’s most running-friendly cities, offers participants an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. The event’s organizer, the Lublin Sports Development Foundation, promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings the running community together.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
The race takes place in central Lublin
An atmosphere that encourages amateur and professional runners to connect
additional: The race is organized by the Lublin Sports Development Foundation, which works to promote physical culture and develop sport in the region. Wiosenna Dycha is one of many running events held in Lublin, with different distances and categories for various age groups. In 2026, the race was scheduled for 09:00.

name: XIV Bieg Wojciechowy
description: The 14th Wojciech Run is an annual running event held in Serock that attracts runners of all ages. The races take place on scenic urban routes, and the organizers provide timing by Time-Sport. The event also includes races for children, making it appealing to families and the local community. Serock, as the host town, offers a wide range of recreational and sporting activities, further highlighting the event’s character.
course_highlights: The running routes pass through the center of Serock
Scenic views of the lake and green areas
Professional timing provided by Time-Sport
additional: Timing is provided by Time-Sport. The event takes place at the Market Square in Serock. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages.

name: XRUN Szczyrk Run
description: Mercure SZCZYRK RUN is a mountain trail race held in picturesque Szczyrk, with its base at Mercure Szczyrk Resort. Runners can choose from a variety of distances, from short courses for children to demanding ultra-distance routes with significant elevation gain. The courses follow atmospheric Beskid trails, offering beautiful views and a classic mountain-running experience. The event is well organized, with clear time limits and starts spread over two days, making participation more comfortable. It is an ideal choice for mountain-running enthusiasts who value a challenge and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: 45 km course with 2,400 m of elevation gain; 9-hour time limit
15 km course passing Klimczok, Trzy Kopce, and Przełęcz Karkoszczonka
Distances range from 150 m for children to 45 km for experienced runners
additional: The start and finish for all distances are located at Mercure Szczyrk Resort. The time limits are 9 hours for the 45 km course, 7 hours for 25 km, 5 hours for 15 km, and 5 hours for 6 km. Starts are spread over two days: Saturday (7 km and children's distances) and Sunday (longer distances). Children's age categories are for ages 3 to 15. Detailed course maps and descriptions are available on the website. The program also includes a children's race. The official website lists the date as 20 June 2027, not 11 April 2027.

name: XVI Bieg Raszyński
description: The 16th Raszyn National Run is an annual 10 km road race held in Raszyn. The course consists of three laps of approximately 3.33 km, along Raszyn’s streets through residential areas. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and runs over flat asphalt, which is conducive to fast times. The participant limit is 600, and the event attracts runners from across Poland.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Three laps of approximately 3.33 km along Raszyn’s streets
Flat asphalt surface
additional: The start and finish are in Raszyn: the start is on Szkolna Street and the finish is at 1 Unii Europejskiej Street. The race office is open from April 7 to 9, from 17:00 to 20:00, and on race day from 8:00 to 10:30. The time limit for completing the race is 2 hours. A 5 km Nordic Walking event with a separate classification and a 10:45 start is also held for residents of Raszyn Municipality. Children can take part in the accompanying races free of charge. For the 2026 edition, the participant limit is 600 and the time limit is 2 hours. The program also includes children’s races and Nordic Walking.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Arek Tołłoczko i Rafał Malitkowski, przy wsparciu Stowarzyszenia na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small running event held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The marathon route follows forest and country roads in a peaceful, uncrowded setting, with an emphasis on camaraderie and recreational running. The organizers, including Arek Tołłoczko, invite runners to take part in four editions of the marathon each year, offering varied conditions and beautiful scenery. The start and finish are on Polna Street, and the course is well marked and prepared for runners.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km route along forest and country roads
Start and finish on Polna Street in Chwałowice
Picturesque views of forests and fields, and a peaceful, uncrowded atmosphere
additional: A 7 km running route laid out and marked by the Harcownik Running Club; the event is not mass-participation in character, with a relaxed approach to competition and prizes; convenient parking; four marathons held each year (in winter, spring, summer, and autumn). Descriptions of earlier races indicate a marathon distance of 42.195 km.

name: Leśne Poruszenie
location: Skwer, ul. Pomorska 71, Dębogórze, gmina Kosakowo, Poland
description: Leśne Poruszenie - Dębogórze is a unique sporting event held on the forest trails of the Kosakowo municipality. The event is for everyone who enjoys an active lifestyle, offering cross-country races for children and adults, a Nordic Walking race, and a cycling ride. Its aim is to bring residents together, promote a healthy lifestyle, and spend time together in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and race office are located at the square in Dębogórze, at 71 Pomorska Street. Participants will receive race packs, commemorative medals, and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Forest trails of the Kosakowo municipality
Cross-country races for children and adults (1 km, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Nordic Walking race and cycling ride
additional: The start and race office are at the square in Dębogórze, at 71 Pomorska Street. In the 2026 edition, the start and race office were at the square in Dębogórze, at 71 Pomorska Street. The previous edition’s program included children’s races of approximately 1 and 2 km, adult races of approximately 5 and 10 km, Nordic Walking over approximately 5 km, and a cycling ride of approximately 10 km.

name: Bieg Kreta
location: Kletno, Stronie Śląskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Kreta is an elite mountain ultramarathon held in the Sudetes, offering two routes: the classic 148 km and the extreme 377 km Hardcore. The route follows the famous Sudetes Triangle, covering the three highest peaks of the Sudetes, across varied terrain, mud, snow, and ice. The race runs day and night without long breaks. It is a challenge for experienced runners who want to take on a legendary route and the history of this ultramarathon. The race traditionally starts in Sobótka, and participants are provided with aid stations and mobile support.
course_highlights: The route covers the Sudetes Triangle: Ślęża, Śnieżka, and Śnieżnik
Varied terrain: asphalt, cobblestones, forest trails, rocky sections, and muddy sections
Extreme elevation gain of up to 12,000 m over the 377 km distance
additional: The race traditionally starts on Wednesday at 17:00 from Winiarnia Celtica in Sobótka (ul. Czysta 1). Participants can leave their cars in the parking lot and book accommodation. Mandatory gear for the route: a charged phone, a flashlight with spare batteries, a water container with a capacity of at least 1 l, a hooded rain/windproof jacket, a route map, and a GPS tracker. The organizer plans gear checks and aid stations where participants can access their own drop bags, as well as mobile support. The Classic route is open to people aged 18 and over who have no medical contraindications to long-distance running; the limit includes 80 places for participants who register and pay the entry fee by the required deadline, plus 25 places allocated by the organizer. Candidates for the Hardcore option are vetted by the organizer.

name: Top Cross Torunia
description: Top Cross is a series of 12 cross-country races held in Rudelka Forest Park in Toruń. Each race consists of 5 laps plus a short run-in, for a total distance of approximately 6,666 metres. Participants earn points for taking part, and their 8 best results count towards the overall standings. Runners who take part in at least 8 editions receive a commemorative medal. It is also possible to complete a race individually without earning points.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Rudelka Forest Park
The course consists of 5 laps plus an approximately 200 m run-in
Course distance: approximately 6,666 metres
additional: Registration takes place at V LO Toruń, at ul. Sienkiewicza / Fałata. The race office opens one hour before the race. A runner can complete a race individually without earning points. The series consists of 12 races. The eight best results count towards the overall standings; a commemorative medal is awarded for taking part in at least eight editions.

name: Szczyt Wytrzymałości
description: Szczyt Wytrzymałości is an extreme mountain race run on a loop of approximately 4.5 km around Mount Równica in Ustroń. The course features substantial elevation gain of around 420 meters per lap, making it very demanding both physically and mentally. Participants can choose one of two categories: the 12-hour category, where the number of completed laps counts, or the 24-hour 8848 Everest category, symbolizing an ascent of Mount Everest. The race is for warriors who want to test their endurance, character, and determination on a challenging, technical course.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 4.5 km with +/- 420 m of elevation gain per lap
Narrow trails, steep climbs, and technical descents
A course featuring one of the most demanding loops in Polish mountain running
additional: Two race categories: 12H (12 hours to complete as many laps as possible) and 8848 Everest (21 laps, approximately 95 km, a 24-hour time limit, symbolizing an ascent of Mount Everest). The race takes place on a loop around Mount Równica, known for its difficult conditions and substantial elevation gain. The course demands great endurance and determination, and the race is a rite of passage and a test of character. In the December edition, the start, finish, and race office were located at Gościniec Równica.

name: 19 Mini Cracovia Maraton im. Piotra Gład...
description: The Cracovia Marathon is Kraków’s most important running event and Poland’s largest spring marathon. It has been held since 2002. The 42 km and 195 m course passes through historic and modern parts of the city, including the Main Market Square, the Royal Castle on Wawel Hill and Nowa Huta. The event attracts runners from around the world and takes place under the slogan “with history in the background.” The marathon weekend also features accompanying races, including the Piotr Gładki Mini Cracovia Marathon, the 10 km Night Run, and roller-skating and Nordic walking events.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Kraków’s Main Market Square
The course passes the Royal Castle on Wawel Hill and the Cloth Hall
The route passes modern venues such as TAURON Arena Kraków and the ICE Kraków Congress Centre
additional: The marathon weekend also features the Piotr Gładki Mini Cracovia Marathon (4.2 km), the 10 km Night Run, the Cracovia Marathon on Roller Skates (the full marathon distance to be completed within a maximum of 3 hours), and a 4.2 km Nordic walking event. Participants with disabilities compete in wheelchairs in the handbike, rim push and active wheelchair categories. In the edition described in the source, registration was open until 10 April or until places were filled; a “School in the Run” classification for students was also planned.

name: II Leśny Lament
location: Ośrodek Sportowo-Rekreacyjny „Grzybówka”, ul. Podgórna 50, Rybnik, Poland
description: II Leśny Lament is a trail run in Rybnik, based at the “Grzybówka” Sports and Recreation Centre. The route follows forest trails, making the event a chance for runners to enjoy off-road running and test themselves on natural terrain. Previous editions featured 4-, 6- and 8-hour formats.
course_highlights: Forest trails and natural terrain
Start and base at the “Grzybówka” Sports and Recreation Centre in Rybnik
Previous editions offered 4-, 6- and 8-hour formats
additional: Previous editions of the event took place at 50 Podgórna Street in Rybnik.

name: 7 Nocna Dycha
description: Nocna Dycha Brzeg is a 10 km road race held in Brzeg, Opole Voivodeship. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), guaranteeing official measurement and high quality. The race attracts night-running enthusiasts, offering a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete on a certified course in the city centre.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
PZLA certification guaranteeing official distance measurement
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
additional: 1,196 runners took part in the 2026 edition.

name: 7. 6 godzin pełnej MOCY
location: Stadion OSiR Targówek, ul. Łabiszyńska 20, Warsaw, Poland
price_range: Bieg indywidualny: 260 zł; sztafeta: 640 zł (ceny z edycji 2026)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa w biegu indywidualnym wynosi 260 zł (dla członków Stowarzyszenia 230 zł)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa w biegu sztafetowym wynosi dla całej sztafety 640 zł (dla sztafet w 100% z członków Stowarzyszenia 540 zł)

description: The 7th edition of the “6 Hours of Full POWER” race will take place on April 17, 2027, at the OSiR Targówek stadium in Warsaw. The event includes an individual race and relay races over a 6-hour time limit, run on laps of approximately 400 m and 422 m. Participants compete in two groups simultaneously, with results combined. An official split time is recorded at the 50 km mark. The event also includes the Masovia Relay Running Championships.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a stadium track with laps of 400 m and 422.382 m
Official split time at the 50 km mark
Two groups compete simultaneously, with results combined
additional: Participant limit: 70 in the individual race and 16 relay teams. A relay team may consist of 4 women, 4 men, or be mixed (at least one woman). The organizer assigns participants to start groups. The entry fee must be paid to the account of the POLSKIE ULTRA Sports Association after completing the entry form.

name: 9 Dziesiątka Babicka
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Stare Babice
description: Skynet Dziesiątka Babicka is the largest running event organized in the Municipality of Stare Babice near Warsaw, aimed at running and healthy-lifestyle enthusiasts. The centerpiece is the main 10 km race on a certified course, following flat asphalt roads with an uphill section in the final 100 meters. The event also includes children’s races over shorter distances, without timing and divided into age categories. Participants receive race packs containing a bib with a chip, a commemorative T-shirt, and a sponsor pack. The start and finish are located at 32 Rynek Street in Stare Babice. The time limit for completing the main race is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 10 km course
Entirely asphalt and flat, with an uphill section in the final 100 meters
Start and finish at Stare Babice Municipal Office, 32 Rynek Street
additional: Race packs can be collected at Stare Babice Primary School, 40 Polna Street, on April 17 (17:00–20:00) and April 18 (7:00–11:30). Each pack contains a race bib with a chip, safety pins, a commemorative T-shirt, and a sponsor pack. The start line will close 10 minutes after the starter’s gun. The time limit for completing the main race is 1.5 hours, with an additional 10-minute allowance for runners who pass the 9 km mark after the cutoff. The children’s races start at 9:45, are untimed, and every participant receives a medal. Awards ceremonies take place on the main stage immediately after each children’s race.

name: Bieg Daniela
description: Daniel’s Run is an annual running event held in Smolarnia, in the Strzeleczki municipality. This is the event’s fifth edition, combining sporting competition with the joy of movement and fun. Participants can take on a course full of sporting energy, regardless of their experience level. The run is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and enjoy the atmosphere of running together.
course_highlights: Previous editions featured 5 km and 10 km races.
Juniors and nordic walking participants also took part in the event.
The run takes place in Smolarnia, in the Strzeleczki municipality.
additional: Daniel’s Run takes place in Smolarnia and is a sports and recreation event that promotes the joy of movement and fun. It is a local event organized by the Strzeleczki Municipal Office. In previous editions, runners competed for personal bests or simply for the satisfaction of finishing with a smile. The running calendar lists an approximate date of April 18, 2027, and a distance of 10 km.

name: Bieg po Zdrowie
organizer: Zespół Szkół nr 1 im. Powstańców Śląskich w Kędzierzynie-Koźlu
description: The 11th Run for Health is an annual running event organized in Kędzierzyn-Koźle by the Powstańcy Śląscy No. 1 School Complex. The race takes place on an urban course with professional RFID timing, ensuring precise results. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and participants can expect smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among local residents.
course_highlights: Urban course in Kędzierzyn-Koźle
Professional RFID timing
Organized by a local school – the Powstańcy Śląscy No. 1 School Complex
additional: The event uses electronic RFID timing provided by Time-Sport.pl. The organizer provides comprehensive technical support and timing. The event is open to all and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: II Półmaraton Karolewo - Pruszcz
description: The 2nd Karolewo–Pruszcz Half Marathon is a certified 21.0975 km race taking place on 17 April 2027. The course is entirely paved, flat and marked every kilometre, making it conducive to good results. The race office is open on race day, and participants receive race packs containing, among other things, a bib, a timing chip, a T-shirt and a voucher for a recovery meal. The event is organised by the Agro-Economic School Complex in Karolewo, and timing is provided by STS-Timing.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course
Entirely paved and flat
Course marked every 1 kilometre
additional: The race office is open on race day from 8:30 to 16:00. Race packs contain a bib, a timing chip, safety pins, a voucher for a recovery meal, running memorabilia and a T-shirt. Participants should indicate their T-shirt size in the registration form. Unclaimed race packs will not be mailed or made available at a later date.

name: II Żelechowska Nocna Piątka
organizer: Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo oraz Miasto i Gmina Żelechów
description: The 2nd Żelechów Night Five is an annual race held in Żelechów that kicks off the running season in the town. The event attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, offering a sporting atmosphere and a chance to spend time actively. The race takes place in the evening, giving it a distinctive character and adding to the appeal for participants. It is organized by the local authorities of the town and municipality of Żelechów together with the Żelechów Active in Sport group.
course_highlights: Evening road race in Żelechów
5 km distance
First stage of the 2nd Żelechów Running Triad
additional: The race takes place in the evening and is organized by the Żelechów Active in Sport group. The event is part of the local sports calendar and aims to promote physical activity among residents. Registration for the race is open.

name: III Mistrzostwa Polski Masters
organizer: Koszalińskie Towarzystwo Krzewienia Kultury Fizycznej i Polski Związek Lekkiej Atletyki Masters
description: The 3rd Polish Masters Championships is a race organized by the Koszalin Society for the Promotion of Physical Culture, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place on Góra Chełmska in Koszalin and is aimed at masters-category runners. It has a recreational and sporting character, with chip timing and overall classifications for women and men. The organizer provides third-party liability insurance, and participants can expect official award ceremonies.
course_highlights: A race on the natural terrain of Góra Chełmska
Chip timing using returnable chips attached to footwear
Overall classifications for women and men, with trophies for places 1–3
additional: No license was required for the 2026 edition.

name: Kresowe Trail #2
description: Kresowe Trail in Mielnik is a small-scale trail race held in the scenic Topolina woodland. The event offers two distances: the shorter Szpurt (7.8 km) and the longer Wertep (15.6 km), along carefully marked routes with natural surfaces and green markings. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature, and the local natural and cultural attractions of eastern Poland. Participants can expect professional organization, electronic timing, aid stations along the course and at the finish, and commemorative medals for those who register in advance.
course_highlights: Routes marked with green arrows on a yellow background
Two laps on the Wertep 15.6 km distance
An aid station along the Wertep course
additional: Online registration is available until 08:40 on race day. The first race bib is free; if it is lost or you change distances, you can purchase a replacement for 30 zł. The course time limit is 2 hours 15 minutes. The race package includes a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, electronic timing, medical support, aid stations at the finish and along the course, and a photography service. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. The 2026 edition started at 11:00 and had a time limit of 2 hours 15 minutes. The organizer announced electronic timing, medical support, and a hot recovery meal.

name: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce
description: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce is an annual road race held in the picturesque Old Town of Głogów. The 5 km course winds through the charming streets of the Old Town, offering participants a unique nighttime running atmosphere. The event is organized by Klub Sportowy ZG RUN and attracts many local runners. It is a great opportunity for sporting competition and an active day out in the heart of the city.
course_highlights: The course passes through the historic Old Town of Głogów
The race takes place in the evening, creating a unique atmosphere
The course is 5 km long, ideal for runners of different ability levels
additional: Participants can purchase a race pack from another runner through the race-pack exchange. Organizer: Klub Sportowy ZG RUN. Start and finish location: Bulwar Nadodrzański/Zespół Szkół Ekonomicznych w Głogowie. The program also includes children's races.

name: OSHEE Bieg Nocny
description: OSHEE Night Run is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque heart of Kraków, at the Main Market Square. This unique sporting event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering a nighttime atmosphere and professional organization. The course runs through the city’s historic streets, making the race not only a sporting challenge but also an unforgettable adventure. The organizers ensure participants’ comfort and safety along the course.
course_highlights: 10 km course in the center of Kraków
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
The course runs through the historic streets around the Main Market Square
additional: Telephone support is available Monday to Friday, 8:00–15:00, at +48 12 616 63 02. Organizer: Sports Infrastructure Management Board in Kraków.

name: Pobiegnij z Siódemką
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Siódemka, Niepubliczna Szkoła Podstawowa nr 7 im. Marii Skłodowskiej-Curie w Słupsku i Słupski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji
description: Pobiegnij z Siódemką is a charity cross-country run organized by the Maria Skłodowska-Curie Non-Public Primary School No. 7 in Słupsk. The event is held to support the treatment and rehabilitation of a child with a cleft palate, and taking part in the run is a real way to help Mateusz and his family. The run is community-focused and inclusive, combining sport with charitable activities. This is the fourth edition of the event, which enjoys strong support from the local community and sponsors.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Słupsk
Charity event supporting a child’s treatment
Organized by a local primary school
additional: The run is a charity event supporting Mateusz, who has a cleft palate. In previous editions, funds were raised and transferred to the Siepomaga foundation’s account. The event is supported by local sponsors and donors. The organizers thank everyone for their support and emphasize the importance of every step in the run. Proceeds from an earlier edition were donated to support Mateusz; one edition raised PLN 7,014.

name: Sportowa Gra Miejska
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 4, Osiedle Paderewskiego, Katowice, Poland
description: The Sport City Game in Katowice is an extreme urban adventure taking place in the Paderewski Estate and around the Three Ponds Valley. Participants can choose from three routes, including a family route with special tasks for parents and children. The game combines physical and logic challenges, offering a unique way to explore the city through a variety of tasks. The event attracts both fans of physical activity and those who want to discover the city in an unusual way.
course_highlights: Three routes to choose from, including a family route with special tasks
Explore the Paderewski Estate and the Three Ponds Valley
Physical and logic challenges at checkpoints
additional: Registration is available on the day of the event. A two-person trip to Prague, Vienna or Budapest will be raffled after the awards ceremony. The event base is at Primary School No. 4 in the Paderewski Estate. Event base: Primary School No. 4. Registration is scheduled to open on March 9.

name: VII Cross Ozimski PagóRace
organizer: Cross Ozimski - PagóRace i Stowarzyszenie ULTRA
description: Cross Ozimski PagóRace is a trail race in Ozimek, following forest hills and sandy climbs. The course combines natural, sometimes boggy terrain with challenging inclines. It’s an option for runners looking for a cross-country challenge in a forest setting.
course_highlights: A forest course among hills and slopes
About 15 sandy climbs, some of them boggy
A distance of about 11 km, with an additional loop allowing runners to cover about 22 km

name: Diagnostyka 19. Mini Cracovia Maraton
description: The Mini Cracovia Marathon in memory of Piotr Gładki is a 4.2 km run in Kraków that opens the city's marathon weekend. The first edition took place in 2006, and the run commemorates the winner of the 4th Cracovia Marathon in 2005, the only Pole so far to win it. The 19th edition ran in 2026, and the Kraków sports infrastructure authority lists the 20th edition for 17 April 2027. The run suits both short-distance specialists and people who are starting out.
course_highlights: Symbolic 4.2 km distance, one tenth of a marathon
Opens the Kraków marathon weekend
For experienced and beginner runners
additional: For the 2026 edition registration ran through an online form until 10 April or until the limit was reached, with remaining places at the race office on 17 and 18 April. Details for the 2027 edition are not yet published.

name: Kudowska Sztafeta Górska
description: Kudowska Mountain Relay is an international running event held in the scenic areas of Table Mountains National Park and Broumovské Stěny in Kudowa-Zdrój. The event includes a 3x25 km relay for teams of three and a solo run of approximately 75 km. There are also races over 42 km, 21 km, and 10 km, as well as Kids Trail races for children. The start and finish are in Kudowa-Zdrój Spa Park, and the routes follow varied mountain trails, offering exceptional views and challenging climbs.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Table Mountains National Park and Broumovské Stěny
The 3x25 km relay is divided into three different stages
A solo run of approximately 75 km with a challenging mountain profile
additional: The start and finish of all races are in Kudowa-Zdrój Spa Park, by the Teatr pod Blachą. The race office is located in the Mineral Water Pump Room in Kudowa-Zdrój. The event takes place on 10–11 April 2027. Entry-fee waivers are available to athletes with a high ITRA ranking. The organizer does not provide accommodation but recommends Kudowa-Zdrój as a place to stay. There are also races for children in three age categories and over three distances. Volunteering opportunities are available; the coordinator is Sylwia Niezgódka. The event is scheduled for 10–11 April 2027. Online registration is available; the organizer also announces fee waivers and preferential rates for selected athletes with an ITRA ranking.

name: 8. Gdańsk Maraton
description: Energa Gdańsk Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The marathon route passes some of the city’s most distinctive landmarks, including the European Solidarity Centre, the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island, the Baltic Philharmonic, the Neptune’s Fountain, the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre, and ERGO Arena. The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The event uses staggered start waves, and participants can expect a full race pack and extensive support along the course.
course_highlights: The route passes the European Solidarity Centre and the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island
Views of the Baltic Philharmonic, Neptune’s Fountain, and the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre
The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, with a visit to ERGO Arena
additional: The marathon starts in waves. The start line will close 5 minutes after the final starting signal. Holders of a Gdańsk resident card receive a 10% discount on the entry fee. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a medal, medical support, course refreshment stations, a hot meal at the finish, and gifts from sponsors. The official marathon T-shirt and backpack are available for purchase. The event is scheduled for 24–25 April 2027; the website lists the marathon, a 5 km race, a relay, and the Junior Marathon. Entry fee details are not provided in the available sources.

name: XXXIV Memoriał Uliczny im. Michała Fludra we Wleniu
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury Sportu i Turystyki we Wleniu
description:
Good morning,

I kindly request that you publish information on your portal/website about the upcoming sporting event—the 34th Michał Fluder Street Memorial, which will take place in Wleń on April 18, 2027.

The Memorial is one of the most important and longest-running running events in our region, attracting experienced athletes, recreational runners, children, and young people every year. The event traditionally features a 10 km main race on the town’s streets, as well as accompanying races for the youngest participants.

Below is a ready-to-use press release.
Proposed publication text:

34th Michał Fluder Street Memorial in Wleń

The Culture, Sport and Tourism Centre in Wleń warmly invites all running enthusiasts to the 34th Michał Fluder Street Memorial, taking place on Sunday, April 18, 2027.

The 10 km main race route will run along the scenic streets of Wleń and the surrounding area. The event is open to everyone and is intended both for runners competing for personal records and for those who want to spend time actively in a sporting atmosphere. As usual, children’s and youth races over shorter distances will be held before the main race.

The detailed rules, schedule, and link to online registration will be available soon on the website: oksit.pl and on social media: Facebook, OKSiT Wleń.

See you at the start in Wleń!
I am attaching photos from the previous race for use in the publication.
Here is a link to the report on the previous race: https://oksit.wlen.pl/wiadomosci/33831/za-nami-xxxiii-memorial-uliczny-im-michala-fludra-we-wleniu
Yours sincerely,

Marcin Jaworski
Culture, Sport and Tourism Centre in Wleń
Tel. 536 578 724
kultura@wlen.pl

Ludzie i dzieci wykonują rozgrzewkę na rynku przed biegiem ulicznym we Wleniu.

name: 15 Półmaraton Henrykowski
description: The 15th Henryków Half Marathon is a trail race whose route passes through picturesque places in Lower Silesia, including Krzelków, Muszkowice and Muszkowicki Forest. The start and finish are by the historic Cistercian Monastery in Henryków, adding a historical and cultural dimension to the event. The route combines asphalt and gravel surfaces, offering runners varied terrain. The event promotes physical activity, regional culture and local tourism. Participants can expect a commemorative T-shirt, a medal and a recovery meal.
course_highlights: The route passes through Krzelków, Muszkowice and Muszkowicki Forest
Asphalt and gravel surfaces
Start and finish by the historic Cistercian Monastery in Henryków
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:45 on race day. Bib numbers with timing chips are issued at the race office upon presentation of a QR code. Participants receive a technical T-shirt, a medal and a recovery meal. A bag drop and toilets are available at the start. Overall and age-group classifications are offered for the 21 km and 10 km races and Nordic Walking. Cash prizes are awarded to the top finishers in the half marathon. The route does not have PZLA certification. The regulations state that the route does not have PZLA certification. Available information also lists a 10 km race and 10 km Nordic Walking.

name: 6 Falstartowa Triada
description: Falstartowa Triada is a running competition across three forest routes, organized by the FALSTART Rudniki Running Club. The event combines a chance to experience forest terrain with sporting competition. Participants can compete individually and in the team classification.
course_highlights: Three forest routes
Individual competition
Team classification

name: Bieg Pamięci - wokół Góry Śmierci
location: Ekspozycja Historyczno-Dydaktyczna przy Górze Śmierci, Paszczyna, Poland
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Dębica
description: The Memorial Run around Góra Śmierci is an annual sporting event held in Paszczyna to commemorate the victims of Nazi labour camps and promote a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. The event takes place at the Historical and Educational Exhibition at Góra Śmierci and includes short-distance children’s races, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a 10 km main race. Participants in the main race receive a race pack, and classifications and prizes are provided for both children and adults in various age categories. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: 10 km main race route around Góra Śmierci
5 km Memorial Nordic Walking march
Children’s and youth races from 50 m to 1,000 m
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:30 and closes 15 minutes before the start of each distance. The main race entry fee includes a race pack. Prizes are awarded for places 1–3 in the main race, as well as in the age-group classifications. OPEN category winners are not awarded prizes in the age-group categories. The start and event venue are at the Historical and Educational Exhibition at Góra Śmierci in Paszczyna.

name: Bydgoski Bieg Urodzinowy
description: The Bydgoszcz Birthday Run is an annual running event held in Bydgoszcz, taking place on April 18, 2027. The race starts at 11:00. The participant limit is 1,500, and the first 1,300 people to register will receive a T-shirt. The route will be announced soon, and the event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels.
additional: A T-shirt is available to the first 1,300 people to register. A T-shirt is provided for the first 1,300 registered participants.

name: Cross na sześć łap
description: Uniejów Cross on Six Paws is a unique race for dog-loving sports enthusiasts, held in the picturesque areas along the Warta River near Uniejów Castle. Participants can choose between 5- and 10-kilometer routes, combining sport, adventure, and time in nature. The race ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, a canicross world champion, who brings his experience and passion to the course. At the finish, medals, trophies for the top finishers, and refreshments await both runners and their four-legged companions. The event is open to anyone who wants to spend active time with their dog and enjoy a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through picturesque areas along the Warta River near Uniejów Castle
Available distances: 5 and 10 kilometers
Run alongside your dog in natural surroundings
additional: At the finish, participants will receive medals, trophies for the top finishers, refreshments, water, and treats for dogs. The event takes place by Uniejów Castle. The race ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, 2025 IFSS canicross world champion. Advance registration is required. The previous edition also featured children's races of 100 and 300 m.

name: Dziki tor run
location: Tor motocrossowo-enduro przy ul. Hożej, Mieroszów, Poland
description: Dziki Tor Run is the inaugural edition of a race held on a motocross and enduro track on Hoża Street in Mieroszów. It’s a unique opportunity to test your endurance on natural, challenging terrain with hills and bumps, where enduro motorcycles usually rule. The race offers two distances: 4 km for beginners and 8 km for more experienced runners seeking a real challenge. The race is scheduled to start at 11:30, and registration is open until April 15, 2027.
course_highlights: A motocross and enduro track with natural terrain
Hills and bumps that challenge runners
No technical obstacles, but demanding terrain
additional: Two distances are available: 4 km (one loop) and 8 km (two loops). Registration is open until April 15 at 23:59. The race takes place on a motocross and enduro track on Hoża Street in Mieroszów. Running calendars list the event in 2027 but give an approximate date of April 19, rather than April 18.

name: IV Białołęcki Bieg Leśny
description: The IV Białołęcki Forest Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw’s Białołęka district. The race takes place on a forest course, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and varied running conditions. The organizers, Fundacja Małopolskie Szlaki, provide professional race services and timing using RFID technology. The participant limit is 500, and the start is scheduled for 10:00.
course_highlights: Forest course in Warsaw’s Białołęka district
Professional RFID timing
Limited to 500 participants
additional: The race takes place in Warsaw’s Białołęka district. The organizer provides electronic RFID timing. The start is at 10:00. The participant limit for the 2026 edition was 500. Timing was provided by Time-Sport.pl.

name: IX Bieg Jelenia
description: Bieg Jelenia is the open Tychy cross-country championships, held in the scenic Paprocany forests. The approximately 7–8 km course consists of two 3.5–4 km loops, following forest tracks and terrain with natural obstacles such as roots, mud, tree branches and soft sand. The event is co-financed by the City of Tychy and also includes the Bieg Jelonka for children and young people. The start is at the Paprocany Recreation Centre in Tychy.
course_highlights: A 7–8 km cross-country course over two loops
Natural obstacles: roots, mud, tree branches and soft sand
Scenic Paprocany forests
additional: The event also includes the Bieg Jelonka for children and young people. The start and finish are at the Paprocany Recreation Centre (Parkowa 17, Tychy). The race is co-financed from the City of Tychy budget. The Bieg Jelonka for children and young people is held alongside the event.

name: Poznań Półmaraton
location: ul. Roosevelta near Międzynarodowe Targi Poznańskie, Poznań, Poland
description: The PKO Poznań Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Poznań, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half-marathon course runs through the city streets, offering a unique sporting experience and an opportunity to test your fitness. The organizers ensure the event has a family-friendly atmosphere, also offering an activity zone and races for children and young people. The event is well organized and enjoys considerable prestige in the running community.
course_highlights: Start on Roosevelta Street, near the Poznań International Fair
Course through the streets of Łazarz and Grunwald
The race also passes through Junikowo and Ławica
additional: Registration for the 19th PKO Poznań Half Marathon will open in December. The regulations and price list are being finalized and will be announced soon. The organizers are providing an activity zone and races for children and young people as accompanying events. The course and program are in preparation, and participants are encouraged to follow the official information channels. Registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open in December; the entry form is being prepared.

name: Siedlecki Maraton Na Raty
organizer: Fundacja Ultramaratonu Nadbużańskiego, Agencja Rozwoju Miasta Siedlce oraz Triathlon Siedlce Club
description: The Siedlce Stage Marathon is a unique running event held in Siedlce, offering two distances to choose from: a marathon and a half marathon. The race takes place in three stages at three different locations: City Park, Sekulski Forest and Muchawka Reservoir, making it an exciting challenge spread over three days. The event has a new format that lets participants tackle the distance in stages and also includes races for children. The organizers provide professional event production and an awards ceremony at the finish.
course_highlights: Three stages held at three locations: City Park, Sekulski Forest and Muchawka Reservoir
Choice of distance: marathon or half marathon
Children’s races during the final stage
additional: The race office is open on April 17 from 17:00 to 18:30 at the Rector’s Office of the University of Siedlce. The awards ceremony will take place on April 19 at around 15:15 by Muchawka Reservoir. Children’s races take place during the final stage, starting at 14:45. Participants may use poles; Nordic Walking classification is available only for the half marathon. The combined participant limit for the marathon and half marathon is 200. Previous editions also featured children’s races and a Nordic Walking competition over the half-marathon distance.

name: TAURON 23. Cracovia Maraton
description: The Cracovia Marathon is Kraków’s most important running event and Poland’s largest spring marathon over the 42 km and 195 m distance. Held since 2002, it attracts runners from around the world, representing more than 80 countries. The course passes through historic and modern parts of Kraków, with the start and finish on the Main Market Square, beside landmarks such as Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall. The event also offers a weekend full of sporting attractions, including the 10 km Night Run, the Mini Cracovia Marathon, roller-skating races and Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Kraków’s Main Market Square
The course passes Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall
Views of the Old Town at night during the 10 km Night Run
additional: The event also includes the Mini Cracovia Marathon (4.2 km), the Cracovia Marathon on Skates (the full distance around the Błonia, with a maximum time limit of 3 hours), a 4.2 km Nordic walking event and the 10 km Night Run, with a time limit of 1.5 hours. Participants with disabilities compete in wheelchairs in the handbike, rim push and active wheelchair categories. The event is international in character and is held under the slogan “with history in the background”.

name: VI Oleśnicki Bieg Leśny
location: Miodary, Oleśnica County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

price_tiers.distance: 21 km, 10 km i Nordic Walking 9 km

description: The 6th Oleśnica Forest Run is an annual running event organized by the Cała Oleśnica Biega Association, held in the picturesque, green forests of Miodary. Participants can compete in the half marathon (21 km), the 10 km race, and 9 km Nordic Walking. The youngest participants can take part in the 100- and 200-meter Gnome Races. The event offers professional organization, high-level sporting competition, and beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: The routes run through the green, unpolluted forests of Miodary
Available distances: half marathon (21 km), 10 km race, and 9 km Nordic Walking
Special races for children: 100 m and 200 m Gnome Races
additional: The Gnome Races start at 10:00, the half marathon at 10:30, and the 10 km race and 9 km Nordic Walking at 11:00. Start location: forest car park in Miodary. The organizers promise a friendly atmosphere, professional organization, and beautiful weather. The event is supported by GKN Automotive Poland, the Oleśnica Śląska Forest District, and the City of Oleśnica.

name: XVIII Bieg Piaśnicki
organizer: Gmina Wejherowo i The North Event
description: The Piaśnica Run commemorates the victims of the German occupation of Poland during World War II. The running and Nordic walking routes pass through places where thousands of innocent people were murdered. The event aims to honor the victims, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring the local community together. It also features cultural events, such as exhibitions, lectures, and concerts, that introduce the history of Gdańsk Pomerania.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes through historic sites of wartime atrocities
Commemoration of the victims of the German occupation of Poland
Cultural events: exhibitions, lectures, concerts, and meetings with historians
additional: The event includes running races and Nordic walking. It promotes a healthy lifestyle and community integration. The event is commemorative and educational. Previous editions have also included races for children and young people.

name: Bronek Run Forest Edition
description: Bronek Run - Forest Edition is the fifth-anniversary edition of the race, held in the picturesque Grudziądz Municipal Forest. It’s an event for running enthusiasts who enjoy being surrounded by nature, with soft forest trails, natural climbs, and the peaceful atmosphere of the woods. The 10 km race is part of the Grand Prix of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, and special Bronek Run Kids - Forest Edition races have been prepared for the youngest participants. Participants can look forward to a special forest-themed medal and forest-themed socks in the race pack, as well as an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: Picturesque routes through the Grudziądz Municipal Forest
Natural climbs and the peaceful atmosphere of the woods
Soft forest trails
additional: A race for children and adults. The race pack includes forest-themed socks, and participants receive a medal inspired by the race’s forest setting.

name: XXXIII Memoriał Uliczny im. Michała Flud...
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury, Sportu i Turystyki we Wleniu
description: The Michał Fluder Street Memorial has been held in Wleń, in the Bóbr Valley, since 1992. The 33rd edition took place in the market square, with a 10 km main race and an additional 6 km distance. The next, 34th edition is scheduled for 18 April 2027. It is organized by the Culture, Sport and Tourism Centre in Wleń, and registration is due to open on the Datasport platform.
course_highlights: Start, finish and race office near Wleń market square
10 km main race and a shorter 6 km distance in the 2026 edition
Races for children and young people, plus an inclusive race
additional: The 2026 edition also welcomed wheelchair athletes, and residents of Wleń municipality had a separate category. For the 2027 edition, the organizers have announced a 10 km race and races for young people; start times and fees have not yet been announced.

name: ITMBWieczorem
location: Bulwar Polewski at Most Dębnicki, Kraków, Poland
description: I Too Can Run in the Evening (ITMBWieczorem) is a popular, weekly series of free 5 km and 10 km races with professional timing, held on the Vistula Boulevards in Kraków. The races take place every Thursday at 20:00, giving participants the chance to test their fitness in a true competitive atmosphere and connect with the running community. The course follows the Vistula Boulevards, starting and finishing by Dębnicki Bridge, with a turnaround at the Field Fort on Tyniecka Street. Everyone is welcome, regardless of experience, and there is no entry fee.
course_highlights: Course along the Vistula Boulevards in Kraków, starting and finishing by Dębnicki Bridge
5 km and 10 km distances (the 10 km course is two laps of the 5 km route)
Turnaround at the Field Fort on Tyniecka Street
additional: The races are run on a friendly basis along walking paths. Participants must take care around pedestrians and cyclists. Time limits are 40 minutes for 5 km and 1 hour for 10 km. Participants must have the race number (barcode) received during registration and provide it at the finish. After completing 25, 50, and 100 races, participants can order a commemorative T-shirt for 25 zł. There is an option to leave small belongings at the start, but the organizer is not responsible for items left there. From March to April and from October to November, races are held only over 5 km. Participants must register using the form. They should have their race number with them or remember its number.

name: 7 Bieg Korczaka
organizer: Specjalny Ośrodek Szkolno-Wychowawczy nr 1 dla Dzieci Niepełnosprawnych Ruchowo w Policach im. Marii Grzegorzewskiej
description: The 7th Korczak Run is an annual running event organized by Special Education Center No. 1 for Children with Physical Disabilities in Police. The event includes a 5 km main race, Nordic walking, and children’s races over various distances, including races for children in wheelchairs. The main race route consists of two loops with an additional section, making for an interesting and varied course. The event promotes inclusion and physical activity among people of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The main race route consists of 2 loops with an extra section
The event includes children’s races over distances from 200 to 600 meters
Nordic walking is available over a distance of 5 km
additional: Medals for race participants. Forms are available to download: transfer of a race entry, guardian’s statement/consent, and authorization to collect a race pack. Recommended parking areas are listed on the website. Numerous photo galleries and videos from previous editions are available. The event website provides registration, regulations, and a course map. Electronic timing by B4SPORT is available.

name: XXXVI Biegi im. Tomasza Hopfera
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janowcu Wielkopolskim
description: The 36th Tomasz Hopfer Runs is an annual running event held in Janowiec Wielkopolski. The main event is a 10 km race that attracts runners from various regions. The organizers also offer races for children, promoting physical activity among the youngest participants. The course is certified, ensuring it has been accurately measured and professionally prepared.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km race course
Children’s races tailored to different age groups
Scenic areas of Janowiec Wielkopolski
additional: The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Janowiec Wielkopolski. Phone: +48 452 469 185. The program includes races for children and the main 10 km race. The website includes regulations and results from previous years.

name: PKO Gdynia Półmaraton 35. PZLA Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaraton
description: PKO Gdynia Half Marathon is one of the largest running events in Poland and will take place on April 24, 2027. The half-marathon course runs through the modern city of Gdynia, showcasing its unique modernist character. The race starts in the evening at 19:30, so runners finish after dark, creating a special atmosphere. The event attracts individual runners, relay teams, and participants in accompanying 5 km and children’s races.
course_highlights: A half-marathon course of over 21 km through Gdynia
Evening start at 19:30, with the finish at City Beach after dark
A PZLA-certified 5 km course, as well as children’s races and relays
additional: The half-marathon participant limit is 15,000. The time limit for completing the half-marathon is 4 hours. The entry fee can be transferred to the next edition up to 14 days before the event. Refunds are available up to 45 days before the race if registration took place within the first 30 days after entries opened. Half-marathon relays consist of teams of 3. The 5 km course is PZLA-certified. The children’s race (Kids Run) takes place on Saturday at midday, with a unique medal at the finish. The event will also include 5 km races, relays, and Kids Run. Early registrants can receive a full refund if they withdraw up to 45 days before the race; the fee can be transferred free of charge to the next edition up to 14 days before the event.

name: 43 Bieg Kujawiaka
organizer: Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy VECTRA we Włocławku
description: The 43rd Bieg Kujawiaka is the oldest sporting event in the Włocławek region, held in memory of Napoleon Dzwonkowski and Wiesław Wesołowski. The race attracts people who enjoy physical activity and runners from various places, and takes place at Przylesie Stadium. This event has a rich tradition, brings the local community together, and promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs around Przylesie Stadium in Włocławek
An event with a long tradition and historical significance
A race in memory of local sports figures Napoleon Dzwonkowski and Wiesław Wesołowski
additional: The organizer is the Sports and Recreation Centre in Włocławek. The event takes place at Przylesie Stadium. The website does not provide details about start waves, participant limits, or race packages.

name: 8 Bełchatowski Bieg Nocny
organizer: Miejskie Centrum Sportu w Bełchatowie oraz Bełchatowski Klub Lekkoatletyczny
description: The 8th Bełchatów Night Run is a unique sporting event combining racing with the one-of-a-kind atmosphere of an evening run through the streets of Bełchatów. Participants cover a 10-kilometre course certified by PZLA, which is well suited to setting personal bests. The start and finish are at Gabriel Narutowicz Square, and the evening schedule adds to the event’s distinctive character. The race promotes an active lifestyle and brings the local running community together.
course_highlights: A certified 10-kilometre course through the streets of Bełchatów
Start and finish at Gabriel Narutowicz Square
Evening start at 21:00, with a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes
additional: The race office is in the concert hall of the Municipal Cultural Centre at 3 Narutowicz Square and is open from 18:00 to 23:00. A baggage deposit is available for participants’ personal belongings. Participants must be over 16; minors need permission from a parent or guardian. Timing is recorded using chips attached to race bibs. The participant limit is approximately 400. Information about the 21:00 start and the 1-hour-40-minute time limit comes from the previous edition.

name: Backyard Ultra TRICITY
description: Backyard Ultra TriCity is a unique ultra race in a format that originated in the USA. Runners start every hour and have to complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they can rest until the next full hour, when they begin another lap. The race continues until only one runner remains at the start and completes the final loop within the hour limit. It is a demanding and exciting race in which only one winner is crowned.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km (4.167 mile) loop
Starts every full hour
A 1-hour limit to complete each loop
additional: Runners have 15 minutes to rest after completing a loop if they finish it in less than 60 minutes. The race takes place in Gdańsk. The organizer provides downloadable rules. The race is for adults. The available registration page is for the 2026 edition.

name: Bieg Zająca
description: Bieg Zająca is one of the Warsaw Grand Prix events, held in the picturesque Kabaty Forest. The event offers running routes of various lengths, suited to runners of different ability levels. Participants can expect professional organization, a race package, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race. The event has a family-friendly, community-oriented atmosphere, with prizes for the top finishers and special recognition for the oldest participant and the funniest costume.
course_highlights: Routes in Kabaty Forest — natural woodland trails
Time limit: 60 minutes for the 5 km race and 80 minutes for the 10 km race
Start and race office on the clearing beside the Kabaty Metro Technical Depot
additional: The race office opens at 09:00. Race bibs are issued only on race day. A special trophy for the oldest male or female participant and recognition for the funniest costume. Prizes in the overall and age-group classifications. Participant limit: 450.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin is the spring edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, highlighting the aesthetic appeal of the venue. The race is recreational and sporting in nature and is part of a series of cross-country races in Wielkopolska and other cities. The organizers aim to promote running and create a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the UMCS Botanical Garden
Picturesque and attractive race setting
Passionately organized since 2014
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races. In summer 2026, they will celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka. Trzymsie.pl is a partner of the autumn series. Previous editions included races for children over four shorter distances.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
location: Polana za Stadionem Piasta, ul. Leśna, Gliwice, Poland
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic walking events held in Gliwice, in the municipal forest by Piast Stadium. The 4,219.5 m course runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections, and is open to anyone who enjoys spending time outdoors in a healthy, active way. The events are open to all, with individual and team classifications, as well as an e-Prowokacja for participants during periods when sports events are prohibited. The organizers encourage regular participation and overcoming laziness, offering rewards for perseverance.
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course along forest trails, gravel paths and asphalt
Start and finish on a clearing near Piast Stadium in Gliwice
A refreshment point with drinks available after each lap
additional: Events are held once a month on Saturdays. The time limit is 3 hours for running and Nordic walking; e-Prowokacja has no time limit. Participants may complete 1 to 5 laps (approximately 4.2 km to 21 km). Race numbers are valid for the entire year and must be returned to the race office after the event. After the event, participants receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a chocolate bar through a prize draw, if sanitary regulations permit. Online registration is available only once a year; changing the discipline requires a new registration and race number. This is a series of events held regularly on Saturdays. In the edition described by MZUK, the race office was open from 9:00, and the start was scheduled for 10:00; prior registration and payment of the entry fee were required to be classified.

name: III Bieg Pełną Parą dla Dzieciaków
Paratriathlon Kraina Liwca
location: Pałac i Folwark Łochów, Łochów, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Leny Grochowskiej i Stowarzyszenie Arche
description: Paratriathlon Kraina Liwca is a charity team event that brings together people with and without disabilities. It takes place in the picturesque Liwiec Valley at the Łochów Palace and Folwark. The event consists of three stages: a 5.5 km run, a 7 km kayak trip and a 22 km bike race. The running route passes through green spaces and historic buildings, while the kayak trip takes place on the Liwiec River. The event promotes physical activity and social inclusion, and proceeds from entry fees go towards creating supported housing.
course_highlights: 5.5 km run on the grounds of Łochów Palace and Folwark — 3 laps through picturesque green spaces and past historic buildings
7 km kayak trip on the Liwiec River, with equipment provided and life jackets required
22 km bike race through Karczewizna, Twarogi, Matały, Zambrzyniec and Kamionna, returning to Łochów Palace and Folwark
additional: Teams of 3–4 people, with at least 1 person holding a disability certificate. The kayak trip uses equipment provided by the organiser; life jackets are mandatory. Time-trial bikes and road bikes with aerodynamic wheels are prohibited, as is drafting during the bike race. Timing is electronic, using chips. The race office is open on 24 April from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 25 April from 8:30 to 12:30. The organiser provides transport for participants to the kayakers’ start. After the event, there will be an open food area and a concert. The start and event are based at Łochów Palace and Folwark. The 2026 edition’s rules allowed teams without a person holding a disability certificate, but added 30 minutes to their result. Route and organisational information is from the 2026 edition.

name: Pelplin Forest Run
description: Pelplin Forest Run is a running and Nordic walking event held at Rajkowski Mill since 2024. The start, finish, and race office are located at the kayak marina, and the routes pass through the scenic Bukowiec Forest District. The event is co-organized by the Kociewie Sports and Cultural Association and the Pelplin Municipality Sprint Kulice Sports Club, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature and compete in a beautiful forest setting.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Bukowiec Forest District
Start and finish at the kayak marina in Rajkowski Mill
Running and Nordic walking in a natural forest setting
additional: The distances and location provided are from previous editions.

name: Wiosenny Fesiwal Biegowy
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Żywcu
description: The 33rd Spring Running Festival is an annual event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Żywiec. It features a cross-country race on Grojec and accompanying races for children. Set in the picturesque surroundings of the Amphitheatre at the foot of Grojec, the event offers participants the chance to spend time outdoors and stay active. Runners of all ages and experience levels are invited to take part in this sporting tradition.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on Grojec
Accompanying races for children
Scenic course around the Amphitheatre at the foot of Grojec
additional: The festival includes the 33rd edition of the Cross-Country Race on Grojec and accompanying races for children. The regulations are available as an attachment on the organizer’s website. Course and program details are from the 2026 edition.

name: XLIV Uliczny Bieg Bartów
location: Stadion w Barcianach, ul. Sportowa 1a, Barciany, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Przy zgłoszeniach internetowych udział osób niepełnoletnich jest bezpłatny.

description: The 44th Bartów Street Run in Memory of Jan Liniewski is a traditional road race held at the stadium in Barciany. The event has a rich history and is open to various age groups, from preschoolers to adults, including people with disabilities. The main race course is approximately 3,800 metres long and runs through the streets of Barciany. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping, medals and prizes, as well as a friendly atmosphere and support from spectators.
course_highlights: The main race course is approximately 3,800 m long and runs through the streets of Barciany
Age categories range from preschoolers to adults, including a race for people with disabilities
Start and finish at the stadium in Barciany, 1a Sportowa Street
additional: The race office is open from 8:30. Registration and race-pack collection are available until 45 minutes before the start of each category. Electronic timekeeping uses a returnable chip. Medical care is available on site. Prizes are drawn after the race. Race numbers must be placed on the chest or on a special belt at the front of the body. The co-organizer of the previous edition was the Warmian-Masurian LZS Association.

name: XVIII Złotowski Bieg Zawilca
description: The 18th Złotów Anemone Run is an annual running event held in Złotów, aimed at people who enjoy running, active recreation and a sporting atmosphere. The race takes place on courses suited to different groups of participants, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The event is open and welcoming to runners of varying experience levels. The organizers provide professional event management and attractive conditions for starting and competing.
additional: The event is co-organized by the Złotów Municipal Office, Granqvists Manufacturing Sp. z o.o. and the Alfred Sokołowski District Hospital in Złotów.

name: XXIX Bieg o Puchar Dyrektora MOSiR
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Czechowicach-Dziedzicach
description: The 29th Race for the MOSiR Director’s Cup is an annual running event held at the MOSiR Stadium in Czechowice-Dziedzice. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, offering an opportunity to spend time actively outdoors. The competition takes place at the municipal stadium, which is well equipped and conducive to sporting competition. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and encourage all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: The course runs around the MOSiR Stadium in Czechowice-Dziedzice
A well-prepared athletics track surface
The event takes place in picturesque urban surroundings
additional: Registration was available online only; it was not possible to register on race day.

name: XXXV Biegi Uliczne Wiosna Cekowska
description: The XXXV Wiosna Cekowska Street Races is an annual running event held in Ceków-Kolonia. The races attract runners from various towns and offer street courses of different lengths. The event is open and welcoming to participants of different ages and ability levels. The start and finish are at the Public Preschool in Ceków-Kolonia, and the races take place in the afternoon.
course_highlights: Street running courses in Ceków-Kolonia
Start and finish at the Public Preschool
The event takes place from 12:00 to 15:00
additional: The races take place from 12:00 to 15:00. A list of confirmed and unconfirmed participants is available on the website. No information is available about entry fees or participant limits.

name: III Bieg na dychę
description: The “Fabianki Ten” is a running event held at the stadium in Chełmica Cukrownia. Its name indicates a distance of 10 km, and an earlier edition took place in April 2026. The race combines sporting competition with an active day out in the Fabianki municipality.
course_highlights: The stadium in Chełmica Cukrownia is the event venue
A 10 km race, as suggested by the name “Ten”
Located in the Fabianki municipality

name: Zabiegani na tropie
organizer: Zabiegani Częstochowa wraz z Miastem Częstochowa

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 180 zł z koszulką - w miarę dostępności koszulek

description: Bieg Częstochowski is an annual running event organized by the Zabiegani association in Częstochowa, promoting running as a simple form of physical activity. The route passes through the city center, and participants can expect professional organization, water stations along the course, and attractive prizes. The race office is located in the sports hall of the H. Sienkiewicz Secondary School No. 4, and the race starts on Sunday at 11:30. The event is very popular and has a positive atmosphere, as confirmed by its many editions and the involvement of the local running community.
course_highlights: The route passes through the center of Częstochowa
Water stations at approximately 3.3 km and 7.3 km
Start and finish near NMP Avenue III, by the City Art Gallery
additional: The race office is open on Saturday from 12:00 to 15:00 and on Sunday from 8:30 to 10:45. Collecting the race pack requires proof of identity or authorization. Using public transport is recommended due to traffic disruptions and the lack of parking at the race office. An awards ceremony and a prize draw for participants are scheduled after the race. According to the organizer’s materials, every team receives a prize at the finish.

name: Pieniny Ultra Trail Spiski Wędrowiec - 135.7 km
description: Spiski Wędrowiec is a 135.7 km mountain ultramarathon held in the picturesque Pieniny Mountains. The race starts at the dam on the Czorsztyn Reservoir in Niedzica and finishes at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. The course passes nine aid stations and offers exceptional views and challenging climbs. Participants can expect professional organization, transport to the start, and commemorative medals for finishers.
course_highlights: A 135.7 km route through the Pieniny Mountains with 9 aid stations
Start at the dam on the Czorsztyn Reservoir; finish in Szczawnica
Transport from Szczawnica to the start and a drop bag in Tylmanowa
additional: The time limit for finishing the race is 30 hours. Buses to the start depart from Szczawnica at 15:50. Mandatory equipment includes a race bib and shoe-mounted chip, a water container with a capacity of at least 1 liter, and a mobile phone with a working battery. Plastic cups are not provided at aid stations. Participants receive a 30 l drop bag for Tylmanowa and a guide with the event’s key information. Prizes and trophies are provided for the top competitors, and every finisher receives a commemorative medal. The organizer provides transport from Szczawnica to the start in Niedzica. A 30 l drop bag for Tylmanowa is available; required equipment includes, among other things, a fluid container with a capacity of at least 1 l and a mobile phone.

name: Zamczyska Trail
description: Zamczyska Trail is a renowned mountain race held in picturesque Rymanów-Zdrój. The event offers three challenging distances: 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km, with significant elevation gain and aid stations along the route. The courses follow both marked and unmarked hiking trails, with additional signage provided by the organizers to make navigation easier. The race attracts mountain-running enthusiasts and offers professional organization and a limited number of places.
course_highlights: The courses follow marked and unmarked hiking trails
Significant elevation gain: 600 m (10 km), 1150 m (21 km), 2300 m (42 km)
Aid and hydration stations along the route: 1–3, depending on the distance
additional: The participant limit is 250 across all distances. A complete race package is guaranteed for participants whose entry fee is paid by 31.03.2027. Time limits: 2h15' (10 km), 4h (21 km), 7h (42 km). The start and finish are by the wooden shelters above Czarny Potok. On the marathon course, aid stations are located at 10 km, 21 km, and 31 km. Participants aged 16 and over may enter the 10 km race after consultation and with a guardian present.

name: 16 Cieszyński Bieg
organizer: Miasto Cieszyn, Město Český Těšín, Správa účelových zařízení, Szkolne Schronisko Młodzieżowe w Cieszynie oraz Agencja Sportu i Reklamy Andrzej Filipiak
description: The Cieszyński FORTUNA Run is an international road race held in the historic city of Cieszyn, which stretches along both banks of the Olza River. The approximately 10 km course runs through the streets of Cieszyn and Český Těšín, along the riverfront boulevards, offering attractive views and sporting excitement. The event attracts runners from various countries, and participants receive commemorative T-shirts and medals. Spectators line the course, and musical and dance entertainment helps create a friendly, joyful atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course follows the Olza River on both the Polish and Czech sides of Cieszyn
The race consists of two loops, with a total distance of approximately 10 km
The route passes through the stadium in Český Těšín, between the stands and the pitch
additional: The main race is limited to 1,200 participants. Runners must be at least 16 years old; minors must submit a statement from a parent or guardian. The time limit for completing the course is 75 minutes. The race pack includes a race bib and a commemorative technical T-shirt. There is a sprint prize on the course in Český Těšín. The course has been slightly modified because of roadworks on Božkova Street. After the race, cash and in-kind prizes are awarded to the top finishers and in age categories. For the 2026 edition, the main race is limited to 1,200 participants, and youth races are also planned.

name: 23 Bieg Jakubowy
description: LOTTO 23rd Jakubowy Run is a road race in Olsztyn with a tradition spanning more than twenty years, organized by the HORUS Association. The 10 km course, certified by PZLA, passes through some of the city’s most beautiful and charming places, with the start and finish in Olsztyn’s Old Town by the fountain. The event is one of the most popular running events in the Warmia and Masuria region and takes place at the beginning of the running season. In addition to the main race, children’s races and a 10 km Nordic Walking event are also held.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Olsztyn’s Old Town by the fountain
The route passes through Podzamcze Park, the boulevards along the Łyna River, and the avenues by the lake
A 10 km road course certified by PZLA
additional: Side events: children’s races over 150–200 m, 300 m, and 400 m, and 10 km Nordic Walking. The start and finish are located in the Old Town by the fountain, and winners are presented with awards after each race. The race office also allows registration and payment of entry fees on race day, if race packages are still available. The 2026 program included races for children in three age groups and Nordic Walking.

name: 35 Maraton Juranda
description: The 35th Jurand Marathon is a historic race held since 1981 and one of the most important marathons in Poland. Its certified course is exceptionally flat and entirely paved, making it ideal for setting personal bests. The route passes through the picturesque Masuria region, including villages, forests, and the landscapes of the Land of a Thousand Lakes. The event combines competitive running with a picnic atmosphere and is open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Certified, flat marathon course measuring 42.195 km
Entirely paved route, with no uphill or downhill sections
Picturesque Masuria region, villages, forests, and the landscapes of the Land of a Thousand Lakes
additional: 6:00–8:30. All distances start together at 9:00; wheelchair participants start at 8:55. The marathon time limit is 6 hours. Side races: the Knight’s Half Marathon (21.0975 km), Jurand’s Daughter’s 10K (10 km), and races for children and young people over 800 m, 600 m, and 300 m. Start, finish, and race office: Świetlica Gminna, Lipowiec 48B.

name: 42 Memoriał Winanda Osińskiego
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczecinku
description: The Winand Osiński Memorial Street Run in Szczecinek is an annual running event with a long tradition, organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Szczecinek. The main 10 km street race runs through the city on roads closed to vehicle traffic. The course is marked every kilometre and has a refreshment point. The event also includes youth races over various distances to promote physical activity among children and young people. The main race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect professional timing and a unique sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through the streets of Szczecinek, closed to vehicle traffic
Course markings every kilometre and a water refreshment point
Electronic timing using chips in race bibs
additional: The time limit for the main race is 2 hours. The start and finish are on Piłsudskiego Street (the start is near “Mała Poczta”; the finish is at the Czesław Kazimierz Lis Municipal Stadium). Race bibs must be attached to the front of the shirt and remain visible throughout the race, or the runner may be disqualified.
