The run is part of the Warsaw Running Triad “Run for Remembrance” and also offers a Nordic walking option for those who prefer a more relaxed pace. Participants receive commemorative medals, and the event’s atmosphere is perfect for celebrating the May holiday together through sport.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through central Warsaw, with views of Łazienki Park, the Botanical Garden, and Zbawiciela Square
Start and finish at Three Crosses Square; the route passes along Ujazdowskie Avenue and Marszałkowska Street, and through Constitution Square
A fast, scenic course suited both to personal-best attempts and to completing the distance at a comfortable pace
additional: Participant limit: 6,500 in the running category and 250 in Nordic walking. The time limit for completing the run is 55 minutes. Medal engraving and a technical T-shirt can be purchased during registration. Race numbers can be collected at the Race Office; on race day, collection is available only to people from outside Warsaw. The course is PZLA-certified and marked every 1 km. Start and finish at Three Crosses Square. Nordic walkers start in the final wave, after the runners.

name: Bieg Konstytucji
organizer: WKB META Lubliniec oraz Burmistrz Miasta Lublińca
description: The 3 May Constitution Day Run in Lubliniec is a patriotic sporting event organized by WKB META Lubliniec and the Mayor of Lubliniec. The 2.5 km run is open to everyone, including children, young people, adults, and seniors. Entry is free, encouraging a wide range of participants to take part. The event combines sporting competition with commemorating an important historical event, creating a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km distance open to all age groups
A course suitable for children, young people, adults, and seniors
A patriotic event combining sport and history
additional: The 2.5 km distance is suitable for participants of different ages and experience levels. A patriotic sporting event organized to mark the National Third of May Holiday.

name: Małopolski Bieg Przełajowy
description: The Małopolska Cross-Country Run is an annual cross-country race held in Kraków as part of the University of Economics’ Juwenalia. The event attracts amateur runners and students, offering the chance to compete on scenic off-road courses. The race takes place in Park Lotników Polskich, giving participants a chance to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the academic community together.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Park Lotników Polskich
Scenic green spaces of Kraków
Juwenalia atmosphere and sporting competition
additional: No information is available about entry fees or the start time. The event is open to all and brings people together.

name: Top Cross Torunia
description: Top Cross is a series of 12 cross-country races held in Rudelka Forest Park in Toruń. Each race consists of five laps plus a short run-in, for a total distance of approximately 6,666 metres. Participants earn points for taking part, and their eight best results count toward the overall standings. To receive a commemorative medal, participants must take part in at least eight races. It is also possible to complete a race individually without earning points.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Rudelka Forest Park
The course consists of five laps plus an approximately 200 m run-in
Course length: approximately 6,666 metres
additional: Registration takes place at V LO Toruń, at ul. Sienkiewicza / Fałata. The race office opens one hour before the race. Participants can complete a race individually without earning points. In the series, points are awarded for the eight best results out of 12 races. Points from individual races contribute to the overall standings, which are based on the eight best results. The commemorative medal is awarded for taking part in at least eight races.

description: The 7th Szczecin Night Run is an exciting sporting event held at night on the streets of Szczecin. Participants can choose between 5- and 10-kilometre routes through the city centre. The event offers a unique atmosphere with striking light displays and numerous attractions in the race village. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal, and the course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).
course_highlights: The course runs through the heart of Szczecin.
Course length: approximately 5 km (one loop) or 10 km (two loops).
The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).
additional: The race pack includes a race number with a timing chip and 4 safety pins, a commemorative medal, photographers along the course, water at the refreshment point for the 10 km distance, and access to a baggage deposit. The race office is open on 7 May (14:00–20:00) at GALAXY Shopping and Entertainment Centre and on 8 May (16:00–23:00) at the Race Village on Jasne Błonia. The participant limit was 2,000. The 5 km and 10 km distances listed for the 2026 edition were certified by the PZLA.

name: 13. PKO Białystok Półmaraton
description: The PKO Białystok Half Marathon is the largest running event in eastern Poland. Held since 2013, it has won numerous awards. The event takes place in May and features the main half-marathon race (21.097 km) and the accompanying 5 km Night Run. Both race courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association, and the event attracts runners from across Poland and more than a dozen other countries. The race weekend also includes children’s races, the Breakfast Run and the Sport Expo trade fair, making it a true celebration of running in the capital of Podlasie.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association
The 5 km Night Run has a certified course and finishes at Kościuszko Market Square
The Breakfast Run and children’s races are accompanying events
additional: The event includes the Breakfast Run (approx. 4 km, free, starting Saturday at 9:00), the PKO Junior Run for children aged 2–14, with distances from 100 m to 1 km, and the Sport Expo trade fair, featuring running apparel, supplements and activities. The generous time limit (50 minutes) for the 5 km Night Run allows runners of varying experience levels to finish.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice 2026
description: Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice is a mountain race in the Beskid Wyspowy range, about 30 km from Kraków, part of the Garmin Ultra Race series. The 2026 edition took place on 9 May with 13, 27, 48 and 78 km distances, and the longest race started at 5:00. The routes use forest paths, steep climbs and viewpoints. The 2027 date has not yet been published on the organizer's site.
course_highlights: Four distances: 13, 27, 48 and 78 km
Forest paths and steep climbs in the Beskid Wyspowy
Garmin Junior races for children
additional: In 2026 the 78 km started at 5:00 and the 48 km at 8:00, with the race office and EXPO on ul. Parkowa. The programme may change.

name: Bieg Herosa
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Herosa is a dynamic 5 km obstacle race combining sandy stretches with natural and man-made obstacles that demand strength, agility, and determination. The course crosses challenging desert terrain that leaves no room for mistakes, offering a true test for resourceful and persistent runners. Alongside the main race, the event also features Nordic walking, a dog run, and children’s obstacle races, making it appealing to families and people with different levels of experience.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometre loop through challenging, sandy terrain
Natural and man-made obstacles testing strength and agility
A course for runners and Nordic walkers, plus a dog run
additional: The event offers several activities: an obstacle race, Nordic walking, a dog run, and children’s obstacle races over distances from 200 to 1,000 metres. The course calls for good technique and effective pole use in Nordic walking. The dog run requires teamwork and coordination between handler and dog. Children tackle additional obstacles, building confidence and gaining satisfaction from overcoming challenging terrain.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.
price_range: Biegi główne: 50 zł za pojedynczy bieg lub 150 zł za cały cykl; biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe bezpłatne
description: The Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur is a series of races held on scenic routes in the Masurian region, including in Piecki. The event includes short-distance races for children and young people, as well as a 5.2 km main race that follows asphalt, cobbled and forest paths. Participants can expect commemorative medals, water and a hot meal prepared by local Rural Housewives’ Associations. The event has a family-friendly character and promotes outdoor activity surrounded by nature.
course_highlights: Distances from 5 to 10 km on asphalt, cobbled and forest roads
Children’s and youth races in several age categories, with separate starts for girls and boys
Scenic routes around Piecki and other towns in the Masurian region
additional: The participant limit across all distances for each race is 400. The race office is open 1.5 hours before the start; race-pack collection and registration are available until 30 minutes before the race. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. The race starts with a chip and a race number issued by the race office. The organizer provides water and a hot meal after the race. In the 2026 edition, the organizer provided participants with water, a hot meal and a commemorative medal. The limit was 400 participants per race.

name: Blue Power Run
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organised for people on the autism spectrum, their families and friends. The event aims to support social inclusion through a shared sporting event, raise awareness of autism and enable everyone to participate on equal terms. The race takes place on a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Complex in Szczecin. It is an opportunity to have fun and connect, with additional activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers. Finishing position is not what matters; the satisfaction of taking part and overcoming your own challenges is.
course_highlights: The race route follows a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Complex.
The start and race office are located by the Szyszka restaurant.
After the race, therapists and volunteers will coordinate activities for everyone to enjoy together.
additional: The event is limited to 300 participants. Race packs can be collected from the race office the day before the race and on event day. The start schedule includes races for different age groups, from 0 to 118 years old, with distances from 200 to 600 metres. After the races, activities for everyone to enjoy together will be coordinated by therapists and volunteers.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014, focused on promoting the sport and the scenic beauty of its courses. The event takes place in picturesque surroundings, offering participants a unique running experience. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and attractive locations, making the race appealing to a wide range of runners.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque courses
Scenic and attractive locations in Łódź
Passionately organized since 2014

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: The Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a scenic and challenging 8.2 km route and the first stop of the 14th edition of the Nordic Walking Grand Prix. Participants can compete and visit local attractions, such as the communal feast table, the largest wooden shoe, and the snuffbox. The event takes place in the municipality of Nowa Wieś Lęborska, which offers certified Nordic walking routes for pre-race training. The event starts on May 9 at 11:00.
course_highlights: Red route, 8.2 km long
Scenic but challenging terrain with plenty of sporting challenges
Local attractions: the communal feast table, the largest wooden shoe, and the snuffbox
additional: The event in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie opens the Nordic Walking Grand Prix series. Participants are encouraged to use the certified Nordic walking routes in the municipality of Nowa Wieś Lęborska.

name: I Tyski Bieg Majowy
description: The 1st Tychy May Run for the Mayor of Tychy’s Cup is an annual running event organized by the PROactive Sports and Recreation Association. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Paprocany Lake in Tychy, giving participants the chance to spend time actively outdoors. The event attracts runners of different ages and ability levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together. It’s a great opportunity for sporting competition and outdoor fun.
course_highlights: Route around Paprocany Lake
Picturesque views and natural surroundings
A well-marked and safe running route

name: III M Park4RUN
location: Centrum Handlowe M Park, Tarnów, Poland
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race of approximately 21.2 km held in Tarnów, on the grounds of the M Park Shopping Center. The course is 100% asphalt, flat, and marked every 1 km, with restricted road traffic during the race. Participants have access to electronic timekeeping and aid stations along the course. The event promotes running and the integration of the local community. Shorter, age-appropriate races are planned for children.
course_highlights: Approximately 21.2 km, 100% asphalt course
Flat course, marked every 1 km
Aid stations at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the finish
additional: The time limit to complete the race is 180 minutes. The race office is open from 7:30 to 9:15. Children’s races range from 100 m to 800 m, with the children’s race office opening at 10:00. The awards ceremony is planned for approximately 12:30–13:00. Participants receive a race pack containing items from sponsors as well as informational and promotional materials.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: Płużnicka Piątka is an annual 5-kilometer race held in the picturesque village of Płużnica. The course runs through the village center and features varied surfaces, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. The event attracts participants of all ages and also offers races for children. The atmosphere is friendly and full of positive energy, and the organization is highly regarded by participants.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the center of Płużnica
Surface: 71% asphalt, 23% dirt road, 6% cobblestones
A scenic, varied course that appeals to runners of different abilities
additional: Schedule: 10:40 official opening, 10:50 warm-up, 10:55 lining up at the start, 11:00 race start, 11:50 children's races, 12:15 awards ceremony, 12:45 official closing. The course starts and finishes in the village center.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Bie...
description: The Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality Cross-Country Championships are a series of cross-country races held in the municipality of Kąty Wrocławskie, attracting both amateur and professional runners. The first event takes place in Krobielowice, offering participants the chance to compete on scenic forest trails. The event is open to all and promotes physical activity and a sense of community among local runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country races on forest trails in the municipality of Kąty Wrocławskie
Scenic routes in Krobielowice and the surrounding area
A series of races held in different localities across the municipality
additional: Registration for the first race is available via the online form at https://formularz.ultimasport.pl/427. The event is organized by Klub Biegacza Kąty Wrocławskie. The races are held as a series in different localities across the municipality.

name: ProviRun for Invisibles IX Mistrzostwa Biegowe Provi Run
description: ProviRun for Invisibles is a 5.5 km race held in Łódź. Participants have access to training plans tailored to different experience levels to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is part of the Provi Run running championships series and promotes physical activity and running development in the local community. The race takes place on a paved course of moderate difficulty.
course_highlights: Distance: 5.5 km
Paved course
Difficulty: moderate
additional: Training plans are available for 8 to 20 weeks and tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support and detailed training instructions.

name: Rajd Beskidy Short
description: Rajd Beskidy Short is a European adventure race held in the picturesque Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The event includes a variety of disciplines, such as MTB, trekking, climbing, kayaking, cave exploration, and orienteering. The courses are demanding and vary in distance and time limit, catering to different teams and individual participants. The start and finish are at the Korzkiew Resort, and the event is part of a European adventure racing series.
course_highlights: Courses run through the picturesque Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Multidisciplinary challenges: MTB, trekking, climbing, kayaking, cave exploration, and orienteering
Different distances and formats: teams of 4, teams of 2, or individual participants
additional: Race office and start/finish at the Korzkiew Resort, 2 Eleonory Wodzickiej St. The time limit for the longest distance is 34 hours, plus 2 extra hours. The course counts toward the Polish Cup of Orienteering Foot Marathons. Teams of 4 for the 220 km distance; teams of 2 or individual participants for the 100 km distance. The start is on Friday morning, May 7, 2027.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The Warmian Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held on scenic routes in Warmia, near Olsztyn. The event offers three varied distances, allowing participants to experience the beauty of nature as they run along soft, natural trails through autumn forests. It is not only a competition, but also a chance to recharge your batteries and take part in a true ritual surrounded by Warmia’s landscapes. The ultramarathon is part of the Warmia Trail Running Grand Prix, underlining its sporting character and prestige.
course_highlights: The routes follow natural, soft forest trails
Views of golden-red tunnels of autumn leaves
Scenic areas of Warmia and its lakes
additional: The race office is open from 07:00 to 10:00. The W25+ and W50+ distances start at 09:00. Checkpoint No. 2 (27 km) closes at 13:00. The finish line officially closes and the races end at 17:00. Updated GPX tracks for the W25+ and W50+ routes are available to download on the website in the Downloads section.

name: Wróblewska Eco Dycha
description: Wróblewska Eko Dycha is a run in Wróblew municipality near Sieradz with main races over 10 km and 5 km. Start and finish are in front of the Walewski Museum in Tubądzin. The course runs through the scenic northern part of the municipality along a wind farm trail. Besides the runs there is a nordic walking event and a children's run. The 5th edition took place in 2026, organised by Wróblew municipality and Rajsport Active.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Walewski Museum in Tubądzin
Course along a wind farm trail in the north of the municipality
10 km and 5 km runs, nordic walking and a children's run
additional: The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet. Registration and fee details will appear on the organiser's site.

name: XXIII Memoriałowy Bieg
description: The Father Józef Kurzeja Memorial Run is an annual race in Kraków’s Mistrzejowice district. The course starts at Planty Mistrzejowickie, runs through the park by the fort in the Złotego Wieku housing estate, and turns back at Reduta Park. The running path was created as part of the Kraków Civic Budget in 2021–2022. The loop is 5 km long; for the 21st edition, runners could also choose 10 km, or two loops. The main organizer is the Mistrzejowice District XV Council.
course_highlights: 5 km loop between Planty Mistrzejowickie and Reduta Park
Running path funded by the Kraków Civic Budget
Memorial run in honor of Father Józef Kurzeja
additional: The date and regulations for the 2027 edition have not yet been published.

name: XXVII Bieg Wilka
description: The 27th Bieg Wilka is an annual 10 km road race held in Grajewo, Podlaskie Voivodeship. The event is a great opportunity to test your running fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels to help participants prepare optimally for race day. The event attracts both local runners and participants from other regions, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition.
course_highlights: A 10 km asphalt course
A moderately challenging road race
Scenic surroundings in Grajewo, Podlaskie Voivodeship
additional: The organizers offer 8- to 20-week training plans tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support.

name: XXXVI Ostródzkie Biegi Uliczne
organizer: Ostródzkie Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji, Gmina Miejska Ostróda
description: Ostródzkie Biegi Uliczne is a two-day running festival in Ostróda, and its main race is the Zdzisław Krzyszkowiak Memorial over 10 km. Start and finish are at the athletics stadium on Wyszyńskiego street, and the course runs through the town streets. The surface is a short section of tartan track and mostly asphalt, and the course is not certified. Pupils from Ostróda schools and preschool children also race as part of the event. The 36th edition took place in 2026.
course_highlights: Zdzisław Krzyszkowiak Memorial over 10 km
Start and finish at the athletics stadium on Wyszyńskiego street
Course through Ostróda streets, mostly asphalt
additional: In 2026 the field was limited to 150 runners with a 1.5 hour time limit. Every finisher received a medal and the best runners won prize money. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Bieg Borków
description: Bieg Borków is an annual running event held in the scenic Spa Park in Połczyn-Zdrój. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering an appealing course surrounded by greenery and a spa-town atmosphere. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect professional organization and the opportunity to discover the charms of the region. Registration and the rules are available on the race’s dedicated website, making it easier to prepare for the start.
course_highlights: The course runs through Spa Park in Połczyn-Zdrój
Scenic surroundings in a spa park
A course map file is available to download
additional: Registration and the race rules are available at biegnijmy.pl. The race course is available to download in JPG format. Public toilets in Spa Park are open 24 hours a day, cost 2 zł, and have facilities for people with disabilities. Information about registration, the rules, and the course for the 2026 edition is available at biegnijmy.pl.

name: Bieg Nadwiślański
description: The Bieg Nadwiślański in Wagańec is an annual running event organized by the Marshal's Office of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship. The race takes place in a picturesque area along the Vistula, offering participants the chance to compete on routes suited to different experience levels. The event promotes physical activity and brings together the local community and sports enthusiasts from across the region. It is part of the voivodeship’s sporting calendar and attracts runners and spectators.
additional: The 2026 edition was part of the 15th Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running.

name: Nocny Bieg na 5 km
description: The PKO Night 5K is a companion event to the PKO Białystok Half Marathon, offering a precisely measured 5 km course certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The start and finish are on Kościuszko Market Square, by the Town Hall in Białystok. The race is ideal both for first-timers and for runners looking to improve their personal bests, and the generous time limit allows almost anyone to finish. It is a great opportunity to join the largest running event in eastern Poland and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in May.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association and precisely measured at 5 km
Start and finish on Kościuszko Market Square, by the Town Hall
Generous 50-minute time limit, suitable for runners of varying experience levels
additional: The race is suitable for people of different ages and ability levels, and is ideal as a first road race. The course runs through the streets of Białystok. The event is part of the larger PKO Białystok Half Marathon. Time limit: 50 minutes. The race takes place as part of the PKO Białystok Half Marathon.

name: Pazur Gryfa
organizer: Słupskie Towarzystwo Osób Pozytywnie Aktywnych STOPA Słupsk
description: The Pazur Gryfa Orienteering Rally is a sports and tourism event held in the Słupsk region, known for its vast forests, hills, valleys, and rich flora and fauna. The route passes through scenic areas full of natural obstacles and historic landmarks, offering participants a unique orienteering experience. The event brings people together and attracts both beginners and experienced competitors. The organizers ensure that the routes are professionally prepared and that participants are safe.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the vast forests, hills, and valleys of the Słupsk region
Rich flora and fauna, along with numerous natural obstacles
Historic landmarks along the rally route
additional: The rally takes place at the Culture and Recreation Park and the Kayak Marina in Słupsk. The organizers professionally prepare the cycling and walking routes. The event is a sports and tourism rally with orienteering elements.

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A., ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race held in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. in Tczew. The route passes through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny and has a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic, and the route is marked every kilometre. The event is small-scale, with a limit of 200 paid participants.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny
Mixed asphalt and gravel surfaces
The route is marked with road markings every 1 km
additional: The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. The number of participants is limited to 200 paid entrants. The start and finish are at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race route runs with restricted vehicle traffic. Information about the route and organization is confirmed by the 2025 and 2026 editions; details of the 2027 edition were not available in the sources.

name: X Ultramaraton 40 Rybnickich Rond
description: The 40 Rybnickich Rond Ultramarathon is a unique race of approximately 100 km held in Rybnik. The route leads through city parks, squares and forest corridors connecting the city’s distinctive roundabouts, and participants navigate using GPS. The race stands out for its original format: the winner is the person who starts as late as possible but still finishes before the finish line closes. Entry to the ultramarathon is free, reflecting its non-commercial nature and focus on the running community.
course_highlights: An approximately 100 km route through city parks, squares and forest corridors
Navigation using GPS devices
A route passing through Rybnik’s famous roundabouts
additional: Entry to the race is free. The winner is the runner who starts as late as possible and finishes before the finish line closes. A drop bag and a hot meal are provided at the 50 km mark. Previous editions have also included the Mini U40RR, approximately 10 km long.

name: 5. Festiwal Gorski Jedlina-Zdroj
price_range: od 120 zł do 250 zł, mieszkańcy gminy 50 zł
description: Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, 23.5 km, and 50 km. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace. The race route passes through the scenic Wałbrzych Mountains, including Borowa Mountain, which has a newly built observation tower, and features challenging climbs and varied terrain. The event is a great opportunity to enjoy an active break and discover the region’s charms.
course_highlights: The route passes over Borowa Mountain, with its new observation tower
Varied terrain: gravel roads, paved roads, forest trails, and mountain trails
Distances of 10 km, 23.5 km, and an ultra 50 km, with refreshment and checkpoint stations
additional: The total participant limit is 600. The 50 km ultra route has 7 refreshment stations and 5 time checkpoints. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4. The organizer reserves the right to modify the route up to one week before the start. The mountain route is challenging and features varied terrain. The participant limit is 600; online registration is available. The date may be changed if sanitary restrictions are introduced. Accommodation and a festival T-shirt are available to participants.

name: Akademicka Dycha
description: Akademicka Dycha is the University of Siedlce's run, held on 9 May 2027. The main race is 10 km on campus and through the city streets. Alongside it there is a 5 km nordic walking event, a 4 x 1 km relay for secondary schools and a 200 m fun run around the Ogiński Palace roundabout. In the fun run category both the presentation and the time are judged. The fifth edition took place in 2026.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km
Secondary school relay 4 x 1 km
200 m run around the Ogiński Palace roundabout
additional: Category details and start times are given in the rules on the race website.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a global race held simultaneously around the world. Participants start with the mobile app and run from the virtual Catcher Car. The race is unique because 100% of entry fees and donations go toward research into treatments for spinal cord injuries. The event is open to everyone, wherever they are, and promotes community and support for people with mobility impairments. The race is scheduled to start on May 9, 2027, at 11:00 local time.
course_highlights: Run with the Wings for Life World Run app—start anywhere in the world
Run from the virtual Catcher Car
Run, use a wheelchair, or walk together—also for those who cannot run
additional: 100% of entry fees go toward spinal cord research. Take part using the mobile app, which tracks distance and simulates the Catcher Car chase. An event-related running apparel collection is available.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, with an emphasis on the visual appeal of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz
Routes with visual appeal and a natural character
Organized with passion and experience since 2014

name: 41 Pszczewska Dwudziestka
description: Pszczewska Dwudziestka is a half marathon in Pszczew, held every May since 1984. The PZLA certified course runs from Pszczew through Silna to Świechocin, where the turnaround is, and back the same way. The surface is entirely asphalt. Runners from all over Poland and abroad as well as athletes with disabilities are invited. The main race is accompanied by shorter street runs for children and young people.
course_highlights: Certified 21.097 km course, all asphalt
Turnaround in Świechocin, return the same way via Silna
Held since 1984
additional: In 2026 the 8th Bieg Katarzyny over 5.6 km (two 2.8 km loops around Lake Kochle) and children's runs over 200 and 400 m took place the same day. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: 41 Półmaraton Solan im. Romana Terlikowskiego
description: The 41st Solan Half Marathon in memory of Roman Terlikowski is an annual running event held in Nowa Sól. The half-marathon course consists of two loops through the city streets, with the start and finish located on al. Wolności next to Park Krasnala. Participants can expect professional race organization, including race-pack collection, bag drop, showers, and post-race catering. The event also features races for children, numerous attractions, and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A circular course consisting of two loops through the streets of Nowa Sól
Start and finish on al. Wolności next to Park Krasnala
The route passes along Portowa, Korzeniowskiego, Żwirki i Wigury, Bohaterów Getta, and other streets
additional: Race packs can be collected on 9 May (13:00–16:00) and 10 May (7:30–9:15). Free parking, changing rooms, a bag drop, and showers are available near the start/finish. After the race, participants receive a recovery meal and drinks using vouchers included in their race packs. The program also includes the 25th Mini Solan Run for children, an awards ceremony, and a prize draw.

name: Charytatywna Dycha
description: Charytatywna Dycha is a race held in Miechów to support the Blessed Sister Bernardyna Jabłońska Hospice. The event is charitable and community-oriented, encouraging participants to be physically active and help those in need. The race takes place in the area around Miechów, and taking part is also an opportunity to work together for the local community and hospice patients.
additional: The organizer is the Blessed Sister Bernardyna Jabłońska Hospice in Miechów. Telephone contact is available from 8:00 to 15:00. Psychological support and volunteering are integral parts of the hospice’s work. The website has no details about the course, start waves, or entry fees.

name: II JBL Run Katowice
location: Plac Sławika i Antalla, Katowice, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa do 30 kwietnia wynosi 50 zł dla dystansu 10 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa do 30 kwietnia wynosi 40 zł dla dystansu 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa do 30 kwietnia wynosi 30 zł dla dystansu 3 km

description: The 2nd JBL Run Katowice is a charity road race held in Katowice on May 9, 2027. Participants can choose from three distances: 3 km (family walk & run), 5 km, and 10 km. The course passes notable Katowice landmarks, including Spodek, the International Congress Centre, the Polish National Radio Symphony Orchestra, the Silesian Museum, the University of Silesia Library, and the Silesian Insurgents Monument. All proceeds from entry fees will be donated to the Gniazdo Foundation for People in Need.
course_highlights: Road course on asphalt
Passes iconic Katowice landmarks: Spodek, the International Congress Centre, the Polish National Radio Symphony Orchestra, and the Silesian Museum
Start and finish at Sławik and Antall Square next to Spodek
additional: Race packs can be collected on May 8–10, 2027, at Sławik and Antall Square. The time limits are 90 minutes for 10 km, 60 minutes for 5 km, and 40 minutes for 3 km. Drink stations and free toilets will be available along the course and at the finish. All participants will receive commemorative medals, and a prize draw for merchandise will take place after the race.

name: II Olkuski Test Coopera
description: The 2nd Olkusz Cooper Test is an annual sporting event held in Olkusz, open to everyone who wants to test their physical fitness in the Cooper Test. The event takes place outdoors, and participants can start at various times throughout the morning. The participant limit is 100, ensuring an intimate atmosphere and a comfortable competition. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors to the city.
additional: Starts take place every 30 minutes from 09:00 to 13:30. Participation is limited to 100 paid entrants.

name: IX Bieg Pilicy
description: Bieg Pilicy in Białobrzegi is a small running event in the town on the Pilica river. Start and finish are on the revitalised Zygmunt Stary square, and the course follows the main streets of the town. The main race, Dycha nad Pilicą, is a fast and flat 10 km. There is also a 3 km recreational run, a 3 km nordic walking event and colour runs for children and teenagers. The 9th edition took place in 2026.
course_highlights: Fast and flat 10 km through Białobrzegi
Start and finish on Zygmunt Stary square
Colour runs for children from about 200 m to 1500 m
additional: Every participant gets a medal and, according to the organiser, a warm meal, drinks and a voucher for Białobrzegi ice cream. The colour runs are free for residents of the municipality. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Półmaraton Ślimaka
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Polskie Miasta Cittaslow, Gmina Miejska Górowo Iławeckie, Gmina Miejska Lidzbark Warmiński
description: Półmaraton Ślimaka is a half marathon on a certified point-to-point course from Górowo Iławeckie to Lidzbark Warmiński. It is part of the Lidzbark Warmiński Running Festival, which also includes the 5 km Night Run with Copernicus the day before and children's runs in Górowo Iławeckie. The organisers are the Polish Cittaslow Towns Association and the town municipalities of Górowo Iławeckie and Lidzbark Warmiński. The organiser provides bus transport to the start and a bag drop that is carried to the finish.
course_highlights: Certified half marathon course from Górowo Iławeckie to Lidzbark Warmiński
Part of the Lidzbark Warmiński Running Festival
Transport to the start and bag drop delivered to the finish
additional: In 2026 the half marathon started on 10 May at 13:00. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: XV Działoszyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 15th Działoszyńska Dziesiątka is an annual race organized by the Atelier Sportu Association in Działoszyn. The race takes place over a 10-kilometer course, with the start scheduled for 16:00. The event attracts runners from various regions and offers professional timing using modern RFID technology. The organizers ensure high sporting and organizational standards, providing participants with a comfortable experience and reliable results.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Professional timing using RFID chips
Start at 16:00 in Działoszyn
additional: Timing is provided by a state-of-the-art electronic system using RFID chips and start/finish mats. The organizer provides telephone support from 8:00 to 16:00, as well as an emergency number on race day.

name: XXIX Górski Bieg Magurki
description: The National Magurka Mountain Run is an annual running event organized by the Ludowy Uczniowski Klub Sportowy “Groniczek” in Bielsko-Biała. The mass-participation race attracts over a hundred competitors from across Poland, as well as visitors from abroad. The 8.8 km course, with 509 m of elevation gain, runs through the picturesque area of Mała Straconka to the summit of Magurka. It is an alpine-style race, meaning it is uphill all the way. The event promotes an active lifestyle, physical fitness, and the Bielsko-Biała region.
course_highlights: An 8.8 km course with 509 m of elevation gain
An alpine-style race—uphill all the way, with no descents
Picturesque trails in Mała Straconka and forest tracks leading to the summit of Magurka
additional: The race starts in the Straconka district of Bielsko-Biała, on Pikowa Street opposite Karczma w Straconce. The finish is by the mountain shelter on Magurka. The course is clearly marked and secured by judges, technical and medical staff, and the police. The race has 12 age categories, from juniors (ages 11–15) to veterans (60+). Competitors’ insurance is the responsibility of the sports clubs they represent. The race takes place regardless of the weather.

name: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie
description: The 33rd Żnińskie Runs is an annual running event held in Żnin, scheduled for May 10, 2026. The event includes road races over 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are located at Freedom Square. The 10 km race counts toward the Pałuki Grand Prix. Participants receive a race pack containing a commemorative medal from the “Great People of Żnin” series, a recovery meal, and souvenirs from Pałuki. The race office is open on race day from 9:00 to 11:45 at Primary School No. 1 in Żnin.

name: II Bieg Europejski Puck - Prolog
description: Energa II European Run Puck is an original sporting event organized by STONE TRI & RUN, bringing runners together to celebrate Europe Day. The event takes place at the Old Market Square in Puck and offers a range of distances, including a certified 10 km main race and a shorter 1,348 m Prologue. The event has a unique atmosphere and is supported by ambassador Jerzy Kowol, a legend of Polish long-distance running. In addition to adult races, children’s races and a Nordic walking event are also held.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km main race
1,348 m Prologue
The routes pass through the Old Market Square in Puck
additional: The event programme includes race-pack collection at Stary Rynek 2 at two times (15:00–20:00 and 7:00–9:00), bag drop in the Expo Zone tent, race and walk starts between 10:00 and 11:40, and the awards ceremony and event summary at 12:00. The event also includes children’s races in two age categories: Mini Kids Run (ages 3–7) and Mega Kids Run (ages 8–15). The distance and location information comes from the 2026 edition.

name: Poligon na Start
location: Żółta Trybuna, Pas Ćwiczeń Taktycznych Bucierz, Centrum Szkolenia Bojowego Drawsko, Drawsko Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 3rd Charity Poligon na Start Run takes place at the Drawsko Combat Training Centre, under the honorary patronage of the Centre’s Commandant. The event is charitable, and proceeds from entry fees and the public collection will go towards supporting a child’s medical treatment. The event also features accompanying demonstrations and performances. Four distances are available, suited to runners of different ability levels.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Drawsko training ground at the Drawsko Combat Training Centre
Four distances: 42 km, 21 km, 13 km and 7 km
Accompanying events include demonstrations and performances organised by the Drawsko Combat Training Centre and the Drawsko Pomorskie Cultural Centre
additional: The participant limit is 200. Payment must be made online via the Przelewy24 platform: click the link next to your name on the start list and enter the participant’s details. The start schedule includes four race waves from 9:30 to 13:30, with the awards ceremony at 15:00. The 2026 edition had a limit of 200 participants and was a charity event. The previously stated fees apply only to the 2026 edition.

name: 13 Żorski Bieg Ogniowy
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Żorach oraz Stowarzyszenie HRmax Żory
description: The 13th Żory Night Fire Run is a unique nighttime race held in Żory that attracts runners from across the region. The event combines sport and recreation and takes place annually, drawing strong interest from participants. It stands out for the atmosphere of racing at night and its attractive prizes, including a professional watch donated by the sponsor. The participant limit is 700, underscoring the event’s intimate character.
course_highlights: Nighttime race through the streets of Żory
Participant limit: 700
Commemorative medal for participants
additional: A professional watch donated by the sponsor Profil Tec will be awarded during the prize-giving ceremony at 23:30. Participants can receive a commemorative medal. In the 2026 edition, the limit was 700 participants, and race packs were collected at the Municipal Museum at ul. Muzealna 1/2.

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: The 5th Night Run in Pairs with Fireflies is a unique nighttime running event held in Reda by the retention reservoir. The runners’ headlamps and the illuminated course create a spectacular visual effect. Participants run in pairs, highlighting the event’s inclusive spirit and setting it apart from other sporting events in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The run takes place after dark, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and adding to the excitement.

name: VIII Bieg Rysia
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dukli
description: The 8th Bieg Rysia is a unique running event held in Dukla Park in Dukla, combining sporting competition with beautiful views and a trail challenge. The course has been modified due to the construction of the S19 road, but retains its mountain character, featuring its most demanding and spectacular climb to the summit of Mount Cergowa, next to the observation tower. Every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish, celebrating the spirit of completing the race and its character. The race is scheduled to start at 14:00.
course_highlights: A course featuring a challenging climb to the summit of Mount Cergowa
A scenic route past the observation tower on Mount Cergowa
Off-road mountain racing—not an ordinary road race
additional: A medal for every participant, regardless of their result. Cash prizes in the Open category, with a total prize pool of 3000 zł. The course was modified due to the construction of the S19 road but retained the character of a mountain race. The start and race office were located in Dukla Park. Every participant received a medal.

name: 12. Dynowska ZaDyszka
description: The 12th Dynowska ZaDyszka is a 10 km race organized by the Jarosławska Grupa Biegowa „Sokół” Association. The event will take place at the “Błękitny San” Tourist Resort in Dynów. The race is held in the evening, and the route passes through scenic areas, promoting physical activity and the region’s tourist attractions. The event is part of the Piona Cup 2026 series, which brings together the local running community.

name: Bieg Iskier - IFMSA Poland Oddział Rzeszów
XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton Piastowski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław as part of the Piast Running Festival. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and compete over the 21 km distance. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: Rudawy Wiosenny Festiwal Biegowy
location: Janowice Wielkie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Rudawy Spring Running Festival is a mountain running event held in the scenic Rudawy Janowickie mountains. Participants can choose from several distances: 9 km (family run), 15 km, 25 km, 45 km, and a demanding 65 km ultra course. The ultra course leads through wild mountains, numerous rock formations, and well-known viewpoints such as Bolczów Castle and the Colorful Lakes. The event brings the mountain running community together and offers a varied program, including a meeting with a naturalist and a wide range of food options in the festival village.
course_highlights: A 65 km ultra course with 2,920 m of elevation gain through the Rudawy Janowickie mountains
Aid stations along the course, including a hot meal at 41 km
Scenic views of the Karkonosze, Kaczawy, Izera, and Suchy Mountains
additional: The start and finish of all races are at Miedzianka Brewery. Mandatory equipment for the ultra course includes a flashlight/headlamp, an emergency blanket, a water container, and a phone with emergency numbers saved. There are four aid stations on the ultra course, including one serving a hot meal. The family run is a competition for pairs—a parent/guardian with a child or another minor—and includes elements of an urban game and a meeting with a naturalist before the start. The festival village offers a wide range of food and a merchandise shop. The organizer’s website lists the start times from the previous edition: 65 km at 5:00, 45 km at 8:00, 25 km at 10:00, 15 km at 11:00, and 9 km at 11:30.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Stradomia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Arboretum Leśne im. prof. Stefana Białoboka, Stradomia Dolna, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Stradomia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts. It takes place in the picturesque Prof. Stefan Białobok Forest Arboretum in the Syców Forest District. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which focuses on scenic courses and natural surroundings. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a unique atmosphere and beautiful views. The organizers promote running and provide a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Prof. Stefan Białobok Forest Arboretum
Picturesque woodland setting and natural scenery
A race in the Botaniczna Piątka series featuring a unique medal
additional: The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, which holds cross-country races at various locations in Wielkopolska and beyond. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on scenic courses and natural surroundings. The 2024 spring edition introduced a medal collection featuring a hyacinth motif, highlighting the event’s unique character.

name: 12 Ćwierćmaraton Komandosa
description: The Commando Quarter Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Sub ventum” Foundation in Słupsk, promoting physical activity among residents of the city and surrounding areas. The race is both a sporting and community event, open to runners of varying ability levels. The organizers provide professional support and a way to get in touch quickly via the registration form. The event takes place in the scenic areas of Słupsk, encouraging a healthy lifestyle.
additional: You can contact the organizers and register using the online form. The race director is Dariusz Kloskowski, available at 602 759 892. Participants are encouraged to log in during registration to speed up the processing of their entries.

name: 3 Mile Dwunastki
organizer: 12 Brygada Zmechanizowana, Stowarzyszenie Klub Biegowy Dzik
description: 3 Mile Dwunastki is a cross-country run held to mark the anniversary of the 12th Mechanised Brigade in Szczecin. The three-mile course, almost 5 km, crosses sand, pits, hills and gravel. The start is at the Krzekowo military shooting range, and amateurs, experienced runners and uniformed services take part. The run is organised by the 12th Mechanised Brigade with support from the Dzik running club from Police. The Extreme Dzikobieg military range edition takes place the same day.
course_highlights: Course over sand, pits, hills and gravel
Start at the Krzekowo military shooting range
Military atmosphere and uniformed services in the field
additional: In 2026 the run took place on 16 May. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: 4 Lędzińska Piwna Mila
description: The 4th Lędziny Beer Mile is an annual running event organized by EMJOT Tri Team in Lędziny. The race is recreational and athletic in nature, attracting both local runners and fans of physical activity from the surrounding area. The course passes through scenic parts of the city, offering participants an enjoyable running experience. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is an opportunity for the running community to come together.
course_highlights: Urban course in Lędziny
Scenic views during the race
Friendly atmosphere and a chance for runners to connect

name: 53 Cross Mysłowicki w biegach przełajowych
description: The 53rd Mysłowice Cross is a traditional cross-country race held in the picturesque Słupna Park in Mysłowice. Participants tackle a nearly 5.5-kilometre loop along challenging forest trails, guaranteeing a memorable sporting experience and a satisfying finish. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Mysłowice and is supported by UKS Chromik Mysłowice and the Central Museum of Firefighting. The race attracts a large number of runners, creating a unique atmosphere of shared energy and competition.
course_highlights: A nearly 5.5-kilometre loop along the forest trails of Słupna Park
Challenging uphill sections and a natural forest setting
A scenic cross-country route
additional: Participants receive a special medal featuring a unique moving element, as well as the legendary doughnuts from Mateusz Skórok Confectionery. The organisers prepare sports trophies, statuettes and attractive prizes for the top finishers.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
location: Okoniny Nadjeziorne, Tuchola County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Join the 8th edition of Okonińska Pętla, taking place on May 16 at 16:00 in Okoniny Nadjeziorne. This running event, organized by the Śliwice Municipal Office, attracts enthusiasts of physical activity and the beautiful landscapes of the Tuchola Forest. The scenic route lets participants enjoy the natural beauty and local scenery. More information and registration are available on the dedicated registration website.
course_highlights: Scenic route in the Tuchola Forest
Route through Okoniny Nadjeziorne
Race organized by the Śliwice Municipal Office

name: Bieg Krokodyla
description: Bieg Krokodyla is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The event includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. The main races and the walk are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s races begin at 9:00. Participants can choose a basic package or an extended package with a technical T-shirt. The course follows a scenic route around the lake, offering attractive views and a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Rusałka in Poznań
Distances: 10 km, 5 km, and a 5 km Nordic Walking event
Children’s and youth races over shorter distances from 100 m to 1,000 m
additional: The main races and the walk start at 12:00. The children’s and youth races start from 9:00. Start location by Lake Rusałka (GPS: 52.423071, 16.884526). Participants aged 16–18 may choose the 5 km or 10 km distance with a guardian’s consent.

name: II Ekstremalny Dzikobieg - edycja poligonowa
description: Ekstremalny Dzikobieg military range edition is an obstacle run at the Krzekowo shooting range in Szczecin. The course is about 5 km and packed with military obstacles. Runners face mud, water, ditches, tunnels, walls 2.5 and 3.5 metres high, ropes, tyres, climbs and steep ravines. Start and finish are on a meadow next to the range on the Krzekowo-Wołczkowo tourist loop, and runners start in waves. The race is run by the Dzik running club, organiser of the Dziki Weekend festival.
course_highlights: About 5 km with military obstacles
2.5 and 3.5 m walls, tunnels, ditches, mud and water
Wave starts on a meadow by the Krzekowo range
additional: In 2026 there was an OPEN category and the 2nd 12th Mechanised Brigade extreme run championship. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Mariuszowa 5-tka
description: Mariuszowa 5-tka is a race held in Leszno on unpaved roads and forest tracks in the Nowy Świat Forest District, near the Dr. Jan Jonston Provincial Multispecialist Hospital. The event offers distances of 5.3 km (one lap) and 10.3 km (two laps), as well as a 4 km Nordic walking event. It also includes youth and children’s races over shorter distances suited to participants’ ages. The race office is located in the hospital’s administrative building, and the start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street. Entries are accepted online only.
course_highlights: The route follows unpaved roads and forest tracks in the Nowy Świat Forest District
Distances of 5.3 km (1 lap) and 10.3 km (2 laps)
Start and finish by the Dr. Jan Jonston Provincial Multispecialist Hospital in Leszno
additional: Participant limits: 5 km and 10 km races — 250 people; Nordic walking — 100 people; children’s races — 100 people. The race office is in the administrative building of the Provincial Multispecialist Hospital, with the entrance from Szpitalna Street. The start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street, on the access road to the hospital beyond the ambulance entrance.

name: V Szczeciniecka 5-tka
description: Szczecinecka 5-tka is a 5 km run in Szczecinek held together with Duathlon Szczecinek. The course is three loops on tartan and asphalt. The race office, start and finish are at the sports grounds of School Complex No. 6 at Stanisława Staszica 15. The time limit is 50 minutes. The 5th edition took place in 2026.
course_highlights: Three loops on tartan and asphalt
Start and finish at School Complex No. 6, Staszica 15
Held together with Duathlon Szczecinek
additional: In 2026 the run started on 16 May at 13:30, and the entry fee rose with later registration. The duathlon was 5 km run, 20 km bike and 2.5 km run. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: VIII Chrzanowski Bieg Uliczny
description: Pociąg do biegania is a popular sporting event in Chrzanów that attracts runners of varying ability levels. The event offers three distances: a 5 km run for beginners and recreational runners, a 10 km run for more advanced runners, and 5 km Nordic walking. The running route follows the city streets, and participants can expect professional organization, timekeeping, and attractive race packages. It’s a great opportunity to join the local running community and spend time being active.
course_highlights: A route through the streets of Chrzanów, with two laps for the 10 km distance
A night run; bringing a headlamp is recommended
Professional timekeeping and online results service
additional: The race office is open Friday, May 15, 15:00–18:00, and Saturday, May 16, 16:00–19:15. Registration is available on the day of the event (May 16), subject to a limited number of race packages; cash payment only. The race package includes a race number with a chip, a medal, a recovery meal, water, and a bag with promotional materials. Bringing a headlamp is recommended due to the nighttime nature of the run. Parking is available near the route.

name: XIII Olecka Trzynastka
location: Stadion Miejski w Olecku, Olecko, Poland

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: w dniach 4 maja – 15 maja oraz w dniu zawodów - 50 zł

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: dla wszystkich uczestników biegu głównego stała kwota w wysokości 70 zł

description: The 13th Olecka Thirteen is an annual main race and Nordic walking event held at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko. Participants can expect professional organization and a welcoming sporting atmosphere. The main race has a fixed entry fee, while Nordic walking offers attractive prices across two registration periods. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete on a scenic course.
additional: Nordic walking entry fees vary depending on when you register. Proof of bank transfer should be sent to oleckobiega@wp.pl. The event takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy
XXVIII Oleskie Uliczne Biegi Pokoju
description: The 28th Olesno Street Peace Runs is an annual running event organized by the Municipality of Olesno, attracting runners of various age groups and ability levels. The races take place on the streets of Olesno, offering participants professionally measured courses with electronic timing. The race is scheduled to start at 16:50, and online registration is open. The organizers ensure a high standard of organization and competition, giving participants an unforgettable sporting experience.
course_highlights: Street race in the center of Olesno
Electronic timing using RFID chips
Professionally organized by the Municipality of Olesno
additional: Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. The organizer provides telephone support from 8:00 to 16:00 and, on race day, at a special number. The event is organized by the Municipality of Olesno with assistance from Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu.

name: Bieg Urodzinowy Miasta Skórcz
description: The Skórcz City Birthday Run is an annual running event organized by the Skórcz Municipal Office and held within the city. The event combines sport and recreation and offers an opportunity to celebrate the city’s birthday together. It attracts both residents and visitors, promoting an active lifestyle and a sense of community.
course_highlights: A road race through the streets of Skórcz
The historic route ran along, among others, Parkowa, Hallera, 3 Maja, Główna, and Sobieskiego streets
In 2011, the main race was approximately 1.5 km long
additional: Previous editions also included a Preschoolers’ Run. The race regulations and consent form for participation by minors are available.

name: VIII Bieg Nocny Św. Kingi
location: Plac Świętej Kingi przy Bramie Szeklerskiej, Stary Sącz, Poland
description: The Saint Kinga Night Run is an annual running event held in Stary Sącz for children, teenagers, and adults. The start and finish are at Saint Kinga Square by the Székely Gate. The event has a long-standing tradition, with seven previous editions, reflecting its popularity and good organization. The run is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively in the town’s picturesque surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Saint Kinga Square – Székely Gate
A night run in picturesque Stary Sącz
An event for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: The event has a long-standing tradition; seven editions were held before the 8th edition.

name: XV Ćwierćmaraton Bielika
location: Siadło Dolne, Gmina Kołbaskowo, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 15th Bielik Quarter Marathon is the largest sporting event organized by the Municipality of Kołbaskowo. The race starts by the Oder River in Siadło Dolne, and the finish is located about 11 km away, at the sports field in Pargowo. The route follows the Bielik Trail and features a beautiful, varied profile with both large and small hills, making it appealing to outdoor enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Start by the Oder River in Siadło Dolne
Finish at the sports field in Pargowo, about 11 km from the start
Route follows the Bielik Trail, with a varied profile and hills

name: POKONAJ LUCYFERA - Półmaraton
description: DEFEAT LUCIFER – The Half Marathon is a mountain race in Nasielsk. The course consists of a 7 km loop through scenic but challenging forest terrain, with numerous climbs and technical descents. The event offers four challenges to choose from: Lucifer 21 km (3 loops), Boruta 14 km (2 loops), Rokita 7 km (1 loop), and 7 km Nordic Walking. This race is for people who value endurance, strength, and determination, with professional timing and commemorative medals for participants.

name: 24h Rawicki Festiwal Sportu
description: The 24-hour Rawicz Sports Festival is a unique sporting event held in Rawicz, bringing amateurs and professionals together for a competition that lasts all day and night. Since 2011, the festival has continued to grow, offering a range of sports, with the 24-hour relay race as its main event. It is the largest sporting initiative in the Rawicz municipality and is organized through the cooperation of numerous institutions and volunteers. Participants can also enjoy a range of non-sporting attractions during the festival weekend.

name: 19. Bieg Wiosny - 5 km
organizer: Biegowe Grand Prix Rybnika, MOSiR Rybnik
description: Bieg Wiosny is an annual running event held in Rybnik and part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix. The event features races for children and young people over various distances, as well as a 5 km cross-country race for adults and young people aged 16 and over. The 19th edition of Bieg Wiosny will take place, offering participants the chance to compete and spend time actively outdoors.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn - edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Arboretum Leśne Warmii i Mazur, Olsztyn, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum, highlighting the scenic beauty of the course. The race is participant-friendly, and the organizers emphasize the beauty of the locations and promoting running among different groups. It is a great opportunity to combine sport with time in nature and earn a unique medal featuring a hyacinth motif.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Spring Edition is a recurring race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, an ideal place for nature lovers and those seeking active recreation. The event aims to promote running and physical activity, and participation is open to all ages. Participants can look forward to a unique atmosphere and commemorative medals, awarded after completing the main race or the children’s races. The event is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and is held under the honorary patronage of the Voivodeship Marshal.

name: VIII Charytatywny Bieg Nadziei
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Żorach
description: The 8th Charity Run of Hope is an annual sporting event held at Cegielnia Park in Żory. The event is charitable and supports the John Paul II Hospice in Żory. Participants can run, walk with poles, skate, or ride a scooter, and all proceeds from entry packages go to support the hospice. The run is open to everyone, regardless of fitness level, and promotes physical activity combined with helping those in need.

name: 32 Bieg Fiata
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Bielsku-Białej, Agencja Sportu i Reklamy Andrzej Filipiak
description: The 32nd Fiat Run is an annual road race held in Bielsko-Biała, taking place on May 17, 2026. The 10 km course runs through the city streets, including Warszawska, 3 Maja and Zamkowa, and finishes at Town Hall Square. The race is open to participants over the age of 16, with a limit of 1,800 participants. It is organized by the Municipal Office in Bielsko-Biała and Agencja Sportu i Reklamy Andrzej Filipiak. The event is a certified PZLA road race with a rich regional tradition.

name: Bieg Po Puszczy
description: Bieg po Puszczy is a unique running event held in the scenic Niepołomice Forest, taking place for the twelfth time in 2026. Participants can choose from three running distances: a half marathon, the Forest 15K, and the Forest 7K. They can also take part in the 40 km Gravel in the Forest cycling race. The course runs along forest trails, gravel roads, and asphalt, offering beautiful views and a chance to connect with nature. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal, and refreshments and professional medical support will be available along the route. The event is also an opportunity to enjoy time together as a family, with recreational cycling events for children.

name: Ekiden Pragmatiq
description: Ekiden PragmatIQ is a team marathon relay held in Poznań by Lake Malta. Teams of six cover the marathon distance (42.195 km), with each runner completing a designated leg. The course is paved and follows a 5.4 km loop, except for the first leg. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Ekiden Junior is also held as part of the event for the youngest runners.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
location: Seaside Park Hotel, ul. Wschodnia 20, Kołobrzeg
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: Kołobrzeski Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku is a 21.1 km race along the coast in Kołobrzeg. The fourth edition takes place on 16 May 2027. Start and finish are at the Seaside Park Hotel on Wschodnia 20. The course is flat and follows the promenade and a foot and bike path to Sianożęty and back. The race is part of the Kołobrzeska Odyseja series.
course_highlights: Flat seaside course with a turnaround in Sianożęty
Five refreshment points
Course marked every kilometre
additional: In 2026 the start was at 11:00 with a 3 hour time limit. Timing is by Herkules using disposable chips. The organizer also plans children's races.

name: IX Bieszczadzki Bieg Lotników - Lato
description: Bieszczady Aviators’ Summer Run is a mountain race held in Ustrzyki Dolne, on the running trails beneath Żuków in the Żuków Range, within the Ustrzyki Dolne Forest District. The route follows forest roads with varied surfaces, including uphill and downhill sections, and the start and finish are at the same location. The event aims to promote outdoor physical activity, bring participants together, and commemorate the aviation heritage of Ustjanowa Górna. The program includes two running distances and a Nordic walking event. The time limit for completing the half-marathon is 4 hours.

name: Kresowe Trail #5
description: Kresowe Trail in Prostki is a trail race in the Kresowe Trail series, held at the forest stadium in Prostki near Ełk. There are two courses: Szpurt over 7 km marked with green arrows on a yellow background and Wertep over 16.6 km marked with red arrows. A nordic walking group also starts. The time limit is 2 hours 15 minutes, and there is one aid station on the Wertep course. The organiser recommends bringing a bottle or cup for water.
course_highlights: Two courses: Szpurt 7 km and Wertep 16.6 km
Start and finish at the forest stadium in Prostki
Course maps and GPX files available
additional: In 2026 the start was set for 9:00, and online registration was possible on race day until 8:40. New bib numbers apply for the 2026 season and the first one is free. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Lone Willow Marathon
description: The Lone Willow Marathon is a marathon held in Jelcz-Laskowice, Poland, organized by Maraton Chwałowice and Arkadiusz Tołłoczko. The race is listed in marathon calendars for the areas around Tyniec Mały and Namysłów, as well as in the sports events directory for the Żórawina region. The marathon course is 42.195 km long and takes place in May, offering participants typical spring weather with temperatures of around 20°C. This sporting event attracts runners from various regions, providing professional organization and an attractive course.

name: Marszobieg Trzech Dzielnic
location: VIII LO im. Stanisława Wyspiańskiego, ul. Grzegórzecka 24, Kraków
description: Marszobieg Trzech Dzielnic is a recreational running and walking event in Kraków organised by the instructor team of the ZHP Kraków-Śródmieście scout district. The 2026 edition took place on 17 May on the track of VIII Liceum Ogólnokształcące at ul. Grzegórzecka 24. The programme had a timed 4 km run, an untimed 4 km walk and children's runs over 500 m and 200 m. The event aims to promote running, bring families together and encourage a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Timed 4 km run from age 13
Untimed 4 km walk
Children's runs over 500 m and 200 m
additional: In 2026 the 4 km run started at 11:00, the walk at 11:10 and the children's runs at 12:15 and 12:30. Partners were the councils of districts I Stare Miasto, II Grzegórzki and III Prądnik Czerwony. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of a trail race held in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The course runs through fields and forests between the towns of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to enjoy nature and spend time actively outdoors. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.

name: Półmaraton...Chce Ci się?
description: “Half marathon… Are you up for it?” is a cross-country race covering 21 km, with an additional 32 km race, held on forest trails in the Herby and Kłobuck Forest Districts near Blachownia. Participants can run or walk the course with Nordic walking poles. The event also includes races for children and young people. This is the fifth edition of the event, combining sport and recreation in a picturesque forest setting.

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy - Run Toruń Plaza features two distances: 5 km and 10 km. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness in the spring edition of the series and experience the unique atmosphere of running in Toruń. The organizers provide professional, nationwide event organization while ensuring a friendly, family atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race held in Sierakowice as part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering a 15 km main race as well as numerous children’s and youth races. The event features electronic timekeeping, an extensive program and prizes for the top competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police support, as well as amenities such as a bag drop, showers and a café.

name: V Bieg Ratownika
description: The 5th Rescuer Run is a milestone fifth edition of an event that combines athletic competition with an educational and community-building mission. Participants can compete on professionally prepared 5 km and 10 km courses, or take part recreationally, including Nordic walking and a 5 km run with a pet. A safe and fun 200 m race is prepared for the youngest participants. After the race, a family and educational picnic with numerous attractions celebrates the anniversary edition. The event takes place in Katowice at 180 Francuska Street and promotes first aid and responsibility for others.

name: VII Bieg im. Rektora Stanisława Komornic...
description: The 7th Stanisław Komornicz Rector’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Tarnów. This sporting event is aimed at runners of varying ability levels and offers the opportunity to prepare with dedicated training plans. The race takes place on the streets of the picturesque city of Tarnów, giving participants an appealing course and sporting excitement.

name: XI Półmaraton Szelkowski
description: The 11th Szelków Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Szelków that attracts runners from various regions. The event includes a half marathon and additional races, such as the 1st Szelków Five and Nordic Walking. The competition is organized by the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Sports Club, offering a sporting atmosphere and the chance to compete on scenic routes. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part and celebrate sport together.

name: XII Bieg Kwitnących Ogrodów
organizer: Klub Biegacza Im. P. Sękowskiego w Płońsku
description: The 12th Blooming Gardens Run is an annual running event held in Kuchary Królewskie. The event features various distances for different age groups, including races for preschoolers and schoolchildren, a 10 km main race, a 3 km accompanying race, and a 6 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are by the forester’s lodge, and participants can look forward to an awards ceremony and a prize drawing after the event. The participant limit is 300, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: XXIII Bieg Skawiński XIV Bieg Skawiński na Rolkach
description: The 23rd Skawina Run is an annual sporting event with a tradition spanning more than 20 years, held in Skawina. The event combines professional competition with a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes an active lifestyle. The program includes races for children and teenagers, the 9th Tomasz Staszczak Memorial, the 17th Polish Energy Workers’ Championships, the 4th Skawina Nordic Walking event over 10 km, and the 14th Skawina Rollerblading Race over 9 km. The race course runs on a resurfaced, even surface, ensuring comfort and safety for participants.

name: Bieg Trzech Zamków
description: The Three Castles Run in Sławków is an annual sporting event that attracts runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts. Participants compete over a distance of 5 km, and the event also features a special Princesses and Knights Run for the youngest participants. The race takes place in the picturesque town of Sławków, which delights visitors with its history, culture, and unique natural surroundings. The organizers warmly invite everyone to take part and cheer on the competitors, promising a friendly atmosphere and plenty of fun.
course_highlights: 5 km route in the center of Sławków
Nordic walking as an alternative to running
Special Princesses and Knights Run for children
additional: On race day, traffic disruptions may occur on several streets in Sławków between 9:30 and 11:30. Traffic will be temporarily stopped as participants pass through. Please do not park along the route and follow instructions from event staff. Information about the distances and route is from a previous edition.

name: Charytatywny bieg dla hospicjum WYBIEGAJ...
description: The “RUN FOR LIFE” Charity Run for the Hospice is a special sporting event held in Lisiniec Park in Częstochowa, combining physical activity with support for the hospice. Participants can choose from three options: the 5 km main run, 5 km Nordic walking, or the approximately 1 km Gnome Run for children. The event aims not only to promote a healthy lifestyle but, above all, to support hospice patients in need. Participants receive medals and a post-race meal, and the event’s atmosphere encourages people to connect and work together for a good cause.
course_highlights: A 5 km running and Nordic walking route in Lisiniec Park
An approximately 1 km Gnome Run for children accompanied by guardians
Scenic parkland suited to recreation and outdoor activity
additional: Participants receive a medal and a post-race meal. Places are limited. The event is charitable and supports the Hospice in Częstochowa. The 2026 edition is listed as taking place in Lisiniec Park, starting at 16:00, with a medal and post-race meal.

name: I Majowa Żelechowska 8
description: The 1st May Żelechów Eight is a race held in Żelechów that attracts participants despite unfavorable weather conditions. The event has a local, sporting character, promoting physical activity among residents and visitors. The race follows a route approximately 8 kilometers long, offering an opportunity for competition and community engagement. The event is part of the sports calendar of the town and municipality of Żelechów.
course_highlights: A route approximately 8 km long
The race takes place in the town of Żelechów
The event attracts local runners despite rainy weather
additional: The race takes place regardless of the weather, showing the participants’ commitment.

name: IV Bieg Dycha z Pompą
description: The 4th Tapflo Run – Dycha z Pompą is a 10-kilometer road race held in Tczew and organized by PCS Tczew, with Tapflo Sp. z o.o. as the main sponsor. The start and finish are at the company’s headquarters at 4b Czatkowska Street. The race takes place on a Sunday, and the starting line closes 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. Participants can register online, and places are limited to 200 runners.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course in Tczew
