Start and finish at Tapflo’s headquarters at 4b Czatkowska Street
The starting line closes 15 minutes after the start
additional: The participant limit is 200. Applications without the entry fee paid within 7 days will be removed from the list. The start and finish are at the same location. The starting line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. For the 2026 edition, the limit is 200 OPEN participants and the start time is 10:00; prices and registration information apply to this edition.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: V Bieg Ochota na Zdrowie
location: Park Forty Korotyńskiego, Ochota, Warszawa, Poland
description: The 5th “Ochota for Health” Run is a running event organized by the Ochota District of the Capital City of Warsaw. The 2026 edition will take place in Forty Korotyńskiego Park, a green space in Warsaw’s Ochota district. It’s an opportunity to spend time actively and take part in a sporting event in the district.
course_highlights: Forty Korotyńskiego Park
A green space in Warsaw’s Ochota district

name: XI Bieg Łomianek
description: The Irena Szewińska Łomianki Run is an annual sporting event held in Łomianki in memory of a legend of Polish athletics. The main 10 km race attracts both recreational and more advanced runners from across Poland. In addition to the main race, Mini Runs for children are held over 200, 400 and 800 metres, along with a 2x200-metre relay for parents and children. The event promotes physical activity and sporting values, making it an important local and sporting occasion.
course_highlights: The 10 km main-race course offers runners the chance to go for personal bests
Mini Runs for children over 200, 400 and 800 metres
A 2x200-metre relay for parents and children
additional: The number of places on the start list is limited.

name: XRUN Wyspowy Trail
description: XRUN Wyspowy Trail is a mountain race in the Beskid Wyspowy range, finishing in the City Park in Limanowa. The 2027 edition takes place on Sunday 16 May. Runners choose between 50 km (2500 m+), 38 km (1700 m+), 22 km (900 m+) and 6 km (300 m+), and there are children's races. The 50 and 38 km courses cross the Mogielica massif, the highest peak of the range, and the 50, 38 and 22 km courses end with the steep climb up Modyń, where ropes are strung between the trees. The race office is at the Limanowa Land Museum.
course_highlights: Four distances: 50, 38, 22 and 6 km
View of the Tatras from the Mogielica massif (1170 m)
Steep rope-assisted climb up Modyń
additional: Starts: 50 km at 7:00 from the car park in Wilczyce (10 h limit), 38 km at 8:30 from Rydza-Śmigłego Pass in Słopnice (8 h), 22 km at 9:30 from Zalesie (6 h), 6 km at 10:20 (2 h). Entry fees rise with the registration date: 190 to 310 zł for 50 km, 160 to 260 zł for 38 km, 150 to 210 zł for 22 km, 60 to 100 zł for 6 km and 30 to 60 zł for the children's races. Courses are marked with XRUN tape and arrows.

name: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna
description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-running event created in the USA. Runners start every hour and have to complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they have time to rest until the next full hour. The competition continues until only one runner remains, and they complete the final loop within the one-hour time limit. This is an endurance race where not only speed matters, but also strategy and perseverance.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed races held in Poznań over 5 km and 10 km distances. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique atmosphere of night racing. The event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: Leśna Piątka Na Dychę
description: Leśna Piątka Na Dychę is a 10 km trail race held in Koszalin on the Karnieszewice Forest District’s forest educational trail. The course winds through scenic woodland, offering participants a unique and enjoyable experience. Organizers prepare distinctive cast-steel medals for runners, presented at the finish. The race is part of the Leśna Piątka series and takes place annually, attracting running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: The course follows the Karnieszewice Forest District’s forest educational trail
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
Scenic woodland offering a unique experience
additional: The race takes place in the evening, with the start at 19:00. Every participant receives a cast-steel medal. The start and finish are at the car park on Słupska Street, where the forest educational trail begins. The race is part of the Leśna Piątka series, which includes various editions and distances.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
description: The XIII 5-Mile Run is a race over 5 nautical miles (9260 m), organized by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Navy Officers’ Association in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Center. The course consists of two 4630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP “Gen. K. Pułaski.” The event is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and registered civilian runners. Foreign nationals may participate after prior verification. The race course is not certified by the PZLA, and payments are processed through Przelewy24.
course_highlights: 5 nautical miles (9260 m), divided into two 4630 m loops
Start and finish in front of the ORP “Gen. K. Pułaski”
The course is not certified by the PZLA
additional: Participation is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and registered civilian runners. Foreign nationals may take part after prior verification and arrangements with the organizer. Payments are made through Przelewy24.

name: Ultra-Trail® Malopolska
description: Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a festival of challenging mountain races held in the Małopolska region, in the Gorce and Beskid Mountains. The event offers a range of distances from 16 to 240 km, taking runners along scenic and demanding mountain trails. It is organized by the 4 Alternatywy Foundation and attracts runners who value a challenge and the beauty of mountain nature. Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a great opportunity to test your abilities on routes of varying difficulty and experience the unique atmosphere of ultrarunning.

name: XXI Ekstremalny Maraton Pieszy KIERAT
description: The KIERAT International Extreme Walking Marathon is 100 km of uninterrupted hiking through the mountains of Beskid Wyspowy, with 4,000 m of elevation gain to cover within 30 hours. It is an extreme challenge for experienced hikers and runners who want to test the limits of their physical and mental endurance. The marathon base is at the Słopnice Educational Institutions Complex, and the route passes through the scenic areas of Beskid Wyspowy. The event promotes active recreation and the scenic attractions of the Limanowa region.
course_highlights: 100 km of hiking through the mountains of Beskid Wyspowy
4,000 m of elevation gain to cover within 30 hours
The route passes through the scenic areas of the Limanowa region
additional: Participants are provided with two nights’ accommodation in basic conditions in the gymnasium and other rooms of the Słopnice Educational Institutions Complex. Four free parking areas for participants are available in Słopnice. Meals are available in the school cafeteria, including a Saturday meal covered by the event provisions, as well as meals available for an additional fee on Friday and Sunday. Bringing a sleeping mat and sleeping bag is recommended. Public transport is available, with a change in Limanowa. The event base is at the Słopnice Educational Institutions Complex. Participants have 30 hours to complete the marathon; the organizer provides two nights’ accommodation in basic conditions, and parking in Słopnice is free.

name: Kiełczowska Dycha i Piątka
description: Kiełczowska Dycha i Piątka is a road-and-trail race in Kiełczów, in Długołęka municipality, organised by the Fit Strefa club. The first edition was held as part of Sports Day in Kiełczów. The course is a 5 km loop, 70% asphalt and 30% unpaved roads; runners in the 10 km race complete it twice. Children can take part in a 200 m race on the sports field.
course_highlights: 5 km loop: 70% asphalt and 30% unpaved roads
10 km and 5 km distances, plus a 200 m children’s race
Electronic timekeeping and a cast medal for every participant
additional: In 2026, the main race started at 10:00 and the children’s race at 12:30. The entry fee was 79 zł until 4 May and 99 zł thereafter (children: 35 zł and 49 zł). Time limits: 90 minutes for 10 km and 60 minutes for 5 km. Details of the 2027 edition have not yet been published.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultrarun held in the picturesque Low Beskids, with routes of varying difficulty. The event draws inspiration from the historic “Jaga-Kora” Courier Route from World War II, giving the race a distinctive character and historical significance. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 19 km to 101 km, passing through the areas of Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój. The race is certified by ITRA and UTMB, underscoring its standing in the mountain running community.

name: Maraton Zagłębiowski
description: The Zagłębie Marathon is a unique night marathon held in Sosnowiec and Dąbrowa Górnicza, combining regional promotion with bringing the running community together. Participants can run the full marathon distance or take part in a two-person relay, with each runner covering a half marathon. The race starts at 20:00, and the route is well lit and secured, creating a distinctive atmosphere for a night race. Supporter groups and local residents cheer on the runners, further adding to the event’s unique character.
course_highlights: Night route through Sosnowiec and Dąbrowa Górnicza
Well-lit and secured route
Start and finish at ArcelorMittal Park, a modern sports complex
additional: The time limit for completing the course is 6 hours. The two-person marathon relay includes a baton handover after approximately 21 km at Pogoria. The start and finish are at ArcelorMittal Park, a sports complex with a pitch, a hall, and an ice rink. The route passes through two cities and is supported by spectators and local residents. Race packs can be collected at designated times, and the race office is open before the event.

name: Siedlecka Nocna Dycha
location: Ośrodek Sportu ARMS, ul. Prusa 6, Siedlce
description: MKL Siedlecka Nocna Dycha is a new nighttime 10 km race in Siedlce, with its first edition taking place on Saturday, May 22, 2027. The start and finish are at the ARMS Sports Centre stadium at 6 Prusa Street, and the course is a single asphalt loop certified by the PZLA. The main race starts at 9:00 p.m. and has a 90-minute time limit. The course is lit by street lighting. Earlier, at 6:00 p.m., children’s races called Kids Run take place.
course_highlights: A single 10 km asphalt loop certified by the PZLA
9:00 p.m. start with street lighting
Kids Run for children over distances of approximately 200 to 600 m
additional: The 10 km entry fee rises from 79 zł (Black Weekend) to 129 zł, and is 159 zł at the Race Office. Kids Run costs 30 zł. There are 600 places for the 10 km race and 200 for children. There are two water stations on the course.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Leśny Ogród Botaniczny Marszewo, ul. Marszewska 5, Gdynia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia is a 5 km run and walk in the Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden in Gdynia, part of the nationwide Botaniczna Piątka series. The 2026 spring edition took place on 23 May at 10:00 at ul. Marszewska 5. The series is run by a group of runners who have organised mainly cross-country events since 2014. The edition also included children's runs.
course_highlights: 5 km course in the Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden
Part of a series of races in botanical gardens
Children's runs over shorter distances
additional: The 2027 spring date in Gdynia has not yet been announced on the organiser's site.

name: I Górski Pólmaraton Szczytniański
description: The 1st Szczytna Mountain Half Marathon is a mountain race organized by the Szczytna Biega Association, held in the picturesque area around Szczytna. The half-marathon course climbs uphill, offering a challenge for every runner, regardless of experience level. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, combining a passion for running with the beauty of the region. The organizers invite both beginners and experienced runners to take part together and create unforgettable memories on the trails around Szczytna.
course_highlights: Uphill mountain race
Course for all experience levels
Picturesque terrain around Szczytna
additional: A 10 km Nordic walking event is also held as part of the event. The association offers official running merchandise, such as sports waist packs and wrist bottles, available for purchase in its online shop.

name: Pancerna Piątka
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in a 5 km road race, held in Żurawica. The event is held under the Honorary Patronage of the Regional Police Commander in Rzeszów and organized by the Regional Board of the Independent Self-Governing Trade Union of Police Officers of the Podkarpackie region. More than 400 participants take part, and the course runs along roads through Żurawica, offering sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km road race
The course runs along roads through Żurawica
The event is held under the Honorary Patronage of the Regional Police Commander in Rzeszów
additional: More than 400 participants took part in the most recent edition.

name: Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossman Run
description: Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossmann Run is a 10 km road race in central Łódź, started in 2003 by sports journalists Robert Blesiński and Tomasz Brzeziński. The organisers have announced the 24th edition for 22 May 2027, with registration opening in January 2027. In 2026 the start and finish were at Łódź Fabryczna station and the main race started at 19:00. It is one of the largest 10 km races in Poland.
course_highlights: 10 km course through central Łódź
Music points and fan zones along the route
One of the biggest 10 km races in Poland
additional: In 2026 the entry fee ranged from 99 zł to 180 zł depending on payment date, with a technical shirt included. Details for 2027 are not yet published.

name: 10 Family Run
description: The KSOS Family Run is a family celebration of running on Kraków’s Błonia, organized by the Kraków School Sports Centre since 2015. The jubilee 10th edition took place and brought together more than 700 participants. The programme includes the 5 km Open Run, the 2.5 km Mom’s Run and Dad’s Run, children’s races, and the colourful 700 m Barefoot Run. The courses run across the grassy area of the Błonia.
course_highlights: 5 km Open Run across the grassy Błonia
2.5 km Mom’s Run and Dad’s Run
Children’s races from 200 m to 2,100 m and the 700 m Barefoot Run
additional: In 2026, the Open Run started at 9:30, and online registration was open until 8 May. Every participant received a technical T-shirt in their race pack. The date of the next edition has not yet been announced.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
description: The Hajnówka Half Marathon is the region’s most important running event, following a route from Białowieża to the center of Hajnówka. Participants cover 21.0975 km through the scenic Białowieża Forest. Despite its intimate scale, the race has earned recognition and numerous awards for its good organization and professional service. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a unique atmosphere and a chance to connect with nature.
course_highlights: Route from Białowieża to the center of Hajnówka
Half-marathon distance: 21.0975 km
Scenic areas of the Białowieża Forest
additional: The race office is open Friday from 15:00 to 21:00 and Saturday from 8:00 to 9:30 at the Hajnówka Municipal Park Amphitheater. An ID card is required to collect the race pack. Running under another participant’s name is not permitted. Entries are not accepted on the day before or on race day. Participants can enjoy a complimentary coffee buffet while collecting their race packs.

name: 48 Zdrojowy Bieg Zwycięstwa
description: The 48th Zdrojowy Victory Run is an annual running event held in Gołdap, promoting physical activity and sports culture among residents and visitors. The race takes place on cross-country trails suited to both recreational and more experienced runners. The organizer, the Gołdap Sports and Recreation Centre, provides modern sports and recreation facilities, creating opportunities for active leisure throughout the year. The event is an important sporting occasion for the region, held during the summer season.
course_highlights: Cross-country trails in the scenic surroundings of Gołdap
Modern sports facilities at the Gołdap Sports and Recreation Centre
An event promoting physical activity and sports culture in the region
additional: The organizer is the Gołdap Sports and Recreation Centre, which manages the municipal stadium, sports and entertainment hall, tennis courts, and indoor swimming pool. The Centre also offers fitness classes, aqua aerobics, and cross-country ski rentals. The event is part of Gołdap’s calendar of major sporting events, alongside, among others, the Gołdap Night Ten and the Jaćwingowie Ski Run.

name: Bieg Lwa
location: Tarnowo Podgórne, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Lion Run is an annual half marathon held in Tarnowo Podgórne, attracting runners from across Poland. The route passes through scenic areas, offering participants both sporting challenges and beautiful views. The event is part of the Lion Festival, which also includes other races and additional attractions, such as an EXPO featuring partners and cheering competitions. The Lion Run is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and socializing in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route passes through Tarnowo Podgórne and includes refreshment stations
Scenic views and varied terrain
Organized as part of the Lion Festival, with additional attractions
additional: The event includes the Lion EXPO, with dozens of partner stands. The streets of Tarnowo Podgórne will be closed on race day from 17:00 to 23:00. A contest is being held in which every hundredth person wins prizes. Race and recovery packages are available for half-marathon participants.

name: Bieg Poznaniaka
description: Bieg Poznaniaka is an annual running event held in Szreniawa, surrounded by Wielkopolski National Park. The event includes main races over 11 km and 5.5 km, a Nordic Walking event, and numerous races for children and young people. The main race course follows a marked loop of approximately 5.5 km, which participants in the longer race complete twice. The event is organized by the Aperio Association, and its goal is to support the education of children and young people with autism.
course_highlights: The main race and Nordic Walking course follows a marked loop of approximately 5.5 km in Wielkopolski National Park
Participants in the 11 km race complete the loop twice; those in the 5.5 km race and Nordic Walking event complete it once
Children’s races take place at the National Museum of Agriculture and Agro-Food Industry in Szreniawa
additional: Race packets can be collected on race day at the National Museum of Agriculture and Agro-Food Industry in Szreniawa from 9:00 to 14:00. A bag drop is available at the venue. Participants are advised to arrive at least one hour before the start. A limited number of race packets (10) for the 11 km, 5.5 km, and Nordic Walking events will be available on race day; payment is cash only. Children’s races are divided into separate heats for the safety of the youngest participants. Participants aged 16–18 who are not accompanied by a guardian must have consent from a parent or legal guardian. The children’s awards ceremony will take place at around 12:25, and the adults’ awards ceremony at 14:45. The event ends at around 15:00.

name: IX Bieg Pileckiego
description: The Pilecki Run in Jodłówka commemorates Captain Witold Pilecki and is organized by the Moc Radości Association in Jodłówka. The ninth edition took place. Nearly 180 participants lined up at the start across four distances, including 10 km. The organizers describe the event as patriotic and family-oriented, with the Public Primary School in Jodłówka as co-organizer.
course_highlights: A run commemorating Captain Witold Pilecki
Four distances, including 10 km
A family-friendly atmosphere and a post-race meal for runners
additional: In 2026, all participant places were filled before the race. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
location: Kampus Główny Akademii Wychowania Fizycznego Józefa Piłsudskiego, Warszawa, Poland
description: The Ekiden Relay Marathon is Poland’s largest team race in the Japanese ekiden relay format, held in Warsaw. The event is designed for teams of 6, who cover the marathon distance together, making it ideal for company, club, or friends’ team-building. The course consists of two loops, 2.195 km and 2.5 km long, and the different relay leg distances allow runners of various ability levels to take part. The start and finish are on the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw, and the event features an extensive program of team-building and sports activities.
course_highlights: The course consists of two loops: a shorter 2.195 km loop and a longer 2.5 km loop
The first runner covers 7.195 km; the next runners cover 10 km or 5 km on the 2.5 km loops
Start and finish on the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw
additional: Starts take place in waves from 9:00 to 13:00, every 15 minutes. The team captain collects the race packs, and relay batons are collected immediately before the start. There is a water station on the course 150 metres before the relay exchange zone. The event takes place on the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw, with access to bag storage, changing rooms, and toilets.

name: Nowomiejska Dycha
description: Nowomiejska Dycha is a unique night road-running event held along the atmospheric, historic streets of Nowe Miasto Lubawskie. The event features two races: 5 km and 10 km, starting at 18:00 and 20:00, respectively. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, post-race meals, and cash and in-kind prizes for the top runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and experience the magic of night running in the welcoming atmosphere of this charming town.
course_highlights: The course winds along the atmospheric, historic streets of Nowe Miasto Lubawskie
Night road races over 5 km and 10 km
Start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square
additional: Participants receive generous race packs containing T-shirts, bags, commemorative magnets, and medals. Post-race meals are available. Both races start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. The event takes place in the evening, creating a unique night-running atmosphere.

name: Phoenix RUN
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a picturesque forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. The event offers a variety of activities for the whole family, including a 10 km main race, 5 km nordic walking, and children’s races over distances from 100 to 800 metres. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively surrounded by nature, regardless of sporting ability. The organizers provide generous race packs, healthy food, and a chillout zone, creating a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km main race in the forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge
5 km nordic walking for adults
Children’s races over distances from 100 to 800 m in age categories 3–15
additional: Start and finish by the Smolarnia forester’s lodge. Children’s races start at 9:00; the main race and adult nordic walking start at 11:00. The event takes place deep in the forest, offering the power of nature and a unique atmosphere. The organizers offer opportunities for participants to socialize, healthy and delicious food, and a chillout zone.

name: Sieprawska Piątka
description: Sieprawska Piątka is an annual race held in Siepraw, attracting runners of different ages and skill levels. The course runs through the municipality’s scenic areas, offering participants an enjoyable sporting experience and a chance to spend time actively. The event brings the community together and is supported by local cultural and sports institutions, highlighting its social dimension.
course_highlights: 5 km race course
Scenic areas of the Siepraw municipality
Organized with support from local cultural and sports institutions
additional: The Sieprawska Piątka Running Group holds running training sessions at Słoneczny Park.

name: VII Skaryszewski Bieg Konia
description: The 7th Skaryszew Horse Run is an annual running event held in Skaryszew at the Hubertus Stud Farm. The event includes the main “Końska Dycha” race and races for children, creating a sporting atmosphere for participants of different ages. The course runs through the stud farm’s scenic grounds, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature and horses. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of Hubertus Stud Farm in Skaryszew
Scenic views and horses nearby along the route
Special races for children alongside the main race
additional: The event takes place at Hubertus Stud Farm, 72 Partyzantów Street, 26-640 Skaryszew. It also includes races for children.

name: X Leśne Bieganie dla Zdrowia
location: Wola, Miedźna, Pszczyna County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 10th Forest Running for Health is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Miedźna, based in Wola. The race takes place in woodland areas around Wola, offering participants the chance to enjoy an active outdoor break. It is a walk-and-run event open to people of different ages and abilities. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and local community integration.
course_highlights: The route runs through scenic woodland areas
Distances of 5 and 10 km suit different participants
A walk-and-run format encourages recreation and health
additional: The organizer is the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Miedźna, based in Wola. The event takes place in woodland areas in Frydek/Wola. In the GOSiR sports events calendar, the race is listed as a walk-and-run event over distances of 5 and 10 km. No information is available about entry fees, the start time, or registration details.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: The Wichrowo Forest District invites all running enthusiasts to the next edition of the Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach race. The event takes place in the Wichrowo Forest District and includes a 10 km main race, races for children and teenagers, a race for people with intellectual disabilities, and a Nordic walking march. The start and finish of the main race are located by the Wichrowo Forest District headquarters. A familiarization run on the course is organized for those interested.
course_highlights: A 10 km main race through the Wichrowo Forest District
Age categories for children and teenagers, with various distances (200 m, 600 m, 2,500 m)
A Nordic walking march of approximately 10 km, starting on Garnizonowa Street in Dobre Miasto
additional: The course familiarization run takes place on June 6 at 10:00. The Nordic walking march starts at 9:00 on Garnizonowa Street in Dobre Miasto, at the parking area by the forest.

name: XVI Bieg Koziołków
description: The 16th Bieg Koziołków is an annual running event organized in Kędzierzyn-Koźle by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre. The races take place on a course adapted to different age groups, including children’s and youth races. The start is scheduled for 16:00, and participants can expect professional RFID timing provided by Time-Sport.pl. The event combines sporting competition with local tradition and is a great opportunity for the whole family to spend time actively.
course_highlights: Course adapted for children’s and youth races
Professional RFID timing
Organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle
additional: The races take place in Kędzierzyn-Koźle and are supported by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in professional timing at sporting events. The event is family-oriented and includes children’s and youth races. The organizer provides electronic RFID timing and comprehensive technical support.

name: XX Bieg Lupusa
location: Barków, Dobroszyce, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 20th edition of the Lupus Run will take place on May 23 in Barków. This is a Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)-certified race, offering professional timekeeping, a medal for participants, and a post-race meal. The event attracts athletes from across the country and is known for its excellent organization and unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified race
Professional timekeeping
Medal and meal for participants
additional: The race takes place in Barków. Participants receive a medal and a meal. The event features professional timekeeping and PZLA certification.

name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: Cross Maraton Przez Piekło do Nieba (Through Hell to Heaven) is an off-road marathon and half marathon finishing in the village of Niebo near Końskie. The 22nd edition takes place on 22 May 2027. Runners choose between the full marathon and the half marathon, with separate veteran categories. Slower marathon runners can use an early start one hour earlier.
course_highlights: Off-road marathon and half marathon
Early marathon start at 8:00
Veteran categories
additional: The marathon starts at 9:00 with an early start at 8:00, and the half marathon starts at 9:15. Registration is handled by Personal Best on the DoStartu platform.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
description: The 28th Bieg Święców is an annual running event held in Sławno, commemorating important historical events and promoting physical activity. The 5 km main race runs through the municipal stadium, along a tartan track and on cycling paths, offering participants an attractive course. The event also includes children’s and youth races at the stadium, held on the tartan track. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping and a 45-minute time limit for finishing the race, ensuring safety and smooth organization.
course_highlights: Main race course: municipal stadium, tartan track, cycling paths (3 x 1.5 km)
Children’s and youth races at the municipal stadium — tartan track
Electronic timekeeping using the ChampionChip system
additional: The time limit for completing the main race is 45 minutes. Participants must follow the instructions of the judges and course marshals. The race is open to people aged 17 and over (born in 2009 or earlier). A medical certificate or a declaration stating that the participant is taking part at their own risk is required. Children and youth participating in their races must have permission signed by a legal guardian.

name: XXXIV Bieg Uliczny po Ziemi Makowskiej
Biegowe Spotkanie z Anią
organizer: Wydział Kultury i Sportu Urzędu Miasta Siemianowice Śląskie oraz Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji „Pszczelnik”
description: Biegowe Spotkanie z Anią and Nordic Walking is an annual sporting event held in Pszczelnik Park in Siemianowice Śląskie. The race commemorates Anna Rembierz, for whom sport was a great passion. Participants cover a 5.5-kilometre route along the park paths, through the Golf Course and Bażantarnia, and past Rzęsa Pond, finishing in Pszczelnik Park. The event takes place during the Health Picnic and encourages participants to wear sportswear with a pink accent, Ania’s favourite colour.
course_highlights: A 5.5 km route along the paths of Pszczelnik Park
Route through the Golf Course and Bażantarnia
Views of Rzęsa Pond
additional: Entries are accepted by email until 16:00 on 21 May, and after that deadline at the Race Office on race day from 11:15 to 11:50. Participants are asked to wear sportswear with a pink accent. The race takes place during the 10th Health Picnic at the “Pszczelnik” Sports Complex. A Nordic walking option is also available. Information about an earlier edition also encouraged participants to wear sportswear with a pink accent.

name: II Podgórski Bieg i Marsz Leśnymi Ścieżkami
description: The 2nd Podgórze Run and Walk on Forest Trails is a sporting event organized by the Podgórze Village Head and Village Council, inviting running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The 10 km run and 6 km walk route passes through the scenic woodland of the Rudzki Cultural Park. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal and a hot meal at the finish. The main sponsor, FA Engineered Nutrition, has prepared attractive race packs and prizes. Registration is available via personalbest.pl.
course_highlights: The route passes through the woodland of the Rudzki Cultural Park
A 10 km run and a 6 km Nordic walk
Beautiful natural surroundings and scenic trails
additional: The main sponsor has prepared attractive race packs and prizes. Registration is available via personalbest.pl. The organizers promise a medal and a hot meal at the finish; the main sponsor has prepared race packs and prizes.

name: Uniwersytecki Test Coopera - edycja wiosenna
location: Stadion lekkoatletyczny MOS Kraków „Zachód”, Kraków, Poland
description: The University Cooper Test – Spring Edition is an annual sporting event organized by the Jagiellonian University Sports Club at the MOS Kraków “Zachód” athletics stadium. The test consists of running continuously for 12 minutes and is used to assess participants’ maximum aerobic capacity. Participants include students, doctoral candidates, academic staff, entire families, and Kraków residents of all ages, from 5 to over 70. After completing the test, runners receive an isotonic drink, a certificate showing the distance covered, and gifts. The event is open and inclusive, and has become a regular fixture in the Jagiellonian University’s sporting calendar.
course_highlights: A continuous 12-minute run at the MOS Kraków “Zachód” athletics stadium
A traditional location at the foot of Wawel Castle
Open to participants of all ages, from children to seniors
additional: After completing the test, participants receive an isotonic drink, a certificate stating the distance covered, and a gift of their choice (a water bottle, neck warmer/buff, sports shoe bag, or socks). The event is co-organized by AZS Kraków and supported by the City of Kraków and OSHEE. Participants span a very wide age range, from 5 to 72. In the previous spring edition, start waves set off every 15 minutes, and registration took place on site.

name: V Ultra Nordic Walking World Records
description: UltraWR is an international nordic walking event held in Na Skarpie Forest in Toruń. The festival features individual and team competitions in various events, as well as the open Ultra Nordic Walking Rally, which is ideal for people of all ages and ability levels. The rally route is 3 km long and runs along forest trails; participants can complete it multiple times during the four-hour event. The event promotes outdoor activity, community, competition, and care for the natural environment.
course_highlights: A 3 km rally route along the forest trails of Na Skarpie
Officially measured route with a chip that counts laps
Participants can complete the route multiple times over four hours
additional: The rally is free for children under 6, who will be registered on site. Participants receive a race bib and a chip for counting laps. A race pack and a recovery meal await participants. Visitors can tour the Bielawy Nursery Farm after registering in advance. The Dobrzejewice Forest District will run environmental and educational activities during the event. The rally is scheduled for Sunday, May 24, from 10:00 to 14:00. The fee depends on the number of people in the entry: from 20 zł for one person to 50 zł for five people; children under 6 can take part for free. The competition program includes 10 individual and team events.

name: VI Półmaraton Jaworze
description: The 6th Jaworze Half Marathon is a mountain race over the half-marathon distance (23.20 km), with approximately 900 metres of elevation gain, organised by the Centre for Winter Sports in Ptaszkowa. The course runs through forest, along gravel roads and mountain trails, offering challenging conditions and beautiful views. The event aims to promote physical activity, a healthy lifestyle and the tourist attractions of the Grybów region, and to determine the Polish Police Mountain Running Champions. The start and finish are at the Centre for Winter Sports in Ptaszkowa, and the time limit is 4.5 hours. A race for children and young people is also planned as part of the event.
course_highlights: Mountain half-marathon distance: 23.20 km
Approximately 900 m of elevation gain
Forest trails, gravel roads and mountain paths
additional: The participant limit is 150. A race for children and young people is also planned (see the separate regulations for details). The 2026 edition regulations specify a 4.5-hour time limit and a maximum of 150 participants.

name: Myślenicki Festiwal Biegowy
description: Myślenice Running Festival 2027 is the first edition of a half marathon in Myślenice, taking place on 23 May 2027. The start and finish are located in picturesque Zarabie, and the course is flat and runs through the city centre. The 21.0975 km race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), ensuring professional timekeeping and high-quality organization. The festival will also feature other running events, including a corporate relay, children’s races, and the night-time Rave Run. The organizers invite runners to join group training sessions with the DALIN running section and to volunteer.
course_highlights: A flat, PZLA-certified 21.0975 km course
Start and finish in picturesque Zarabie, Myślenice
The course runs through the city centre, with markings every 1 km and 4 refreshment stations
additional: The half marathon is limited to 800 participants. The start may be organized in waves based on declared finish times. There are 4 refreshment stations along the course, spaced approximately 5 km apart, and a station at the finish. The race pack includes a race bib with a timing chip, accident insurance, a medal, water, and a post-race meal. The organizers invite runners to join group training sessions with Dalin Myślenice Sports Club and to volunteer; recruitment opens in January 2027. The program also includes a 4×5 km corporate relay, children’s races over 400 and 800 m, and the 5 km night-time Rave Run. Register via dostartu.pl by 16 May 2027 or until places are filled. Half-marathon participants must be at least 16 years old; those aged 16–17 need a parent or guardian’s consent.

name: Biegi Śnieżnickie
description: The Śnieżnickie Runs are legendary mountain races held in picturesque Międzygórze, in the heart of the Śnieżnik Massif. The routes feature challenging climbs and technical descents, taking runners along beautiful forest trails and gravel roads, as well as to the very summit of Śnieżnik. This event has a rich tradition dating back to the 1990s and attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes from across Europe. Participants can choose between the classic 9.6 km alpine race and the Śnieżnik Half Marathon, approximately 21 km long, which loops around the Crown of Śnieżnik.

name: 14. Bieg Firmowy Wrocław
description: Bieg Firmowy is Poland’s largest charity relay, held in Wrocław. Corporate teams of five cover a total distance of 25 km, with each participant running or walking 5 km. The event combines sport, team building, and support for the beneficiaries of the Everest Foundation, who are facing serious health challenges. Participants can choose the in-person format at the University of Physical Education and the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, or run online from anywhere in the world. Bieg Firmowy is not only a sporting event, but also an important social and charitable initiative.

name: 12 Bieg Elegant na 5
description: The 12th Elegant na 5 Run is an annual running event held in Mosina, scheduled for May 24 in 2026. The event offers a variety of distances for children, young people and people with disabilities, as well as a 5 km main race that runs through the streets of the Mosina municipality. The start and finish are at Plac 20 Października, and the main race begins at 11:15. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a T-shirt, making the event appealing to a wide range of runners.

name: Bieg o rogatywkę rotmistrza Witolda Pile...
description: The Captain Witold Pilecki’s Cap Race is organized by the “Zielone Światło Dla Wrząsowic” Association in Wrząsowice. The race starts at 10:00. Timing is provided electronically by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in timing at sporting events in Poland. This sporting event combines the spirit of competition with a tribute to Captain Witold Pilecki, giving it a unique character.

name: Biegamy, nie klikamy!
organizer: Biegamy, nie klikamy i Rotary Club Warszawa Konstancin
description: Biegamy, nie klikamy! is a charity 5 km run held in the picturesque Chojnów Landscape Park in Konstancin-Jeziorna. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all levels. The start and finish are located at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, providing easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. The event promotes inclusion and supports a charitable cause, with all proceeds going to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery. Participation is free for primary and secondary school students.

name: BoryRun
description: The event brings together sport, health and mindful time spent offline, promoting intergenerational inclusion and the joy of movement without the pressure of competition. The routes pass through the scenic Lower Silesian Forests and the historic grounds of Kliczków Castle, offering a chance to connect with nature and the region’s history. Children can take part in the special Boryrun Active race, featuring activities that develop fitness and confidence.

name: Gontyniec Ultra Trail
description: Gontyniec Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held on the picturesque Gontyniec Hill in Chodzież, the highest elevation in the Greater Poland Lake District. The courses run mainly along forest trails marked with red and yellow signs, offering runners a variety of distances and elevation gains. Organized by the Gontyniec Ultra Trail Foundation, the event attracts cross-country and ultrarunning enthusiasts from across Poland, offering unique challenges over distances from 12 to 52 km. This iconic event combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature and the history of the region.

name: II Charytatywny Bieg Świetlika
organizer: Fundacja Śląskie Hospicjum dla Dzieci Świetlikowo
description: The Świetlik Charity Run is a family-friendly event at the Paprocany Leisure Centre in Tychy, organised by the Silesian Hospice for Children Świetlikowo Foundation in cooperation with MOSiR Tychy. The aim of the run is to support the construction of the Silesian Inpatient Hospice for Children “TuSieTuli”. The second edition took place, with the main race starting at 11:00. Participants could choose between 5 km and 10 km races, or a 5 km Nordic walking event beside Paprocany Lake.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes beside Paprocany Lake
5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s and youth races from 100 to 800 m
additional: In 2026, the children’s and youth races started at 10:00, and registration was online. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: IV Honorowy Bieg Kadecki
description: The 4th Honorary Cadet Run is a special sporting event organized by I LO PUL Kutno – Uniformed Services High School, held to mark the Regimental Day of the 37th Infantry Regiment. The run pays tribute to local history and uniformed services traditions. Participants tackle a 5.5 km obstacle course at the military training ground in Kutno. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Kutno, Mariusz Sikora, and invites everyone who enjoys physical activity to compete and have fun. The run starts at 13:00 at the AMZ S.A. training ground in Kutno, on Metalowa Street.

name: Kęcka Piątka
description: Kęcka Piątka is a 5 km road race held in the picturesque town of Kęty. The certified course runs through the town streets, with key turns and junctions secured to ensure participants’ safety. The race is a local sporting celebration that promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among residents and visitors. It is organized by the Kęty Sports and Recreation Centre under the patronage of the Mayor of the Kęty Municipality. Runners aged 14 and over are invited to take part in this energetic event.

name: Mucharskie Pętle
description: Mucharskie Pętle Run is a unique running event set in the picturesque surroundings of Lake Mucharskie and the hills of the Little Beskids. The course is suitable for both beginner runners and those looking for a more challenging trail run. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts and anyone who enjoys a great sporting atmosphere to take part in the event, which will be held in Mucharz. Places are limited, and registration is online.

name: Prusice Biegają - etap 2
description: The 13th edition of Prusice Biegają is a sporting event held on Żmigrodzka Street, next to the Prusice Fitness Center in Prusice. The course runs along the streets of Prusice and through Pietrowice Małe, offering participants scenic and runner-friendly conditions. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete within the local running community.

name: VI Niechanowska Dyszka i Piątka
description: The 6th Niechanowo 10K and 5K is an annual race held in the picturesque Planty Park in Niechanowo. The event offers two popular race distances: 10 km and 5 km, attracting both recreational and more experienced runners. It is an athletics event and a great opportunity to spend time outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and technical support.

name: XII Bieg z książką
description: The 12th Run with a Book, ON THE TRAIL TO THE FINISH, is an open running event organized by the Nicolaus Copernicus University Alumni Program and the NCUM Marathon Club. It is dedicated to the Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń community and to fans of running and reading. The race takes place on the university campus in Bielany, Toruń, and its route follows forest paths and lanes through the campus woodland. Participants must complete the course while holding a book weighing at least 100 grams, highlighting the event’s unique combination of sport and the promotion of reading. The race is sponsored by Robert Małecki, a crime fiction author and NCUM alumnus, who takes part in the race and meets participants after the competition.

name: XVII Bieg Uliczny o Łaziskie Liście
description: The Alojzy Kaleja Łaziskie Liście Street Race is an annual road race in Łaziska Górne, organized by the municipal sports and recreation center. Competitors race over 5 km and 10 km, alongside a 5 km Nordic walking event. The seventeenth edition attracted a record number of participants. Everyone who finished the race received a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km road races
5 km Nordic walking event
Separate awards for residents of Łaziska Górne
additional: Top competitors in the categories receive trophies and prizes. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced on the MOSiR website.

name: XXII Bieg Sanguszków
organizer: Uczniowski Klub Sportowy „OGRODNIK” i Zespół Szkół Ekonomiczno-Ogrodniczych w Tarnowie
description: The 22nd Sanguszko Run is an annual running event held in Sanguszko Park in Tarnów. The event is organised by Kępa Sport, LKS Burzyn and the “OGRODNIK” Student Sports Club. The run aims to promote running and bring the running community together. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping and professional event organisation.

name: 4 Bieg pamięci Stanisława Dzięgielewskiego
description: Bieg ku pamięci Stanisława Dzięgielewskiego is a run in Obierwia honouring the first marathon runner of the Kurpie region. It is organised by the Projekt Radomir association. The 2026 edition took place on Sunday 24 May. The routes run through pine forests, sandy roads and the countryside along the Omulew river, with running and nordic walking categories.
course_highlights: Routes through pine forest and sandy roads
5 km and 10 km runs plus 5 km nordic walking
Family walk for those not racing
additional: Participants were offered food after the race. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: Bieg 760-lecia Bierutowa
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Bierutowie
price_range: Bieg główny: 50 zł; biegi honorowy i dziecięcy: bezpłatnie
description: The 760th Anniversary of Bierutów Run is a unique sporting event organized by the Bierutów Culture and Sport Centre to commemorate the 760th anniversary of Bierutów being granted town rights. The run follows a route around Bierutów’s Old Town, giving participants the chance to celebrate local history and bring the community together. The event combines family-friendly activities and sport, with different participant categories, including the main race and Nordic walking. The organizers provide professional event support, with the start and finish set in an attractive location on the Market Square in Bierutów.
course_highlights: The 7,600 m main race route runs around Bierutów’s Old Town
A mix of surfaces: asphalt, unpaved road, and cobblestones
Start and finish on the Market Square in Bierutów
additional: The race office is located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 3 Krasińskiego Street. After the main race, a family picnic is held with activities for children and adults, followed by a trophy presentation for the winners. The main race is limited to 100 participants registering online. In previous editions, the children’s race covered 200 m around the town hall tower. Information about distances, the route, and fees comes from the invitation to the 2026 edition.

name: IX Bieg Uliczny Z Siódemką na 7-kę
organizer: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 7 im. Konstantego Ildefonsa Gałczyńskiego w Częstochowie
description: The 9th Z Siódemką na 7-kę Street Run is an annual running event organized by Konstanty Ildefons Gałczyński Primary School No. 7 in Częstochowa. The event takes place in the picturesque Lisiniec Park, offering participants the chance to compete on a street-running course. The run promotes physical activity and brings the local community together, particularly students and residents of Częstochowa. The organizers ensure a sporting atmosphere and participant safety.
course_highlights: Street course in Lisiniec Park in Częstochowa
Picturesque park surroundings make for an enjoyable run
Organized by a local school with a sporting tradition
additional: Information about the course and children’s races comes from the 2023 edition.

name: XII Bieg Ulicami Bohaterów
location: Rynek, Plac Tadeusza Kościuszki, Małogoszcz, Poland
description: The Małogoszcz Streets Run – Heroes’ Run is an annual running event held in Małogoszcz that combines athletic competition with a voluntary blood donation campaign. Races are held over various distances suited to different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The start and finish are at the Market Square, at Tadeusz Kościuszko Square, and the courses run through the town streets. The event promotes physical activity and remembrance of heroes, offering prizes in age categories and special cash cards for the winners.
course_highlights: Race distances range from 300 m to 10,000 m
Start and finish at the Market Square, Tadeusz Kościuszko Square, in Małogoszcz
Courses suited to different age categories
additional: Residents of Małogoszcz municipality are eligible to compete in the children’s and youth categories (ages 4–15); other participants may run out of competition and are not eligible for the main prizes. Prizes are cash cards redeemable at stores with a payment terminal anywhere in the country. The event program runs from 15:00 to 16:55. The registration form allows you to quickly contact the organizer and system administrator. Previous editions included children’s and youth categories for ages 4–15; these were open to residents of Małogoszcz municipality, while others ran out of competition. Participants who finished the race received a commemorative medal.

name: XVII Bieg Wegański
description: The Vegan Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw that promotes a healthy, vegan lifestyle. The route runs mainly along the path by the Vistula River, offering participants scenic views and pleasant running conditions. The event is open to everyone who wants to combine sport with veganism and an active lifestyle. The organizers provide professional support and assistance from volunteers.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along the path by the Vistula River
Scenic views along the river
Pleasant running conditions in Warsaw
additional: Before collecting their race packs, participants should check that their names are on the start list. This helps the volunteers work efficiently and reduces waiting times. For errors in registration or questions, participants can contact the organizers by email: info@runvegan.pl.

name: XXII Bieg Patrona Miasta św. Andrzeja Boboli
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Czechowicach-Dziedzicach
description: The 22nd St. Andrew Bobola City Patron Run is an annual road race held at the MOSiR Stadium in Czechowice-Dziedzice. The 10 km course is clearly marked and designed for runners of various ability levels. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping and water stations. After finishing, each runner receives a commemorative medal, water, and a recovery meal, reflecting the organizers’ commitment to participants’ comfort and satisfaction.
course_highlights: 10 km course marked every 1 km
Water station near the 6.2 km mark
Electronic timekeeping using a chip in the race bib
additional: The race office is open from 10:30 to 12:30 before the main stadium entrance. The time limit for 5 km is 45 minutes, and the time limit for the full race is 90 minutes. The race bib with the timing chip must be worn on the front of the shirt and cannot be exchanged. The winners’ awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00. In 2026, the event was held as part of the “Run for Health 2026” series; a charity collection for Nikos was held during the event.

name: Myślenicki Półmaraton
description:
As part of the First Myślenice Running Festival, the organizers are planning four race formats: a PZLA-certified half marathon, the 4×5 km Business Relay, the 5 km Saturday Night Rave Run, and children’s races.
The event will also feature a Runner’s Village with an EXPO zone and space for families.
The organizers are especially keen to welcome people who will run their first half marathon in Myślenice.

images.alt_text: Stadion lekkoatletyczny z widokiem na bieżnię i boisko przy zachodzie słońca
Biegacze biegnący przez most nad rzeką w otoczeniu zieleni o zmierzchu
Widok z lotu ptaka na rynek i zabudowania Myślenic w słoneczny dzień
Rynek w Myślenicach z widokiem na góry i budynki w tle

name: X Wojewódzkie Mistrzostwa Policji
location: Zespół Boisk Piłkarskich OSiR Bytom, ul. Ostatnia 10, Bytom, Poland
organizer: Komenda Miejska Policji w Bytomiu, Komenda Wojewódzka Policji w Katowicach, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Bytomiu, NSZZ Policjantów województwa śląskiego oraz NSZZ „Solidarność”
description: The 10th Provincial Police Cross-Country Championships, named in memory of Senior Sergeant Marek Sienicki, is a special sporting event held in Bytom. It aims to promote physical activity and commemorate an officer who tragically lost his life in the line of duty. The event will take place in the Bytomka Valley at 10 Ostatnia Street, where participants will tackle an 8-kilometre course along unpaved roads. The race is open to uniformed service officers, civilian employees, students in uniformed-service classes, and all running enthusiasts in the OPEN category. The organisers have prizes for the top finishers and commemorative medals for everyone who completes the race.
course_highlights: An 8-kilometre course along unpaved roads
Start, finish and race office at the OSiR Bytom Football Pitches Complex
The course runs through the Bytomka Valley
additional: Prizes for the top finishers include trophies, certificates and in-kind prizes. Every participant who completes the race will receive a commemorative medal. In the 2026 edition, the start is scheduled for 11:00. Participants who completed the race received commemorative medals.

name: Leśna Piątka Pikuś
location: Parking Nadleśnictwa Karnieszewice, ul. Słupska, Koszalin, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział jest bezpłatny, zachęcamy do dobrowolnych wpłat wspierających organizację

description: Leśna Piątka Pikuś is an annual cross-country run held in Koszalin on the forest educational trail of the Karnieszewice Forest District. The route starts and finishes at the car park on Słupska Street and is open to participants of all ages and experience levels. There is no timing or racing; the event promotes recreation and spending time outdoors as a family. Participants are encouraged to wear fairytale costumes, creating a unique and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows the forest educational trail of the Karnieszewice Forest District
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
A recreational cross-country run with no timing
additional: Participation is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. Participants are encouraged to dress in fairytale costumes, creating a unique atmosphere. On-site registration is also possible, but keepsakes and participation in the prize quiz are not guaranteed.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa - Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in picturesque locations, and the night edition stands out for its unique medals for participants. The race is ideal for runners who value scenic routes and a sense of community.

name: Night Run Zakopane
description: Night Run Zakopane is a unique evening race held in the heart of the Tatra Mountains, in picturesque Zakopane. Participants can choose from three distances: a dynamic 10 km route through the city center, a fast 5 km run, and a special children’s race focused on fun and movement. It’s an unforgettable nighttime running experience that attracts both experienced runners and those just starting out.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the heart of Zakopane
Fast 5 km route with a nighttime atmosphere
Special children’s race focused on fun
additional: Official regulations in Polish and Slovak are available for the main races and the children’s race. The available information relates to the previous edition.

name: XXVII Bieg na Groń Jana Pawła II
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Szkoła dla Regionu, LKS Orkan, ZSCKU w Radoczy
description: The Hiking Rally and Run to Groń Jana Pawła II is an annual event in the Little Beskids, organized by the Szkoła dla Regionu Association, LKS “Orkan” and the Radocza School Complex for Continuing Education. The 27th edition was held to mark the 106th anniversary of the birth of St. John Paul II. Participants set off from Ponikiew and followed the blue trail to Groń Jana Pawła II. The run has school and open categories, and around 150 people took part in the event.
course_highlights: Start in Ponikiew and run along the blue trail to Groń Jana Pawła II
School and open categories
Trophies and prizes for the top finishers
additional: After reaching the summit, participants descended to the “Czartak” pizzeria for refreshments and a recap. The route distance was not provided. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: XIII Smolecka (za)Dyszka
location: Smolec, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Smolec (za)Dyszka is a 10 km road race around the village of Smolec, starting at 18:00. The race takes place on a certified course and is organized by running enthusiasts and volunteers who ensure plenty of fun and sporting excitement. The event attracts recreational runners, families, and residents of the Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality and Lower Silesia. The organizers provide professional event management and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Bieg na Sleze
description: The Bieg na Ślężę is one of the oldest mountain races in Poland, held in Sobótka on the slopes of the Ślęża Massif. The approximately 5 km course, with over 500 metres of elevation gain, follows scenic, challenging mountain trails and finishes at the summit of Ślęża, next to the mountain shelter. The race attracts both top competitors and amateurs who want to take on the legendary climb to the “Ślężański Olympus.”

name: Ultraroztocze
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique running event held in Józefów, in the Roztocze region. Participants can choose from a variety of routes, from short night races to ultra distances of 60 km and 120 km, which take them through the scenic landscapes of Roztocze. The event is organized by the Janosik Race Series Foundation, which has promoted an active and mindful lifestyle through sport since 2014. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering unforgettable experiences and a chance to connect with nature.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Zielonogórskiego, Zielona Góra
description: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra is a 5 km run and walk in the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden, part of the nationwide Botaniczna Piątka series. The 2026 spring edition took place on 30 May. The spring course was two loops. The series is run by a group of runners who have organised mainly cross-country events since 2014.
course_highlights: 5 km course in the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden
Two loops through the garden
Part of a series of races in botanical gardens
additional: The organiser ran separate registration for adults and children. The 2027 spring date in Zielona Góra has not been announced yet.

name: RockRun Jarocin
description: RockRun Jarocin is a running event in Jarocin, Poland's city of music, mixing sport with a rock atmosphere. The programme has a night half marathon, a 10 km race and junior runs. The course passes through the most interesting parts of Jarocin municipality, and the half marathon is part of the Wielkopolska half marathon Grand Prix. The 2026 edition took place on 30 May with close to 1000 participants.
course_highlights: Night half marathon through Jarocin
10 km race at the same event
Part of the Wielkopolska half marathon Grand Prix
additional: The 2026 ambassador was Olympian Adam Nowicki. The main partner in 2026 was BAU-TECHNIK. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: XIII IONWAY Bieg Nyski
description: The Nyski Run is the region’s largest road race, held over a PZLA-certified 10 km course through the streets of Nysa. The 13th edition of the IONWAY Nyski Run took place unusually in May, at 19:00. The start and finish were on Sudecka Street by the Sports and Entertainment Hall. The free Family Mile starts one hour earlier. The event is organised by the “W działaniu” foundation from Nysa.
course_highlights: Flat, certified 10 km course past Nysa’s historic landmarks
Evening start at 19:00
Free Family Mile open to everyone
additional: In 2026, the Nysa Children’s and Youth Races were also held at the Polonia stadium. The entry fee increased across several price tiers. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: 13 Bieg Konopielki
description: The 13th Bieg Konopielki is an annual running event held in Juchnowiec Kościelny, attracting both local runners and visitors from other towns. The main 10 km race runs along the streets of Juchnowiec Dolny, with the start and finish at the stadium. After the race, participants can join a social picnic in Frampol, the birthplace of Edward Redliński, featuring regional food, a concert, and a book prize drawing. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with a family run and numerous other activities.
course_highlights: A 10 km route along the streets of Juchnowiec Dolny, with a loop in Wólka
Start and finish at the stadium in Juchnowiec Dolny
Sandy roads and local streets along the route
additional: Registration is available on race day from 9:00 to 11:30 at the Race Office at the stadium. After the race, a social picnic will be held in Frampol, featuring regional food, a visit to Edward Redliński’s House of Creativity, a concert, and a book prize drawing. Race packages include an invitation to the feast. Meals can be reserved for accompanying guests (adults and children, including meat-free options).

name: Bieg o Złotą Kaczkę
description: The Golden Duck Run is an annual running event held in Toszek. Its aim is to promote running and Nordic walking as recreational activities, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and foster social integration, including for people with disabilities. The main race course is approximately 10 km long and runs over mixed terrain, including cobblestones, asphalt, country roads, and park paths, with soft surfaces predominating. The start and finish are at Toszek Castle. The organizers offer numerous age and special categories, as well as trophies for the top competitors.

name: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema
location: Żelkowo, Gmina Główczyce, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema Run is a 10 km race held in Żelkowo, in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to different experience levels, with support from experts. The event is a road race for runners looking to improve their 10 km times.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging asphalt course
10 km distance
Location: Żelkowo, Pomeranian Voivodeship
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. There is also an opportunity to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.
price_range: 50 zł za pojedynczy bieg lub 150 zł za cały cykl; biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe bezpłatne

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach głównych: 150,00 zł wpłata jednorazowa za cały cykl biegowy (opcja dostępna w elektronicznym formularzu zgłoszeniowym)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach dziecięcych i młodzieżowych jest bezpłatny.

description: The Masurian Running Grand Prix is a series of races held in scenic towns across Masuria, including Sorkwity. The 5 to 10 km courses run along paved, cobbled, and forest paths, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature. The event also includes races for children and teenagers in various age categories, with separate starts for girls and boys. Every participant in the main race receives a commemorative medal, and the organizer provides water and a hot meal. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the beautiful Masurian scenery.
course_highlights: Courses from 5 to 10 km on paved roads, cobblestones, and forest paths
Races for children and teenagers in several age categories, with separate starts for girls and boys
Scenic Masurian surroundings near Sorkwity
additional: The participant limit for all distances at each race is 400. The race office opens 1.5 hours before the start. Race packs can be collected up to 30 minutes before the race. The organizer provides water and a hot meal prepared by local Rural Housewives’ Circles. The limit for the 2026 edition was 400 participants.

name: Dolska Dycha
description: Dolska Dycha is a 10 km road race held in Dolsk, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among the local community. The course is certified by the PZLA and marked every kilometre. It runs on roads closed to traffic within the Dolsk municipality. The event also includes a 3 km race, “Kozia Trójka.” Runners can expect refreshment stations, medical care, and a post-race recovery meal. The start and finish are at the Janusz Kusociński Primary School.
course_highlights: Course certified by the PZLA
Markers every kilometre and volunteers on more challenging sections
The race takes place on roads closed to traffic
additional: Race packs can be collected at the Race Office on event day from 16:00 to 17:30. A race pack may be collected by a third party or transferred to another person. No bag drop is available for participants. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km and 60 minutes for the 3 km. A refreshment point with water is located at the 5 km mark.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice, in the municipal forest. The course is 4,219.5 metres per lap and runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections. The events are amateur and promote a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle. Participants can take part in running or Nordic Walking, as well as e-Prowokacja, an online competition. Events take place on Saturdays, with a 10:00 start and a 3-hour time limit for running and Nordic Walking.
course_highlights: The course is 4,219.5 m per lap
Runs along forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections
Start and finish are on a clearing near Piast Stadium in the municipal forest
additional: Participants can take part in running or Nordic Walking, as well as e-Prowokacja (an online competition). The time limit is 3 hours for running and Nordic Walking; there is no time limit for e-Prowokacja. Participants can complete 1 to 5 laps (approximately 4.2 km to approximately 21 km). After the event, participants must return their race number and collect a drink and a snack (sausage or banana; a bar is awarded in a prize draw). The race number is valid for the whole year and assigned to the participant. Events take place on Saturdays once a month throughout the year. The event recurs monthly.

name: Kresowe Trail #6
description: Kresowe Trail is an intimate series of trail races held on scenic routes in eastern Poland, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The races offer two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), as well as Nordic Walking competition. Organized by the Maratony Kresowe Foundation, the races combine passion, competition, and friendship, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of varying ability levels. The events are held with respect for local communities and the natural environment.
course_highlights: Trail routes of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Scenic areas of Podlasie and its surroundings, including hilly terrain and forest paths
Carefully marked routes with aid stations on the longer distance
additional: Starts are organized in corrals according to results from the previous season. The race package includes a race bib with a timing chip valid for the entire season, a hot post-race meal (with a vegetarian option), medical cover, aid stations along the route and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography services, and prizes for the top competitors. Online registration is also available on race day until 08:40. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited.

name: Roztocze Ultra Race
location: Józefów, Biłgoraj County, Lublin Voivodeship, Poland
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a challenging ultrarunning event held in the picturesque Roztocze region, near Józefów. The course passes through diverse landscapes, including forests, hills, and valleys, offering participants unforgettable views and off-road challenges. The event is part of the Janosik Race Series, organized by a foundation with a passion for sport and development. It attracts runners looking for challenging courses and a sense of community.
course_highlights: The course runs through Roztocze National Park and the surrounding forests
Varied terrain: forest trails, gravel roads, and dirt roads
Picturesque views of the Roztocze hills and valleys
additional: The event offers live GPS tracking and live results. The varied routes range in distance from 3 km (Nocna Trójka) to 100 km (Roztoczańska Setka). The event is part of the Janosik Race Series, which also organizes other races in Poland. Participants can expect professional organization and support along the course.

name: Run4aSmile
description: Run4aSmile is a 10 km race held in Nowy Sącz. Participants can prepare for the race with training plans tailored to different ability levels, featuring detailed instructions and expert support. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a paved course and join a running community. The organizers encourage professional management of race information and marketing collaboration, demonstrating their commitment to the event’s quality and growth.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on a paved course
Training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to VDOT level
Expert support during preparation
additional: Training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, with instructions and expert support, are available. Organizers can manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. The website provides no information about the start time, prices, or registration.

name: Wadowicka Dycha
description: Wadowicka Dycha is a 10 km road race in Wadowice. Start and finish are on Jana Pawła II Square, and the asphalt course runs through Wadowice, Zawadka and Chocznia. The time limit is 1 hour 20 minutes. Children's runs over 200 m and 400 m take place before the main race. In 2026 the race started on 30 May at 15:30.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Jana Pawła II Square in Wadowice
Asphalt course through Wadowice, Zawadka and Chocznia
Refreshment point in Zawadka at about 5 km
additional: In 2026 the entry fee was 89 to 150 zł depending on the registration date, and the main race was capped at 500 runners. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: XI Bieg Memoriałowy
description: The 11th Adam Lewandowski Memorial Run in Orchowo is an annual running event organized by the Orchowo Municipality. The run commemorates Adam Lewandowski and attracts runners of various age groups and skill levels. The races take place on routes around Orchowo, giving participants the opportunity to compete and connect in a sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide professional support and attractive race conditions.

name: XI Bieg Pamięci Grupy Kampinos Żołnierzy...
location: Zespół Sportowo-Rekreacyjny, Leszno, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Kampinos Group Home Army Soldiers Memorial Run is a race commemorating the soldiers of the Kampinos Group of the Home Army. The event takes place in Leszno, and the start and finish of the main race and the Children’s Races are on the track at the Sports and Recreation Complex. The main race is 11 km long and is held in a spirit of historical remembrance.

name: XV Kwidzyński Bieg Papiernika
description: The Kwidzyn Paper Run is an annual running event that began in 2010, born from a passion for running and promoting physical activity for health and fun. The 10 km race runs through the center of Kwidzyn, bringing together the local community and runners from across Poland. The event accompanies Paperworker’s Day, a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees, and participants can enjoy a range of free activities. It is organized by MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. and the MM Kwidzyn Care Foundation. Join the running community and celebrate sport and a healthy lifestyle together.
course_highlights: The course is 10,000 meters long and runs through the center of Kwidzyn
There are two checkpoints and two water stations along the course
The course provides participants with comfort and safety
additional: The event accompanies Paperworker’s Day—a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees—with many free activities throughout the day. The schedule includes the opening of the race office, a group warm-up, yoga and mobility, a meeting with champion Robert Korzeniowski, the awards ceremony, and a children’s race. Photos and video footage are taken during the race for promotional purposes.

name: XV Żmigrodzki Bieg Smoka
description: The 15th Żmigród Dragon Run is an annual running event held on the streets of Żmigród. Participants run a 10-kilometre course that combines sporting competition with the unique atmosphere of a local event. The race attracts both experienced runners and people looking to spend time actively and promote a healthy lifestyle. The fifteenth edition highlights the event’s tradition and its place in the region’s sporting calendar. The organisers warmly invite everyone who enjoys exercise and a challenge to take part in this sporting celebration.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometre route through the streets of Żmigród
An event with a unique atmosphere and local character
A race combining sporting competition with the promotion of a healthy lifestyle
additional: The race is part of local sporting events and promotes a healthy lifestyle. It brings together experienced runners and amateurs alike. Registration is online. The start and finish are in the centre of Żmigród.

name: 12 Leżajski Bieg Zośki Turosz
organizer: Burmistrz Leżajska; Miejskie Centrum Kultury w Leżajsku; Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Leżajsku; Uczniowski Klub Sportowy przy SP1 w Leżajsku
description: The 12th Leżajski Bieg Zośki Turosz is an annual street race held in Leżajsk that brings generations together and promotes physical activity. The event features races at various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including a 15 km main race and additional races of 8 km, 3 km and 0.5 km. The event combines sport and community, commemorating Zośka Turosz. The organizers provide professional event services and support from the relevant services, and participants can look forward to an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: 15 km main race through the streets of Leżajsk
Additional 8 km, 3 km and 0.5 km races for children and teenagers
Street course with support from event organizers and the relevant services
