additional: The event also includes 3 km races for adults and teenagers and a 0.5 km race for children. Consent forms for underage participants must be submitted to the Race Office on race day. The organizers include the Mayor of Leżajsk, the Municipal Cultural Centre, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Leżajsk.

name: Ostrowski Bieg Biznesu
organizer: Zespół Szkół Ekonomicznych im. Józefa Gniazdowskiego w Ostrowie Wielkopolskim
description: Ostrowski Bieg Biznesu is a run organised by the Józef Gniazdowski School of Economics in Ostrów Wielkopolski. It takes place at the Piaski-Szczygliczka recreation area, on two loops around a large reservoir of about 5.8 km in total. Local company teams and individual runners take part. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Ostrów county head, and the largest team receives the county head's cup. In 2026 the race took place on 30 May.
course_highlights: Two loops around the Piaski-Szczygliczka reservoir
Company teams and individual runners
County head's cup for the largest team
additional: The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: RUNGDN Hevelianum
description: #RUNGDN Hevelianum is a run on Gradowa Hill in Gdańsk, around the Hevelianum Centre, organised by Gdańsk Sports Centre (GOS). It is the final event of the spring #RUNGDN series, where the best three of four results count. Besides the main run there is a nordic walking race and children's runs. The best athletes of the whole series are honoured at the end. In 2026 the start was on 30 May at 11:00.
course_highlights: Hilly course on Gradowa Hill around the Hevelianum Centre
Sections over stones and cobbles
Finale of the #RUNGDN series with overall standings
additional: The race office opens one hour before the start. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: 1. Zielony Półmaraton
location: Konstancin-Jeziorna (Park Zdrojowy im. hrabiego Witolda Skórzewskiego)
description: The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all ability levels. The start and finish are at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, offering easy access and convenient viewing for spectators. The event combines sporting competition with community spirit and support for the local community, and all funds raised will be donated to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere filled with sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with wooded sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding even more excitement to the running festival.

name: 45. Bieg Krotosa
description: Bieg Krotosa is an annual race in Krotoszyn, held for the 45th time in 2026 with a record field of more than 1,150 runners. The main race is 10 km, with an accompanying 5 km run. The day before, children's and youth runs from 100 m to 1,200 m take place during the family sports festival on the Błonie in Krotoszyn. In 2026 the 10 km started on 31 May at 10:00 and the 5 km at 10:10.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race and a 5 km run
Children's and youth runs from 100 m to 1,200 m the day before
Family sports weekend on the Błonie in Krotoszyn
additional: Race packs can be collected on the Friday and Saturday before the race and on race morning. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: 2. Uliczna Mila / 3. Parkowa Piątka
description: Uliczna Mila (1609 m) and Parkowa Piątka (5 km) are road races held entirely on the paths of TAURON Park Śląski in Chorzów. The courses are certified by PZLA and World Athletics, ensuring high quality and the opportunity to achieve official results. Uliczna Mila will also host the Polish Masters Championships in 2027. The races are designed to help competitors achieve their best results on flat, fast courses.
course_highlights: Courses run entirely along the paths of TAURON Park Śląski
Certified by PZLA and World Athletics
Flat, fast courses conducive to good results
additional: Registration for the 2027 edition opens on 30 November 2026. Uliczna Mila is a 1609 m race, while Parkowa Piątka is 5 km.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz is a 21.097 km half marathon in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops around Lake Swarzędz. The race is part of the Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival, which also includes a 10 km race and a family run. The event combines sport with educational and charity activities. The 5th edition took place on 31 May 2026.
course_highlights: Two loops around Lake Swarzędz
Part of the Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival
Pacemakers, massage and a recovery meal after the race
additional: The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Bieg z okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej 2026
description: The Run on the Occasion of the Ropczyce Land Days is a 10 km race taking place in Ropczyce. This running event is organized to mark a local celebration and attracts runners looking to spend time actively on a moderately long course. The route runs through the scenic surroundings of Ropczyce, and participants can expect typical May weather, with temperatures around 20 degrees Celsius. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part in the event.

name: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN Kupienino 31.05.2026
description: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN in Kupienin is a new running event taking place for the first time. The race offers a dynamic 5-kilometre course, ideal for fans of fast-paced running and sporting competition. The organisers invite all runners to take part in this event, which is intended to become a regular fixture on the region’s running calendar.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Fast, flat course profile
Picturesque surroundings of Kupienin

name: 16 Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 20 zł za udział w biegach młodzieżowych (zapisy do 20.05.2027)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bieg symboliczny ok. 200 m, bez zapisów internetowych

description: The 16th Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach is a road race over 5 km and 10 km, taking place on June 6, 2027. Runners compete on a 5 km loop, with the 10 km distance consisting of two loops. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and the recreational attractions of the Siechnice municipality. The Polish Engineers’ Championships over 10 km will also be held for the third time. Organizers offer attractive prizes, commemorative medals, and participant T-shirts.
course_highlights: Road course through Siechnice with a 5 km loop
Start and finish on Kościelna Street, by the intersection with Jana Pawła II Street
The 10 km distance consists of two 5 km loops
additional: Race packs for the 5 km and 10 km distances include a race number, T-shirt, Primator drink, and Eatyx product. Youth races include a race number and medal. The race office is open on the days before the race and on race day from 7:00 to 8:30. The participant limit is 900. Free parking is available by the LA/Błękitna Laguna stadium; parking by the railway station and Toro Park shopping center is recommended. Race numbers are issued upon presentation of a QR code sent to a phone or email.

name: 3 Zduńskowolski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Zduńska Wola Running Festival is a jubilee running event held to mark the 200th anniversary of Zduńska Wola being granted town rights. The races take place on the town’s streets and in nearby municipalities, starting and finishing at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street. Participants can compete in the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and family run. The event attracts many runners, offering attractive routes and a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the streets of Zduńska Wola
Half-marathon turnaround in the village of Brzeski in Sędziejowice Municipality
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street
additional: The event is organized by the Zduńska Wola City Office. Previous editions have seen several hundred participants, including 151 in the 5 km, 111 in the 10 km, and 151 in the half marathon. The half-marathon route passes through Zapolice Municipality to the village of Brzeski.

name: 4 Bieg Zawierciański
description: The 4th Zawiercie Run is a running event organized by the “Warto Biegać” Sports Club and the Sports and Recreation Center in Zawiercie. The event aims to promote running among all age groups and bring runners from across Poland together. The main race is 10 km, with a companion 5 km race; both routes run along the streets of Zawiercie. The start and finish are at the OSIR Stadium in Zawiercie, and the course is properly secured and marked. Runners compete in age categories and for the title of largest team in the business/club category.
course_highlights: Race route through the streets of Zawiercie
Each kilometer of the route is marked
Course closed to traffic and secured, but not certified by the PZLA
additional: The limit is 500 participants with paid entries. The race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30 on race day. Race packs can also be collected on Saturday from 16:00 to 19:00. The time limit is 1:30 for 10 km and 1:00 for 5 km. Electronic timing uses a returnable chip attached to the shoe. Participants with strollers start from the last wave after receiving the organizer’s approval.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
description: The Crown of Princess Dąbrówka Run is an annual running event held on the last Sunday of May in Dąbrówka. The main 10 km race follows forest trails surrounded by greenery. There is also a 7.5 km Nordic walking event and shorter races for children. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting physical activity among local residents and running enthusiasts. The organizers foster a welcoming atmosphere and offer a range of classifications, including team categories and categories for people with disabilities.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race along forest trails surrounded by greenery
7.5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s races over distances from 200 to 1,000 metres
additional: The start and finish for the run and Nordic walking event are at the edge of the Palędzie-Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. Race packets can be collected in the days before the event at the GOSiR Dopiewo sports hall and on race day at the race office. There are numerous classifications, including a team category for mixed teams of five, age categories, categories for people with disabilities, and awards for residents of Dopiewo Municipality and LINEA Developer housing estates. The children’s races take place from 9:00 to 12:00, over distances suited to participants’ ages. The event is a jubilee celebration and a festival of running for the local community.

name: Bieg Rodzinny Radia Wrocław
description: The Radio Wrocław Family Run is an annual running event held in East Park in Wrocław, aimed at families and children. Participants run in pairs—a child with an adult guardian—on a recreational 2.8 km route. The focus is on having fun together, building family bonds, and promoting physical activity among children. The event takes place in a friendly, sporty atmosphere, with commemorative medals and gifts for participants.
course_highlights: A 2.8 km route in East Park in Wrocław
Start and finish by the Radio Wrocław running path on Krakowska Street
A family run—children run in pairs with adult guardians
additional: All participants receive commemorative medals, and children receive gifts. Refreshments are available after the run. The event’s partner is Wrocław—The Meeting Place, and the Municipal Greenery Board supports its organization.

name: Bukowica Run
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury w Babicach, KS Zagórzanka Zagórze
description: Bukowica Run, the Spring Run, is a race in Zagórze in Babice municipality. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The start is at the sports ground on ul. Wieczysta in Zagórze. It is organised by the Babice Municipal Culture Centre with the sports club Zagórzanka Zagórze. The 10th anniversary edition took place on 31 May 2026 at 11:00.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Start at the sports ground on ul. Wieczysta in Zagórze
Scenic course for beginners and experienced runners
additional: The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Krakowski Bieg Swoszowicki
location: Park Zdrojowy w Swoszowicach, Kraków, Poland
description: The Kraków Swoszowice Run is a special sporting event held in the southern part of Kraków, in the Swoszowice district. The event brings generations together, offering 10 km and 5 km races, a family mile, and races for children aged 1 to 11. The main race route follows the streets of Swoszowice and the surrounding area, giving participants a chance to discover beautiful parts of the city. In addition to the sporting competition, the event takes the form of a family picnic, making it an ideal way to spend time with loved ones.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race route follows the streets of district X, Swoszowice, and the surrounding area
Intergenerational competition in the family mile
Races for children aged 1 to 11
additional: The race pack includes sponsor merchandise, a race bib, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place on the weekend before Children's Day and is held as a family picnic in the Spa Park in Swoszowice. The organizers provide numerous attractions for the whole family, as well as prizes for the fastest three-person family teams in the mile race.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: LoveLas Trail is a unique sports and recreation event held in the heart of the Masovian forests in the village of Przystań, Olszewo-Borki Municipality. This forest race brings together a passion for physical activity, a love of nature, and social connection. Courses of varying difficulty are available to runners of different skill levels, as well as families and Nordic Walking enthusiasts. The event has an atmosphere full of positive energy and respect for nature, making LoveLas Trail a special celebration of sport and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes along forest trails of varying difficulty
The Król Lasu distance of approximately 20 km for determined runners
The 2 km family race Zielona Przygoda, open to everyone, including the youngest participants
additional: Race office open from 7:30 to 9:30. Start times: 09:00 - Król Lasu (approx. 20 km), 10:00 - Bieg Wiatrów (5 km) and Trasa Wilka (10 km), 10:05 - Spacer Szakala (Nordic Walking 5 km), 10:15 - Zielona Przygoda (2 km family run/walk). The entry fee includes a race bib, returnable timing chip, commemorative gift, medal, recovery meal, and sweet treat. Open classifications for women and men are held for the 5, 10, and 20 km distances and Nordic Walking, with trophies for the top finishers.

name: Mazowiecka Piętnastka
description: Mazowiecka Piętnastka is a celebratory road race organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Mińsk Mazowiecki. Held annually, the event attracts runners from across Poland and offers an appealing 15-kilometre course. It is a great opportunity to celebrate through sport and connect in the picturesque city of Mińsk Mazowiecki. In 2026, the race takes place on May 31, and MOSiR celebrates 50 years of operation.
course_highlights: A 15 km course along the streets of Mińsk Mazowiecki
Picturesque views and a clearly marked course
A celebratory edition organized by MOSiR, which has 50 years of experience
additional: The organizer is the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Mińsk Mazowiecki, open from 8:00 to 16:00 Monday through Friday. The course is statically marked on a map available on the organizer's website.

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The Mokotów SGH Run is Poland’s largest student-organized charity run, combining sport with support for people in need. The event’s 13th edition is an opportunity to cover the streets of Mokotów together, in an atmosphere of sporting passion and community spirit. Participants can look forward to a gathering area, a group warm-up and a medal ceremony. The run supports the “Akogo?” Foundation, helping people in comas. It brings together sport, solidarity and the energy of student involvement.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through Mokotów
Finish line in the SGH Rector’s Gardens
A run for children and whole families
additional: A race village with partner activities, a group warm-up before the start, a medal ceremony after the run, the option for whole families to take part, a charity run supporting the “Akogo?” Foundation.

name: Stryszów w Biegu
description: Stryszów w Biegu is a running event organised by Stryszów municipality with three distances. The 6 km Rodzinna Szóstka is a recreational family run, Stryszowska Zadyszka covers 10 km, and the 21 km Stryszowski Półmaraton Górski is a demanding mountain race. The courses run through fields and forests with views of Lake Mucharskie and the surrounding hills. In 2026 the event took place on 31 May.
course_highlights: Three distances: 6 km, 10 km and 21 km
Views of Lake Mucharskie
Mountain half marathon for experienced runners
additional: The organiser provides course and parking maps and GPX files. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: UltraPark Weekend
description: UltraPark Weekend is an ultrarunning festival held in Pabianice, featuring three main events: UltraPark 48h, UltraPark 24h, and UltraPark 100 km. The competition also serves as the Polish Cup of the Polish Ultra Sports Association and the PZLA Polish Championships in ultrarunning. This unique event attracts long-distance runners, offering challenging courses and a top-level competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: UltraPark 48h and UltraPark 24h courses — timed races that test endurance
UltraPark 100 km — a classic ultra distance certified by PZLA
High-level organization with professional support and timing

name: V Półmaraton Po Kolei
location: Lemany, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 5th Po Kolei Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Lemany, near Szczytno. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.1 km long and follows scenic routes around the village. In addition to the half marathon, the event includes children’s races over various distances and a 5 km race, making it appealing to participants of different ages and ability levels. The event combines sport and recreation and is organized by the District Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Szczytno together with local partners. The main race is scheduled to start at 9:00. Participants can collect their race packets the day before or on race day.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course of approximately 21.1 km
Children’s races over distances from 100 m to 800 m
A 5 km race as an additional event
additional: On race day, registration is available only for race packets that have been released. The race office is open from 7:00. Participants must start with a chip and race bib, which must be returned after the race. Minors must have written consent from their legal guardians. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 12:30.

name: X Charytatywny Gminny Bieg Między Wiatra...
location: Łukaszów, Gmina Zagrodno, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between the Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sport, and a healthy lifestyle. The event is charitable, and all funds raised are donated to support those in need. The route follows a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children’s race and 5 km and 10 km runs. The organizers provide chip timing, as well as a hot meal and drinks for participants.
course_highlights: A loop around the windmills in Łukaszów
5 km and 10 km routes with a time limit of 1 hour 30 minutes
A children’s race of approximately 500 m on the recreation grounds
additional: The total participant limit is 200 across all distances. Timing is provided by Sports Timing Poland using reusable electronic chips worn on the leg. Chips must be returned after the race; a fee of 50 zł applies for a lost chip. Participants must check in at the race office, which is open on race day from 8:30 to 10:35. The organizers provide a hot meal, cakes, water, coffee, and tea.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
location: Park Miejski im. Adama Mickiewicza, Sieradz, Poland
description: The 11th Sieradz Friendly Cross is organized by the Sieradz Biega Sports Club. It promotes running as a simple form of physical activity and brings together the running community of Sieradz. The event takes place in A. Mickiewicz Municipal Park, where participants compete on a 2-kilometer gravel loop. The race lasts 6 hours, and the winner is the runner who completes the most laps in that time. Runners receive bibs with chips for electronic lap and time tracking.
course_highlights: 2 km loop in Sieradz Municipal Park
100% gravel surface
Lap markers every 500 m
additional: The race runs from 11:00 to 17:00. Participants may stop and resume running at any time, but during breaks they must remain in the designated transition area. The participant limit is 250. Participants receive a returnable race bib with a chip to track laps and time. Minors may take part with parental consent and may run a maximum of 10 km (5 laps).

name: XII Biegnij Dla Aniołów
description: TAURON Run for the Angels is a charity race held in Katowice to support the children cared for by the Angels’ Guard House. The event takes place in Kościuszko Park and combines sporting competition with a family picnic full of attractions. Participants can choose the main 5 km race, children’s races in various age categories, or a virtual race. All entry fees go toward helping children from disadvantaged backgrounds by providing them with educational, therapeutic, and academic support. The event is for people of all ages who want to combine physical activity with helping those in need.
course_highlights: Main 5 km race in Kościuszko Park in Katowice
Three races for children in various age categories
Option to take part in the virtual race from anywhere
additional: Children aged 0–6 may accompany a guardian on the main race route free of charge, provided they are registered in advance on the form. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and a small gift. Prizes and trophies are awarded to the top three finishers in the women’s and men’s categories and in the children’s races. The maximum number of participants in the main race is 550. The event runs from 09:00 to 14:00 and is combined with a Family Picnic.

name: XIV Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka
description: The 14th Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka in Kostrzyn is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Kostrzyn. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The race takes place on a course in Kostrzyn, engaging the local community and fostering integration. The organizers ensure participants’ comfort and safety by providing well-prepared sports facilities.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
description: The 39th Stolemów Run is an annual 10 km race held in Gniewino, attracting runners from different age categories. The event takes place at the Arena Mistrzów sports stadium and also includes children’s races, a Nordic Walking march, and a recreational run-walk. Participants are timed electronically, and medals and prizes for the top finishers await them at the finish. For those unable to attend in person, a virtual race option is also available during a designated period.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km main race
5 km Nordic Walking march
Children’s races over distances from 80 m to 800 m
additional: 11:00, official warm-up at 13:10.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is an annual road race held in Kielce that promotes physical activity and social integration. The 5-kilometer course runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the May Funds events in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, highlighting European values and the local community.
course_highlights: A 5 km road course
The race takes place in central Kielce
The event promotes physical activity and social integration

name: 11 Mazowiecka Piątka
location: MOSiR Aquapark Miejski, ul. Wyszyńskiego 56, Mińsk Mazowiecki
organizer: MOSiR w Mińsku Mazowieckim, Stowarzyszenie Klub Sportowy Barakuda
description: Mazowiecka Piątka is a 5 km road race in Mińsk Mazowiecki, held as part of the national street races together with Mazowiecka Piętnastka. Start, finish and race office are at the MOSiR Aquapark on ul. Wyszyńskiego 56. A 5 km nordic walking race starts just after the run. It is organised by MOSiR Mińsk Mazowiecki and the Barakuda sports club. The 11th edition started on 31 May 2026 at 11:00.
course_highlights: Course through the streets of Mińsk Mazowiecki
Start and finish at the MOSiR Aquapark
5 km nordic walking race right after the run start
additional: In 2026 the 5 km entry fee was 65 to 100 zł depending on the registration date and T-shirt option. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Bieg Papieski
description: Bieg Papieski is a 10 km race in Pelplin, held as part of the Pelplin Days. The base is the Municipal Stadium, where the start and finish are located. The main course is two 5 km loops through the streets of Pelplin on asphalt, field roads and paved sidewalks. Children and youth race over 100 m to 800 m. In 2026 the main race started on 31 May at 16:00.
course_highlights: Two 5 km loops through Pelplin
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium
Children's and youth runs from 100 m to 800 m
additional: In 2026 registration was open until 28 May or until the limit of 250 paid runners was reached. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Dycha nad Regą
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Świdwinie
description: Dycha nad Regą, the Wojtek Pismenko Memorial, is a 10 km road race in Świdwin, organized by MOSiR Świdwin in cooperation with the 21st Tactical Air Base. The race commemorates Wojtek Pismenko, a marathon runner from Świdwin and a soldier in the Polish Armed Forces. The 11th edition started at 10:00 on 1 Maja Street. At the finish, participants received a medal and military pea soup prepared by the 21st Tactical Air Base. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.
course_highlights: A 10 km road race in Świdwin
Cash prizes of 1000, 500 and 300 zł for the top three women and men
A medal and pea soup prepared by the 21st Tactical Air Base
additional: In 2026, the race package included a technical T-shirt, promotional materials and a one-hour swimming pool pass for race day. Registration was available on biegnijmy.pl.

name: III Bieg Izabeli Czartoryskiej
description: The Izabela Czartoryska Run is a 5 km and 10 km race in Gołuchów. The start and finish are at the Forest Culture Centre, and the course follows the streets of Gołuchów and roads towards Jedlec and Macew. The third edition has taken place. The children’s races started at 10:00, and the main races at 12:00. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Start and finish at the Forest Culture Centre in Gołuchów
Course through the streets of Gołuchów towards Jedlec and Macew
additional: In 2026, families with children could enjoy bouncy castles, activities, mascots, cotton candy and popcorn.

name: IV Marszobieg Politechniki Częstochowskiej
organizer: Studium Wychowania Fizycznego i Sportu Politechniki Częstochowskiej, Miasto i Gmina Olsztyn
description: The Prof. Maciej Mrowiec Częstochowa University of Technology Run-Walk is a running and Nordic walking event in Olsztyn near Częstochowa, in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. It is organized by the Physical Education and Sports Centre of Częstochowa University of Technology and the Town and Municipality of Olsztyn. The event base is at GOSiR, 66 Zielona Street. Participants can choose a 5 or 10 km run or a 5 km Nordic walk, while children compete in 100 m and 400 m races. The fourth edition’s run-walk started at 11:20.
course_highlights: 5 or 10 km run and 5 km Nordic walk
Route through the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Children’s races: 100 m (ages 5–8) and 400 m (ages 9–12)
additional: In 2026, race packets were distributed from 9:00 to 11:00, and registration was available on dostartu.pl. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: Wydminy Night Run 5K
description: Wydminy Night Run is an annual 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Wydminy. The event is organized by HERON ULTRA TRAIL and local partners, attracting runners who enjoy the atmosphere of a night race surrounded by the Masurian countryside. The course passes through forested areas and along lakes, offering participants exceptional views and challenges. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and connect with others in the spirit of sport.
course_highlights: The route runs through forests and the Masurian countryside
The race takes place at night, adding a unique atmosphere
Views of lakes and hilly terrain
additional: The organizer is HERON ULTRA TRAIL. The event is a night race covering 5 km. No information is available about entry fees or the start time. The event is promoted on Facebook, where you can find updates and contact the organizers.

name: III Ryszewkowy Bieg o Puchar Strażaka
Otwarte Mistrzostwa biegusiem.pl w Biega...
description: The biegusiem.pl Open Cross-Country Championships is a race of about 8.6 km in Ryki, organised by the biegusiem.pl running club. It is also the Kornelia Wąsik Memorial, in honour of a club friend who died too early. The course is cross-country, with only about 300 m on asphalt. The 2026 edition took place on 4 June at 16:00 at Ranczo Kozia Górka. The race is part of the biegusiem.pl Grand Prix series.
course_highlights: Cross-country course of about 8.6 km
Start at Ranczo Kozia Górka in Ryki
Kornelia Wąsik Memorial
additional: The organiser posts current race information in a Facebook event. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: II Biegniem bez las
organizer: LUKS Huragan Lipniki oraz grupa „Razem możemy więcej”
description: “Biegniem bez las” is a running event held in Lipniki, in the Łyse municipality. Participants can choose a 5 km or 10 km race, or a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The routes follow forest roads in the Kurpie region, and the event combines sporting activity with a gathering of the local community.
course_highlights: 5 km race
10 km race
5 km Nordic Walking event
additional: The event takes place in Lipniki, in the Łyse municipality.

name: Ultramaraton Babia Góra
description: The Babia Góra Ultramarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in Lipnica Wielka. The event features various distances, including ultramarathons covering multiple loops of Babia Góra, as well as shorter races such as SkyRace®. The course runs through the picturesque areas of Babia Góra National Park, offering challenging climbs and spectacular views. The event promotes an active lifestyle and supports the charitable work of the Rak’n’Roll Foundation. The organizer provides aid stations, medical support, and the option to have drop bags delivered to the course for the longest distances.

name: 12. Tarczyński Nocny Wrocław Półmaraton
description: The 12th Tarczyński Night Wrocław Half Marathon is one of Wrocław’s most important sporting events and will take place on 5 June 2027. Runners will follow a new, wide and safe course, starting and finishing at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The half marathon has symbolic significance for the city as an event promoting physical activity and the health of residents, attracting thousands of runners from Poland and abroad every year. The organizers have set themselves the ambitious goal of joining the ranks of Europe’s largest half marathons, offering a record number of race packages. It is a special sporting celebration with strong support from the local community and spectators.
course_highlights: A new, wide and safe half-marathon course
Start and finish at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław
A 21.0975 km course whose distance is reflected in the number of race packages
additional: The record number of 21,975 race packages reflects the half-marathon distance. The start is scheduled at Gate A of Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. In previous years, the first allocation of race packages sold out in just 30 hours. The event aims to exceed 20,000 participants and enter the top ten largest half marathons in Europe.

name: II Półmaraton Miasteczkowskich Lasów
description: The 2nd Miasteczko Forests Half Marathon is an annual running event organized by the Góra Jerzego Association in Miasteczko Śląskie, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The half-marathon route passes through picturesque woodland around the town, offering participants a unique running experience surrounded by nature. The event attracts both runners from the region and visitors, creating an atmosphere of sporting competition and family fun. The organizers prioritize participants’ safety and comfort, providing facilities such as parking, a race office, and attractive prizes.
course_highlights: The route passes through picturesque forests around Miasteczko Śląskie
The race brings the local community together and promotes a healthy lifestyle
The organizers provide safe conditions and amenities for runners
additional: The race office is open from 8:30 to 10:30 at the CSIR sports field. On race day, temporary traffic disruptions are planned from 11:00 due to the closure of several intersections. Two public parking areas are available near the race office. Prizes for participants include two Garmin Forerunner 55 watches donated by the Municipality of Miasteczko Śląskie. Residents of Miasteczko Śląskie can receive a 50% discount on the entry fee.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
location: Fort Poznań Event Place, Poznań, Poland
description: Poznań Beer Mile is a series of mile races combining athletic competition with a passion for running and promoting an active lifestyle. The event takes place at Fort Poznań Event Place in Poznań and attracts runners who want to test themselves over a short, dynamic distance. The atmosphere encourages both sporting competition and socializing among participants.
course_highlights: A one-mile race
Held at Fort Poznań Event Place
A series of races combining sport and a passion for running

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk is a race along the route of the SGO "Narew" combat bunkers, held in Nowogród. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.1 km long and runs mainly along field, forest and unpaved roads, with short paved sections. There are three aid stations on the course offering water, cola, isotonic drinks, homemade cakes, fruit and snacks. Participants receive a commemorative medal after completing the race within the 3-hour-and-30-minute time limit. The event also includes a 7 km race with no time limit. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a campfire gathering.
course_highlights: The approximately 21.1 km half-marathon course runs along field, forest and unpaved roads
Three well-stocked aid stations on the half-marathon course
The course includes short paved sections, including residential streets in Nowogród
additional: The race office and start/finish are by the stage near the open-air museum in Nowogród. The half-marathon time limit is 3 hours and 30 minutes; there is no time limit for the 7 km race. Medical support is provided along the course. After the race, there is an awards ceremony for the winners, a prize competition and a campfire gathering. Also on the event day, visitors can tour the open-air museum with a guide and watch a reenactment of the 1939 battles for Nowogród. In previous editions, the accompanying programme included a 5 km or 7 km race, Nordic walking and children’s races.

name: Kwietny Bieg
description: Kwietny Bieg in Lisowice is a unique 24-hour running relay that commemorates the spirit of freedom awakened by the Holy Father John Paul II during his first pilgrimage to Poland. The race takes place on a certified 1,352-meter loop that is clearly marked and illuminated after dark. The event is open to everyone and has a recreational and sporting character, attracting both amateur and experienced runners. Participants who complete 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km) receive a certificate and commemorative medal. Kwietny Bieg is also an opportunity to celebrate together and set records on the course.
course_highlights: A 24-hour relay on a 1,352-meter loop certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
A course clearly marked and illuminated with torches and lamps
The race is held over the symbolic Flower Mile distance of 3,530 meters
additional: The race takes place on a 1,352 m loop certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The course is illuminated with torches and lamps after dark. A relay team of standard-bearers keeps the race going, running with a white-and-red sash. The event is open and free of charge, and previous editions have seen records set for the number of participants and laps completed.

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique street race held in the magical setting of Toruń, the city of Nicolaus Copernicus. Participants can choose between the 10 km and 5 km distances, and can also take part in Nordic Walking. The race starts in the evening, offering an unforgettable experience of the city’s nighttime atmosphere. The finish is at the Municipal Stadium, and the organizers provide a bag drop and support from volunteers.
course_highlights: The 10 km course starts at Galeria Copernicus, 15 Żółkiewskiego Street
The 5 km and Nordic Walking start at Józef Piłsudski Bridge, Camping Tramp, Dybowska Street
Finish at the Municipal Stadium, 23/29 Bema Street
additional: The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour 20 minutes. The time limit for the 5 km is 50 minutes, and for Nordic Walking it is 60 minutes. The race office is located at Galeria Copernicus next to the Decathlon store and is open on June 6 from 15:00 to 21:00. The organizer provides a bag drop at the start and transports belongings to the finish. Volunteers hand out bag-drop bags marked with the race number; participants must tie them themselves and hand them in before the race.

name: Sudecki Festiwal Biegów Gorskich
description: The Sudetes Mountain Running Festival is a continuation of the Riese Trail Runs in a new format, held in the picturesque town of Głuszyca. The festival offers a variety of mountain routes with different levels of difficulty, including an ultramarathon, a half marathon, and shorter races. Participants can access professionally prepared course profiles in GPX format. This event is for trail-running enthusiasts who want to take on the challenging mountain trails of the Sudetes.
course_highlights: WRC course – Waligóra Run Cross, Road of the Titans, 82 km
ULTRA WRC course – 53 km
HALF WRC course – 28 km
additional: Course profiles and links to GPX files are available for all distances. The event features several mountain races of varying lengths, including WRC – Waligóra Run Cross, Road of the Titans, 82 km; ULTRA WRC, 53 km; and HALF WRC, 28 km.

name: XII Festiwal Biegu Rzeźnika
description: The Rzeźnik Running Festival is a prestigious running event held in the scenic Bieszczady Mountains near Cisna. It offers a variety of distances, from short races for children to ultramarathons and hiking challenges, attracting both recreational and experienced runners. The routes follow mountain trails, offering exceptional views and technically demanding sections. It is not only a competition, but also a celebration of sport and outdoor activity, with a rich programme of accompanying events.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the Bieszczady with challenging climbs and descents
Scenic views of wild nature and Beskid landscapes
A variety of distances from 5 km to 175 km, as well as a multi-stage hiking challenge
additional: The Festival features numerous races over various distances, including races for children. Multi-stage hiking challenges and special events such as the Rzeźnicki Szlem are also available. The event takes place over several days, with a full schedule of races and accompanying events.

name: Backyard Ultra Piekiełki
description: Backyard Ultra Piekiełki is a backyard ultra in Starogard Gdański, in the Kociewie region in the Wierzyca river valley. Runners complete the same 6706 m loop every hour, and the race continues until only one runner is left. The 2027 edition takes place on Saturday 5 June, with the first yard at 8:00 and 60 places. The course record is 52 yards (217 miles), set by Grzegorz Sułek in 2026.
course_highlights: 6706 m loop run every hour
Course in the Wierzyca valley, Kociewie
Limited to 60 runners
additional: The race directors are Michał Sitarek and Joanna Kozłowska. In 2026, 65 runners were ranked in the results.

name: XVI Bieg Uliczny Jedlicka Siódemka
description: Jedlicka Siódemka is a 7 km road race in Jedlicze open to participants from across Poland. The 16th edition took place. The main race started at 17:00, followed five minutes later by the Nordic walking event and, for the first time, a Nordic walking event for seniors. Earlier, races were held for children and young people, from preschoolers to eighth-grade students. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.
course_highlights: 7 km road race
Nordic walking event, including a seniors’ category
Races for children and young people, with a medal for every finisher
additional: In 2026, nearly 300 people took part in the event, including 147 in the main race. Every child who finished a race received a commemorative medal and a sweet treat, while the top finishers received trophies.

name: Coconaut Pomerania Summer Trail
description: Pomerania Summer Trail is a summer trail running event in the Pomerania Trail series, held on hilly and technical trails in Kashubia. It has four distances from 55 km down to 10 km plus a Junior Trail for young runners. The race is part of the Pomerania Trail 2027 Ultra Kaszub series.
course_highlights: Four distances: 55, 42, 25 and 10 km
Hilly and technical Pomeranian trails
Junior Trail for young runners
additional: Rules in Polish and English, the courses and results are published on the race website.

name: Bieg po zdrowie
description: The Władysław Zamoyski Run for Health is held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. It combines competition with the promotion of health and preventive care, particularly among men. The course follows paths around the lake. Participants can choose between 10 km and 5 km, a 5 km Nordic walking event, and children’s races. The third edition took place.
course_highlights: Course on paths around Lake Rusałka
10 km and 5 km races, plus 5 km Nordic walking
Children’s races
additional: In 2026, the entry fee was 49 zł for registrations by 15 April and 69 zł from 16 April to 22 May; fees for children were 15 zł and 30 zł. Each participant received a race pack with a chip, a T-shirt, and a medal. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Aktywny Kazimierz Biskupi, Gmina Kazimierz Biskupi
description: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami is a run in Kazimierz Biskupi that returned to the calendar in 2025. The main race is 10 km, with a 5 km run and a 5 km Nordic walking event alongside it. Children and teenagers run the Biegi Szewczyków over 100 to 800 m. The 2026 edition took place on 7 June.
course_highlights: 10 km main race starting at 13:00
5 km run and 5 km Nordic walking at 13:10
Biegi Szewczyków kids' races from 100 to 800 m
additional: In 2026 bibs were handed out the day before from 17:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 8:30 to 12:15. The time limit ended at 14:40. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: Bieg Śladem Konia
description: The Bieg Śladem Konia is an annual race organized by WKB Piast Wrocław, held in the picturesque areas of Wrocław. The course runs along a variety of paths and through green spaces, offering participants a unique running experience. The event is amateur in nature and is part of the club race calendar, promoting physical activity and bringing runners together. The race is well known in the local community and has a long tradition.
course_highlights: The course passes through Wrocław’s green spaces
A variety of surfaces, including forest and urban paths
Picturesque views and natural surroundings
additional: The organizer is WKB Piast Wrocław. Results from previous years are available on the website. No detailed information about entry fees or the start time is available on the main website or in archived race regulations.

name: I Bieg po Jagodę Kamczacką
description: The Haskap Berry Run is held in Muniakowice, near Kraków, with the event base, start and finish at PLANTIN’s haskap berry plantation. The main race is 10 km, alongside a 10 km Nordic walking event and races for children. The first edition was held as the first race in the Berry Relay. The event was organized in cooperation with the Bieg Rolnika Foundation.
course_highlights: Start and finish at a haskap berry plantation
10 km run and 10 km Nordic walking event
Races for children
additional: The event was held under the honorary patronage of the Słomniki Municipality and the Miechów Municipality. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Warszawa
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw is a prestigious triathlon held in the heart of Poland’s capital, combining swimming, cycling, and running over the half-Ironman distance. The race starts at Zegrze Reservoir, and the cycling course passes through scenic municipalities and Warsaw streets, followed by a run in the Multimedia Fountain Park. This exceptional sporting event attracts athletes from around the world, offering not only a sporting challenge but also an opportunity to discover Warsaw’s cultural and historical riches.
course_highlights: A 1.9 km swim in Zegrze Lake, with a time limit of 1 hour 10 minutes
A 90 km cycling course through the municipalities of Nieporęt, Marki, and Radzymin, as well as the streets of Warsaw
A 21.1 km run over three laps through the streets of Warsaw’s historic center, finishing at the Multimedia Fountain Park
additional: The event offers services including bike rental, bike transfer, bike build & pack, medal engraving, finisher photos, and a camper park. The course is fully secured and closed off, with street closures and traffic control. A helpline for drivers is available during the event at 500 261 000. The start is at Zegrze Reservoir, and the finish is at the Multimedia Fountain Park. The time limit for completing the entire race is 8 hours 30 minutes.

name: Pogórzański Festiwal Biegowy - Lato
description: Pogórzański Running Festival – Summer is an annual sporting event held in Burzyn near Tuchów, promoting running and a healthy lifestyle among residents of Małopolska. The event includes races at various distances, including a 22 km mountain race with 800 m of elevation gain, a 10 km race, a 5.5 km race, and a 5.5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are at the LKS Burzyn stadium by the Primary School in Burzyn, and participants receive a race pack with a gift and snacks. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Tuchów Municipality and is organized by LKS Burzyn and Kępa Sport.
course_highlights: 22 km mountain race with 800 m of total elevation gain
4 aid stations along the 22 km race route
Start and finish at the LKS Burzyn stadium by the Primary School in Burzyn
additional: On race day, 30 additional race packs are available. The children’s races begin at 9:30 at the stadium, with a new race starting every 5 minutes. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:30–14:00. The race office, baggage storage, changing rooms, and showers are located in the hall of the Primary School in Burzyn, next to the stadium.

name: Test Coopera dla wszystkich
location: Stadion im. Opolskich Olimpijczyków, ul. Sosnkowskiego 12, Opole
description: Test Coopera dla Wszystkich is a free nationwide fitness test, held in Opole at the Stadion im. Opolskich Olimpijczyków. The aim is to cover as much distance as possible in 12 minutes, running or walking. Heats start about every 15 minutes in groups of around 25. The 2026 spring edition took place on 7 June from 10:00 to 15:00.
course_highlights: Timed run: 12 minutes on the track
Free entry, bib and certificate with your result
Heats about every 15 minutes in groups of 25
additional: Sign-up is at the stadium on the day, at the race office by the track. Minors need a guardian's consent. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: VI EKO Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie
description: The 6th Eko Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie is an annual running event held in Jerzmanowice-Przeginia that promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. The race takes place in a scenic area, and participants can compete on courses suited to different experience levels. The organizers provide safe, official registration and the option to purchase race packages from other participants. The event is eco-friendly and inclusive, encouraging regular training from registration through race day.
course_highlights: The course runs through the municipality of Jerzmanowice-Przeginia
Scenic landscapes and natural surroundings
Training counts from registration through race day
additional: Race packages can be bought or listed on the official package exchange safely. The race office is located at Chochołowy Dwór, ul. Jana III Sobieskiego 172, and is open from 8:00 to 9:15.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
location: Boisko przy ul. Leśnej, Wdzydze Kiszewskie, Poland
description: The Northern Poland Running and Physical Activity Festival in Wdzydze is the tenth anniversary edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia. The event takes place June 5–7 and features five main races in the Hard Runner series, with distances ranging from 1.6 km to a half marathon. Participants compete for an overall ranking based on the total points earned across all races. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland while also promoting local culture and nature.
course_highlights: Routes of 1.6 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and a half marathon (21 km)
Picturesque landscapes of Kashubia and the forests of the Kościerzyna Forest District
Routes available to view on the Traseo platform
additional: Race number with a timing chip (returnable). The race office is open during the festival. The overall ranking is based on the total points earned across five races. Recognition for the top competitors from the Municipality of Kościerzyna.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
location: Opalenie, Gmina Gniew, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XIII DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon in Memory of Barbara Karaczyńska is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie to coincide with the anniversary of the founding of the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon course is entirely paved, runs through the picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie, is certified by the Polish Athletics Association, and features numerous fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race is demanding due to the terrain and thermal conditions, but offers beautiful views and an unforgettable atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal, and everyone receives a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.
course_highlights: An entirely paved course through the fields and forests of Kociewie
646 m of total elevation gain with numerous steep climbs
The course is marked every 1 km, with refreshment stations every 5 km and mobile refreshment stations
additional: A recovery meal is served after the race. The 10 km “Olka” course is paved and partially follows the half-marathon course. The entry fee is donated in full to the DASZRADE Foundation, which supports people recovering from addiction.

name: XV Bieg Pszczyński
description: The 15th Carbo Asecura Pszczyna Run is an annual running event held in Pszczyna since 2012. The main race follows a well-known and popular 10 km course, and the event also includes races for children and young people. The main race course is not certified by the Polish Athletic Association (PZLA), but participants can expect a tried-and-tested and attractive route. The event attracts runners of various age groups, offering sporting competition and a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km main race course
Two water stations on the course (at approximately 4 km and 7.8 km)
Races for children and young people as part of the event
additional: The race office is located in the MORiS sports hall in Pszczyna, at 4 Basztowa Street. Race packs can be collected on Saturday and Sunday using a QR code. There are two water stations on the main race course, serving water in plastic cups. The main race starts from the Market Square at 09:30. Paid and free parking is available near the start. After the race, gross time is recorded using a chip in the race bib.

name: 10 Bieg po Gminie Świerczów
location: Dąbrowa, Świerczów Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: 47 Biegu V Stawów
description: The International Five Ponds Run is a trail race in Myszków, held at the Dotyk Jury complex in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The longest distance is the 21 km half marathon, alongside an 11 km quarter marathon and the 5 km Jurajska Piątka. There is also an 11 km Nordic walking event.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon with fast and technical sections
11 km quarter marathon around the ponds, also available for Nordic walking
5 km Jurajska Piątka for beginners and families
additional: The routes are marked by color: blue for 21 km, green for 11 km and Nordic walking, and orange for 5 km. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: III Bieg Charytatywny Dookoła Jeziora Cz...
IV Bieg Charytatywny Nagronik
organizer: OREW w Tarnawie Górnej (PSONI Koło w Zawoi), Urząd Gminy Stryszawa
description: The Charity Run and Nordic Walking March Na Gronik for the Mayor of Stryszawa Municipality Cup is a race in Stryszawa, based at Primary School No. 2 and Jałowiec Sports Club. The run and Nordic walking march are both 5 km long. The route starts at the sports field and heads uphill through the Gawrony housing estate. Proceeds support the Rehabilitation, Education and Care Centre in Tarnawa Górna. The fourth edition took place.
course_highlights: 5 km run starting at 9:30
5 km Nordic walking march at 9:45
Family run: one lap of the Jałowiec grounds
additional: In 2026, the entry fee was 80 zł, and the family run cost 50 zł per family. Every participant received a commemorative medal. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: Jędrzejowski Bieg Uliczny
organizer: UMKS NADIR Jędrzejów, Urząd Miejski w Jędrzejowie
description: Jędrzejowski Bieg Uliczny im. Kazimierza Mazurkiewicza is a 10 km road race held as part of the Bieg Lisów event in Jędrzejów. The course loops through the town streets, past the market square, and is not certified. Start and finish are on Świętej Barbary street by the Zalew reservoir, which is also the race centre. The 2026 edition took place on 7 June, starting at 11:00.
course_highlights: 10 km on the streets around Jędrzejów
Start and finish by the Zalew on Świętej Barbary street
Course through the market square
additional: In 2026 the race office was open from 8:00 to 10:30, with on-site entry possible. Runners aged 16 to 18 needed parental consent. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: V Bieg Szczuków
description: Bieg Szczuków is a run in Szczuczyn based at the Transgraniczne Centrum Dialogu Kultur on Sportowa street. Since the fifth edition the main race is a certified 10 km with electronic timing. The programme also has kids' runs and an integration run. The 2026 edition took place on 7 June.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Electronic timing with results by SMS
Kids' runs and an integration run
additional: Runners got a recovery meal and there was an activity zone for children. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: XXXVII Policka Piętnastka
description: Policka Piętnastka is a road race in Police, with a 15 km main race. It also features 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event, and all distances are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The start is at the intersection of Piaskowa and Zamenhofa streets, and the race office is at the athletics stadium. The 37th edition has taken place, and children and young people raced the day before.
course_highlights: The certified-by-PZLA main 15 km race, plus 10 km and 5 km races
Races start at 9:30; Nordic walking starts at 10:30
Children’s and youth races take place on Saturday before the main race
additional: In 2026, the race office operated at the athletics stadium at 97 Piaskowa Street. The children’s and youth races took place on June 6 in the clearing behind SP8. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: XXX Bieg Łagowskiego Lata
organizer: Wójt Gminy Łagów, Starostwo Powiatowe w Świebodzinie, Szkoła Podstawowa w Łagowie
description: The Bieg Łagowskiego Lata is a race of approximately 10 km in Łagów, starting and finishing at the amphitheatre. The course runs along the town’s streets, through a forest section and along the shore of Lake Łagowskie. The main race is part of the Świebodzin County Grand Prix, followed by races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km along the streets of Łagów and the shore of Lake Łagowskie
Start and finish at the amphitheatre
Races for children and young people from 100 to 1,000 m
additional: In 2026, the main race started at 9:30, the time limit was 90 minutes, and the participant limit was 230. The entry fee was 60 zł, and online registration was open until 22 May. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: 189 Pobino i 73 popekspres
location: Brynek, Tarnowskie Góry County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nocny Półmaraton Piotrkowski
location: Amfiteatr Miejski, ul. Gabriela Narutowicza, Piotrków Trybunalski, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piotrkowie Trybunalskim
description: The Piotrków Night Half Marathon is an annual running event held on the streets of Piotrków Trybunalski. The half marathon course is 21.0975 km long and runs through the city streets, offering participants a unique nighttime running experience. The event also includes a Quarter Half Marathon over a distance of 5.2 km. The race starts at 21:00, and the race office is located at the Municipal Amphitheatre on Gabriela Narutowicza Street. The event is organised by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Piotrków Trybunalski.
course_highlights: Half marathon course on the streets of Piotrków Trybunalski
Half marathon distance of 21.0975 km
Night race start at 21:00
additional: The race office is open on 12.06.2027 from 12:00 to 20:00 at the Municipal Amphitheatre. The event centre is located at the Municipal Amphitheatre on Gabriela Narutowicza Street.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual road race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event is taking place and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the registration form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile distance (1,609 meters) on scenic recreational grounds
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: Children’s races of approximately 200 meters are also held as part of the event. Participants can use the registration form available on the website to quickly contact the organizer and system administrator. Participants can use training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
description: The 4th Bilcza 10K is a road race held in Morawica, attracting running enthusiasts to its 10 km course. The event takes place in the recreational area of Bilcza Park and is part of the Bilcza Road Races, which also include races for children. A family festival accompanies the event, creating a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere for participants and their loved ones.
course_highlights: The course runs through the recreational area of Bilcza Park
A 10 km road race
An accompanying family festival
additional: A family festival is held on race day, adding to the event for participants and their families.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level and achieve officially recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing refreshments after the race and awards for the winners.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Night race starting at 21:55
Urban course through the streets of Szamotuły
additional: Temporary traffic changes apply on race day, with parking restrictions and designated detours. Race packet collection is available from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments for participants and awards for the winners are planned after the race. There are 26 free race packets available for people with disabilities in the family race, accompanied by a caregiver; apply by email.

name: 8 Bieg Chwalisza
description: The 8th edition of the Chwalisz Run is an annual charity race held in Ściernie, combining sport with support for children in need. The course is well marked and varied, making it ideal for both recreational and experienced runners. A family festival accompanies the event, creating a cheerful, welcoming atmosphere for the whole family. The organizers also invite participants to group training sessions every Thursday at 19:00. Every race participant supports a worthy cause, and the event’s atmosphere encourages the local community to come together.
course_highlights: A varied, well-marked cross-country course
Suitable for recreational and experienced runners
A family-friendly atmosphere with a festival alongside the race
additional: Group training sessions take place every Thursday at 19:00, starting outside the kindergarten in Ściernie, ul. Kamienna 17. The event is a charity race supporting children in need. A family festival accompanies the race, offering additional activities and bringing participants together.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Bieg Iskry is an evening race on the runway of Mielec airport, organized by Studio Wizualne with partners including the City of Mielec, Mielec Airport and MOSiR Mielec. In 2026 it was held on 13 June at 20:00. Runners cover 6.5 km with the runway lights on and the sun setting. Start, finish and the prize giving are at the hangars of the Biało-Czerwone Skrzydła foundation.
course_highlights: 6.5 km on the Mielec airport runway
Start and finish by hangars full of aircraft
Medal and shirt featuring the Iskra jet once built in Mielec
additional: The 2026 entry fee was 140 zł. There are age categories and an open category, with aircraft themed trophies. Water, supplements and a recovery meal wait at the finish, and a glider flight is drawn among runners present.

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
description: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie is a national running event in Arturówek, Łódź, at ul. Skrzydlata 75. The eighth edition was held on 13 June 2026. Runners choose between 5 km and 10 km, there is a 5 km Nordic walking event, and children and teenagers have their own races. The 10 km course is two 5 km loops.
course_highlights: Exact 5 km and 10 km courses, the 10 km is two 5 km loops
5 km Nordic walking
Children's and youth races from 12:00
additional: The 5 km run and Nordic walking start at 10:00 and the 10 km at 13:30. The race office opens at 8:00 on race day in the race village in Arturówek. A family picnic with blood pressure and blood sugar checks runs near the start and finish. There are separate registrations for adults, pharmacists and children.

name: II Leśny Bieg Gminy Brzeźnio - Tumidaj
Leśna ZaDyszka
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin Municipality, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in forest areas. The course is a 5 km loop through forest tracks and an asphalt section, showcasing the beauty of the Masovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (2 loops), and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Children can take part in a 1,500 m run with no rankings. The start and finish are in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop through forest tracks and asphalt (4 km through the forest, 1 km on asphalt)
Picturesque Masovian countryside
Start and finish in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road
additional: Times are recorded using chips attached to participants’ shoes. The race office opens at 9:00. All participants receive a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. Prizes are awarded for places in age-group and open categories. Participants can choose a standard T-shirt at no extra cost or a Premium LAS T-shirt for an additional 20 zł. Volunteers provide course support.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
description: The 13th Radomszczański Street Run, the Marian Szymański Memorial, is an annual running event held in Radomsko to honor Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, offering participants the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Radomsko, with timing provided by the professional company Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 17:30, and online registration closes a few days before the event.
course_highlights: A street race in central Radomsko
High-quality organization with professional timing
Evening start at 17:30

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka is a 10 km race in Kwidzyn, in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is scheduled for Saturday, 12 June 2027. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging paved course. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels to help participants prepare optimally for race day.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging paved course
10 km distance
Road race in scenic Kwidzyn
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to a runner’s VDOT level, with detailed instructions and expert support.

name: XII Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar ...
description: The 12th Voivodeship Cross-Country Run for the Badger Cup is a traditional cross-country race held in the picturesque village of Zagwiździe. The event attracts runners who enjoy natural forest trails and competition on challenging terrain. It is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness alongside fellow trail-running enthusiasts and spend time actively outdoors. The organizers ensure professional timekeeping and smooth event management.
course_highlights: A cross-country route through natural forest terrain
Challenging climbs and varied surfaces
Picturesque views and a close connection with nature

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: Bieg Marszałka is an annual running event in Sulejówek, inspired by the pre-war Sulejówek–Belweder marches over a distance of 26 km. The event includes a 10 km main race and accompanying races for children and young people. The course runs along the streets of Sulejówek, mainly on asphalt, with a short section on cobblestones. The start and finish are at 94 Paderewskiego Street, next to Willa Bzów. The race has historical and sporting significance, combining tradition with physical activity.
course_highlights: The 10 km main-race course runs along the streets of Sulejówek, mainly on asphalt
A short section of the course is on cobblestones
Start and finish at 94 Paderewskiego Street, next to Willa Bzów
additional: The Bieg Marszałka also includes accompanying races: the Halina Zielińska Memorial (approx. 3.6 km), the Little Ones’ Race (approx. 100 m) and the Older Kids’ Race (approx. 200 m). The Little Ones’ Race starts at 09:30 and the Older Kids’ Race at 09:40. Before the main race and the Memorial start at 09:50, a ceremony is held to lay flowers at the monument to Marshal Józef Piłsudski. 17:00–19:00 and on race day from 7:00 to 9:45. The organizer provides a recovery meal and water. Museum parking is available at the junction of Piłsudski Avenue and Matejki Street. The food area is in the Museum building and in the Museum courtyard.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
XV Siemiatycka Wieczorna Dycha
description: Siemiatycze Evening 10K is an evening road race in Siemiatycze organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre. The 15th edition took place. The start and finish are at the municipal amphitheater at 31 Grodzieńska Street. Participants can choose between 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a children’s race.
course_highlights: Evening start at 18:00
Start and finish at the municipal amphitheater
10 km and 5 km races, plus a children’s race
additional: The 10 km race is open to people aged 18 and over. The 5 km race is open to people aged 16 and over with a declaration or certificate. Children can be registered by a parent or guardian directly at the start.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
44 Półmaraton Gochów
description: The Gochów Half Marathon is a half marathon in Bytów organized by Klub Biegacza Goch 2 Bytów. The start and finish are by Bytów Castle. The 44th edition started at 10:00. The club also organizes other running events and Nordic Walking marches in Bytów.
course_highlights: Half marathon distance of 21.1 km
Start and finish by Bytów Castle
One of the oldest half marathons in the region; the 44th edition takes place in 2026
additional: Registration, the participant list and the race rules are available on the Klub Biegacza Goch 2 Bytów registration website. Timing is provided by Herkules.

name: Bieg galopem po rodzinę
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Jana Pawła II 14, Szubin
description: Galopem po rodzinę is a race at the Municipal Stadium in Szubin, ul. Jana Pawła II 14. In 2026 it was held on 13 June. The main race is 3 km and a Nordic walking event uses the same distance. Children's and youth races from 200 m to 1500 m are held first. Entry is free.
course_highlights: 3 km main race with start and finish at the stadium
3 km Nordic walking
Children's and youth races over 200, 400, 800 and 1500 m
additional: In 2026 the children's and youth races ran from 10:00 to 11:45, the 3 km started at 12:00 and the Nordic walking at 12:03. Online entries closed on 5 June. The 200 m is a joint race for children with their parents.

name: Bieg Nocny Marek
description: Bieg Nocny Marek is an evening race in Marki, based at the Marek Educational and Recreational Centre at ul. Wspólna 40/42. The 12th edition took place. The main race is a PZLA-certified 10 km, accompanied by a 5 km race, an approximately 5 km Nordic Walking event, and races for children and young people. The race is part of the Marek Running Triad.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 10 km course starting on the MCER running track
The main race starts at 21:00 at night
5 km race, Nordic Walking event, and races for children
additional: In 2026, the Nordic Walking event started at 16:00, the races for children and young people at 18:30, the 5 km race at 20:10, and the main 10 km race at 21:00. The race office, changing rooms, and baggage storage are located at Primary School No. 4 at MCER. The event is organised by the Marek Economic Association together with the City of Marki, Marki Runners Sports Club, and Marek Municipal Investments.

name: IX Memoriał im. Zofii Morawskiej
description: The Zofia Morawska Charity Memorial is a race in Laski organized by the Society for the Care of the Blind. The course is a loop of approximately 3.3 km through the so-called Lipówka area, along Partyzantów Street and forest trails in Kampinos Forest. Participants can complete one loop, several loops, or run for the entire duration of the event. The 9th edition took place, with each loop supporting a fundraiser for the Center.
course_highlights: An approximately 3.3 km loop through Lipówka and Kampinos Forest
Choose how many loops to complete
A ceramic medal for completing at least one loop
additional: The start and finish are near the Center’s main gate in Laski, while race registration and baggage storage are at the Friends of the Blind House. Participants in the main race receive a race number with a timing chip and a meal voucher. Parking is not allowed on the Center’s grounds on race day; parking is available on Brzozowa Street. In 2026, the fundraiser supported the renovation and adaptation of the Center’s bathrooms.

name: KrwioBieg Warszawa
organizer: Mazowiecki Oddział Okręgowy Polskiego Czerwonego Krzyża i Adliner
description: KrwioBieg Warszawa is an annual race promoting blood donation, organized by the Masovian branch of the Polish Red Cross and the agency Adliner. It takes place on the Vistula riverside next to the Polish Olympic Centre at Wybrzeże Gdyńskie 4. In 2026 the 9th edition ran over two days, 13 and 14 June. Distances are 5 km and 10 km, 5 km Nordic walking, 50 km and 100 km ultramarathons, a 50 km relay and children's races.
course_highlights: Riverside course by the Polish Olympic Centre
Distances from 5 km up to a 100 km ultra
Children's races from 100 m to 1000 m
additional: In 2026 the 100 km started on 13 June and the other races on 14 June, World Blood Donor Day. Field limits: 125 runners each for 5 km and 10 km, 80 for the 5 km walk, 50 each for 50 km and 100 km, and 20 relay teams. Funds raised went to educational support for children and young people in Masovia.

name: Niezależny Festiwal Biegowy
description: Niezależny Festiwal Biegowy is a friendly running event in Milanówek organized by Wsparcie Treningowe, a Warsaw coaching group. Distances are 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. Every runner has individual timing.
course_highlights: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon
Individual timing
Small, friendly event in Milanówek
additional: Partners include Społeczne Liceum Ogólnokształcące nr 5 in Milanówek and UKS MTE Milanówek.

name: VI Wieluńska Piona
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Wieluń Biega, Atelier Sportu, Gmina Wieluń
description: Wieluńska Piona is an evening 5 km road race in central Wieluń. The course is two laps through the old town streets and is PZLA certified. Start and finish are on Plac Legionów. Children's and youth races are held before the main race. The sixth edition in June 2026 drew around 460 participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course of two laps
Evening start on Plac Legionów
Children's races from 200 to 1000 m
additional: In 2026 the main race started at 20:30 with a 45 minute time limit. The main race is limited to 300 runners and entry cost 50 to 80 zł. The race office was at Królewska 1.

name: VII Bieg Kłodawskiego Święta Soli
description: The Kłodawa Salt Festival Run is a 10 km race held in Kłodawa during the annual Salt City Festival. The course goes through the stadium, Górnik Park, and the city streets. A 5 km Nordic Walking march is held alongside the race. The seventh edition took place.
course_highlights: 10 km race through the streets of Kłodawa
Course through Górnik Park and the stadium
5 km Nordic Walking march
additional: The race is part of the three-day Salt City Festival, which features a football tournament, a brass band review, and concerts.

name: XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
description: Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku is a series of four races by the Stargard athletics club, one in each season and each in a different place. The summer stage, Bieg na Przywitanie Wakacji, is held in Morzyczyn by Lake Miedwie. The main race is 5 km, with a 3.5 km Nordic walk and children's races alongside. The races are recreational but count towards the series classification.
course_highlights: 5 km race by Lake Miedwie
3.5 km Nordic walk
Children's races
additional: The final series ranking is based on the total time from the four races. Runners can enter single races or the whole series.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: 15 Piknik Biegowy Biała Biega
description: The 15th Biała Biega Running Picnic is a family-friendly running event held in Biała Podlaska, attracting runners of different ages and abilities. The event has a picnic atmosphere, combining sporting competition with fun and a chance for the local community to come together.
