More than 260 people are already on the participant list, reflecting the event’s strong appeal and friendly atmosphere.
additional: More than 260 people have already registered, indicating the event’s popularity. The event is a family running picnic, suggesting activities for different age groups and opportunities for participants to connect.

name: TATRA FEST 2026
description: Tatra Fest is a unique mountain festival held in Zakopane, offering a variety of running, climbing, and trekking activities. Its best-known event is the TATRA FEST BIEG 68 km, a demanding skyrunning race on Tatra trails, with a course that reaches above 2,000 m above sea level and includes significant elevation gain. The festival promotes a connection with nature, physical activity, and environmental responsibility, inviting people to celebrate life and the Tatras outdoors.
course_highlights: The TATRA FEST BIEG 68 km course follows Tatra trails above 2,000 m above sea level.
The longest ascent and descent each have approximately 1,100 m of elevation change.
Exposed mountain trails, with fixed ropes on some sections.
additional: The race office is located at Sokolnia, ul. Orkana 2. The 68 km race course has cutoff checkpoints at Kasprowy Wierch, Hala Ornak, Polana Chochołowska, and Zahradziska. The start and finish are at the Municipal Park in Zakopane. Mandatory gear is checked before the start. The festival also includes workshops, hikes, and other outdoor activities.

name: XVII Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka Mini Bieg Piekarczyka
description: The Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is one of the largest and best-known running events in Elbląg, held every year in June. The two-day event combines sporting competition with numerous side attractions, including races at various distances and activities for children. The route runs through the streets of the city centre and features a flat asphalt-and-cobblestone surface with one hill, making it suitable for fast times. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, as well as many spectators cheering participants along the route.
course_highlights: Flat route with one hill on Teatralna Street
Asphalt (80%) and cobblestones (20%)
Route certified by the Polish Athletics Association
additional: The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour and 30 minutes. The Mini Piekarczyk Run takes place on loops of Teatralna Street ranging from 50 to 600 metres, adjusted to the children's ages. Race packs are distributed at two locations: Ogrody Shopping Centre (13 June) and the “Helena” MOSiR ice rink (14 June). Participants over the age of 70 are exempt from the entry fee after registering.

name: XX Ogólnopolski Bieg Uliczny o Puchar Burmistrza Miasta Bukowno
description: The Nationwide Street Race for the Mayor of Bukowno’s Cup is held annually during Bukowno Days. The main race is 10 km and consists of two 5 km loops along asphalt streets. There is also a recreational race of approximately 5 km and a Nordic Walking march. The start and finish are at the MOSiR stadium. The twentieth anniversary edition took place.
course_highlights: 10 km main race on two asphalt loops
Recreational race and Nordic Walking over approximately 5 km
Start and finish at the MOSiR stadium in Bukowno
additional: In 2026, the races started at 17:15 and the Nordic Walking march at 17:20. The time limit for the main race is 90 minutes, and there are four water stations along the route. Participants in the 10 km race must be at least 16 years old.

name: Aktywna Gmina Sportowy Niechlów
description: Aktywna Gmina Sportowy Niechlów is a family running event in Niechlów. The program includes races for different age groups, from preschoolers to students in grades I–VIII, as well as a 5 km main race and a Nordic Walking march. All participants receive commemorative medals and race packs. The tenth, anniversary edition has taken place.
course_highlights: 5 km main race
Nordic Walking march
Children’s races for ages ranging from preschoolers to students in grade VIII
additional: At the end of the event, prizes are drawn among the participants.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
location: Park przy dworcu kolejowym, Oława, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie; Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The FOUR SEASONS Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking march on the same route. The event is charitable and is coordinated by a local association and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office operates on race day, and electronic timing ensures professional organization.
course_highlights: A run and walking route approximately 5 km long
Start and finish in the park by the railway station in Oława
Electronic timing provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl
additional: The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30 near the start. Categories: run of approximately 5 km and Nordic Walking march of approximately 5 km. The organizers provide the rules and consent forms for parents/guardians and participants. Race coordinators: Mariusz Jarławski and Mateusz Bularz. Information about the available distances and event location comes from the description of Stage IV of the series.

name: Bieg Uliczny Maksymila
description: Bieg Uliczny Maksymila is a road race of about 16 km in Teresin municipality, held in memory of St. Maximilian Kolbe. It starts on Kolbego street in Paprotnia near the Franciscan monastery in Niepokalanów and finishes at the GOSiR stadium in Teresin. The course runs mostly on asphalt roads through Szymanów and Elżbietów, with a short forest section by the Teresin palace. Children's and youth races are held on the stadium track at the same time.
course_highlights: About 16 km from Niepokalanów to Teresin
Short forest section by the Teresin palace
Finish on the GOSiR stadium track
additional: In 2026 the start was at about 14:15 and the children's races began at about 14:00. A mass for runners is held in the Niepokalanów basilica before the race. There is a water and food point in Szymanów, and timing is by chip.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń is a mountain ultra race held in the picturesque Pieniny region, starting and finishing at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. The approximately 54 km course crosses demanding natural terrain and has five aid stations, offering participants exceptional views and challenges. The race is part of Pieniny Ultra-Trail®, and participants receive commemorative medals, with prizes and trophies available for the top finishers. The organizers care for the environment by eliminating plastic cups at aid stations.
course_highlights: Approximately 54 km through the Pieniny Mountains, with five aid stations
Start and finish at Dietl Square in Szczawnica
Natural mountain terrain with a demanding elevation profile
additional: Mandatory equipment: race bib and shoe chip, a water container with a capacity of at least 0.5 litres, and a mobile phone with a charged battery. There are 5 aid stations on the course, including one serving water only. The organizer does not provide plastic cups at aid stations. Commemorative medals for all finishers and prizes for the top finishers. Prize details will be published by 31.03.2027.

name: Grodziski Półmaraton Słowaka
description: The Grodzisk Słowak Half Marathon is a half marathon in Grodzisk Wielkopolski, organized by the Mayor of Grodzisk Wielkopolski in cooperation with the Juliusz Słowacki Upper Secondary School. The race takes place in June over the classic distance of 21.0975 km. The 18th edition was held under the name Hunters Grodziski Półmaraton Słowaka.
course_highlights: Half marathon: 21.0975 km
Co-organized by the Juliusz Słowacki Upper Secondary School
Race entry resale available in the registration portal
additional: In 2026, the race office operated at 2A Żwirki i Wigury Street on Saturday from 12:00 to 20:00 and on Sunday from 6:00 to 8:00. Registration is handled by Datasport.

name: IV Charytatywny Bieg z Żonkilem
location: Klubokawiarnia Laba, Wyspa Bolko, Opole, Poland
description: The 4th Charity Daffodil Run is a sporting event held in Opole that combines a passion for running with charitable causes. The run is inclusive and promotes physical activity and support for those in need. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and a welcoming atmosphere. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Opole and welcomes runners of all experience levels.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki is a three-day city running festival organized by the Suwałki sports and recreation centre. The main race is the Suwalska Ćwiartka over 10.5 km on Saturday evening. The program also includes a 5 km race, children's and youth races and a recreational breakfast run to the island. The courses are flat and fast.
course_highlights: Suwalska Ćwiartka 10.5 km in the evening
5 km race on Friday evening
Breakfast run of about 3.5 km with breakfast at the finish
additional: In 2026 the 5 km started on Friday at 20:00, the children's races on Saturday from 18:00, the Suwalska Ćwiartka on Saturday at 21:00 and the breakfast run on Sunday at 9:00.

name: Suszecki dziki bieg

description: The Suszec Running Festival is an annual running event organized by the Suszec Municipal Sports Centre, promoting an active lifestyle among children, young people, and adults. The event takes place at the “Gwaruś” Recreation Centre and features a variety of cross-country obstacle races for the youngest participants, youth races over 800 and 1,600 metres, and adult distances, including the Wild Super Double over 10 and 21 km. The event has a family-friendly, community-building atmosphere, with numerous attractions for participants of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country obstacle races for children up to 9 years old
Youth races over 800 m and 1,600 m
Wild Super Double: 10 km and 21 km on cross-country courses
additional: Race office hours: Saturday 12:00–14:55, Sunday 8:00–10:00. Participants must register for each race no later than 30 minutes before the start. An obstacle course is available for children and young people. Award ceremonies take place after the children’s races and the half marathon. Cash payments are accepted at the sports hall cashier and at the race office.

name: VIII Rodzinny Festiwal Biegowy o Złotą K...
description: The Golden Little Goat Family Running Festival is a family running event held on the meadows in Dobczyce and organized by the Rozbiegane Dobczyce Association. After the children’s races, the main race and a 5 km Nordic Walking event take place on the streets of Dobczyce, including through the Market Square. Winners receive Golden Little Goat-shaped statuettes. The eighth edition attracted 389 participants in the main race.
course_highlights: 5 km main race and Nordic Walking event on the streets of Dobczyce
Children’s races from 60 to 400 m
Start and finish on the meadows by RCOS
additional: In 2026, the main race started at 16:00. Participants could enjoy inflatable slides, a photo booth, and advice from specialists at the race office. Gift vouchers and other vouchers were raffled among participants in the main race.

name: X Bieg o Złotą Monetę
description: The 9th Charity Run for the Golden Coin in Olsztyn is an annual running event organised by the Future for Children Foundation to support sick and disabled children from Warmia and Masuria. The 5 km main race takes place by Lake Ukiel and is open to runners of varying abilities, including beginners. The event also features a family picnic and numerous attractions, giving participants the chance to help through physical activity and fun. The run is the finale of the “GOOD GIVES BACK” campaign and supports rehabilitation and the purchase of medical equipment for children.
course_highlights: A scenic route by Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn
Welcoming and accessible to runners of all abilities, including walkers
5 km distance with a one-hour time limit
additional: The event also includes children’s fun runs over distances starting at 400 m, as well as junior and youth races over age-appropriate distances. The special guest is Krystyna Abramczyk Puzio, a multiple Polish and world champion in weightlifting. After the run, there is a family picnic with prizes and gifts for participants.

name: Maraton Smolecki
location: Smolec, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Mrowna Run Grodzisk łączy w biegu
2 Yellow Ribbon Run Polska
location: Park Leśnicki, Zamek w Leśnicy, Wrocław, Poland
description: Yellow Ribbon Run Polska is an international initiative promoting the idea of second chances and the social reintegration of people who have served prison sentences. The run takes place in Leśnicki Park, around Leśnica Castle in Wrocław, and aims to break stereotypes and support the social reintegration of former prisoners. The event is organised by the Ministry of Justice and is an important part of educational and promotional efforts to foster an inclusive society. Participants show solidarity with people striving for a fresh start in life.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic Leśnicki Park, around Leśnica Castle
The run is symbolic, promoting the idea of second chances and countering stigma
The event takes place on the grounds of the historic castle and its surrounding park
additional: The event is part of a two-day programme held at the castle and in Leśnicki Park. The project is partly funded by the Justice Fund. Deputy Minister of Justice Maria Ejchart takes part in the run, highlighting the importance of the initiative. The event brings together participants from different backgrounds, including people who have served prison sentences, Prison Service officers and local residents.

name: Challenge Gdańsk 2026
description: Challenge Gdańsk is a triathlon held in a beautiful location on the Baltic Sea, in the city of freedom and Solidarity. The event includes the T100 distance, consisting of a 2 km swim in the Gulf of Gdańsk, an 80 km fast bike course through the Vistula River delta, and an 18 km run along Gdańsk’s beach and Ronald Reagan Park. The finish line is at the Gdańsk pier in Brzeźno, making for a unique finish experience. The event is an official qualifying race and attracts athletes from various categories, including Challenge Women by Brooks.
course_highlights: 2 km swim in the Gulf of Gdańsk, starting and finishing on Gdańsk Brzeźno beach
80 km fast bike course through the Vistula River delta, passing through Kiezmark, Cedry Małe, and Koszwały
18 km run over 4 laps along Gdańsk’s beach and Ronald Reagan Park, with aid stations along the course
additional: The Sprint distance starts at 8:00 from Gdańsk Brzeźno beach. The race office is open from 10:00 to 20:00. The option to purchase a start fee refund is available if withdrawing by 31 May 2027. The bike course consists of two fast laps through the Vistula River delta. The run course consists of 4 laps of 4.5 km, with aid stations on each lap. The finish line is at the pier in Gdańsk Brzeźno. Athletes must collect their race packs and attend the race briefing. The organizer reserves the right to change the course and race format in the event of adverse weather conditions.

name: Nocny Bieg Firmowy Warszawa
description: The Night Corporate Run in Warsaw is a charity relay for teams of five, held at the Służewiec Racecourse. Each participant runs approximately 5 km after dark, and the team’s combined time determines the result. It’s a unique opportunity to spend an evening together in an engaging nighttime atmosphere while supporting children from the Everest Foundation. The event combines sport, fun, and social good, creating an unforgettable experience for participants.

name: 17 Legionowska Dycha
description: The 17th Legionowo Ten is an annual 10 km race held in Legionowo. The start and finish are located outside Arena Legionowo. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and is open to adults and people over 16 who meet the requirements set out in the regulations. The event also includes the accompanying “Uniformed Services Ten” race for uniformed services and enthusiasts. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping and a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes to complete the course.

name: Nocny Bieg Świętojański
description: The Świętojański Night Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Grand Prix of Gdynia. The main 10 km race takes place amid the city’s picturesque scenery, accompanied by races for children and youth. The event attracts runners of different age groups, offering sporting competition and a chance to connect in a nighttime atmosphere. The organizers provide professional event support as well as photo and video coverage.

name: Stacjonarne DaVita Run Kraków
description: The in-person DaVita Run Kraków 2026 is a charity run held in Kraków that promotes a healthy, active lifestyle and brings together nephrology professionals, patients, and running enthusiasts. Participants can choose between a distance of 2.5 km or 5 km, with 60 minutes to complete the run. The entry fee is donated in full to the Moje Nerki National Association, and every participant receives a T-shirt featuring the event’s original design. A virtual run option is also available for those unable to take part in person.

name: Zawojski Festiwal Biegowy
distance_verbose: 106 km, 63 km, 45.9 km, 33.5 km, Półmaraton, 10.1 km, 8.1 km
description: Zawojski Festiwal Biegowy is a mountain running festival in Zawoja at the foot of Babia Góra. The fifth edition takes place on 18-20 June 2027. The program has eight events, from the 106 km Diablak Pilsko Ultra Trail over Babia Góra and Pilsko to the Zawojska 10 and a Nordic walking race. New courses are the Małopolski Ultra Trail 45, Mała Babia Trail 33 and Mała Babia Vertical.
course_highlights: Diablak Pilsko Ultra Trail 100: 106 km with over 5500 m of climbing
Półmaraton Zawojski 21.1 km with over 800 m of climbing
Mała Babia Vertical: 8.1 km and over 900 m up
additional: Diablak Pilsko Ultra Trail 100 starts at 3:00 with a 22 hour limit, Diablak Ultra Trail 60 at 5:00 and the Półmaraton Zawojski at 10:00. Registration opens on 6 December.

name: 54 Memoriał Żylewicza - Bieg Amatorów
description: The 54th Józef Żylewicz Memorial is a prestigious athletics meet organized annually since 1973 by the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club. The event commemorates Józef Żylewicz, an outstanding coach and sports official, one of the founders of KS LECHIA Gdańsk and a contributor to the Polish national athletics team’s successes. The Memorial takes place at the Athletics and Rugby Stadium in Gdańsk and combines sporting professionalism with a welcoming atmosphere for the local community, attracting athletes from Poland and abroad. The event also includes the amateur 3,000 m race “Fast Arrow of the North,” open to all running enthusiasts, with no age limits or athletic requirements.

name: Drabina Wałbrzyska
description: The Wałbrzych Ladder is a physically demanding mountain route in the Sudetes, passing through the Wałbrzych and Kamienne Mountains. Over a distance of approximately 78 km, participants climb nearly 4,000 metres of elevation gain and summit more than 30 peaks. The route forms a loop, and the start and finish can be at any point along the course. It is an excellent choice for anyone wishing to discover the scenic and natural attractions of this part of the Sudetes, offering an ambitious challenge without having to travel to high mountains.

name: I Nocny Półmaraton Piaseczyńśki
description: The Piaseczno Night Half Marathon is a unique 21.0975 km road race held at night along the scenic, illuminated streets of Piaseczno and nearby towns. The course is certified by the PZLA, flat and fast, making it ideal for runners looking to improve their personal bests. Participants can expect professional organization, comprehensive medical coverage and well-stocked refreshment stations. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and a recovery area with drinks and a meal awaits at the finish. The event also offers an unforgettable atmosphere of running beneath the stars, with plenty of attractions and competitions for spectators.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course, 21.0975 km long
Flat, fast course with minimal elevation changes
The course passes through Piaseczno, Górki Szymona, Głosków and Jazgarzew
additional: Race packs can be collected from 15–19 June at Decathlon Piaseczno and on 20 June at the Race Office. The half marathon is limited to 2,000 participants. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours gun time, with a 1.5-hour limit at the halfway point. There are three refreshment stations along the course (at approximately 5, 10 and 15 km). After the race, a finish area will offer water, isotonic drinks, a recovery meal, music and an LED screen. A competition will be held for the best spectator area. Race-pack transfers are available until 31.05.2027 for a fee of 20 PLN. A commemorative T-shirt is available separately for 75 PLN (orders accepted until 29.05.2027).

name: XII BIEG WIERCHAMI

late_fee.price: wg stawki obowiązującej w dniu dokonania wpłaty
wg stawki obowiązującej w dniu dokonania wpłaty

description: Bieg Wierchami is a mountain challenge held in the Beskid Sądecki, offering a range of distances from 11 km to 100 km. The routes follow scenic trails with substantial elevation gain, giving runners a chance to connect with nature and tackle demanding climbs. The event is organized by the Visegrad Maraton Association in Rytro, which ensures professional organization and a generous race pack. Starts take place at the RyterSKI Resort, and participants can expect aid stations and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Corno Owca: 11 km with approximately +394 m/-393 m elevation change
Waligóra: 30 km with approximately +1124 m/-1124 m elevation change, including a climb up Wielki Rogacz and the route’s highest point, Radziejowa
The routes pass through the Beskid Sądecki, taking in landmarks such as a windmill and the Rytro bunker
additional: A race pack is provided to participants who register and pay before the deadline. The race office is located at the RyterSKI Resort. Aid stations are available on the routes, and the finish is by an asphalt road after passing landmarks such as the windmill and bunker.

name: 16. PKO Rybnicki Półmaraton Księżycowy
description: The Rybnik Moonlight Half Marathon is an annual running event organized by MOSiR Rybnik, attracting runners from various regions. The race takes place in the picturesque city of Rybnik, offering participants a unique atmosphere and sporting excitement. It is an event with a well-established tradition that promotes an active lifestyle and brings the local community together.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Biegach Przełajowych. Bieg 4: Kąty Wrocławskie
location: Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality Cross-Country Running Championships are a series of four races held on scenic routes in the Kąty Wrocławskie municipality. The routes impress with their varied terrain and the natural beauty of the Bystrzyca Valley Landscape Park. Participants can enter individual races or the entire series. Those who complete at least three races are included in the overall standings. After each race, participants receive a commemorative medal; once all four medals have been collected, they form a complete design featuring the outline of the municipality’s boundaries. The final race takes place in Kąty Wrocławskie on a 5 km course.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Bystrzyca Valley Landscape Park
Varied surfaces and terrain, including hills, vineyards and forests
The final 5 km route runs between Kąty Wrocławskie, Jurczyce and Sośnica
additional: Participants can enter individual races or the entire series. To be included in the overall standings, runners must complete at least 3 of the 4 races. OPEN categories for women and men, as well as team standings (minimum 3 runners). Trophies are awarded at a formal ceremony at the end of the series.

name: ULTRA TURNICKI
description: Ultra Turnicki is a unique running festival held in the scenic region of the Przemyśl Foothills and the Sanok-Turka Mountains. The event offers both winter and summer races over various distances, combining sporting competition with a rich cultural and festival program. The routes pass through distinctive landscapes, and participants can count on well-stocked aid stations and opportunities to connect with the local community. The start and finish are in Huwniki, offering easy access and attractive accommodation options.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Przemyśl Foothills and the Sanok-Turka Mountains
The summer race takes place during the Wianki festival, featuring workshops and concerts
The winter race offers views from the Żytnia Pass and has two aid stations along the route
additional: The summer race offers four distances: 10 km, 24 km, 48 km, and 75 km, with transport to the start and a rich festival program. The winter race has two distances: 15 km and 36 km, with transport to the start and aid stations along the route. After the races, there are social gatherings, talks, and an awards ceremony. Accommodation is available at agritourism farms, and camping is possible during the summer season. Public transport is available, and Huwniki can be reached by motorway and train.

name: Wieczorna Piątka
description: Wieczorna Piątka is a 5,000-meter race held on the tartan track at the Municipal Stadium in Maków Mazowiecki. The race is scheduled for 6:00 PM and will be divided into heats based on participants’ predicted times. It is organized by Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki, with a limit of 200 participants. The race is open to people over 15 years of age; minors must provide written consent from a guardian.
course_highlights: 5,000 m on the stadium’s tartan track
One lap is 400 m
Heats are based on predicted race times
additional: The limit is 200 race packages. Payments can be made online through the Przelewy24 platform or by bank transfer to the club’s account. The detailed schedule, including the heats, will be published on the website during the week before the race.

name: 15 Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej
description: The Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej is a mountain race held in Koszalin on a course around Góra Chełmska. Participants can choose between 10.55 km (quarter marathon) and 21.1 km (half marathon), which consists of two loops. The start and finish are at plac Gościńcowy near the summit of Góra Chełmska, and the course runs through scenic forest areas with views. The race is organized by the Stowarzyszenie Sport, rekreacja i wolontariat „SFX” and is recreational and sporting in nature, promoting an active lifestyle and forest tourism.
course_highlights: Mountain course around Góra Chełmska, reaching an elevation of 136.2 m above sea level
Two distances to choose from: 10.55 km (one loop) and 21.1 km (two loops)
Start and finish at plac Gościńcowy, between the sanctuary and the observation tower
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30. The ceremonial start is from the square between the sanctuary and the observation tower. Awards will be presented at around 14:30. The course is well marked and measured. Participants can choose their distance during the race. Donations toward the statutory objectives of the SFX Association are required to participate and are non-refundable and non-transferable.

name: 43 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is an orienteering event on foot in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on the map. The event is open to participants of all ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts to those taking part recreationally. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is an excellent way to enjoy outdoor activity and take a break from everyday life. Organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin Land Branch, it has a long tradition and attracts international interest.
course_highlights: Teams choose their own route and can select checkpoints of varying difficulty
Checkpoints are spread across the terrain, shown on the map and marked on the ground with navigation flags
Distances range from a few to several dozen kilometres, and the route can be changed during the event
additional: Teams travel only on foot, using a map and compass to navigate. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or gender. Participants can plan their own route of any length, from around 5 km to as much as 70 km, and change it while on the course. The event combines tourism and sport and is also suitable for families and people who take part in sport recreationally.

name: Bieg Dwie Wieże
description: Bieg Dwie Wieże is a race of approximately 15 km held in Kopalino. The course follows a dirt road, the beach, and a sidewalk, offering varied terrain and scenic views. The time limit is 2.5 hours, and participation is limited to 250 people. Runners receive a timing chip and a race bib. Water stations are available along the course, and a recovery meal is provided at the finish. The event has professional medical coverage and is photographed.
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km course
Race along a dirt road, the beach, and a sidewalk
Water stations at 4, 8, and 12 km, and at the finish
additional: Race office hours: 19.06, 13:00–19:00, and 20.06, 8:00–9:45 (verification closes at 9:45). Identity verification is mandatory (ID card/student ID). The timing chip is mandatory, collected at the race office and returned at the finish. Water and a recovery meal are available at the finish. Medical coverage is provided. Participation constitutes consent to the use of one’s image. Runners are asked to follow event rules and road traffic regulations.

name: Challenge Poland
description: Challenge Poland is a prestigious triathlon held in Gdańsk, offering a range of distances, including the popular T100 distance. The event takes place on the Baltic Sea, with a fast, flat cycling course and a scenic run along the beach and through Ronald Reagan Park. The start and finish are on the beautiful pier in Gdańsk, making it a unique attraction for athletes and spectators. The event is an official qualifier and is highly regarded by triathletes around the world.
course_highlights: 2.0 km swim at the city beach by Brzeźno Pier
80 km flat and fast cycling course through the Vistula Żuławy
18 km run along Gdańsk Beach and through Ronald Reagan Park, finishing with a scenic stretch on the pier
additional: Option to purchase registration cancellation coverage until 31 May 2027. Special discounts for teams of 10 or more. The cycling course passes, among other places, by Polsat Plus Arena stadium. Races are held in several categories and distances, including solo and relay. The race office and expo are located at Brzeźno Beach. Awards ceremonies take place on the pier in Gdańsk.

name: VI Bieg Świętojański
description: The VI Świętojański Run is a 10 km race held in picturesque Zawichost, in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship. Runners can choose training plans tailored to different experience levels to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through an online platform.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on an asphalt course
Moderately challenging course
Picturesque location in Zawichost
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support is provided, along with the option to use a platform to manage the race listing and marketing collaborations.

name: VIII Nocny Bieg
description: The 8th Open Academic Championships of Łomża in night road running is an annual event organized by Łomża Academy and the AZS University Club of Łomża Academy. The race takes place on the streets of Łomża and aims to commemorate the founding of the Academy and promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, with the 10 km course certified by PZLA. The race starts in the evening, giving it a distinctive nighttime character.
course_highlights: 10 km course certified by PZLA
Road race through Łomża
Time limit: 1.5 hours from the start
additional: Participant limit: 100 runners for the 5 km and 100 for the 10 km, plus an organizer’s allocation. Runner check-in at the Race Office on the day of the event from 19:00 to 20:45. Runners must complete the entire declared distance on asphalt; taking a shortcut results in disqualification. Distance changes are possible on the day of the event at the timing tent.

name: XII Półmaraton Wierchami
description: The XII Półmaraton Wierchami is a mountain race held in the picturesque Beskid Sądecki, near Rytro. The route follows demanding mountain trails with beautiful views and significant elevation gain, making it a real challenge for mountain runners. The event is organized by the Visegrad Maraton Association and attracts fans of ultra-running as well as shorter distances. Participants can choose from several routes of varying lengths and difficulty levels.
course_highlights: Mountain route with significant elevation changes (e.g. +1124 m / -1124 m over 30 km)
Route through the Beskid Sądecki with aid stations along the way
Views of peaks such as Wielki Rogacz and Radziejowa
additional: Races start at the Ryterski Resort. The 11 km Corno Owca starts at 12:00, and the 30 km Waligóra starts at 9:00. The routes follow marked mountain trails with aid stations. A race pack is provided to participants who register and pay by a specified deadline. Payment is available via DotPay or at the race office.

name: XIX Bieg O Błękitną Wstęgę
description: The 19th International Run for the Blue Ribbon is an annual event organized by the Stargard Athletics Club, which has been promoting health, fitness, and positive energy for 19 years. The main race takes place at night, giving it a unique atmosphere, and the route runs through the streets of Stargard, allowing participants to admire the city’s most beautiful historic landmarks in the moonlight. It’s an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and build physical and mental endurance. The organizers invite both amateurs and experienced athletes to celebrate exercise and a healthy lifestyle together.
course_highlights: An atmospheric night run at 9:00 p.m.
The route starts at the Amphitheatre and runs around the Jewel of Pomerania
Views of Stargard’s most beautiful historic landmarks in the moonlight
additional: The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere. The route is designed to let participants admire Stargard’s historic landmarks. The organizers encourage participants to build physical and mental endurance before the race. The event is international and organized by the Stargard Athletics Club.

name: Wrocławska Dycha
description: Wrocławska Dycha is an annual running event held in Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, providing a sporting atmosphere and the opportunity to compete on the city’s scenic routes. The event is a great way to spend time actively and bring Wrocław’s running community together.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes in central Wrocław
Scenic urban views
A welcoming atmosphere for runners of all experience levels

name: X Bieg Pamięci Powstań Śląskich
location: Góra Świętej Anny, Leśnica, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: Perly Malopolski Wapienne Magura
location: Wapienne, Sękowa, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Perły Małopolski Wapienne - Magura is a mountain race in the area around Wapienne and Magura. Four distances are available: approximately 5, 10, 20 and 50 km, including an ultra route. The event welcomes both people taking their first steps in mountain running and experienced runners looking for a longer challenge.
course_highlights: Four distances: approximately 5, 10, 20 and 50 km.
The routes run through the area around Wapienne and Magura.
The longest distance is an ultra race of approximately 50 km.

name: Bieg Lotnej Kompanii Szturmowej
description: The 8th Lotna Assault Company Run in Haczów is an annual running event commemorating the Lotna Assault Company of Lieutenant Stanisław Maczek and the Haczów heroes who fought for Poland’s independence in 1918–1921. The event features routes of approximately 12 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event, mostly on asphalt and gravel roads in the Haczów municipality. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and community integration. Free shorter races adapted to children’s ages are also organized.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 12 km and 5 km, plus a 5 km Nordic walking event
Mostly asphalt and gravel roads in the Haczów municipality
One water refreshment point on the route
additional: The participant limit is 150. There is one water refreshment point on the route. Race headquarters and the event base are located in the Manor Park by the Municipal Cultural and Recreation Centre in Haczów, and at the LKS stadium in Haczów. Free children’s races are organized over distances of approximately 200 m to 1,000 m, depending on age category. The participant limit for the children’s races is 200. Adult entry fees are non-refundable. Race packs are distributed from 13:00 to 14:30.

name: Gryf Arena Run
description: Gryf Arena Run is an annual street race held in the town of Gryfice, attracting runners of different ages and abilities across various distances. The route runs through the town streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event also includes races for children, making it a family-friendly and inclusive gathering. This is the ninth edition of the popular race, an important sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Gryfice
An atmosphere full of sporting excitement and positive energy
Children’s races are part of the program, making the event family-friendly

name: Klon Biega i Chodzi Dla Zdrowia
description: Klon Runs and Walks for Health is a local initiative organized by the Association for the Development of the Village of Klon and Surrounding Areas. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and supporters of the region. The run and walk take place in the picturesque surroundings of Klon, bringing the local community together. The event is recreational and open to everyone.

name: X Bieg STO-nogi
description: The STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The course is T-shaped and consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets. The event is organized by a local group of running enthusiasts who promote sport among residents and participants from across Poland. The race has an intimate atmosphere and is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and connect with fellow runners.
course_highlights: T-shaped course
Two 5 km loops through the streets of Milanówek
Start and finish at SLO No. 5, 41 Herberta Street
additional: The race traditionally starts at SLO No. 5 (41 Herberta Street). The road course consists of two 5 km loops. The organizers are the local STO-nogi Milanówek group, which also organizes other races and running events. Organizer phone contacts: Leszek Janasik - 666 353 600, Jerzy Stypa - 601 825 560.

name: X Ostródzki Półmaraton św. Jerzego
description: The 10th Ostróda St. George’s Half Marathon is a jubilee edition of the event organized by the Ostróda Runners Group, PLAY Sports Club, and the Ostróda Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in picturesque Ostróda, on the shores of Lake Drwęckie. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and comprehensive organizational support. The event attracts local runners as well as visitors from other regions, and offers cash prizes to the top finishers. Race packs are distributed at the race office, and the organizers ensure smooth and safe service for participants.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course follows the picturesque lakeside promenade along Lake Drwęckie in Ostróda
Professional timekeeping with a returnable chip
Race packs can be collected at the lakeside Amphitheatre
additional: 7:00–9:00. Registration after 9:00 on race day is not possible. Race packs are issued upon presentation of an identity document. A race pack may be collected on behalf of another person with a signed authorization and a copy of their ID. The entry fee is non-refundable and cannot be transferred to another participant. Cash prizes for the top female and male athletes are 1000, 700, and 500 PLN, paid into their bank accounts within 3 days of the race. 5 zł from each entry fee is donated to rehabilitation through a charity initiative.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Cross-Country Run takes place in the forested grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied terrain, uphill and downhill sections of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get off the asphalt or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as races for children and teenagers. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, and the top runners in each distance receive trophies.
course_highlights: The course runs through the forested grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka
Varied terrain with uphill and downhill sections, sand, and narrow sections through bushes
A cross-country course, unusual for an urban area
additional: All runners start at the same time, regardless of distance. The Nordic walking event covers 4 km. Children’s and teenagers’ races are held over 150 m (ages 0–6) and 800 m (ages 7–15). The event village offers attractions including a playground, pump track, water playground, beach volleyball courts, mini soccer and basketball courts, beach soccer courts, bathing areas, kayak rental, a golf driving range, and games and activities for children.

name: Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna
location: Centrum Rekreacji i Wypoczynku Deczno, Świecie, Poland
description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the picturesque surroundings of the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre. The event includes a 10 km main race and free races for children, making it appealing to families and runners of different ability levels. The main race route follows the banks of the Deczna River, offering participants beautiful views and pleasant racing conditions. The organizers provide professional timing and race kits with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 240 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km main race route along the banks of the Deczna River
Picturesque views and a natural setting around the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre
Additional free races for children, limited to 115 participants
additional: The main race is limited to 240 participants, and the children's races to 115 participants. The children's races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. 23:59.

name: XI Cienińska Szóstka
location: Cienin Zaborny, Słupca County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Minimum 40 zł, a w przypadku chęci otrzymania prezentu dla dziecka - minimum 50 zł

description: The 5th Charity Run for Children of Heroes is a special initiative by the Dorastaj z Nami Foundation, which supports the children of public service and medical workers who were killed or injured while on duty. Participants choose a 5 km route and can run it at any time between June 1 and 23, submitting a screenshot from their running app. The run symbolically brings together Children’s Day and Father’s Day, highlighting remembrance of the heroes and support for their children. This charitable event combines sport with help and remembrance.
course_highlights: A 5 km route chosen by the participant
The run can take place at any time from June 1 to 23
Participation is possible from anywhere in Poland
additional: After registering, participants receive a link to pay the entry fee and a link to submit a screenshot from the app used to track the run. The event is virtual, allowing participation from any place and at any time during the designated period. After the run, participants should send the organizers a screenshot from the app used to record their activity.

name: Szczecińska Dobranocka 27 - finał
description: Szczecińska Dobranocka is a series of orienteering races organized by the BnO Szczecin Orienteering Club. The races take place in various areas around Szczecin, giving participants the chance to test their navigation and running skills. The event is open to competitors of all ability levels, from beginners to experienced runners. Its tradition and varied courses make it a popular event in the orienteering community.
course_highlights: Varied woodland areas around Szczecin
Courses suited to different ability levels
The option to confirm control points using pictograms
additional: The event is organized by the BnO Szczecin Orienteering Club. It is a recurring event and forms part of the wider regional orienteering calendar. Maps for the races and instructions for beginners on confirming control points are available on the website.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
description: Herbatka u Tadka, or the Run to the Tea House, is a 10 km race held in Warsaw. Participants can prepare for the start with training plans tailored to different experience levels, offering expert support and detailed instructions. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on the streets of the capital in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on the streets of Warsaw
Training tailored to the runner’s VDOT level
Expert support and detailed training plans
additional: Training plans are available for 8 to 20 weeks and are tailored to each runner’s individual level. The platform can also be used to manage the race listing and support marketing collaboration.

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea, held in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubian region. Runners can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gains and scenic routes. The start and finish are at different locations, and the organizer provides transport to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to take on a challenging course and enjoy the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2,502 m of elevation gain, starting in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2,267 m of elevation gain, starting in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes run through Kashubia and coastal areas, with checkpoints and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), runners are transported by coach from outside the Gdynia Sports Centre – National Rugby Stadium (paid transport). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The course has checkpoints with time limits and drop bags. The event includes both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through various towns in the region and providing an unforgettable experience for runners of all ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on the beauty of the courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, making them worth collecting. It’s a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of the night.

name: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku
description: The Australian Ten in Pszczelnik is a 10 km race taking place in Siemianowice Śląskie, in Pszczelnik Park. The course consists of four laps, and all runners start together. After each lap, the 20 runners who took the longest to complete it are eliminated and receive a so-called “almost medal” at the finish. The fastest runners, competing for the win, complete the final lap. The race is open to anyone over the age of 16.

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Run with the Ghosts is a unique night trail run held in Leśniów. Participants can choose between two routes, 15 km and 9 km long, full of dark corners and surprises that create an unforgettable atmosphere with a hint of suspense. Runners are encouraged to dress up as spectres, ghosts and other spooky characters, adding a touch of magic and atmosphere to the event. It’s not just a race, but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants face their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the route.

name: Bieg dla Słonia
description: Bieg dla Słonia is a night run commemorating Artur Hajzer, a mountaineer who climbed seven eight-thousanders. Participants cover a symbolic distance of about 7 kilometres on the grounds of the Silesian Stadium and Silesian Park in Chorzów. The run is recreational, with no rankings or timing, and participation is free. The event takes place in the evening, creating a unique atmosphere while keeping the memory of an outstanding mountaineer alive.
course_highlights: A route of about 7 km on the grounds of the Silesian Stadium and Silesian Park
A night run on a partly illuminated route; headlamps are recommended
A symbolic commemoration of the seven eight-thousanders climbed by Artur Hajzer
additional: Participant registration is open from 20:00 to 21:50 at the race office by Gate 4 of the Silesian Stadium. The run takes place regardless of weather conditions. Participants must sign a declaration before the start. Headlamps are recommended because the route takes place at night. Part of the route is poorly lit, so the organisers recommend bringing a headlamp.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce - edycja nocna
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014, combining a passion for running with the beauty of natural and scenic locations. The event promotes outdoor physical activity, especially in picturesque gardens and green spaces. The night edition in Kielce is a unique opportunity to compete and celebrate sport together in unusual conditions. The organizers focus on a welcoming atmosphere and promoting running among people of different ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: A cross-country course through picturesque green spaces
A run in a unique nighttime atmosphere
A scenic, welcoming setting ideal for recreation
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts with experience dating back to 2014, specializing in cross-country races. Events take place at various locations, often in botanical gardens and green spaces. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrated its 10th anniversary. The organizer encourages people to subscribe to the newsletter to stay up to date with race news.

name: Supermaraton Gor Stolowych
description: The Table Mountains Supermarathon is a demanding mountain race held in the picturesque Table Mountains near Karłów. The route follows hiking trails and is technically challenging, with numerous rocks, turns, and significant elevation gain. Participants can expect changing conditions, including possible snow and ice, and are required to carry suitable equipment. The event is part of the Grand Prix DFBG mountain-running series and attracts fans of ultrarunning and mountain half-marathons.

name: Sudecka 100
description: Sudecka 100 is Poland’s oldest night ultramarathon, held amid the picturesque mountain scenery of Boguszów-Gorce. The demanding route runs through the beautiful forest areas of the Kamienna Góra and Wałbrzych Forest Districts, offering unforgettable excitement and a chance to test your limits. The event attracts runners taking part in different distances, including 100 km, 42 km and 21 km. Organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing aid stations along the route and race packs containing technical T-shirts. The atmosphere is enhanced by support from spectators and additional attractions such as concerts and overnight accommodation for runners.
course_highlights: A demanding route in mountain terrain
Runs through the forest areas of the Kamienna Góra and Wałbrzych Forest Districts
A night ultramarathon with a unique atmosphere and support from spectators
additional: Race packs include technical T-shirts for entries paid for by June 12. Aid stations and refreshment points are available along the route. Race packs can be collected at the Decathlon store in Szczawno-Zdrój. The organizer provides free overnight accommodation and a place for runners to rest. Payments at the race office can be made in cash only.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km race held in Brodnica, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging paved course. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different ability levels, supporting participants in their preparations. The event is open and welcoming to runners, encouraging physical activity and competition on the city streets.
course_highlights: A paved course of moderate difficulty
A 10 km road race
Held in the picturesque city of Brodnica
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support.

name: 7 Maraton Pędziwiatra
description: The 7th Pędziwiatr Marathon is organized by the Pędziwiatr Gliwice Amateur Running Club and will take place on June 26, 2027, in Gliwice. Participants will complete 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop, running mainly along sheltered park paths. The event is both a memorial and a sporting competition, with individual and team classifications and relay races. The start is at 10:00, alongside the start of the Gliwice Park Running Challenge. All runners are welcome to take part in this special event.
course_highlights: 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop
The route runs mainly along sheltered park paths
Starts alongside the Gliwice Park Running Challenge
additional: Planned classifications: individual overall, women, men, age categories, team, and relays.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
location: Polana za stadionem Piasta, Gliwice, Poland
description: The Gliwice Park Run Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice, in the municipal forest near Piast Stadium. Each lap is 4,219.5 metres long and runs mainly along forest tracks and gravel paths, with some asphalt. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation, with the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!” Participants can take part in the run or Nordic Walking, as well as the e-Provocation, an online competition.
course_highlights: A lap is 4,219.5 m long
The route follows forest tracks and gravel paths, with some asphalt
Start and finish are in a clearing near Piast Stadium in Gliwice
additional: The events are held once a month on Saturdays. The time limit for the run and Nordic Walking is 3 hours. Participants can complete 1 to 5 laps (about 4.2 km to about 21 km). Race numbers are valid for the entire year and must be returned after each race. After the event, participants receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a bar in the prize draw, if sanitary regulations allow. The e-Provocation has no time limit and participants may choose any activity. In previous editions, the race office opened at 9:00 and the start was at 10:00; advance registration and payment of the entry fee were required to be classified.

name: III Bieg w Sławicach
description: The III Run in Sławice is a 10 km road race held in the picturesque village of Sławice in the Masovian Voivodeship. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is open and welcoming to runners who want to improve their results and enjoy sporting competition.
course_highlights: 10 km asphalt course
Moderate difficulty
Picturesque surroundings of Sławice
additional: Training plans from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support.

name: X Lubeński Cross
description: Lubeński Cross is a mountain cross-country race held in the scenic area of the Lubenia municipality. The start and finish are at the market square in Lubenia. The main race routes cover varied terrain, including asphalt, paved roads and dirt paths, and participants climb 3 or 5 green hills depending on the distance chosen. The available distances are 13.8 km and 22.3 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and is also open to children and young people, who compete on the stadium track over designated loops.
course_highlights: Mountain route with 3 or 5 green hills
Varied terrain: asphalt (21–25%), paved roads (32–38%), dirt roads and paths (41–43%)
Start and finish at the market square in Lubenia
additional: Children’s and youth races take place on the stadium track over designated loops of 200 to 800 m, divided by age and gender categories. Children’s race bibs must be collected by 10:30. On race day, registration for the children’s races is unavailable because of the 200-participant limit. The children’s races start after the shorter main race. On-site registration at the stadium after 10:30 is limited.

name: XIII Bieg Cichociemnych
description: The Cichociemni Run is a demanding cross-country race dedicated to the memory of Poland’s heroes, the Cichociemni soldiers. The course is more challenging than most cross-country races and features natural and man-made obstacles of varying difficulty. Participants must tackle mud and water, jump over obstacles, crawl under them, and squeeze through channels. The race takes place every June in Sochaczew and offers a chance to test your strength and get to know the Bzura River and its surroundings.
course_highlights: A course featuring natural and man-made obstacles of varying difficulty
Sections through mud and water, and through channels
Views and proximity to the banks and riverbed of the Bzura River
additional: Registration is available through the Zmierzymy Czas platform. A dedicated T-shirt can be ordered during selected registration periods. Discounts are available for running groups of at least 6 people upon prior contact by email. Organizer: UKS Dragon Fight Club Sochaczew. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence, and the Mayor of the City of Sochaczew.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The 21st Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race held in Unisław as part of Unisław Days. The course follows paved roads through the scenic Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty. The race is part of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running and is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The event also includes a Nordic walking event, making it appealing to a wide range of participants.
course_highlights: The course runs through Chełmno Landscape Park
Paved roads through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty
The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association
additional: The race course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association.

name: XXVII Bieg Górski Żar
description: The 27th Żar Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race held in the picturesque town of Międzybrodzie Żywieckie. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a challenging mountain course and enjoy an active day outdoors. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels, helping participants prepare optimally for the start. The event is open and welcoming to runners of varying experience.
course_highlights: A 10 km mountain course
Picturesque views around Międzybrodzie Żywieckie
A challenge for runners of varying experience levels
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support.

name: XXXVII Cross Świętojański
location: Pogórze, Cieszyn County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 37th Jan Marek Cross-Country Race in Pogórze is a traditional cross-country race organized by LKS Pogórze. The event takes place in the picturesque village of Pogórze, offering participants the chance to compete on a challenging cross-country course. The race is scheduled to start at 18:00, bringing sporting excitement to a summer evening. The organizers provide professional timekeeping using RFID technology to ensure accurate results.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Pogórze
Evening start at 18:00
Professional RFID timekeeping
additional: The event is organized by LKS Pogórze. Timekeeping is electronic and uses RFID technology.

name: Wielka Pętla Izerska w ramach Izerskiego Weekendu Biegowego
location: Szklarska Poręba, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Great Jizera Loop is a scenic half marathon held as part of the Jizera Running Weekend in Szklarska Poręba. The course runs through the town streets and along trails in the Jizera Mountains, offering runners a chance to connect with nature and enjoy mountain scenery. The event combines recreation and sport, promoting physical activity and the popularity of running. Participants use electronic timekeeping, and the time limit for completing the course is 3 hours.

name: XVIII Bieg w pogoni za żubrem
description: The 15th Bieg w Pogoni za Żubrem is an annual running event held in Niepołomice, attracting runners across various distances. The course passes through picturesque surroundings, giving participants the opportunity to compete amid beautiful scenery and a passion for sport. The event is a great way for the whole family to spend time actively, with separate races for children and adults. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: An 8-kilometer race route through Niepołomice
A longer 15-kilometer race with a varied course profile
Special races for children tailored to their age and abilities
additional: The event includes 8 km and 15 km races, as well as children’s races. A detailed information guide is available in PDF format at https://biegwpogonizazubrem.pl/Informator2026.pdf. No start times or details about start waves or participant limits are provided.

name: Izery Ultra-Trail
description: Izery Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the heart of the scenic Jizera Mountains, with the start and finish in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes of varying lengths and difficulty lead through wild, little-known areas, offering runners unforgettable views and challenges. The event attracts both experienced ultramarathon runners and trail enthusiasts eager to take on demanding terrain and enjoy the beauty of nature. The organizers provide full support at aid stations and specify mandatory equipment to ensure participants’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: Routes pass through wild, little-known areas of the Jizera Mountains
Start and finish in the heart of Świeradów-Zdrój, in Spa Park
Significant elevation gain: up to +2,650 m on the longest, 100 km route
additional: Start and finish in Spa Park in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes have aid stations (6 on the 100 km route, 4 on the 50 km route). Mandatory equipment includes a water cup, a cap or buff, a rain jacket, a water container with a capacity of at least 1 liter, an elastic bandage, and a sterile dressing. Runners receive a race bib with a chip, route maps, and a GPS device with the route loaded. A working phone must be available for contact throughout the race.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate off-road races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The series consists of several stages held on different courses with varying levels of difficulty, featuring two main distances: Szpurt (6–8 km) and Wertep (17–21 km). The events are characterized by environmental care, a limited number of participants, and an atmosphere of passion, competition, and friendship. Races usually start in the morning, and participants can expect professional organization, timekeeping, and prizes in various categories.
course_highlights: Off-road courses of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Carefully marked trails with aid stations along the longer-distance course
Races take place in the scenic regions of Podlasie and surrounding areas, with respect for nature
additional: Starts are organized in corrals based on results from the previous season. The race package includes a race number with a timing chip valid for the entire season, a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography services, and prizes for the top athletes in the OPEN and age-group categories. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited.

name: Roztoczański Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Roztocze Running Festival 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Roztocze region, organized by the Lubaczów Municipality. The three-day festival takes place in Basznia Dolna, at Kresowa Osada, the start and finish venue for all races and Nordic walking events. Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night races and Nordic walking events to an ultramarathon and half marathon, on routes through the picturesque Lubaczów region. The event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
description: The Łabiszyn St. John’s Eve Run is an annual running event held in Łabiszyn, with the start and finish at the Municipal Stadium. The 5 km main race starts at 7:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Main-race participants receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners receive a medal and a surprise. The awards ceremony for the top runners takes place after the competitions. The run is part of a running series and offers race packs to the first registrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn
5 km main-race route
Children’s and youth races in 4 age categories
additional: After the main race, participants receive a medal and a sweet snack, while children and youth receive a medal and a surprise. The awards ceremony for the top runners takes place after all races have ended. Race packs are available to the first registrants.

name: 3 Otwarty Bieg Sejmowy o Puchar Marszałka
Bieg Powitania Lata
location: Strzelce Wielkie, Pajęczno County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, offering 5 km and 10 km courses. The route follows mainly paths and forest tracks, with one significant uphill section, combining sport with history. After the race, participants and their companions can tour historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a guide, making the event a unique combination of physical activity and education. The race’s mission is to promote running and raise awareness of local heritage.
course_highlights: Cross-country route along paths and forest tracks
One substantial uphill section on the route
Guided tours of historic Kraków Fortress sites after the race
additional: After the race, participants can take a tour with a professional guide of sites belonging to the former Kraków Fortress, including forts, earthworks, caverns, field batteries, and shelters. The race route is off-road and green, with history in the background. Unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks are awarded to the top competitors in each category. After the race, participants and their companions can take a guided tour of sites belonging to the former Kraków Fortress, including forts, earthworks, caverns, field batteries, and shelters.

name: V RUNda Żubra Biegi i Nordic Walking
Grill Run=Fun 2026
description: Grill+Run=Fun 2026 is a race held in Palowice that combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and fun. The event starts at 08:00, and participants can expect professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support. The event is organized by the LUXTORPEDA Association, which ensures high-quality organization and support for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and experience the spirit of sporting community.

name: XXIV Atlantis Bieg Opolski
description: The 24th Atlantis Opole Run is an annual race held since 2003 on the first Saturday of July on Bolko Island in Opole. The route runs through a designated quiet, green area in the city center, offering participants the opportunity to compete over 5 km and 10 km distances. Since 2015, the race has been called the Atlantis Opole Run, thanks to the support of Atlantis-Deweloper. The event is organized by the Opole Run Association, which promotes physical activity and sports-based community integration.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: The Kalisz Night Amber Hellena Half Marathon is a unique nighttime half marathon held in Kalisz. The event attracts hundreds of runners from different cities, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a running challenge after dark. The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of the city, giving participants an unforgettable experience. The event has become a tradition and is popular with both amateur and professional runners.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to make Marlena, one of the foundation’s beneficiaries, dream come true: a trip to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sporting challenge, but also an opportunity to work together to support children in need.

name: VI Półmaraton Gęstwinami Murckowskimi
description: The 5th Murckowski Forest Half Marathon is organized by the W Kręgu Natury Association and takes place in the picturesque forests of Murcki in Katowice. The half-marathon course winds through varied woodland terrain, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy a unique atmosphere. The event is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors, whether you are an experienced runner or a beginner. The organizers provide convenient access by public transport and parking near the start.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowo ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The race covers 10 km, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Centre, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Krokowska 10 is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4 in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from pieces awarded at the individual stages.

name: XXVI Bieg o Kryształową Perłę Jeziora Na...
description: The 26th National Run for the Crystal Pearl of Lake Narie is the main race, covering a distance of 31.13 km. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Lake Narie in Kretowiny. The start and finish are located at the Main Beach in Kretowiny. The event includes age categories for men and women, and participants can look forward to a formal opening and closing ceremony, with awards presented. The event is national in scope and attracts runners from various age groups.

name: Bieg i Nordic Walking O Buławę Sieniawską
Letnia Dwunastka
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Turbacz Summer Trail
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 05.07.2026
description: The 7th Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 2026 is an annual running event held in Wilkowo near Świebodzin. The race attracts runners from various categories and offers the chance to compete on a route combining road and off-road sections. The organizers provide professional timing and technical support, while participants can expect efficient organization and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to get active and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: A route combining road and off-road sections
Scenic surroundings of Wilkowo near Świebodzin
Professional electronic timing
additional: The event is organized by Super Sport, a company from Zielona Góra, which provides timing, race bib printing, and technical support. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Registration will be available at super-sport.com.pl, and the event attracts local runners and sports enthusiasts.

name: Pogoń za Jednorożcem
description: The Unicorn Chase is an annual running event held in Jednorożec, taking place for the eighth time in 2026. The event includes a 5 km race and Nordic walking over the same distance, as well as children’s races over shorter distances. It is organized by the “Jednorożec robi co może” Association in cooperation with local partners and patrons, offering participants sporting competition, numerous attractions, and prizes. The start and awards ceremony take place on the same day, and participants can expect professional organization and chip timing.

name: XV Limanowa Forrest
description: XV Limanowa Forrest is an international mountain race on a route leading to Miejska Góra (716 m above sea level), home to the Millennium Cross—the tallest steel cross in Poland. The Anglo-Saxon-style course covers varied terrain, including hiking trails, forest and field roads, rocky sections, asphalt, and pavement. The start and finish are on Bulwary Street in Limanowa, near the race office. The event is well organized and welcoming to different age groups, including children under 13.
course_highlights: The route leads to Miejska Góra and the Millennium Cross—the tallest steel cross in Poland
Varied terrain: hiking trails, forest and field roads, rocky sections, asphalt, and pavement
Start and finish on Bulwary Street, near the race office
additional: The race office is at 4 M. Konopnickiej Street, Limanowa, and is open from 8:30 to 11:30. Competitor check-in is from 8:30 to 11:30; bag drop is available until 14:30. The Nordic Walking start is at 12:02. The awards ceremony is at 14:45, a prize draw is at 15:30, and the event ends at around 16:30. KS Limanowa Forrest members are exempt from the entry fee.

name: 34 Bieg po Plaży
location: Jarosławiec, Postomino, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 34th Jarosławiec Beach Run is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Postomino. The race takes place on a scenic route along the beach by the Baltic Sea, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by coastal nature. The event attracts runners from various regions, combining sporting competition with recreation and socializing. The organizers provide professional event support and attractive keepsakes for participants.
course_highlights: The race route runs along a sandy beach by the Baltic Sea
Scenic views of the sea and coastal nature
Flat, fast terrain conducive to good race times
additional: The event is organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Postomino and takes place in Jarosławiec. The website has no detailed information about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Reports and photo galleries from previous editions are available.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale running event held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The marathon route passes through woodland and rural areas, offering runners peace and contact with nature, away from crowds and mass events. The race is friendly in spirit, without competitive pressure, creating a welcoming atmosphere and an opportunity to cover the distance together. The organizers, including local runner Arek Tołłoczko, take care of route marking and participants’ comfort.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km route along forest and country roads
Start and finish on Polna Street in Chwałowice
Every kilometre is marked, with convenient parking nearby
additional: The race is small-scale and friendly, without the feel of a mass event or competitive pressure. The varied route is marked every kilometre. Four marathons are held each year: in winter, spring, summer and autumn. There is convenient parking nearby. Sources describe the friendly format and self-timed results.

name: Bieg bez Granic
organizer: Słubicki Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Sp. z o.o. oraz Miejski Związek Sportu we Frankfurcie
description: Bieg bez Granic is an annual race held on the border bridge between Słubice and Frankfurt (Oder). Participants can choose between 5 km (two laps of 2.5 km) and 10 km (four laps of 2.5 km). The start and finish are located at Slubicer Str. 15230 in Frankfurt (Oder), heading towards Poland. The race is international in nature and promotes cross-border cooperation and physical activity in the region.
course_highlights: The course crosses the border bridge between Słubice and Frankfurt (Oder)
The 5 km and 10 km distances consist of laps of 2.5 km
The start and finish are located in Frankfurt (Oder), heading towards Poland
additional: Registration and payment of the entry fee are not available on race day. The start and finish are located at Slubicer Str. 15230 Frankfurt (Oder), heading towards Poland.

name: Ultramarathon Górski - 3 x Sniezka = 1 x Mont Blanc
description: The 3xŚnieżka Mountain Ultramarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the Karkonosze Mountains.
