name: VI Bieg do Nocy Siedleczek
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Kostrzynie
description: The 6th Siedleczek Night Run is an evening 5 km race held in the picturesque area around the pond in Siedleczek. The course follows forest roads and paved roads, and runners’ times are measured electronically. Participants can expect a race pack with a bib number and chip, water, a post-race meal, and a finisher’s medal. The event is part of the Grand Prix of Running Events in the Kostrzyn Municipality and attracts runners from various categories, with prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: 5 km course on forest roads and paved roads
Electronic net timekeeping
Evening start at 21:00
additional: The participant limit is 200. The race office is open on race day from 19:30 to 20:30 near the start/finish line. The race pack can be collected in person or by an authorized person. The maximum time to finish the race is 60 minutes. Trophies and statuettes are awarded in the OPEN category and to residents of the Kostrzyn Municipality. Electronic net timekeeping; the time limit for completing the course is 60 minutes. Participants receive water, a post-race meal, and a medal.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by a group of running enthusiasts. The events take place on scenic courses in Wielkopolska and other locations, with an emphasis on their aesthetic and natural qualities. The summer edition in Łódź is a special opportunity to celebrate the event’s 10th birthday, with participants receiving special medals featuring a daylily motif. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and beautiful courses.
course_highlights: Cross-country races on scenic courses
The aesthetic appeal of the locations
Special birthday medals featuring a daylily
additional: The summer edition celebrates Botaniczna Piątka’s 10th birthday with unique medals. The organizers place particular emphasis on cross-country running and the visual appeal of the courses. Events take place at various locations, including Łódź.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, as an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. It is a major sporting event of the summer on the coast, attracting over 1,200 runners and tens of thousands of spectators, and offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic center. The course is a 1,412-meter loop along the streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, with the start and finish by Neptune’s Fountain. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, and also offers a rich program of accompanying events, including concerts and shows.
course_highlights: A 1,412 m course in central Gdańsk, with the start and finish by Neptune’s Fountain
A loop along Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników, Podwale Przedmiejskie and other streets
Incredible support from over 25,000 spectators along the course
additional: The event includes four races under the shared slogan “Chase St. Dominic”: the Prologue, open to all St. Dominic’s Fair participants; the 5 km Women’s Run Lotto Cup; the 5 km Men’s Run Energa Cup; and the Men’s Elite Run, the Polish 10 km Championships. The event takes place as part of the Running Festival, with a rich program of accompanying activities, including partner booths, presentations and Fair concerts.

name: Arm Race Kamień
description: Arm Race Kamień is an extreme obstacle race held in the Ceków-Kolonia municipality. The course offers a sporting challenge for participants of varying experience levels, combining competition, technique, and the satisfaction of overcoming obstacles. The event is part of an OCR race series that attracts both competitors focused on results and people new to obstacle-course racing, as well as entire families. It is not just a race, but also an exciting experience and an opportunity to get active outdoors.
course_highlights: A 5 km or 10 km course with around 25 or 40 obstacles
A range of formats: PRO, OPEN, FUN, and family and youth formats
Extreme obstacles requiring endurance, technique, and intensity
additional: Choose a format suited to your experience level, including PRO for those competing for results and OPEN for those looking for a sporting challenge. Family and youth formats are also available. The 2027 season pass includes 3 race entries (5 km or 10 km, including PRO/ELITE) for 699 zł, with an ARM RACE technical cap as a gift.

name: Bieg o Wronkę Szlakiem Świętego Jakuba
location: Wronka, Giżycko County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Bieg o Wronkę Szlakiem Świętego Jakuba is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Wronka near Giżycko. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes on gravel roads, as well as shorter races for children. Participants can expect professional timekeeping, race packs with medals, and a post-race meal. The event is organized by the Wronka Rural Housewives’ Association in cooperation with the Giżycko Municipality, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 5 km race route on a gravel road
10 km race route on a gravel road
Children’s and youth races over a distance of 0.5 km
additional: The race office is open from 8:00 to 11:30 on event day. Race packs can be collected, and registration and cash payment are available on race day, subject to a limit of 200 participants. Participants receive a medal at the finish and a voucher for a post-race meal. Timekeeping is done using chips, which must be returned at the finish. Children’s and youth races have no timekeeping or classification.

name: IX Rudzki Półmaraton Industrialny
description: The IX Ruda Industrial Half Marathon is a unique running event held in Ruda Śląska, combining sport with the region’s industrial heritage. The 10.5 km course runs through the city centre, passing post-industrial landmarks such as Chebzie railway station, the Mikołaj Shaft, the Kaufhaus housing estate and the blast furnace at Pokój Steelworks. In addition to the half marathon, an accompanying race of around 10 km is also held, allowing less experienced runners to take part. The start and finish are at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, which also houses the race office and event facilities.
course_highlights: A 10.5 km loop through the city centre
Passes post-industrial landmarks: Chebzie railway station, the Mikołaj Shaft and the Kaufhaus housing estate
Runs past the only blast furnace in Silesia, at Pokój Steelworks
additional: The start and finish are at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, where the Race Office and event facilities are also located. An accompanying race of around 10 km is available for those not ready for the half marathon. Registration takes place on the DO:ST:AR:TU platform.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastary Five is an annual road race held in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various places. The event combines sport and recreation and takes place on a 5-kilometer course through the municipality’s scenic areas. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring together the local community and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: A 5 km course
A road race through the Czastary municipality
Scenic landscapes and a welcoming atmosphere

name: Bieg z okazji 82. Rocznicy Wybuchu Powstania Warszawskiego
II Wielgomłyński Dycha
location: Wielgomłyny, Radomsko County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Półmaraton Cross Laskowa
location: Laskowa, Limanowa County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XI Gorce Ultra-Trail
description: Gorce Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the picturesque surroundings of Ochotnica Dolna. Participants can choose from five varied routes, ranging from 5 to 102 km and suited to different experience levels, from beginners to seasoned ultramarathoners. The routes pass through the beautiful Gorce Mountains, featuring challenging climbs and spectacular views. The time limit for the longest route is 20 hours, underscoring the event’s challenging nature.

name: Kresowe Trail #9
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The series consists of eleven races held over two distances: the shorter Szpurt (6–8 km) and the longer Wertep (17–21 km). The events take place in scenic locations, with respect for the environment and local communities. Participants can expect professional organization, electronic timing, and a generous race package. Kresowe Trail also features Nordic Walking competitions and brings runners together in a spirit of fair play and friendship.
course_highlights: Trail routes of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Scenic areas of Podlasie and the Vilnius Region, with marked routes and aid stations
Limited participant numbers to ensure safety and high-quality organization
additional: Starts are divided into waves according to results from the previous season. The race package includes a hot recovery meal, electronic timing, a race bib with a chip valid for the entire season, medical support, aid stations along the route and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for those who register in advance), photography services, and prizes for the top competitors. Littering on the route is strictly prohibited. Online registration is available until 08:40 on race day, and on-site registration is available from 8:00. If you register fewer than 10 days before the race, your race package may be incomplete.

name: XI Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól
description: The 11th Run Among the Krasnopol Fields is an annual running event held in the picturesque municipality of Krasnopol. The course is approximately 10 km long and follows forest roads exclusively, with gravel and grassy surfaces, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy pleasant running conditions. The race office is located at the Municipal Reading and Culture Centre, and the race starts in the afternoon. The event is open to different groups of runners, including Nordic Walking over a distance of 5 km. The organizers help ensure participants’ comfort by providing maps and guidance on parking and starting points.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km on forest roads only (gravel and grassy surfaces)
Start and finish in the municipality of Krasnopol
Picturesque natural surroundings ideal for running
additional: The race office is open from 13:00 to 15:00 at the Municipal Reading and Culture Centre, ul. 1 Maja 1. Parking is permitted throughout the town in designated areas. The course follows gravel and grassy forest roads. Available distances: 10 km run and 5 km Nordic Walking. The races are free, but responsible registration is required.

name: XXXIV Bieg Jezior
location: Stary Uścimów, Lubartów County, Lublin Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Memoriał Biegowy
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lidzbarku Warmińskim
description: The jubilee 10th Tadeusz Brzostek Memorial Run is an annual running event organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Lidzbark Warmiński. The competition takes place at the Municipal Stadium, offering participants the opportunity to compete and spend time actively in a sporting atmosphere. The event is local in character and promotes sport and recreation among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: The main race is 5 km long.
Children’s and youth races cover distances from 200 m to 1 km.
The Municipal Stadium is the start and finish venue.
additional: Children’s races take place on a tartan running track.

name: niedamiRUN - Ultramaraton Sudecki
location: Niedamirów, Kamienna Góra County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: NiedamiRUN is a Sudeten ultramarathon held in Niedamirów, a picturesque village at the crossroads of three cultures. The routes run through the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate and the Bóbr Valley, offering participants exceptional views and challenging climbs. The event features four distances: 10 km, 20 km, 50 km and 100 km, across varied terrain including gravel roads, meadows, montane forests and mountain trails. It’s a great opportunity to challenge nature and your own limits alongside fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes cross the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate and the Bóbr Valley
They follow the border ridge of the Lasocki Range, the area around Okraj Pass and the shores of Bukówka Reservoir
Varied terrain: gravel roads, meadows, montane forests and challenging mountain climbs
additional: The participant limit is 100 people per distance. VAT invoices are available upon request. The start and finish are in Niedamirów.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
location: Śliwice, Tuchola County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique timed race held in Koszalin at Górka Piaskowa. Participants compete on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through hilly forest terrain with sandy sections. The race lasts exactly 1 hour, during which runners can complete as many laps as they wish; the winner is the runner who completes the most. At the finish, unique, very heavy medals await, along with a barbecue and bonfire, creating a friendly, sociable atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 1 km loop through challenging, hilly forest terrain
Varied surface with sandy sections
Challenging uphill sections and numerous elevation changes
additional: Start and finish at Górka Piaskowa in Koszalin. Electronic chip timing. Participants receive a race bib and safety pins. Drinks and medical support from the Polish Red Cross in Koszalin are available at the finish. After the race, refreshments include grilled sausage, sweet rolls, and a bonfire. Participant limit: 100. Entry is open to participants aged 18 and over with a current medical examination or a declaration.

name: Bieg Zbója
description: Bieg Zbója is a mountain race in Bielsko-Biała inspired by the legend of the bandit Klimczok. The course follows scenic but demanding mountain trails, including the iconic climb beneath the cable car to Szyndzielnia and the summit of Klimczok. The race promises unforgettable thrills and will test every participant’s endurance, combining beautiful views with challenging terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain course with a climb beneath the cable car to Szyndzielnia
Klimczok summit, steeped in the legend of the bandit
A wild, fast descent that demands great endurance
additional: Zimowy Bieg Zbója 2027 offers two courses: Zbójnik, 18 km with 996 m of elevation gain, starting at 09:00, and Piechur, 13 km with 786 m of elevation gain, starting at 09:45. The courses are challenging, with winter conditions and a mountain character. Registration is online, with payments via PayU and PayPal.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a series of races that have promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate both sporting competition and the beauty of their surroundings. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the UAM Botanical Garden
Picturesque green spaces and natural surroundings
Alternative location by Lake Rusałka, 500 m from the start
additional: Race packs can be collected by an authorised representative. The organisers place particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of the proposed race locations. This summer marks the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: I Jura Night Dog Run
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Jura Night Dog Run is a unique canicross race held at night in the picturesque Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. Participants can choose between a 10 km distance and a 21 km half marathon, or take part virtually at any distance. The event is limited to 200 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere and safety. The race is scheduled to start at 20:00, adding a distinctive character to the competition with your dog by your side.
course_highlights: A night race in the picturesque scenery of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Available distances: 10 km and a 21 km half marathon
Virtual participation available at any distance
additional: The participant limit is 200. Individual and team categories are available; teams must include at least one woman or one man. A full race package is available for all distances. Standard and virtual race regulations are available.

name: Złota Dycha
description: Złota Dycha is a road race held in Złotoryja, with distances of 5 and 10 kilometres. The course consists of 2.5 km loops, which participants complete twice or four times, respectively. The race is challenging, with a gently undulating course profile, and water stations along the route help participants stay hydrated during the race. After the event, the top runners in various categories are presented with awards. The event attracts runners from across the region and is organised with participants’ comfort and safety in mind.
course_highlights: The course consists of 2.5 km loops
Two distances: 5 km (2 loops) and 10 km (4 loops)
Water stations along the route: 4 on the 5 km course and 8 on the 10 km course
additional: The Race Office is open from 7:00 to 9:30 at the fountain of Delfin on ul. Rynek. Participant limit: 100 places for the 5 km race and 200 for the 10 km race, for a total of 300 participants. Each participant receives a race bib with a chip, a mini race pack, a commemorative medal and a post-race meal. Time limits: 60 minutes for 5 km and 105 minutes for 10 km. The awards ceremony for the top runners will take place after 12:00.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and nature experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful surroundings of Kielce.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The beauty of the proposed locations
Organized since 2014, with an emphasis on off-road running
additional: The organizer states that they have been organizing races since 2014.

name: Chudy Wawrzyniec
description: Chudy Wawrzyniec is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Żywiec Beskids, with its base in Rajcza and Ujsoły. The event offers three ultra distances: 50 km, 80 km and 100 km, featuring substantial elevation gain and technically demanding courses. Additional races include Parszywa Bendoszka, Mała Rycerzowa and Muńcuł Vertical, as well as events for children and young people called Chudy Hulajnik. The event promotes physical activity in a natural setting and is scored by ITRA. The organizer provides the Chudy Bus shuttle and parking guidance because parking spaces are limited.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon courses of 52 km, 82 km and 102 km, with elevation gains of 2,500 m, 3,800 m and over 5,100 m, respectively
The course passes through the Żywiec Beskids, including peaks such as Wielka Rycerzowa, Wielka Racza, Pilsko and Romanka
There are three aid stations on the 100 km course, two on the 80 km course and one on the 50 km course; disposable cups are not provided at aid stations
additional: The ultramarathon starts at 4:00 in Rajcza; start times for the accompanying races and children’s events are listed in detail. The time limit for the ultramarathons is 16 hours, for Parszywa Bendoszka 13.5 hours, and for Mała Rycerzowa 5 hours. Courses are marked with tape, and disposable cups are not provided at aid stations. The Chudy Bus shuttle is provided to make transport easier because parking spaces are limited. Children’s and young people’s races cover distances from 200 m to 2.5 km in the area around the amphitheatre in Ujsoły.

name: VII Charytatywny Bieg świętego Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, as an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. This exceptional sporting event attracts both amateur and professional runners, offering races over various distances against the picturesque backdrop of Gdańsk’s Old Town. The course runs through the streets of the city’s historic center, while cheers from more than 25,000 spectators create an unforgettable atmosphere. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration and is accompanied by numerous cultural and sporting events.
course_highlights: A 1,412 m course in central Gdańsk, running along Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników and other streets
Start and finish by the Neptune Fountain in the historic city center
Cheers from more than 25,000 spectators along the course during each race
additional: The event comprises four races under the slogan “Chase St. Dominic,” including a Prologue for all visitors to the Fair, a race for people with disabilities as part of the “Integration Through Sport” program, the 5 km Women’s Race Lotto Cup, and the 5 km Men’s Race Energa Cup. The course is a closed loop, allowing spectators to follow the competition easily. The event is accompanied by numerous attractions, such as partner booths, presentations, shows, and concerts at St. Dominic’s Fair.

name: XI Bieg Lucka
description: The 11th Luck Run is a memorial race honoring Lucjan Chorąży, held in Skawinki near Lanckorona. The event offers several distances: a main race of approximately 14 km, a recreational run and Nordic Walking over approximately 5.2 km, and shorter races for children. The main race route leads to Mount Chełm, and participants can gather for refreshments after the race. The event is family-friendly and welcoming, organized by the Lucjan Chorąży Association.
course_highlights: The approximately 14 km main race route leads to Mount Chełm
Recreational run and Nordic Walking over approximately 5.2 km
Children’s races from 50 m to 1,000 m on the field and meadows near the race office
additional: Entry limit: 270 participants for the Main Race, Recreational Run and Nordic Walking; 80 online places and 30 places on race day for the children’s races. Race bib collection and additional registration on race day from 9:00 to 11:00. Children’s races start at 10:30; the main races and Nordic Walking start at 12:00 in three start groups.

name: Bieg na Wielką Sowę
location: Ludwikowice Kłodzkie, Gmina Nowa Ruda, Poland

name: 15 Diecezjalna Pielgrzymka Biegowa Radom...
description: The Diocesan Running Pilgrimage is a unique pilgrimage run from Radom to Częstochowa, held as a relay over several days. The event combines recreational sport with a spiritual experience, promoting a healthy lifestyle and prayer for world peace. It is organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association, which engages the local running community and promotes physical activity in the region.
course_highlights: Pilgrimage route from Radom to Częstochowa
Relay run spread over several days
Spiritual program modeled on traditional walking pilgrimages
additional: The run is held with prayers for peace in Ukraine and around the world. The organizers provide a spiritual program during the run. Participants run in relays. In the past, they held organizational meetings and asked people to express their willingness to lend cars for the duration of the pilgrimage.

name: 303 Maraton Antoniego Fili
description: The 303 Antoni Fili Marathon is a marathon held in Sztum, Mazowieckie. Runners have access to a training plan tailored to their level, helping them prepare optimally for the race. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to runners of various experience levels. The event takes place annually, and in 2026 it will be held on August 15.
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. The race listing can be managed and marketing partnerships arranged through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz - Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community in Wielkopolska and beyond.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The beauty of the proposed locations
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts

name: XII Rozłaziński Bieg po radość z życia
Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race held in Szemud as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two routes, 5 and 10 km long, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging participants to enjoy the outdoors. It attracts runners of different ages and experience levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.

name: XXXIII Bieg im. Marszałka Józefa Piłsudskiego
The Loop Run
distance_verbose: 225 km, 105 km, 45 km, 30 km, 15 km, 5 km
description: The Loop Run is a mountain race organized by the Rajd Beskidy Association, combining sport, adventure, and the exceptional scenery of the Beskids. The event takes place in the Bielsko-Biała area and offers a range of distances suited to runners of different ability levels. The organizers place a strong emphasis on participant safety and environmental protection. The event is authentic and athletic, driven by a passion for the mountains and endurance running.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the Little Beskids, Żywiec Beskids, and Silesian Beskids
The start, finish, and event village are located at the BBOSiR Sports and Entertainment Hall in Bielsko-Biała
The option to enter two races on the same day (combo packages)
additional: You can enter two races on the same day: Vertical Loop + Klimczok Loop 15 (Combo Package) and Vertical Loop + Loop 30 (Combo Plus Package). The event is scheduled for August 19–22, 2027. Packages combining Vertical Loop with Klimczok Loop 15 or Loop 30 are available.

name: Grand Prix Biskupca #4
location: Island on Lake Kraksy, Biskupiec, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział płatny przelewem - 20,00 zł. Decyduje kolejność zgłoszeń w ramach limitu 200 uczestników na imprezę.

description: The Biskupiec Grand Prix is a series of four races held in Biskupiec and the surrounding area, including on an island in Lake Kraksy. The fourth edition is a Night Run of approximately 8 km, following paths and cycling routes and passing through the Municipal Park. The event uses electronic timing and includes an overall classification based on all four races. Participants must wear their race numbers at chest or waist height, and the participant limit is 200. The event has a sporting and recreational character, attracting runners from the region.
course_highlights: Approximately 8 km route on an island in Lake Kraksy
Night run along paths and cycling routes and through the Municipal Park
Electronic chip timing
additional: Registration and payment are available at the race office until 30 minutes before the start; the fee is 30 zł, payable in cash. Race numbers must be pinned to the front at chest or waist height. Timing is electronic, and chips must be returned at the finish. The midday race in the series is held as a four-person relay, but the Night Run is an individual event. The course surface includes asphalt, paving stones, sand, and grass; the route is marked every 500 m. The time limit is 60 minutes, and the participant limit is 200.

name: IV Festiwal Pustelnika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz rozwoju Wysowej-Zdroju „Przekrocz Granice”
description: The 4th Pustelnik Festival is an annual sports and recreation event organized in the picturesque town of Wysowa-Zdrój by the Przekrocz Granice Association. The festival brings together sport, culture, and nature, offering participants the chance to take part in runs, marathons, and MTB and E-BIKE races. It’s a unique opportunity to discover the charms of the Low Beskids, spend time actively, and connect with the local community.

name: Maraton Wigry
location: Wigry National Park, Suwałki County, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Wigry Marathon is a unique marathon held within Wigry National Park, around the picturesque Lake Wigry. The route follows narrow, winding forest trails, long boardwalks across marshes and gravel roads, with a short stretch of asphalt, offering runners pristine air and beautiful views. It is a great opportunity to explore the Suwałki and Sejny regions during an enjoyable yet challenging marathon. The event is recreational in nature and is not focused on breaking records, making it ideal for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: The route lies entirely within Wigry National Park
Narrow, winding forest trails along the lakeshore
Long boardwalks across marshes and gravel roads
additional: The marathon route is approximately 42.2 km long, of which 82% consists of forest and unpaved roads and trails, and 18% of asphalt and sidewalks. The start is at the Monastery in Wigry, and the finish is at the Municipal Square in Stary Folwark. Transport for participants to the start, a technical briefing, race office services until 8:30, and a bonfire for participants and spectators after the race are planned.

name: XI Bieg Obrońców Płocka 1920r
description: The International Run of the Defenders of Płock 1920 is an annual running event organized by the Płock Biega No Age Limit Club. The race commemorates the defenders of the city of Płock in 1920 and traditionally takes place in the second half of August. The event attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition in an atmosphere of historical remembrance.

name: 7. PKO Tarnogórski Półmaraton oraz Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka
description: The 7th PKO Tarnogórski Half Marathon and Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka are the region’s biggest running celebration, held in Tarnowskie Góry. The 21.0975 km half-marathon course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and runs entirely on paved streets in Tarnowskie Góry, with traffic partially restricted. The event also offers a race of approximately 10.5 km—the Srebrna Dyszka. Both courses have refreshment and hydration stations, and participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A fully paved course through the streets of Tarnowskie Góry
Half-marathon certified by the Polish Athletics Association (21.0975 km)
Refreshment and hydration stations on both courses
additional: The half-marathon and Srebrna Dyszka courses run with traffic closed or partially restricted. Shortening the course results in disqualification. The organizer provides refreshment and hydration stations along the course. The event is part of the PKO Silesian Half Marathon Crown.

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: The Full Bowl Run is an annual running event held in Szubin since 2023. It is a charity run and continues an initiative supporting animal shelters. The event attracts runners who want to combine sport with helping animals in need. It is organized by the "Pod Egidą" Association and the local community.

name: Biegi wokół Bursztynowej Góry
description: The Runs Around Bursztynowa Góra are an annual running event held in picturesque Bąkowo as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The races attract runners from various age categories, offering appealing routes and the unique atmosphere of Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors amid beautiful nature and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: XVI Festiwal Biegowy Dziki Weekend
description: The 16th Dziki Weekend Running Festival is an annual running event held in Police that has gained considerable popularity in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship since 2010. The festival offers a range of trail and cross-country races, including races for children and young people, as well as extreme obstacle races. The courses run through the natural landscapes of the Wkrzańska Forest, promoting an active lifestyle and sporting competition in a unique atmosphere. The organizers welcome both recreational and experienced runners to take part in this dynamic and challenging event.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes through the Wkrzańska Forest with natural obstacles
Children’s and youth races with different distances and obstacles
Extreme trail races with military-style obstacles at the training ground
additional: The start and finish of all races are at the sports clearing at ul. Piaskowa 99 in Police. Children’s races start on 22.08 from 10:35, with waves starting every 5–10 minutes. Extreme obstacle races take place on 23.08, with waves starting every 3–5 minutes. The race office is in the sports hall at SP8, ul. Piaskowa 99. The courses feature natural obstacles such as tires, mud, walls, water obstacles, and ropes.

name: Letni Ultra Świr
description: Letni Ultra Świr is a unique 24-hour ultramarathon held on a 15 km loop near Grybów. It is a challenge for runners who want to test the limits of their endurance and enjoy an atmosphere full of sweat, dust and fatigue, but also laughter and madness. The event attracts long-distance running enthusiasts, offering a one-of-a-kind experience and intense emotions.

name: Półmaraton Roztoczański im. Czesławy Kwoki , Nielisz - Zamość
description: The Czesława Kwoka Roztocze Half Marathon is a half-marathon-distance race from Nielisz to Zamość. It is the final stage of the Four-Stage Peace Run in Memory of the Children of the Zamość Region. Join us for a race that combines sporting competition with commemorating the children of the Zamość Region.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs from Nielisz to Zamość.
The race is the final stage of the Four-Stage Peace Run in Memory of the Children of the Zamość Region.

name: UKIEL Susnet Run Olsztyn
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: Participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances, running through the center of Olsztyn with scenic views of the Old Town and CRS Ukiel beach. The course is certified by the PZLA, and the finish line is located on the beach, where a finisher zone awaits with music and lighting. It’s a great opportunity to combine sporting competition with the atmosphere of a city event.

name: 11 Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich
description: The Sądecki Couriers Run is a historic mountain race held in the Sądecki Beskids, on a route from Rytro to the PTTK mountain shelter on Przehyba. The course is marked and features varied surfaces: 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, and 80% forest trails, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and tackle challenging terrain. The race commemorates couriers from World War II, and the course record is just under an hour. The organizer provides timekeeping, medical support, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race.

name: 11 Łańcucka Piątka
description: The Łańcucka Piątka is an annual 5 km race held in Łańcut, combining sporting competition with charitable giving. The course passes through the town’s scenic areas, offering participants attractive views and a friendly atmosphere. The event draws runners of different ages and abilities, promoting physical activity and community spirit.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in central Łańcut
Scenic views and a welcoming urban setting
Held as part of the Łańcucki Bieg Dobroci
additional: The event also includes the Mini Łańcucka Piątka for children. Organizers provide race packs and prizes, and the event supports local charitable initiatives.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwice Park Running Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. They take place once a month on Saturdays in the park behind Piast Stadium. The 4,219.5-metre route runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some sections on asphalt. A refreshment point is located at the start/finish line. The event aims to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation under the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!”

name: Kunicki Bieg Reggae
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Kunicach
description: Kunicki Reggae Run is a nationwide sporting event held on the picturesque Lake Kunickie in Kunice. Participants can choose from three certified running routes: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The start and finish are in front of the GOKiS in Kunice at 11 Słoneczna Street. The event combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and reggae music, attracting a growing number of participants from across Poland.

name: Mały Wielki Bieg
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański
description: Mały Wielki Bieg is the largest race in the Pruszcz Gdański municipality and returns to Straszyn after a one-year break. It is organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre of the Pruszcz Gdański Municipality, which promotes sport and recreation among local residents. The event is an important sporting occasion in the region.

name: NorDan RUN
description: NorDan RUN is a race held in the picturesque town of Wolsztyn, with routes following paths through the municipal park along Lake Wolsztyńskie. Participants can choose from several distances, from shorter races for children to challenging 48 km routes with checkpoint and refreshment stations. The start and finish are located at the “Fala Park” venue, offering convenient race arrangements and beautiful views. The race is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the surrounding nature.

name: Tatraman
description: Tatraman is a challenging half-Ironman-distance triathlon held in the scenic areas of Polish and Slovak Spiš and the Tatra Mountains. The course starts in Niedzica on Lake Czorsztyn, crosses mountainous terrain, and finishes at the summit of Kasprowy Wierch. The event is aimed mainly at experienced athletes, but amateurs can also test their skills on this extreme course. Tatraman combines sporting competition with beautiful views and highland hospitality.

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą
description: The 8th Dycha nad Wisłą is an annual road race held in Tczew and forms part of the 9th Kociewie Running Grand Prix. The race attracts runners from various regions and offers a scenic route along the Vistula. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: X Jubileuszowy Charytatywny Cross
description: The 10th Anniversary Charity Cross-Country Run and Nordic Walking event in Iwonicz-Zdrój is an annual sporting event held at Dietl Square in Iwonicz-Zdrój. The event combines a cross-country run and a Nordic walking march, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in this beautiful spa town. This anniversary edition attracts participants of different age groups and ability levels. The organizers invite everyone to take part and emphasize the event’s charitable nature.

name: XVI Bałtycki Maraton Brzegiem Morza
description: The 16th Baltic Seaside Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, both of which follow the coast, offering exceptional views and atmosphere. The event attracts runners from various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: XXIX Bieg Miodobrania Kurpiowskiego
location: Kurpiowska Kraina nad Zalewem Wykrot, Wykrot, Poland
description: The 29th Kurpie Honey Harvest Run is an annual 10 km race on a certified course, running from Myszyniec to Kurpiowska Kraina by the Wykrot Reservoir. The event is held and organized by the Myszyniec Municipal Athletics Club. The program also includes shorter accompanying races for children and young people. The start and finish are located at Kurpiowska Kraina, and participants can expect professional timekeeping and an awards ceremony for the winners. The race has a family-friendly, regional character, promoting physical activity and local Kurpie culture.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Starts in Myszyniec and finishes at Kurpiowska Kraina by the Wykrot Reservoir
Accompanying races for children and young people over distances from 200 to 1,200 m
additional: The race office and finish are at Kurpiowska Kraina, 1 Miodobrania Street, Wydmusy. The race starts in Myszyniec, and participants are transported by coach from the car park next to Karczma Kurpiowska. The timing chip is issued at the race office and must be returned after the race. The children’s accompanying races take place in the car park next to Karczma Kurpiowska. Competitors from the Myszyniec municipality and those in the 65–69, 70–74, and 75+ age categories receive a 50% discount on the entry fee when paying by traditional bank transfer. The children’s races cover distances of 200, 400, 800, and 1,200 m.

name: Piąteczka dla każdego
location: Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Poland

name: XVII Maraton Pieszo i Rowerem Dookoła Lubina
11 Bieg po Oddech

tiers.description: Dla dzieci i młodzieży do lat 17 włącznie. Pakiet z koszulką

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Dla dzieci i młodzieży do lat 17 włącznie. Pakiet bez koszulki

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: Pakiet dla chorych na mukowiscydozę. Pakiet z koszulką

description: The 11th Bieg po Oddech is a charity 5 km run through the streets of Zakopane, organised to support people with cystic fibrosis. Participants start and finish in the Municipal Park, and the event is accompanied by a family picnic with games and competitions. Every participant receives a special T-shirt and medal, and all proceeds support rehabilitation and treatment for people with the condition. The run promotes physical activity as an important part of everyday therapy, as well as social inclusion.
course_highlights: The 5 km route passes through the scenic streets of Zakopane
Start and finish in the Municipal Park
Family picnic with games and competitions after the run
additional: Electronic timing is provided by S-Time. Refreshments are served to participants after the run. A charity family picnic with games and competitions takes place in the event village. Race packs include T-shirts and medals. Virtual participation is available.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: The Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY is an extreme winter half marathon and quarter marathon held in the picturesque terrain of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The Cold Half is a challenging half marathon with Jurassic climbs and forest trails, a true test of character for runners. The Chilly Quarter is a shorter distance for runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts, offering a technical course and a unique winter-adventure atmosphere. The event takes place in December weather, further highlighting its distinctive character.
course_highlights: Jurassic climbs and forest trails
A technical course with picturesque scenery
Winter weather and challenging terrain
additional: Starts: Cold Half (21 km) at 10:30, Chilly Quarter (11 km) at 10:40, and the 11 km Nordic Walking event at 10:45. The finish closes at 13:05; results are announced and awards presented at 13:10. Partners and sponsors include Gmina Łazy, the Sports and Recreation Centre in Łazy, Under Armour, and Decathlon. GPX course files are available. Race office and phone contact: +48 664 715 931.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
location: Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II, Szczecin, Poland
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon and 10 km race is an annual sporting event held in Szczecin, combining competition with the chance to discover the city’s most beautiful sights. The course runs through central Szczecin, including Wały Chrobrego and Wojska Polskiego Avenue, offering participants exceptional views and comfortable running conditions. The start and finish are located at John Paul II Jasne Błonia Square. Runners can choose their distance during the race: 10 km or a half marathon on a single PZLA-certified loop.
course_highlights: The course runs through central Szczecin and Wały Chrobrego
The route includes Wojska Polskiego Avenue, Szczecin’s longest street
Start and finish at John Paul II Jasne Błonia Square
additional: Runners can choose their distance (10 km or half marathon) during the race at the distance selection point, approximately 9.6 km into the course. The course is marked every 1 km. Time is recorded electronically using chips in the race bibs. Two race pack options are available: basic and extended, the latter including a Ventus technical shirt.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held on the shores of historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim and a fast, flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań. The run finishes at Enea Stadium, where a special sporting atmosphere awaits, with the finish line on the pitch at Lech Poznań Stadium. This exceptional event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swim in the calm, warm waters of Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon
A flat, fast bike course through villages and the western part of Poznań
A run finishing at Enea Stadium, with the finish line on the pitch at Lech Poznań Stadium
additional: The race starts in a rolling-start format. The finish line and race village are located at Enea Stadium and the Poznań International Fair. The race offers qualification slots for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. Participants must be at least 18 years old on race day.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is an intimate series of trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The event is open to runners of all ages, offering a variety of distances and formats, and bringing the running community together through a spirit of passion, competition, and friendship. The organizers prioritize safety, high-quality event organization, and an environmentally friendly approach.
course_highlights: Trail routes in the scenic regions of Podlasie and the Lublin area
Carefully marked trails with refreshment stations on longer distances
A time limit of around 2 hours for the main distances, with electronic timing
additional: The race package includes a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, electronic timing, a free race bib with a chip valid for the entire season, medical support, refreshment stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography, and awards in age-group and open categories. Registration is also available on race day until 08:40. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited.

name: Półmaraton Buski
description: The half-marathon course passes prominent hotels and sanatoriums, the scenic Spa Park, and charming promenades, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The time limit for completing the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes, allowing both experienced runners and amateurs to finish at a comfortable pace. It’s a great opportunity to test your abilities and join the sporting celebration in Busko-Zdrój.
course_highlights: The course passes prominent hotels and sanatoriums in Busko-Zdrój
Run through the scenic Spa Park and charming promenades
Time limit of 3 hours and 30 minutes for the 21.0975 km distance
additional: Mass start from the Municipal Stadium. The course is available to download in GPX format for Suunto and Garmin devices. The 3-hour-and-30-minute time limit runs from the start to the finish.

name: VII Maraton od Zmierzchu do Świtu
Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin and the final event of the Leśne Piątki season. The course runs in the opposite direction to usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in various age groups and disciplines. The race takes place on the Karnieszewice Forest District’s educational forest trail, amid scenic natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Course on the Karnieszewice Forest District’s educational forest trail
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
The course runs in the opposite direction to usual, offering a fresh experience
additional: Race numbers with timing chips can be collected from the race office on the day of the event. Participants can compete in the running race, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories. The race is part of the Tour Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, where participants can accumulate kilometres throughout the year. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in the main classifications, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories.

name: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3
description: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3 is a night race covering 10 km, held in Jelcz-Laskowice. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for autumn races. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different ability levels so everyone can prepare for the race optimally. The event is aimed at runners who enjoy the atmosphere of night running and sporting competition.

name: X Srebrna Dziesiątka
description: Srebrna Dziesiątka is an annual road race in Olkusz, organized since 2016 in memory of the distinguished coach Kazimierz Chechelski. The event combines sporting competition with bringing the local community together and promoting an active lifestyle. Participants can choose from several distances suited to different ability levels, and the course runs through the city streets, starting and finishing at the stadium. The race is also an opportunity to have fun together and motivate people of all ages and abilities to stay active.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of Olkusz, starting and finishing at the stadium
Distances: 10 km main race, 5 km accompanying race, 5 km Nordic Walking
The course passes along, among others, Parkowa, Żuradzka, Mazaniec, and Starowiejska streets
additional: The Kazimierz Chechelski Memorial for the youngest participants is held as part of the event. The event offers commemorative medals and prizes for the top finishers. The course is marked, and the race office runs efficiently. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings together runners from Olkusz and the surrounding area. Information about the previous edition lists the start and finish at the stadium at 12c 29 Listopada Street in Olkusz, and a 90-minute time limit for the main race. These details may change for the 2027 edition.

name: RAWki na Surowo
description: RAWki na Surowo is a mountain trail race held in the magical Bieszczady Mountains, taking runners across the scenic alpine meadows of Mała and Wielka Rawka. The 29 km course with 1,550 m of elevation gain passes through Bieszczady National Park, requiring the race to be held without aid stations or course markings. The event is certified by ITRA and UTMB and is part of the MTrail Running Series. The start and finish are in Wetlina, and the race follows a self-supported format, emphasizing its rugged character.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
description: The International Race Walking Festival in Gdańsk is a prestigious sporting event that brings together competitors of different ages and skill levels. The festival features race walking events over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, including the Polish Masters Championships and the Polish U23 Championships. The event also promotes physical activity among people with disabilities, offering wheelchair races and FrameRunning events. The festival also includes the open “Walk with the Postman” and the Defenders of the Polish Post Office Run, creating a sporting atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Race walking events over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km for different age categories
Polish Masters and U23 Race Walking Championships
Competition and activities for people with disabilities: wheelchair races and FrameRunning events
additional: Defenders of the Polish Post Office Energa Cup. The event promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by organizing parallel events adapted to their needs.

name: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Chojnik Karkonoski Running Festival is a mountain running event held in the scenic Karkonosze Mountains, in Sobieszów. The festival offers a variety of distances, from an educational family run to a challenging 102 km ultramarathon with over 5,000 metres of elevation gain. The routes feature rocky descents, forest trails and mountain peaks, offering unforgettable views and challenges for runners of varying abilities. The event brings people together and promotes running as a team sport, as well as nature education in Karkonosze National Park.
course_highlights: 102 km ultramarathon with over 5,100 m of elevation gain
Scenic routes through Karkonosze National Park, with rocky descents and forest trails
A range of distances, from an 8 km family run to 71 km and 42 km races
additional: The start and finish of all races are located near Chojnik Castle in Sobieszów. The ultramarathon has a 20-hour time limit, and the half-marathon a 7-hour limit. A wide range of food options and an expo area are available during the festival. The educational family run features learning stops and questions to test participants’ knowledge. Mandatory equipment for the ultra and half-marathon includes, among other items, a phone with roaming, a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket and a course map. Participant limits are set for each distance (e.g. 100 for the ultra and 375 for the half-marathon).

name: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny
description: The Olkusz Street Run VII Silver Ten is an annual running event organized by the Olkuszbiega Association, the Olkusz City and Municipality Office, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Olkusz. The races take place over 10 km (main race), 5 km (companion race), and a 5 km Nordic walking route, with the start and finish at the Market Square in Olkusz. The route follows streets with asphalt and some cobblestone surfaces, is marked every 1 km, and has an intermediate time check at 5 km. Runners use a chip timing system, and the time limit for completing the race is 90 minutes. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation for all age groups.
course_highlights: The 10 km route consists of two 5 km loops, with asphalt and cobblestone surfaces
The route is marked every 1 km, with an intermediate time check at 5 km
Refreshment point at around 6 km of the main race
additional: The participant limit is 300. Verification and race-pack collection take place on 6 and 7 September 2024. Chip timing device is attached to the shoe. The route is partially closed to vehicular traffic until 16:30. Underage participants must have written consent from a parent or guardian. A bag drop is available at the Race Office.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: The Praski Half Marathon is an annual night half marathon held in Warsaw, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The route passes through the picturesque districts of Praga, offering a unique night-running atmosphere in the heart of the city. The event is well organized, with timing and extensive facilities for participants. The event also includes the Praska 5K Run, welcoming runners of varying experience levels.
course_highlights: A night run through the streets of Warsaw’s Praga district
Picturesque views of historic neighborhoods
Professional timing and start zones
additional: The event also includes a 5 km race, the Praska 5K Run. Customer service is available Monday to Friday, 9:00–18:00. The route and event program for 2027 will be announced closer to the event.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The XLVI Usedom Marathon is a unique race connecting two countries and offering unforgettable moments surrounded by nature. The route leads from Świnoujście along Europe’s longest seaside promenade, through the historic Kaiserbäder, coastal forests, and on to Wolgast. Runners will experience a variety of surfaces and landscapes, from asphalt and cobblestones to forest paths, with views of the Baltic Sea and a fresh sea breeze. The race starts at 9:00 in Świnoujście and finishes at Peene-Stadion in Wolgast, offering a unique sporting and maritime experience on the island of Usedom.
course_highlights: The route follows Europe’s longest seaside promenade
Varied surfaces: asphalt, cobblestones, and forest paths
Crossing the German-Polish border and views of the Baltic Sea
additional: Baggage transport to the finish stadium is provided. Time limits: runners must pass the Kölpinsee checkpoint (km 21.8) within 2:30 h and Zinnowitz (km 30) within 3:30 h. Runners who exceed the limits are withdrawn from the course and transported to the finish. After the time limits, there is no course support or refreshment stations.

name: I Mistrzostwa Śląska Osób z Niepełnosprawnościami
V Bieg Pamięci Ofiar Bombardowania Węzła Kolejowego
XIV Grand Prix Nordic Walking Nowa Wieś Lęborska
14 Tyski Półmaraton
description: The 14th Tychy Half Marathon is a 21.0975 km race certified by the PZLA. It runs through the streets of Tychy and around Lake Paprocany. The start, finish, and race village are located at the Tychy Athletics Stadium. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the city’s sporting spirit, and offers numerous activities, including children’s races, massages, and sports demonstrations. The course was modified in 2022 to reduce the number of uphill sections, making it more participant-friendly. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Tychy and has been growing in popularity since 2012.

name: Festiwal Sportowy im. Kazimierza Bubuli 2026
organizer: LKS Markam Wiśniowa – Osieczany, LKS Lubomir Wiśniowa oraz Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Wiśniowej
description: The Kazimierz Bubula Sports Festival in Wiśniowa is a special sporting and community event taking place on September 5, 2027. The program includes races at two distances: Wiśniowa Run (5 km) and the mountain Bieg Trzech Wysp (15 km), along municipal roads and hiking trails. In addition to the races, the festival features sports tournaments, roller-skiing competitions, and activities for children, making it a family-friendly event full of sporting excitement. Participants can look forward to attractive cash prizes and commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Wiśniowa Run — a fast, challenging 5 km course along municipal roads, partly closed to motor traffic
Bieg Trzech Wysp — a 15 km mountain race along municipal roads and hiking trails in the Grodzisko/Księża Góra/Ciecień massif
The courses are properly marked and secured
additional: The awards ceremony will take place at 3:00 p.m., followed by cross-country races for children. Cash prizes in the OPEN categories for women and men: 1st place — 700 zł, 2nd place — 400 zł, 3rd place — 300 zł. Additional prizes of 200 zł will go to the top residents of Wiśniowa Municipality in both races. Everyone who finishes within the time limit will receive a commemorative medal. A prize draw for goods will be held after the races. The race office is located in the gymnasium of the Primary School in Wiśniowa. The race pack includes a race bib, medal, meal voucher, and bag for depositing belongings.

name: Perly Malopolski Szczawnica Pieniny
description: Perły Małopolski Szczawnica is a mountain running event held in the picturesque Pieniny Mountains. The course runs through varied terrain, offering participants exceptional views and challenging climbs. The event is part of the Perły Małopolski series, attracting runners who value being close to nature and sporting competition. Szczawnica is an excellent start and finish location, providing good organization and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain course in the Pieniny Mountains with views of picturesque landscapes
Varied climbs and descents on natural trails
Start and finish in Szczawnica, a popular spa town

name: 26 Eco Półmaraton Wałbrzych
description: The 26th edition of the Toyota Eko Half Marathon Wałbrzych is one of the most important running events in the region and the country, attracting runners from all over Poland. Following last year’s organizational success and record attendance, the event once again confirms its strong position on Poland’s sporting map. Participants gave the half-marathon course very high ratings, and the unique atmosphere created by Wałbrzych’s supporters gives the event its unmistakable character. We warmly invite you to take part or cheer on the runners.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
location: Obliwice, Nowa Wieś Lęborska, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: We invite you to the 44th International Open Cross-Country Race for the Forest Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, which will take place in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two 3.2 km loops, with the start and finish in the same place. The event has a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for the whole family amid nature. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and a track and field athlete, and also promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.

name: Bieg KoBBiet
description: Bieg KoBBiet is an annual race held in Bielsko-Biała. In 2026, it will take place on September 6 at the Municipal Stadium. The event is dedicated to the memory of Ewa Szymanek-Płaska, Head of the Education and Sports Department at the Bielsko-Biała City Hall. This year’s race supports children on the autism spectrum, and registration will open at 10:00. The race is held under the honorary patronage of Jarosław Klimaszewski, Mayor of Bielsko-Biała.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on an easy asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual levels and offer support from experts. The event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere and is ideal for those who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running.

name: Wiśniowa Run
organizer: LKS Markam Wiśniowa – Osieczany, LKS Lubomir Wiśniowa oraz Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Wiśniowej
description: Wiśniowa Run is a 5 km race held as part of the Kazimierz Bubula Sports Festival in Wiśniowa. The course is fast but challenging, and runs along municipal roads that are partially closed to car traffic. The event combines sporting competition with community spirit and a family-friendly atmosphere. In addition to Wiśniowa Run, the 15 km mountain Bieg Trzech Wysp is also held, followed by cross-country races for children after the main races. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes, commemorative medals, and a draw for prizes.
course_highlights: 5 km course along municipal roads that are partially closed to car traffic
15 km mountain race along municipal roads and hiking trails in the Grodzisko/Księża Góra/Ciecień massif
Courses are clearly marked and secured
additional: Cash prizes in the OPEN classification: 1st place: PLN 700, 2nd place: PLN 400, 3rd place: PLN 300. Commemorative statuettes are also awarded for 1st–3rd place in age categories. An additional classification is available to residents of Wiśniowa Municipality, with a PLN 200 prize for the fastest woman and man across both distances. A draw for prizes takes place after the competition. Everyone who finishes within the time limit receives a commemorative medal.

name: XVIII Bieg Koguta
description: The 18th Rooster Run is a 10 km race held in Oława. The event is organized by the Oława Running Group in cooperation with local institutions, and participants can expect professional timekeeping. The race office will be open both the day before the race and on race day, making it easier to collect race packets. The race is open and welcoming to runners of varying experience levels.

name: Bieg na Rowerze - Rower na Biegu
VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Bieg Neptuna
location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
distance_verbose: 159 km, 79 km, 56 km, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 is a mountain trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Table Mountains, near Radków Reservoir. The courses pass through rocky mazes, technical trails, and beautiful rock formations such as Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały. The event attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners, offering a range of distances and a unique atmosphere close to nature. Radków is an ideal place for a sporting adventure and a chance to recharge amid nature.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines sporting excitement with tangible support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place throughout Poland, encouraging participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and support. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
description: Bieg 7 Dolin is a 100 km mountain ultramarathon held in the scenic Sądecki Beskids, starting and finishing in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The course follows challenging mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and a chance to connect with nature. The race is part of the Running Festival, which combines sporting competition with promoting the region and an active lifestyle. The time limit for completing the course is 19 hours, and aid stations and drop bags are available along the route. It is a challenge for experienced mountain runners looking to take on demanding but beautiful terrain.

name: IX Bieg o Puchar Miasteczka Siewierz Jeziorna
description: The 9th Race for the Siewierz Jeziorna Town Cup is an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Siewierz. The race attracts runners from various categories, offering the chance to compete on courses suited to different levels of experience. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and connect with the local community.

name: 5 Aktywna Piątka

A Family Run for children and young people up to 15 years old is also part of the event, making it appealing to whole families.

The event is a great opportunity for running enthusiasts to enjoy an active day and compete in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers ensure participants’ safety and the smooth running of the event.

A road race in the center of Złotów
Scenic views and safe conditions on the course
additional: The race takes place over two 5 km loops. The organizer works with the relevant services to ensure the safety of runners, pedestrians, and drivers. The ZCAS office is located at al. Mickiewicza 18 in Złotów.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting automotive events held at the Poznań race track. Participants can compete, train, and take part in qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motoring enthusiasts and also offers the option to rent cars and take one-to-one lessons with instructors. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of motorsport and hone your skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Poznań race track with professional facilities
Opportunity to take part in various rounds and qualifying events during the 2026 season
Training options and one-to-one lessons with instructors

The entry package includes participation by one team member, the option to take part in a co-drive (age >17), full catering, individual timing, and instructor-led training options. To confirm participation, payments must include the required wording in the payment reference.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are annual running events held in Środa Wielkopolska. The event combines sporting competition with bringing together the region’s legal community. It attracts both professionals and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively outdoors. Registration for the run is now open, and participants can expect a well-organized event with a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: The course runs through the scenic areas of Środa Wielkopolska
The run combines competition with bringing together the legal community
Held annually and backed by a long-standing tradition

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
description: Vistula Trail is a mountain trail race held in Wisła, offering a variety of distances, from short routes for beginners to demanding long-distance races. The routes follow scenic Beskid trails, with significant elevation gain and beautiful views. The event has a friendly atmosphere and welcomes both experienced runners and amateurs looking to spend time outdoors. The start and finish are located in the center of Wisła or in Ustroń, and the time limits allow for a comfortable race.
course_highlights: 40 km distance with 1,800 m of elevation gain, starting at 07:00 in Wisła
16 km route with 1,000 m of elevation gain, starting at the lower station of the Czantoria Rope Ski Resort
Shorter distances of 6 km and 4 km, with demanding climbs and fast descents
additional: The time limit is 9 hours for the 40 km route, 7 hours for 26 km, and 4 hours for 16 km. The races start on Sunday, 12.09.2027, except for the 4 km distance, which starts on Saturday at 13:00. The routes pass through the Czantoria Nature Reserve and the area around Bukowa Mountain. Children’s age categories include distances from 150 to 1,000 m. The race office is located in Wisła.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course runs along the city’s main avenues, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a special prestige. The race has an official course certification, attracting runners focused on a fast pace and setting personal bests. It’s an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in scenic urban surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km course through the center of Częstochowa
Route passes near Jasna Góra
Officially certified course
additional: A structured training plan tailored to the 10 km distance is available.

name: Bieg na Skałę
description: Bieg na Skałę is a unique sporting event that combines physical activity with the natural beauty of this picturesque region. The race route follows charming paths and hills through Ojców National Park, offering participants stunning views and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky sections, and steep climbs. The race is a challenge for experienced runners and an opportunity for beginners to embrace the spirit of adventure and enjoy the fresh air. After the race, participants can look forward to commemorative medals, prizes, and numerous activities, including games and contests for children.
course_highlights: Route through Ojców National Park with beautiful views
Varied terrain: forest trails, rocky sections, steep climbs
Activities for children: bouncy castles, entertainers, contests with prizes
additional: Three race distances are available: the Bieg po Pstrąga Ojcowskiego (8 km), with team rankings and a prize for the top resident of Skała Municipality; the Bieg Szlakiem Skał i Dolin (15 km), also with team rankings and a prize for the top municipal resident; and children’s races over 100 m (ages 2–5, unranked), 800 m (ages 10–11), and 1,300 m (ages 12–15). The entire event takes place in a friendly, sporting atmosphere.

name: Chyża 10
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a popular 10 km race organized by the Chyży Nowotomyski Running Club in Nowy Tomyśl. The course is fast and popular with participants, and the race takes place in a friendly atmosphere. It also counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix. The race is scheduled to start at 9:00, making for comfortable racing conditions. The organizers warmly invite runners to this event, which brings together a passion for sport and the local community.
course_highlights: A fast course popular with runners
A 10 km race in Nowy Tomyśl
Counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix
additional: The race office is open from 07:00 to 08:30 on race day. Winners’ awards ceremony at 10:45. The race is co-funded by the Municipality of Nowy Tomyśl and Nowotomyski County.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Północy XI Maraton Bieg Czterech Latarni
location: Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event held on the Hel Peninsula, combining tradition with fresh energy. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a race for children and teenagers—the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. The course passes through scenic spots in Hel, Jastarnia and Rozewie, and participants get to run surrounded by four lighthouses, making this race unique in Poland. It is an excellent choice for runners of all abilities who want to combine sport with the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: The course runs along Puck Bay, with views of the sea
Passes four lighthouses: Hel, Jastarnia and two in Rozewie
Scenic landscapes of the Hel Peninsula and the coast
additional: The marathon relay races have been cancelled due to too few registrations. The marathon course is available to download in GPX, KML and TCX formats. The Władysławowo Municipality Resident Card can be used for discounts on entry fees. The Little Lighthouse Keeper Run is for children and teenagers up to 14 years old.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The 15th DAMAK Tarczyn Half Marathon is a family celebration of running held in Tarczyn. Participants can look forward to a certified half-marathon course, a wonderful atmosphere, and sporting excitement in a welcoming, family-friendly setting. The event attracts runners from a range of backgrounds, offering memorable experiences and a community of running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Certified half-marathon course measuring 21.097 km
Family-friendly atmosphere and a wonderful race-day experience
Sporting excitement and a chance for runners to connect
additional: The race office is located at 8 Szarych Szeregów Street in Tarczyn. The event takes place annually in September, with the start at 10:00. The program also includes the 5 km Tarczyn Run and races for children and young people.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The race takes place on scenic routes in the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The event brings people together and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the spirit of sobriety. The marathon has a long-standing tradition, and the organizers ensure a welcoming atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Kozienice Forest
Scenic forest trails and natural surroundings
The race takes place near Jedlnia-Letnisko
additional: Medals can be personalized during the event for a nominal fee of 10 PLN. The organizer is the “Biegiem Radom!” Association, which promotes running and physical activity in the region. The event is a forest cross-country race and traditionally takes place in September.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów in Running is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cyclists’ Association, taking place on September 12, 2027. The event features two distances: a 10 km main race and a 5 km accompanying race, both run around the Żyrardów Reservoir. The course is flat and consists of laps around the reservoir, offering scenic views and favorable conditions for fast times. Participants receive race numbers with chips, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also take part in the 10 km race. The event promotes physical activity and a welcoming sporting atmosphere in the city of Żyrardów.

4 laps for the 10 km distance and 2 laps for the 5 km distance
A flat, scenic course that favors fast times
additional: Race numbers with chips can be collected at the race office on race day. The event base (start, finish, and parking) is located by the Żyrardów Reservoir, 17 Ziołowa Street.
