Maraton 3 Jezior / Three Lakes Marathon
description: The 3 Lakes Marathon is a mountain running festival held in the scenic Beskid Mały region, in the Soła River valley. The main distance is an ultramarathon of approximately 43 km with around 2,485 m of elevation gain, taking runners through the highest parts of the Beskid Mały Mountains, with beautiful views of three lakes and the surrounding mountains. The course combines challenging climbs and technical descents, giving participants the chance to discover both the region’s wild nature and its historic sites. The event takes place during the beautiful transition from summer to autumn, adding to the charm of the route and its surroundings.

name: 23 Przejście Dookoła Kotliny Jeleniogórs...
description: The Hike Around the Jelenia Góra Valley is one of Poland’s best-known long-distance hiking events, held since 2004. Participants cover a route of approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Valley, crossing the Karkonosze, Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains and Izera Mountains. The event commemorates GOPR rescuers. The entry fee includes race materials, a souvenir, a hot meal and a certificate. The challenging route has approximately 5,500 m of elevation gain, and participants have a 48-hour time limit to complete it.

name: 3 Backyard Ultra Zagłębie
description: Backyard Ultra Zagłębie is a unique ultramarathon run on a 6.706 km loop around Pogoria 3 Lake in Dąbrowa Górnicza. Runners start every hour, and the last person to finish each lap continues running until only one winner remains. The course combines varied surfaces—asphalt, dirt and forest paths, and a beach section—requiring both endurance and technical precision. The event is the final of the Polish Backyard Ultra League and attracts fans of extreme challenges from across Poland.

The website features reports, photos, and results from previous editions, highlighting the event’s growing popularity and record attendance.

The course is a single 21.097 km loop, entirely on asphalt and certified by the PZLA, with markers every kilometre and refreshment and checkpoint stations. Runners have a time limit of 3 hours, and after the race they can personalise their medals with engraving. The event is an excellent opportunity to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the scenic Gontyniec massif. Runners cover as much distance as possible, with fully equipped aid stations after each loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, beautiful views of the Noteć Valley, and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It’s a special experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable memories.

The start and finish are in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the participant limit is 250. The race is part of the Run in Sopot series, which also includes beach races.

A steep climb up Łysa Góra and varied terrain with switchbacks

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

The event is organized by the Łęka Opatowska Municipality, the Wieruszów Municipality, and the Municipal Sports and Tourism Centre in Wieruszów. The race is open and runner-friendly, with a scenic route along the Red Oak Avenue. The race office will be open on event day from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing will be electronic. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and attractive race-day conditions.

It follows a single loop, starting and finishing at 3 Międzyrzecka Street. The event promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, offering participants professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race has a time limit of 3 hours and provides hydration points and a recovery meal at the finish.

Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking event on the same route. The event is charitable in nature and is coordinated by the Active People Association “Biegnij Oławo” and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the event is scheduled to start on December 20, 2026. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.

name: Festiwal Górski Maraton Trzech Jezior
description: The Three Lakes Mountain Marathon Festival is a unique running event in the picturesque region of the Beskid lakes, featuring four distances: the 3.5 km Czupel Vertical with 600 m of elevation gain, a 43 km marathon, 21 km, and 17 km. The routes pass through the wild mountain terrain of the Little Beskids, offering participants beautiful views, varied terrain, and a chance to connect with nature and the region’s history. The event brings the running community together and promotes an active lifestyle as well as the area’s tourist and cultural attractions. The races take place, and the main marathon is an ultramarathon with challenging climbs and technical descents.

It’s a day full of energy, smiles, and friendly competition, ideal both for runners chasing a result and for those looking to spend their time actively.

The event also features a 5 km race and races for children, creating a sporting atmosphere for the whole family. The organizers provide professional support and an appealing schedule, welcoming both recreational and experienced runners.

The start and finish are on the illuminated pitch at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can enjoy a spectacular show featuring lasers, music, and light effects. The course runs through the city and features cheering points with music and fire shows, creating a one-of-a-kind nighttime atmosphere. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and the race office opens at 9:00, with the run starting at 10:00. Advance registration and an entry fee are required. It’s a great opportunity to end February actively and head into the upcoming spring season with renewed energy.

The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon, and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by the PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a great opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.

It is organised by the Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Association and the “Dolina Małej Panwi” Circle of the Society of Friends of the Forest.

The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: XXI Mikołowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 21st Henryk Biskupiak Mikołów Street Race is the biggest sporting celebration in Mikołów and takes place annually. The street race attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and the spirit of sporting competition. Participants can take on a route through the city streets, while the organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere full of sporting excitement. The event is an excellent opportunity to bring the local community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, with 5 km and 10 km routes. The course runs mainly along paths and forest tracks, with one significant uphill section, combining sport with the chance to discover the history of the Kraków Fortress. After the race, participants can explore historic fortifications and sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a guide, making this event a unique combination of physical activity and history education. The organizers are members of the Adventure Association, who have been involved in organizing sporting and adventure events for years.
course_highlights: Cross-country route along paths and forest tracks
One substantial uphill section
Guided tour of historic Kraków Fortress sites after the race
additional: After the race, participants and their companions can take a guided tour of historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a professional guide. The top finishers receive unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks. The running routes are off-road and green, with history in the background. Guided tours of sites of the former Kraków Fortress are available after the race. Information about the distances, route and location comes from previous editions.

name: VIII Bieg Szlakiem Kolejowym
location: Czerwona Woda, Gmina Węgliniec, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to a large field, with start corrals based on declared finish times, and also offers the option of taking part in four-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timing, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as raising the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Start corrals based on declared finish times
additional: The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish times (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race pack includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timing, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration is online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and young people are also available.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a special running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The course passes through the capital’s most beautiful and historic locations, offering unique views and an unforgettable atmosphere. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, while spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that brings together sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start beneath the Palace of Culture and Science in the centre of Warsaw
The course passes along Krakowskie Przedmieście and Nowy Świat, over Poniatowski Bridge with views of the Vistula, and by PGE Narodowy
Road closures ensure safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The race number must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. The start and finish are in the city centre, near metro stations. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions and cheering zones, as well as a programme at the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the #BiegamDobrze charity programme with a free race number. Races include a 10 km event (Warszawska Dycha) and the Mini Marathon for children and young people, held during the same weekend. Registration is available through the official website, and the event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km race. The organisers provide attractions and support for participants.

name: 21. Kamień Extreme - Rybnik
description: The 21st Kamień Extreme is a challenging mountain race held in Rybnik, attracting fans of extreme running challenges. The event offers professional timing using RFID technology. It is organized by MOSiR Rybnik, ensuring smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere for participants. The race starts at 12:00, and registration closes at 23:59.

name: 1 Półmaraton Ostrzeszowski
description: The Half Marathon on the Crown of the Wielkopolska Hills is a unique race held in picturesque Ostrzeszów. The half-marathon course takes runners over two hills and past two springs, offering participants distinctive views and off-road challenges. It’s a great opportunity to tackle a demanding course and enjoy a sporting adventure in the heart of Wielkopolska. Runners are invited to take part and celebrate sport and nature together.
course_highlights: The course takes runners over two hills
It passes by two springs
Picturesque landscapes of Wielkopolska

name: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa
description: The 16th Paweł Lorens Memorial Run is an annual 10 km race held in Tychy, commemorating the outstanding runner Paweł Lorens and his contributions to the development of athletics in the region. The course follows scenic paths around Paprocany Lake. It is flat and fast, making it favorable for good results. Free children’s races are also held on race day, with registration available that day. The event is organized by the Przyjaciele Tyskiego Sportu group in cooperation with MOSiR Tychy and other local partners.
course_highlights: 10 km course around Paprocany Lake
Flat, fast course on packed paths and a paved sidewalk
Scenic views of the lake and Paprocany recreational areas
additional: Free children’s races are held on race day, with registration available that day.

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The series consists of eleven stages, held mainly in Podlasie, with routes of varying difficulty suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The races are non-commercial and have a limited number of participants, helping ensure safety and respect for local communities and the environment. The series offers two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), as well as a Nordic Walking competition. The 2027 season finale will take place on September 26 in Michałowo.
course_highlights: Trail routes of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Routes marked with colored arrows (green on a yellow background for Szpurt, red for Wertep)
Races take place in the scenic regions of Podlasie and the Vilnius Region, with respect for nature and local communities
additional: Runners start in waves based on results from the previous season. Time limits are approximately 2 hours for the shorter distance and 2 hours 15 minutes for the longer one. The race package includes a race bib with a chip, a hot recovery meal (including a vegetarian option), refreshment stations along the route and at the finish, medical support, a commemorative medal (for those who register in advance), and race photography. Registration is available on race day until 08:40, though the race package may be incomplete. The organizer allows the entry fee to be transferred to another date at no additional cost before online registration closes.

name: X Półmaraton Crossowy
description: The 10th Cross Half Marathon is a trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Jelcz-Laskowice. The half-marathon course crosses varied terrain, offering participants a challenge and the satisfaction of overcoming natural obstacles. The event attracts runners who value being close to nature and competing in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course crosses rugged terrain with natural obstacles
Scenic landscapes around Jelcz-Laskowice
Varied woodland and field terrain

name: XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie
description: The 28th Małkinia Autumn Runs is an annual running event held in Małkinia Górna, attracting running and Nordic walking enthusiasts from across the region. The route follows scenic forest paths near the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre, offering participants a unique sporting experience and a chance to connect with nature. The event brings people together and promotes an active lifestyle among different age groups. The organizers ensure a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Scenic forest paths around the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre
Route suited to runners and Nordic walking participants
A regional event with a long-standing tradition
additional: The event takes place near the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre in Małkinia Górna. It brings together runners and Nordic walking participants. The organizer is the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre in Małkinia Górna.

name: Festiwal Biegowy i Nordic Walking
location: Olszewo-Borki, Ostrołęka County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

Nowotarski Półmaraton
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XII Zielona Wierzchosławicka Dycha
location: Wierzchosławice, Tarnów County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: ACE BATTLE RUN:  ACE BATTLE Mile indywidualni zawody rankingowe na dystan...
description: ACE BATTLE RUN is an innovative tactical team running format held over one mile (1609 m) at Podskarbińska Stadium in Warsaw. The competition combines individual qualifying with team competition, where individual and team results contribute to the official runners’ ranking. The 2027 season features exciting head-to-head matchups and competition for a place in the ACE BATTLE Mile City League Warsaw. Runners can compete solo or in teams, earning levels and ratings in the ACE BATTLE RUN system.
course_highlights: One-mile distance (1609 m) on a stadium track
Individual and team competition with an official ranking
Exciting team matches in a tactical format
additional: The competition consists of three stages: individual qualifying, a team race for an ABR level, and an ACE BATTLE Mile team rating. Teams earn an official rating, and each participant becomes an ABM athlete. After the season, teams with a rating compete in head-to-head matches in the ACE BATTLE Mile City League Warsaw. Results and photo galleries from past events are available online. The official website lists Podskarbińska Stadium as the venue for the ACE BATTLE RUN format. The program also includes a briefing, team roles, and prizes.

name: Baran Trail Race
description: Baran Trail Race is a recurring running event held in scenic Węgierska Górka. The event offers a range of distances from 10 km to 100 km, along challenging mountain routes with beautiful views and natural terrain. It attracts both amateurs and experienced runners, offering unique challenges and an exciting atmosphere. The organizers ensure the event runs professionally and participants stay safe.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Biegnij Warszawo is one of Poland’s most recognisable running events, bringing together thousands of participants every year in the heart of the capital. The race takes place on the first Saturday in October and features a 10 km route through Warsaw’s most iconic locations. The FUNRUN format welcomes everyone, regardless of age or experience, focusing on the joy of movement and having fun without the pressure of competition. Participants can look forward to music zones, crowd support and comprehensive medical cover along the route.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Warsaw’s most atmospheric and iconic locations
Music zones and crowd support along the entire route
The route is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and is beginner-friendly
additional: The race pack includes a Nike Dri-FIT T-shirt with a commemorative print, a race bib with a timing chip, gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. There is a hydration station halfway along the route, and the organiser provides comprehensive medical cover. The participant limit is 10,000.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Czerwonce Włościańskiej, Czerwonka Włościańska, Poland
description: The Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazowieckiej is a 5 km race held in the picturesque village of Czerwonka Włościańska. The start and finish are at the Primary School in Czerwonka, and the route follows National Road No. 60 between Maków Mazowiecki and Różan. The event is organized by local sports clubs and institutions, and participants can expect professional organization and an awards ceremony for the winners. The race is open to people over 18 and to younger participants with the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: A 5 km route along National Road No. 60
Start and finish at the Primary School in Czerwonka Włościańska
Picturesque surroundings of the Masovian Lowland
additional: The participant limit is 200 race packs. Registration and race-pack pickup take place at the race office on the school sports field in Czerwonka from 08:30 to 10:00. An awards ceremony for the winners and an event wrap-up are scheduled after the race.

name: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę
description: The 13th Run up Makowica is a 10 km mountain race held in the picturesque town of Rytro in the Lesser Poland Voivodeship. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a challenging course with uphill sections. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels to help participants prepare optimally for race day. The event is small and welcoming, appealing to runners who value being close to nature and sporting competition.
course_highlights: A 10 km mountain course
Picturesque views around Rytro
The challenge of the climbs up Makowica
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. There is also an opportunity to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026
distance_verbose: 104 km, 81 km, Maraton, 23 km, Półmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 9 km, 5 km
description: JuraRun 2026 Running Festival is a unique trail-running event held in the heart of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, in Podlesice. Participants can choose from a range of distances, from short children’s races to demanding ultramarathons that follow scenic forest trails, limestone rock formations, and the upland’s hills. This event is for lovers of sport and nature, combining a passion for running with the chance to discover the beauty of the region. JuraRun is also an opportunity to meet people with similar interests and enjoy an unforgettable running adventure.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the scenic landscapes of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Limestone rock formations and forest trails of varying difficulty
Distances range from 100 metres for children to an ultramarathon of over 100 km
additional: Starts take place in waves, including the JuraRun Night 10+ night race at 21:00 and the JuraRun ULTRA 100+ and ULTRA 80+ ultramarathons at 23:00. The race office is open from Friday at 17:00 until Saturday at 13:30, with registration closing at different times for each distance. The event also includes a 12 km Nordic walking event and children’s races starting at 100 metres. Places for each distance are limited, and race packages are available at different times.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Silesia Marathon 2026
description: Silesia Marathon is the largest running event in Silesia, and in 2026 it will take place as a three-day running festival. Participants can choose from a range of distances, including the marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, and 10 km and 5 km races. The finish line is at the iconic Silesian Stadium, adding a unique touch to the event. It’s not just a competition, but also an unforgettable experience and a celebration of the running community.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The Poznań Marathon is the 25th-anniversary edition of the city’s premier 42.195 km marathon, held in the heart of Poznań. The route runs along the city’s most important streets, including a return to the Old Market Square after 18 years, as well as scenic locations such as Sołacki Park, Malta and Enea Stadium. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and enthusiastic spectator support. Organizers have prepared a new, attractive course and a rich accompanying program, including children’s races and shorter distances.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Old Market Square, Ratajskiego Square and Wolności Square
Runs through the scenic areas around Malta and Sołacki Park
Finish at Plac Marka, at the Poznań International Fair
additional: The start for wheelchair athletes is at 8:55, and for runners at 9:00. Start corrals are assigned according to the declared marathon finish time and marked with colored stripes on race bibs. The participant limit is 8,000. The race office is open October 2–3 at the Poznań International Fair.

name: II Radomski Bieg Onkologiczny
description: The 2nd Radom Oncology Run is a sporting event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association in Radom, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The run is charitable and inclusive, welcoming people of different ages and running abilities. The organizers emphasize community and support for people affected by cancer, combining sport with an important social mission. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Radom and welcomes both runners and fans of physical activity.

name: Wild Run
description: Wild Run is a charity race held in Wrocław at the Wrocław Zoo. Participants can run the 10 km distance or take part in a virtual race on a route of their choice. The event supports the protection of endangered animal species and promotes physical activity and a family-oriented lifestyle. It is organized for nature lovers and runners of all ages, and also features races for children and teenagers.
course_highlights: The main course is a loop of approximately 5 km inside the Wrocław Zoo, completed twice
The option to take part in a virtual race on a route of your choice
Accompanying races for children and teenagers over approximately 1 km and 100 m
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 12:00 to 15:00 at the zoo ticket offices, and on Saturday at Decathlon Magnolia from 15:00 to 20:00. Entry to the zoo is with a single-entry ticket, which participants receive when collecting their race pack. The first 1,000 participants in the in-person race will receive a special canvas bag. The extended pack offers the option to purchase technical T-shirts and a quick-dry towel, and to support the Zoo Wrocław - DODO Foundation.

name: Botaniczna Piątka - edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczna Piątka, Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland

name: Bieg o Puchar Wójta Mikołajki Pomorskie
II Korczyński Półmaraton Górski XI Korczyński Bieg i Nordic Walking "Do Prządek"
description: The 2nd Korczyna Mountain Half Marathon and the 11th Korczyna “Do Prządek” Run and Nordic Walking event take place in the scenic surroundings of the Czarnorzecko-Strzyżowski Landscape Park. Participants can choose between running distances of 21 km and 6 km, or a Nordic Walking route, putting their fitness and endurance to the test amid beautiful scenery. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the region’s natural attractions, bringing together the local community and sports enthusiasts. It is organized by the Municipal Cultural Centre in Korczyna, with the involvement of numerous partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Czarnorzecko-Strzyżowski Landscape Park
Available distances: mountain half marathon (21 km) and 6 km run
Scenic landscapes and the region’s natural attractions
additional: The event is organized by the Municipal Cultural Centre in Korczyna. Around 120 people take part. Medals and prizes are presented by representatives of local government and partner organizations. Cooperation with volunteer fire brigades and volunteers supports the event. Partners include the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Krosno, Kołaczyce Forest District and local schools.

name: 30 Bieg Przełajowy o Nóż Komandosa
location: Stadion Miejski w Lublińcu, Lubliniec, Poland
description: The “O Nóż Komandosa” Cross-Country Race is an annual running event held in Lubliniec, attracting numerous military, police, and sports teams. The race is a cross-country event on a challenging course. Its tradition spans many years, as reflected in the high turnout and participants’ commitment. The race is held under the honorary patronage of Bishop Wiesław Lechowicz, the Military Ordinary of Poland, underscoring its standing and significance. The event also has a charitable and community-building dimension, and reports and photos from previous editions are available online.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with varied terrain
High turnout and participation by military and police teams
Honorary patronage of Bishop Wiesław Lechowicz, the Military Ordinary of Poland
additional: Results and reports from previous editions are available online. Numerous military and police teams take part in the race. The event has a charitable and community-building character.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Warsaw’s Młociński Park. The races are recreational and sporting events that promote physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall standings. Races take place during the season from October to April, with the main race starting at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests or urban parks
A race in the natural surroundings of Młociński Park in Warsaw
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race bibs and chips are collected on race day. The entry fee on race day is PLN 60. A season pass also allows one free start in a city other than the main location, provided the participant applies by email in advance. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants (born 2008–2010) may take part with parental consent. The race schedule is fixed and also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children. The Warsaw races for the 2026/2027 season are scheduled for October 10, November 21, January 16, and March 20; the start is at 11:00.

name: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka
description: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka is a 13 km trail race held in the scenic area around Chrząszczyce. The course follows local roads and crosses a military training area between Chrząszczyce, Domecko, Opole-Winów and Górki. The event promotes a healthy, active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation. Alongside the individual race, it also features relay races, a uniformed services category and a family team orienteering challenge. The start and race office are in Chrząszczyce, and the participant limit is 300.

name: 12. PKO Cracovia Półmaraton Królewski
description: The 12th PKO Cracovia Royal Half Marathon is a prestigious half marathon held in historic Kraków, combining sporting competition with the unique atmosphere of a city with a thousand-year tradition. The certified 21.0975 km course runs through Kraków’s picturesque streets, with the finish line inside the impressive TAURON Arena Kraków, making for an unforgettable finish. The race is part of the Royal Running Triad and the Polish Half Marathon Crown, attracting thousands of participants from around the world. The event is known for its high participation and international character, as well as record-breaking performances by runners from Africa and Poland.
course_highlights: Certified 21.0975 km course
Finish line in Poland’s largest indoor sports and entertainment arena, TAURON Arena Kraków
Kilometre markers and water stations along the course (around the 4th and 13th km)
additional: The Race Office and Expo will be open on 9–10 October and on race day, 11 October, until 9:00. Starts are assigned by declared finish time. The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours. It will not be possible to join the race after the start gate has closed.

name: Dobromiejski Festiwal Biegów i Nordic Wa...
location: Swobodna, Gmina Dobre Miasto, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Piwna Mila
location: Wąsowo, Kuślin, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Beer Mile is a unique race over a flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres and the main event on the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start immediately after drinking a beer, and beer stations are placed along the course approximately every 500 metres. Runners must drink the beer at each station. This sporting celebration brings together runners, spectators and families, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a special finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: Flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres
Beer stations approximately every 500 metres
The race starts after runners drink their first beer
additional: 9:30–10:30. The race bib must be pinned to the front of your clothing and must not be altered. You can order a T-shirt when paying for your race bib in the Runner’s Panel. Photos from the event will be available after the race.

name: UltraKotlina
description: UltraKotlina is a series of mountain ultramarathons held in the Jelenia Góra Valley and surrounding areas. The races offer a variety of distances from 15 km to 144 km, along scenic trails and through the wilderness of the Western Sudetes. The courses feature significant elevation gain and challenging terrain, with the finish in Szklarska Poręba. Organizers provide bus transport to the start lines and a rich programme of accompanying events, including talks and workshops. UltraKotlina is an excellent opportunity to combine extreme running with mountain tourism and to bring the running community together.
course_highlights: Courses pass through the main mountain ranges of the Jelenia Góra Valley
Significant elevation gain, e.g. 5,541 m over the 144 km distance
Scenic views and course marking with reflective white tape and directional signs
additional: Race packets can be collected at race headquarters or just before the start. The organizer provides buses from the finish to the start. The race office operates at different locations and times depending on the distance. The course is marked with special tape bearing the UltraKotlina logo and directional signs. A GPX track will be available to download from the website about 2 weeks before the race. As part of UltraKotlina Week, talks and workshops are held, including sessions on supplementation and mountain safety.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
location: Skrzeszewo, Gmina Żukowo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Friendship Run is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Skrzeszewo, giving participants the chance to spend time actively and discover the charms of Kashubia. The series attracts runners of different ages and abilities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in a natural, welcoming environment
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful wooded settings of city parks and forests. In Poznań, the course loops around Lake Rusałka, starting near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the municipal beach on the lake. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to more experienced runners, who can compare their results on the same course over the years. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the municipal beach on Lake Rusałka
Suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants under 16 may take part with the consent of a parent or guardian. The series also includes races for children and young people.

name: Pielgrzymi Półmaraton o Memoriał Jana Pawła II
X Festiwal Biegów Rodzinnych Cała Oleśnica Biega
Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
location: Luzino, Wejherowo County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Dębowiec Nocna Pętla
description: Dębowiec Night Loop is a mountain run on the slopes of Dębowiec in Bielsko-Biała. The route follows forest trails from Dębowiec to the Wapienica Valley and back. The approximately 8 km course includes a steep climb beneath the Dębowiec chairlift. After the run, participants can enjoy a bonfire and a meal at the Dębowiec 520 mountain shelter. The event also includes an approximately 4 km Nordic Walking march starting at the lower station of the Dębowiec chairlift. It’s a great way to spend an active October evening in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: An 8 km route along forest trails from Dębowiec to the Wapienica Valley and back
A steep climb beneath the Dębowiec chairlift
Finish at the Dębowiec 520 mountain shelter, with a bonfire and a meal
additional: Runners must bring a headlamp. The first three finishers in the Open categories and the first three women will receive vouchers for sports equipment. Special prizes are planned for the oldest male and female participants. All participants will receive a race pack, a medal and a meal at the finish. A bonfire will be held after the run at the Dębowiec 520 mountain shelter. A free Nordic Walking march of approximately 4 km will take place at the same time; advance registration is required via the Decathlon GO website.

name: IV Wilczy Półmaraton
location: Uroczysko Głębokie Doły, Nadleśnictwo Rybnik, Poland
description: The IV Wilczy Half Marathon is a race organized by the ZATYRANI Association, taking participants through the scenic Wilcza nature reserve. Runners can expect professional organization, including timing provided by LESZY.RUN and race-pack collection upon presentation of a QR code. The half-marathon course has water stations and a special WK DZIK Sprint Bonus at the 14th kilometer. The race also promotes the #17milionów social campaign, supporting children with cerebral palsy.
course_highlights: The course runs through a nature reserve
WK DZIK Sprint Bonus at the 14th kilometer
Water stations at kilometers 6 and 19; no disposable cups are provided, so bring your own
additional: Race packs are issued only upon presentation of a QR code. Bib numbers are reusable and must be returned after the race. No disposable cups will be available on the course or at the finish; participants should bring their own cup or soft flask. Three official parking areas are available to participants. Timing and race communications are handled through the LESZY.RUN system.

name: Rajd Waligóry
description: Rajd Waligóry is an orienteering cycling rally that combines adventure, physical activity, and great fun outdoors. Participants receive a map with checkpoints to find in any order, using their ingenuity and navigation skills without GPS. The rally takes place in the scenic area around Bochnia, offering challenges for cycling and navigation enthusiasts. It’s a great opportunity to test your skills and have fun in the fresh air.
course_highlights: A cycling route with checkpoints to find
Scenic areas around Bochnia
Navigation without GPS, using only a map and compass
additional: Participants receive a map marked with checkpoints and must confirm they have reached them using a control punch. GPS navigation is prohibited, ensuring a true adventure and requiring a good strategy. The winner is the person who finds the most checkpoints within the allotted time and does so the fastest.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. The races take place on forest trails around the park’s highest elevation, Dziewicza Góra. Participants can choose from 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. The event brings together runners of different ages and ability levels, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely on forest trails
The route climbs twice to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the highest point in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park
The route passes through the event center after approximately 3.7 km, where spectators can cheer on the runners
additional: The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30 in the building of the Łopuchówko Forest District Education Center. Children’s races start between 9:00 and 9:45, over distances of 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m. The 5 km race starts at 10:50, the 10 km race at 11:00, and Nordic Walking at 11:02. The participant limit is 500. After leaving the forest, runners finishing the race should head to the left side of the balloon marked Finish; 10 km runners pass under the Finish balloon and continue for a second loop.

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: The 52nd Dębno Marathon is the oldest and one of the fastest marathons in Poland. The 42.195 km course, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), runs through the streets of Dębno and the surrounding area, offering ideal conditions for personal bests. The event has a rich tradition dating back to 1966 and attracts both amateur and professional runners from Poland and abroad. Participants can expect professional organization, numerous refreshment stations, and enthusiastic support from spectators. The marathon is also an opportunity for the running community to come together and a celebration of sport for the whole family.

name: 12. PKO Półmaraton Gliwicki
description: The PKO Gliwice Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gliwice since 2014. It has grown in popularity as a local initiative promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The half-marathon route runs through the city’s scenic streets, with the start and finish at PreZero Arena Gliwice. Participants have 3 hours to complete the distance and can expect professional event management and support along the route. The event is part of a larger health and sports festival that attracts runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Start and finish at PreZero Arena Gliwice
The route runs through the streets of Gliwice
The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours
additional: The race office is located at PreZero Arena Gliwice. Race packs can be collected on the Saturday and Sunday before the race. Water and music points are available along the route. The event also includes the Health Festival and the Poho50 running races for different age groups. The time limit for completing the half-marathon distance is 3 hours from the start.

name: 10 Półmaraton Lubelski
description: The 10th Lubelski Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Lublin, attracting runners from across the region. The half-marathon course runs through the city streets, offering participants dynamic and fast sections. The event is part of Lublin’s running calendar for the 2026 season and is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the running community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of Lublin
Dynamic and fast sections
Picturesque urban scenery
additional: The event is part of the 2026 Grand Prix of Lublin. Lublin’s running calendar features many events, and the half marathon is one of the season’s major races.

name: Wartko!... bez Gaszowice
description: WARTKO!... bez Gaszowice is an annual 10 km race organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Gaszowice. The event attracts people who enjoy an active lifestyle and promotes sporting competition in scenic surroundings. The race takes place in October and is growing in popularity, offering participants professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Scenic areas of Gaszowice
Professional timing
additional: Race packs can be collected at the race office in the Culture and Sports Centre. Open running and Nordic walking training sessions are also held on the WARTKO! course. Traffic disruptions may occur on race day.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
description: The XVII Puck Region Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in a new format under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. Held in autumn, it offers a refreshed course and a unique atmosphere, serving as the final event in the Puck Running Triad. It’s an ideal opportunity to end the running season on a high note, competing in the half marathon or shorter races and Nordic walking events. The organizers provide participants with comprehensive information and support, including the event schedule, course maps, and baggage-drop areas.
course_highlights: Refreshed half-marathon course measuring 21.097 km
Autumn atmosphere and the final event in the Puck Running Triad
Additional 5 km race and 5 km Nordic walking event
additional: Race office open 15:00–20:00 and 7:00–9:00 on race day at MOKSiR Puck. Baggage drop available 8:00–13:00. Start times: half marathon 10:00, 5 km race 10:05, 5 km Nordic walking 10:07. For children: Mini Kids Run (approx. 400 m) and Mega Kids Run (approx. 800 m) after the half marathon. Winners’ awards ceremony at 13:00.

name: 40. Bieg Barbórkowy o Lampkę Górniczą – Sztafeta Międzyzakładowa
XII Otwarty Bieg Uliczny i Marsz Nordic Walking
Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: 149 km, 102 km, 69 km, 46 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: Łemkowyna Trail is a mountain race along a route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering a range of distances from 10 km to a 150 km ultramarathon. The course features substantial elevation gain and challenging natural terrain, making it a test for trail running and mountain adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation changes of up to +5860 m and -5970 m on the longest distance
A range of distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Participant limits for individual distances range from 300 to 550. Each distance has a time limit. The event takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation gain. Courses include elevation gain of up to 740 m for the 30 km race and the 150 km ultramarathon, with time limits of up to 35 hours. Online registration is available, with options to receive a refund of the entry fee and transfer race packages.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Wrocław’s Osobowicki Forest. The event is recreational and competitive, promoting physical activity in nature and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall rankings. The main race starts at 11:00. The event is open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part under parental supervision.
course_highlights: The 5 km route runs through the urban forest of Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław
A cross-country race in a natural setting, through forest and parkland
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. A season pass allows participants to enter all four races in a given city. Season-pass holders may also take part in one race in another city free of charge, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, and the event ends at around 12:15. Cars cannot access the start area or race office; parking is available along Osobowicka Street.

name: XXIII Bieg śladami ks. Józefa Londzina
Sopot Półmaraton
description: PKO Sopot Half Marathon is an annual running event held in the seaside city of Sopot, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half marathon course runs through the city’s picturesque streets, offering exceptional views and the atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, adding a distinctive character and sporting spirit to the event. It is also an opportunity for families to celebrate sport together, with numerous accompanying races for different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A seaside course through the streets of Sopot
Finish line at ERGO Arena—a unique place to cross the finish
The atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city, attracting runners and spectators
additional: The event also includes accompanying races such as the Half Marathon Relay, the 5 km Run, and races for children and juniors. The race pack includes a medal and other merchandise. The finish at ERGO Arena provides a unique atmosphere and comfort for participants. The organizer also offers the “Run, Be Ready” training plan for those preparing for the race.

location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night road race in Koszalin, offering three distances: 7 km, a half marathon, and a marathon. The course runs through the city streets, with the start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium. The race has official PZLA certification, ensuring accurate course measurement and the possibility of setting records. The event has a one-of-a-kind atmosphere, with a laser start at 2:00 a.m. highlighting its unique nocturnal character. Participants can expect excellent organization, attractive prizes, and keepsakes.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course, confirming accurate measurement
A loop of approximately 7 km, completed multiple times depending on the distance
Start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium in Koszalin
additional: The race starts at 2:00 a.m. with a laser start. The race office for children and young people is located at the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall. The course runs through the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. After each distance, children receive gifts and prizes directly at the stadium. The course is undulating, and runners can rest at the stadium, which the loop passes through.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale running event held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The marathon course runs through woodland and rural areas, offering runners peace and a chance to connect with nature, with a distinctive point on the loop at Napoleon’s Stone. The race has a friendly, sociable character, without the pressure of competition or crowds, fostering a welcoming atmosphere and a chance to run the miles together. The organizers, including local runner Arek Tołłoczko, take care of course markings and participants’ comfort. In 2024, a series of four marathons on this course is planned, taking place at different times of the year.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km course through forests and picturesque fields
A loop featuring the distinctive Napoleon’s Stone as a landmark
Every kilometre marked, with the start and finish on Polna Street
additional: A 7 km running route laid out and marked by the Harcownik Running Club from Jelcz-Laskowice; convenient parking; no crowds and a relaxed atmosphere without the pressure of competition; a planned series of four marathons in 2024, held in winter, spring, summer and autumn. Earlier editions included a series of four marathons corresponding to the seasons.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
description: The Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Dolnej Doliny Wisły is an annual running event held in Tczew County. The event features two races: a PZLA-certified marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. The routes pass through the scenic Vistula Valley, over a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces, with traffic restricted during the race. The start and finish are located in Tczew, and the event attracts runners from various regions, offering professional organization and clearly marked routes.
course_highlights: A PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
A 21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals; traffic is restricted during the race
additional: The participant limit is 400 paid entrants. The marathon starts at 09:00 at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew; the half marathon starts at 11:00 at the Primary School in Małe Walichnowy. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon course is PZLA-certified; the half marathon course is not. The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals.

name: XLIV Perła Paprocan
description: Perła Paprocan is a marathon held around Lake Paprocany in Tychy on a 7 km loop. Participants can choose any distance by completing multiples of the loop, up to a full marathon. The event is recreational and intended for training, with no need to declare a distance in advance, and every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish. The organizers emphasize that the atmosphere and sense of community among runners matter more than competition. Tychy is the only city in Poland where a marathon is held twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of those editions.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop around Lake Paprocany
Paved surface (more than 50%), as well as compacted paths and forest trails
A refreshment point with drinks, fruit, and sweets after each loop
additional: A race number may be collected by a third party with written authorization. Participants under 18 must have consent from a parent or guardian. Valuables can be left in storage, labeled with the race number.

description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice, in the municipal forest behind Piast Stadium. The approximately 4.2 km course follows forest tracks, gravel paths and sections of asphalt. The events aim to promote healthy, active ways to spend time outdoors. Participants can choose between 1 and 5 laps, covering distances from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon. The event is amateur and welcoming, with individual and team classifications, and the option to take part in the online e-Prowokacja.
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course on forest tracks, gravel paths and asphalt
Start and finish on the clearing near Piast Stadium in Gliwice
Choose between 1 and 5 laps (from 4.2 km to a half marathon)
additional: Events take place once a month on Saturdays. The time limit for running and Nordic Walking is 3 hours; e-Prowokacja has no time limit. Participants can enter either the running or Nordic Walking event; switching disciplines requires a new registration and race number. A refreshment station with drinks is available after each lap. After the event, participants receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a chocolate bar in a prize draw, if sanitary regulations allow. Race numbers are valid for the whole year and must be returned after the event. The organizers maintain individual endurance and team classifications. For the edition described by MZUK, the event office opened at 9:00 and the start was scheduled for 10:00. Advance registration and payment of the entry fee were required to be included in the classification.

description: Gorlice Mountain Run is a two-day running event held in the picturesque Low Beskids, near Radocyna and Sękowa. The event features three distances: 7 km, 24 km, and a Vertical race up Magura Małastowska. The courses feature significant elevation gain and beautiful views, while participant numbers are strictly limited to ensure an intimate atmosphere. The organizers provide professional race services, awards ceremonies, and cash prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: 24 km course with 610 m of elevation gain
8 km course with 160 m of elevation gain
2.3 km Vertical with 340 m of elevation gain up Magura Małastowska
additional: Participant limits: 24 km – 250 people, 8 km – 150 people, Vertical – 150 people. Start and finish for the 7 km and 24 km races at the State Forests Recreation Center in Radocyna; the Vertical starts at Magura Ski Park / Małastów. Time limits: 5 hours for the 24 km race and 1 hour for the Vertical. Refunds of the entry fee are available until 31.10.2027, and race packages may be transferred to another person until the same date.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide cross-country running series covering 5 km and held in seven locations, including the Tricity (Gdańsk and Gdynia). The races take place in forests and urban parks, giving participants the chance to compete outdoors in a natural setting. The series consists of four races at each location, with results combined for the overall standings. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the appropriate permission. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Tricity location: Gdańsk Forest District, Tricity Landscape Park near the Gdańsk University of Physical Education and Sport
Regular schedule and consistent race-office locations
additional: A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. The race office opens at 8:30; race numbers and timing chips can be collected on race day. Participants with a season pass can take one free start in another city after notifying the organizers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start. In the 2026/2027 season, CITY TRAIL races in the Tricity are held in Gdańsk and Gdynia.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, free running and Nordic walking league held on the scenic routes of the Międzyzdroje Municipality. In the 2026/2027 season, participants compete over distances of approximately 5 and 10 km in the running events, and 5 and 7 km in Nordic walking. The league is known for its friendly, family atmosphere and healthy competition, welcoming both returning participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete at least four events at the required distances. The events are open to people over 14, and participation is free.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 5 and 10 km for runners
Routes of approximately 5 and 7 km for Nordic walkers
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participation is free. Participants must be at least 14 years old; minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must enter and complete at least four events at the required distances (two 5 km and two 10 km running events, or two 5 km and two 7 km Nordic walking events). The series includes several events during the season; participation in at least four is required for the overall standings. Registration is handled through ProTiming24. Participant age: 14 and over; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian.

name: VII Bieg Chrystowskich dla Niepodległości
location: Tłokinia Kościelna, Gmina Opatówek, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: 10 Bieg Niepodległości z wąsem
description: The Wrocław Independence Day Run with a Mustache is an annual running event held on November 11 to commemorate Poland regaining its independence. Participants can choose the PZLA-certified 10 km distance or the accompanying 5 km run. The start and finish are at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, and the course passes through scenic areas along the Oder Canal and the Chrobry Bridges. The event is open to all and promotes physical activity and patriotism among city residents.
course_highlights: The PZLA-certified 10 km course is one loop around the Olympic Stadium.
The 5 km course runs along the Oder Canal embankments and the Chrobry Bridges.
The start and finish are at the Pergola at the Olympic Stadium.
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Olympic Stadium in the days leading up to the race and on race day. The pack includes a race bib, a race wristband, a stick-on mustache, a Nose Up strip, kabanos sausages, a calendar, and a medal. A technical T-shirt and a race bib belt are available for purchase. The race takes place on closed roads; traveling by tram is recommended. Time limits: 90 minutes for 10 km and 45 minutes for 5 km. There is a hydration and refreshment station on the course.

name: 14. PKO Bieg Niepodległości w Rzeszowie
description: The 14th PKO Independence Run in Rzeszów is an annual running event organized by the Rzeszów Biega Running Club. The 10 km main race takes place on November 11 and promotes an active lifestyle and running in Rzeszów and the Podkarpackie region. Participants compete in various age categories, and everyone receives a commemorative medal at the finish. The organizer provides a race pack, including a T-shirt, bib number, and chip, as well as the option to have the medal engraved.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
Classifications by age and special categories (e.g. doctors, top Rzeszów residents)
Participants must wear the organizer’s T-shirt (white or red)
additional: The participant limit is 3,500. On race day, race packs are available only at the race office; payment is by cash. Medal engraving is available for an additional fee of PLN 30. Participants compete at their own risk and must have a valid medical certificate or submit a declaration of fitness to participate.

name: 36. Bieg Niepodległości w Warszawie
location: al. Jana Pawła II, Warsaw, Poland
description: The 36th Independence Run in Warsaw is a classic 10-kilometer road race that brings together thousands of participants each year to actively celebrate Independence Day. The course is fast and ideal for setting personal bests, with the start and finish at Jana Pawła II Avenue. Alongside the main race, there are also events for children and young people over the symbolic distance of 1,918 meters, and a Nordic Walking march of approximately 6 kilometers. The event combines sporting competition with a patriotic atmosphere and a shared celebration.
course_highlights: A 10 km course through the streets of Warsaw, starting and finishing at Jana Pawła II Avenue
A fast course conducive to personal bests, almost unchanged for years
The symbolic 1,918 m Independence Mile for children and young people
additional: On race day, the race bib must be worn on the front of the outfit, and participants must line up in the appropriate start zone based on their predicted finish time. The organizers provide spectator zones and activities for participants and their loved ones near the start and finish. Press accreditation is also available, with limited access to the start and finish zones. A Virtual Independence Run over 10 km is available for those who cannot be in Warsaw.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
description: The Poznań Independence Run – I Love Poland! is a cross-country race held in picturesque locations in Poznań, particularly in Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of the activities of a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, with an emphasis on attractive courses and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension and takes place on 11 November, combining sport with a celebration of Poland’s independence. Runners are invited to take part in a range of distances amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
A patriotic race held on 11 November
additional: The organiser is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014 and specialising in cross-country races. The race takes place in the green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Triad. Participant limit: 750; picturesque courses; cross-country races.

name: 9 Olsztyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Olsztyn Independence Run is an annual patriotic sporting event held in Olsztyn, combining the joy of running with the celebration of Poland’s Independence Day. The event takes place at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and includes 5 km and 10 km races, Nordic walking, and children’s races of up to 400 metres. The event is open to everyone, from experienced runners to whole families with children, creating an atmosphere of community and patriotism. The main race is scheduled to start at 9:00, and places are limited, so registration is online.
course_highlights: The race routes run through the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and along nearby streets: Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska
Available distances are 5 km and 10 km, as well as Nordic walking
Children’s races on short routes of up to 400 metres
additional: The start and finish are located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre. The event also includes Nordic walking and children’s races. Traffic disruptions are expected along the race route.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run with PGZ Naval Shipyard is an annual running event held in Gdynia to commemorate Poland regaining its independence. The event attracts thousands of participants who come together to celebrate the run’s patriotic spirit. The route passes through charming parts of the city, and participants can expect professional organization and a festive sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route passes through central Gdynia
The event takes place in November to commemorate National Independence Day
A patriotic atmosphere and sporting camaraderie among residents
additional: Photos and video footage are taken during the event to promote events organized by GCS and the Municipality of Gdynia.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
location: Władysławowo–Rozewie–Jastrzębia Góra, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 2nd Polish Legions Run commemorates the anniversary of Poland regaining its independence and offers two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The route passes through the scenic locations of Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra. Transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The 10 km race starts by the General Haller monument in Władysławowo, while the 5 km race starts by the bust of Marshal Piłsudski in Rozewie. The race office is open on the days before the run, and the course is available online to view.
course_highlights: The route passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra
The 10 km race starts by the General Haller monument on Morska Street in Władysławowo
The 5 km race starts by the bust of Marshal Piłsudski on Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on the day before the run and on race day at specified times and locations.

name: XXXVIII Goleniowska Mila Niepodległości o Puchar Burmistrza Gminy Goleniów
description: The Goleniów Independence Mile is an annual road race held in the Gmina of Goleniów to commemorate Poland regaining its independence. The event attracts strong interest from the local community and runners from the region. The race course is one mile long, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A one-mile course (approx. 1,609 meters)
A road race in central Goleniów
An event commemorating Poland regaining its independence

Its aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition and community integration. Residents of the county who turn 16 in 2025 may participate. Women and men are classified separately, and participants earn points based on their finishing places in each race. The entry fee for each race is set locally, while participation in the Grand Prix is free.
course_highlights: A series of five 5 km races
Organized by all the municipalities of Kościan County
Points-based classification combining results from the individual races
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; you only pay the entry fee for each race, as set by its local organizers. Women and men are classified separately, with no age categories. Guaranteed prizes for the top six women and top six men, plus additional special prizes from the organizers of individual races.

name: XXIV Maraton Odrzański
description: The XXIV Odra Marathon is a race held in Kędzierzyn-Koźle and organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation. The event includes two categories: a full marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. It is a sporting and recreational event, partnered by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. The race office operates on the days leading up to the race and on race day, providing support for participants.
course_highlights: Marathon and half-marathon courses in Kędzierzyn-Koźle
Organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation
In partnership with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre
additional: 7:00–8:30. Contact the organizers by phone: Piotr (+48) 500 028 811, Piotr (+48) 604 589 483, Ania (+48) 602 534 780. Electronic timing; 6-hour time limit to finish. The event includes both a marathon and a half marathon and takes place in November in Kędzierzyn-Koźle.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The races take place in beautiful woodland surroundings by Lake Szmaragdowe, with a course suitable for both beginners and advanced runners. Each race is an opportunity to test yourself on the same course, and results from individual races count toward the series standings. The organizers promote outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland beside Lake Szmaragdowe
A varied course profile with climbs and descents, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
The start and finish are located behind Zajazd Szmaragd, at ul. Kopalniana
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The main race starts at 11:00. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. Participants can collect their race number and timing chip at the race office on race day. A pass for the entire series entitles the holder to one free start in another city in the series, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Registration is available online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. The main race is open to participants aged 16 or older, or those who turn 16 in 2026; CITY TRAIL Junior is also held alongside the event.
