description: The 2nd Mazovian Autumn Run is an annual race held in Staroźreby. Participants can compete in the 10 km race, and a 400-metre run is available for the youngest runners. The event is open to everyone and offers attractive prizes, medals, and the opportunity to take part in both the main race and the children’s races. The race takes place on urban and park routes, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km route on asphalt and through park areas
400-metre children’s run
Medals and prizes for participants
additional: Online and on-site registration; the event also includes a programme for children and adults, with the schedule and details available on the organiser’s website.

name: X Koszęcińska Dycha
description: The anniversary 10th Koszęcińska Dycha is a special race held in Koszęcin that attracts runners from various places. Its anniversary edition highlights the event’s special significance and atmosphere. The race follows a 10 km course, giving participants the chance to test their fitness in scenic surroundings. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain, providing an attractive and varied course
Anniversary edition, highlighting the event’s long-standing tradition
Local sporting event that brings together the Koszęcin municipality community
additional: The event is held as a race over a distance of approximately 10 km, with strong involvement from the local community and broad participation.

name: Piekło Czantorii
location: Dolna stacja Kolei Linowej Czantoria, Ustroń, Poland
description: Piekło Czantorii is a challenging mountain race held in Ustroń, featuring courses with a range of distances and elevation gains. Participants can choose from five courses ranging from 10 to 94 km, with substantial elevation gains of up to 7,900 m. The start and finish are at the lower station of the Czantoria Cable Railway and the Hotel Poniwiec ski station. The event attracts fans of ultra and trail running, offering a unique end-of-season challenge.
course_highlights: Courses ranging from 10 km to 94 km, with elevation gains from +1,100 m to +7,900 m
Start and finish at the lower station of the Czantoria Cable Railway and the Hotel Poniwiec ski station
Time limits ranging from 3 to 19 hours, with limits for individual loops and different start groups
additional: 19:00 and 22:00 for the Lucyfer 94 km distance). Time limits vary by course and include limits for individual loops on some distances. The start and finish location is the lower station of the Czantoria Cable Railway and the Hotel Poniwiec ski station in Ustroń. Bestyjka 10K starts at the Hotel Poniwiec ski station at 107 Akacjowa Street; the other distances start at the lower station of the Czantoria Cable Railway. The organizer publishes time limits for the courses and selected loops.

name: 6 Półmaraton Kocich Gór Kocur
description: The 6th Kocie Góry KOCUR Half Marathon is a mountain half marathon held in Oborniki Śląskie. The event is organized by the Oborygeni Running Group Association, which provides comfortable start and finish facilities at 9 Parkowa Street. The course covers challenging terrain and features three aid stations, while a hot recovery meal awaits runners at the finish. Participants have access to changing rooms and portable toilets, supporting smooth organization and a welcoming race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain course with aid stations at 6 km, 13 km, and 16 km
Start and finish at 9 Parkowa Street in Oborniki Śląskie
Hot recovery meal for participants at the finish
additional: There are three aid stations along the course with water, fruit, and snacks. A hot recovery meal is served at the finish. Two changing rooms (women’s and men’s) and portable toilets are available at the start and finish. Race packets can be collected on November 19 and 20 from 18:00 to 20:00, and on November 21 from 8:00 to 9:30. Packets can be picked up at 9 Parkowa Street in Oborniki Śląskie: November 19 and 20 from 18:00 to 20:00, and November 21 from 8:00 to 9:30.

name: Botaniczna Piątka – Gdynia, edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczny Ogród w Gdyni, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Autumn Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places special emphasis on the scenic appeal of its courses, offering picturesque and attractive surroundings for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and join a close-knit running community. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part in the autumn edition of the event in Gdynia.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque courses in Gdynia
Courses with scenic appeal and a natural character
Organized with passion and experience since 2014

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Warsaw’s Młociński Park. The races take place in wooded areas and urban parks, promoting outdoor physical activity. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both local and overall rankings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with permission from their guardians. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Located in Młociński Park in Warsaw
A series of four races per season
additional: Participants can purchase a pass for the entire race series in a given city. The entry fee on race day at the race office is 60 zł. The race office opens at 8:30; race numbers and chips can be collected on race day. In Warsaw, the warm-up is at 10:30 and the main race starts at 11:00. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with permission from their guardians. Online registration is available through the CITY TRAIL website; the regulations also allow registration at the race office on race day. CITY TRAIL Junior races are also held as part of the series.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. Events offer a range of distances: 5 km and 10 km races, Nordic walking, and shorter races for children and young people. The course runs through forest terrain and climbs twice to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the park’s highest point, providing challenging, mountainous conditions. The event brings runners and sports enthusiasts together in a family-friendly atmosphere, with a participant limit of 500.
course_highlights: The course is entirely on forest trails and follows a 5.15 km loop
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The race centre and spectator support are located after approximately 3.7 km
additional: Children's races start between 9:00 and 9:45, over distances of 200m, 500m, 1000m and 1500m. The 5 km race starts at 10:50, the 10 km race at 11:00, and Nordic walking at 11:02. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30 in the Łopuchówko Forest District Educational Centre building. Runners in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. After leaving the forest, the finish-area layout separates runners finishing the race from those continuing for a second lap. This is the second stage of the series. Online registration closes on Thursday at 20:00.

name: LoveLas JESIENIĄ 2026
description: LoveLas JESIENIĄ 2026 is a recurring trail race held in the picturesque Sandomierz Forest in Przyłęk. Participants can choose from four distances: 10 km, 25 km, 50 km, and the legendary 100 km, offering a range of challenges from a recreational run to a demanding ultra. The routes follow natural forest paths, forest roads, and technical MTB sections, providing close contact with nature and beautiful scenery. The event is aimed at both beginners and experienced runners who enjoy the forest atmosphere and long-distance challenges.
course_highlights: Routes through the entirely natural surroundings of the Sandomierz Forest
Varied terrain: wide forest roads and technical MTB trails
Distances from a recreational 10 km forest run to a 100 km ultra
additional: Available distances: 10 km (Dycha Mondi), 25 km (LoveLas), 50 km (Bardzo LoveLas), and 100 km (Seta z LoveLasem). The routes pass through varied parts of the forest, from easy to technical sections. The event is organized in cooperation with the Tuszyma Forest District and private owners of forest plots. It is a forest ultra-trail event with a strong emphasis on being close to nature.

name: Borecka Lekuk Trail
description: Borecka Łękuk Trail is an ultramarathon held in the Masuria region, in the picturesque Borecka Forest, with its base at Folwark Łękuk. Participants can choose from four distances: 10 km, 21 km, 30 km and 45 km, taking them through varied forest and natural terrain with moderate elevation gain. The event combines sporting competition with the natural surroundings and promotes physical activity and off-season running tourism. The organizers prioritize safety and ecology and offer a wide-ranging program of side events, including conferences, an after-party and recovery activities.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the Borecka Forest over natural forest terrain
Distances with varied elevation gain, from +64m to +284m
Start and finish at Folwark Łękuk hotel, with a transfer to the start of the longest distance
additional: Mandatory equipment for the 30 km and 45 km distances includes a charged phone, drink containers, at least three energy bars or gels, a headlamp or flashlight, an emergency blanket, a head covering and a rain jacket. An after-party will be held at the Ogień i Woda Restaurant after the race. Separate races for children are scheduled for Friday, November 20. Participants must follow safety and environmental rules, including the ban on leaving litter on the course. The race office and race-pack collection will be open on November 20 at Folwark Łękuk. The organizers provide a transfer to the 30 km start near the Czerwony Dwór Forest District Office; getting to this start independently is prohibited. The 10 km distance can be completed by running or walking.

The race attracts both experienced runners and younger participants, offering sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere.

Two distances to choose from: 15 km and 5 km
An urban course suited to adult and youth runners

The race is filmed in Full HD, and an electronic clock at the finish tracks the time. The organizer provides original race bibs made of synthetic or laminated paper. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 15 km races; the event includes training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks and expert support; the race is part of a series of sporting events in the region.

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewnickie forests in Katowice. The race takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about appropriate conduct in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and members of sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewnickie forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Children and young people under 18 may participate only when accompanied by a parent or guardian. A package covering all starts during the year is available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable, but they may be transferred to the next start if the request is submitted by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the start. Running and Nordic walking events; 3-hour time limit; annual packages available.

name: 2 Bieg dla Jaj
description: The 2nd Bieg dla Jaj is a 5 km race in Poznań, scheduled for November 22, 2026. The event will take place by Lake Malta and encourages people to promote preventive health screenings for men together. Join the race and support an important health cause in a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5 km race
Route in the area around Poznań’s Lake Malta
The event combines running with promoting preventive health screenings for men
additional: Registration is available through DoStartu.

name: Biegi im. ppłk. Maksymiliana Ciężkiego
location: Pomnik Maksymiliana Ciężkiego, ul. Dworcowa, Szamotuły, Poland
description: Dycha Ciężkiego is a race commemorating Lt. Col. Maksymilian Ciężki, taking place on November 22, 2026, in Szamotuły. The start and finish are located on Dworcowa Street, respectively by the Halszka Cinema and the Maksymilian Ciężki Monument. The race starts at 11:00, and the time limit for completing the course is 1.5 hours. The event is small-scale and is not a mass sporting event.
course_highlights: Start by the Halszka Cinema on Dworcowa Street
Finish by the Maksymilian Ciężki Monument
Course time limit: until 12:30
additional: The race is not a mass event within the meaning of the Act on the Safety of Mass Events. Timing is provided by STS-Timing using highly reliable Chronotrack active chips (99.8%). The time limit for completing the race is 1.5 hours from the start. The 10 km race starts at 11:00, and the time limit is 90 minutes. The start is planned by the Halszka Cinema, and the finish is by the Maksymilian Ciężki Monument.

name: Borecka Łękuk Trail
description: Borecka Łękuk Trail is an ultramarathon held in the Masurian region, in the scenic Borecka Forest, with the start and finish by Folwark Łękuk Hotel. Participants can choose from four running distances: 10 km, 21 km, 30 km and 45 km, taking them through varied forest and natural terrain. The event emphasizes safety, ecology and bringing runners together, and also offers additional activities such as Borecka Offline and Borecka Kids. It is a great opportunity to round off the running season in a unique atmosphere amid the wild nature of Masuria.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Borecka Forest, with varied terrain and elevation gains of up to 284 m
The start and finish are by Folwark Łękuk Hotel, providing a convenient event base
Mandatory gear for the longer distances includes a headlamp and an NRC emergency blanket, highlighting the ultramarathon’s mountain character
additional: The 45 km, 21 km and 10 km races start at Folwark Łękuk, while the 30 km race starts at the Czerwony Dwór Forest District, with a transfer provided. Mandatory gear for the 30 km and 45 km distances includes, among other items, a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, headwear and a rain jacket. The time limit to reach the finish is between 4 and 7 hours, depending on the distance. An After Party will be held after the race at the Ogień i Woda restaurant. You can change your distance or transfer your fee until November 10, 2026. Race packs can be collected at the race office, where last-minute registration will also be available if places remain. The event is scheduled for November 20–22, 2026; the main races will take place on November 21, and a free 5–7 km Coffee Run is scheduled for November 22. The race pack includes, among other items, a chip-equipped bib, a medal and a tree at the finish; accommodation is not included.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks and forests. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located on Św. Wawrzyńca Street. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compare their results on the same course over many years. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and nationwide rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start and finish by the city beach at Rusałka, Św. Wawrzyńca Street
Suitable for both run-walking and fast running, and accessible to runners of all abilities
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course remains unchanged, allowing participants to compare results over the years. In the 2026/2027 season, the Poznań edition also includes races on 11 October 2026, 17 January 2027, and 21 March 2027. The series also features races for children and young people.

description: The Długa Góra Mountain Half Marathon is an autumn running event held in Gdynia, in the Tricity Landscape Park. The 21.1 km route winds through scenic moraine hills, with approximately 650 metres of elevation gain, offering challenging climbs and descents. The start and finish are located at Primary School No. 16 in Pustki Cisowskie-Demptowo. Participants can expect two aid stations along the route, a substantial finisher’s medal, and prizes for the top runners. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness amid beautiful forest scenery.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km route with approximately 650 m of elevation gain
Two aid stations along the route with water, isotonic drinks, and snacks
Start and finish at Primary School No. 16 in Gdynia, Pustki Cisowskie-Demptowo
additional: Participant limit: 450. Time limit to complete the race: 4 hours. Race packs include a returnable chip and a race bib. The route is marked with ribbons and signs every 5 km. After the race, there will be hot tea, cake, and a pasta dish provided by the sponsor. Awards will be presented to the top 3 runners in the OPEN and age-group categories. Start time: 10:30. Online registration is open through Competit until 9 November 2026; the organizer notes that registering earlier is cheaper. Registration is also available at the race office on event day.

description: Radwanice Elephant Half Marathon is a running event for everyone—from experienced half-marathoners and 5 km debutants to the youngest participants in the children’s races. The start and finish are at the ROSZARNIA Social Services Centre in Radwanice. The half-marathon and 5 km courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). Runners can expect electronic timing, medical support, and a commemorative medal featuring a unique elephant design. Organizers also offer the option to purchase a technical event T-shirt and ensure the course is safely closed to traffic.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 5 km courses certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Start and finish at the ROSZARNIA Social Services Centre in Radwanice
Electronic timing and medical support on the course
additional: A technical event T-shirt can be purchased during registration for PLN 39.99. Cancellation and a refund are possible until 2.11.2026, subject to a PLN 25 administrative fee. Entries can be transferred to another runner until 15.11.2026 for a PLN 25 fee. The course is secured and closed to traffic. Electronic chip timing with results available online. A commemorative medal is awarded to everyone who completes their race. The program also includes children’s and youth races. Registration is online; payment by online payment or bank transfer is available. Participants receive electronic timing, medical support, and a commemorative medal.

name: X Jubileuszowy Bieg Tarnowski
description: The 10th Anniversary Tarnów Run – Forest Mayhem will take place on November 22, 2026, in Tarnów Opolski. The program includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as races for children and youth. This anniversary edition of a local running event invites participants of all ages to take part together.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Races for children and youth
Race held in Tarnów Opolski
additional: The event is scheduled for November 22, 2026.

name: sprawmy sobie ŁOMOT
location: Nadleśnictwo Łąck, ul. Lipowa 4, Łąck, Poland
description: Sprawmy sobie ŁOMOT is a cross-country trail race held in the Łąck Forest District, for runners who enjoy natural, forest surroundings. The course is over 21 kilometres long and challenging, with numerous elevation changes and difficult sections that will test participants’ endurance. The event is an amateur trail race promoting physical activity, hiking, and the region’s natural and recreational attractions. The start and finish are in Łąck, and the event is organised by the Rykowisko Foundation and the Łąck Forest District. name: I Bieg NIEUCHWYTNI – Bieg Charytatywny dla Fundacji Podkarpackie Hospicjum dla Dzieci
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Szlachta Biega, Klub Sportowy Ultra Sp. z.o.o. oraz MOSiR Łańcut.
description: What sets the Nieuchwytni Run apart from other events is its regionally unique “moving finish line” format. Participants do not run toward a designated point; instead, they try to stay ahead of the pursuit team for as long as possible. The runners will start at 10:00, and exactly 15 minutes later the “finish line” will set off along the course—a cyclist and a car equipped with professional timing equipment. The moment these vehicles overtake a runner marks the end of their race, and their result is recorded. The pursuit team will gradually increase its speed, from an initial 15 km/h to 35 km/h in the final stage of the race.

name: I BIEG JABŁONI
description:
1st Apple Blossom Run - Jabłonna Lacka | 5 km

We invite you to the 1st Apple Blossom Run, taking place on October 10, 2026, in Jabłonna Lacka. This is the first edition of an event that aims to bring together sporting competition, activities for the whole family, and local culture and tradition.

The main event will be a 5 km run, starting at 12:45. The course runs through the streets of Jabłonna Lacka and features varied surfaces, consisting mainly of paved roads and a section of unpaved road. The time limit is 45 minutes.

The Main Run is open to anyone who will be at least 16 years old on race day. The entry fee is PLN 40. The participant package includes a race bib with a chip for electronic timekeeping, a commemorative finisher’s medal, water, and a hot recovery meal.

The 5 km race will feature overall classifications for women and men, as well as age-group categories. There will also be a special classification for the fastest female and male residents of the Municipality of Jabłonna Lacka.

But the 1st Apple Blossom Run is about more than just 5 km. Free races for children and young people aged 4–15 will also take place from 10:15, over distances of approximately 150 m, 400 m, 600 m, and 1,100 m. Every child who completes their race will receive a finisher’s medal, and categories D2–D4 will feature electronic timekeeping and separate girls’ and boys’ classifications.

At the Race Village, sport will meet culture, with a Literary and Educational Zone accompanying the event.

name: II Bieg Transgranicznej Przyjaźni
description:
A 5-kilometre main race, a Nordic walking event over the same distance, and shorter races for children in the Young Athlete Zone. The event opens the Polish-Czech Grand Prix series, which concludes a month later in Ludgeřovice.

Course: moderately easy, with a new route this year

We have changed the route compared with the first edition. Four kilometres now run along Teligi and Czarnieckiego streets—on asphalt, with plenty of space and no tight turns. It’s a stretch where you can keep a steady pace from start to finish.

Only the final kilometre goes through post-mining areas. The surface gets uneven, but it’s just five minutes of running—and also the most interesting part of the course. You run through a part of Silesia that is coming back to life.

The total elevation gain is 18 metres, spread across the whole distance. There are no climbs that disrupt your rhythm. It’s a good course for your first-ever five kilometres, and a fair one for anyone looking to test their time—as long as you save some strength for the finish.
additional:
The event is part of the “Pink October” campaign and promotes breast cancer prevention. It is organised by the “Srebrne Nici” Association, with the Czech club BK Ludgeřovice as its partner.

name: XXV Bieg Sobiborski "Ocalić od zapomnienia - uczyć dla przyszłości"
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Włodawie
description: The start is at 12:00 by the Sobibór Museum and Memorial to the Victims, on county road No. 1727L along the Żłobek–Sobibór–Wołczyny section. After approximately 300 m, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa and run to provincial road 816. They then follow provincial road 816 towards Włodawa. After approximately 8.5 km, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa again and run through the village of Orchówek to Włodawa, continuing along Okunińska Street, Rynek Street and J. Piłsudski Avenue, with the finish at 4 Szkolna Street.
additional:
“There are places in our country marked especially by the blood of thousands of victims murdered in the cruellest way and in the name of the most despicable of ideologies—the ideology of hatred. One such place is Sobibór, where, in just over a dozen months (1942–1943), the Nazis managed to murder approximately a quarter of a million people, especially people of Jewish nationality.”

The race is an unusual history lesson for society. It contributes to achieving sporting goals and also helps instil in the younger generation a remembrance of the tragic history of the extermination camp in Sobibór.

name: Bieg Wolności Podatkowej
description:
When the tax authorities let up, the race begins! IFIRMA invites you to a special event celebrating Tax Freedom Day and the company’s 25th anniversary. It’s a race for entrepreneurs, IFIRMA customers, and everyone who values being active, independence, and good energy.

On June 13, participants can take on the 5 km or 10 km distance, either in person in Wrocław or virtually from anywhere in Poland. The main event will take place at the Olympic Stadium, and the route follows a scenic loop along the Oder. Flat and scenic—ideal running conditions in the City of a Hundred Bridges.

Every step has extra meaning here. Race participants support the “Na Ratunek Dzieciom z Chorobą Nowotworową” Foundation, showing that the energy of sport can make a real difference to others. It’s a great opportunity to combine physical activity with supporting an important cause.

Participants will also receive a generous race pack prepared by IFIRMA: the official race T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, a race bib, a reusable cup, a sports bag, and a certificate for a tree of their own in the IFIRMA forest in Oleśnica.

Join the 2026 Tax Freedom Run and celebrate freedom actively!
additional: The start and finish will be located by the Pergola at the Olympic Stadium, al. Jana Ignacego Paderewskiego 35, Wrocław.

name: XI ZaDyszka Gminy Bełchhatów
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Promocji Gminy Bełchatów
description:
We encourage all running enthusiasts to mark September 20 in their calendars. The eleventh edition of ZaDyszka Gminy Bełchatów will take place then. After a one-year break, the street charity race returns to Kurnos (last year, ZaDyszka was held in Postękalice). The race will follow the familiar loop through Kurnos Drugi and Kurnos Pierwszy, starting and finishing at the Alfons Brandt Primary School.

As usual, runners can choose between two distances: 10 km in the main race and 3.4 km, one lap of the course, in the recreational race. The youngest participants can take part in the Krasnal Race, while primary school pupils can run distances from 400 to 1,000 m.

As always, a race village will be set up on the school grounds, with a children’s play area and a place to enjoy a restorative meal.

Recreational race – 3.4 km (one lap)
